jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **New York, NY · Full\-time · Hybrid (in office 3 days a week) · $150,000 \- $275,000 \+ equity** **We’re deploying advanced agents into the real world to solve some of the biggest pain points in healthcare, and bringing the JOY back to healthcare by fixing the financial chaos behind it.** Every year, healthcare practices fail to collect an estimated $125 billion in earned revenue. The money disappears into fragmented financial data, manual workflows, and opaque payer systems that don’t talk to one another. Often, these costs are passed on to patients through higher bills or rising health costs, and for many practices the losses are fatal. Joyful Health builds AI agents that take on insurers so providers get paid for the care they deliver. We didn’t start with a product. We spent ten months working as fractional CFOs for a dozen practices, doing the work alongside providers before we wrote the technology that automates it. We just announced our $22M Series A, led by CRV, with world\-class investors including the founders of MongoDB and KAYAK. Now we’re doubling our engineering team. **ABOUT THE ROLE** ------------------ We’re looking for a talented and ambitious AI Engineer with 4\+ years of experience building production AI systems who’s excited to solve one of the toughest challenges in healthcare: automatically resolving claim denials. You’ll be the technical lead for our agentic AI platform that autonomously researches, understands, and resolves insurance claim denials, helping healthcare practices recover millions in lost revenue. Resolving denials requires deep expertise in medical billing, payer rules, and claim documentation. Today, billing managers spend hours manually researching each denial, gathering supporting documentation, and crafting appeals. We’re building an agentic AI system that automates this entire workflow, from denial classification and root cause analysis to evidence gathering and appeal letter generation. You’ll architect and build the intelligent agents that power this system. You’ll design multi\-agent workflows that collaborate to interpret complex denial reasons, retrieve relevant clinical and billing information through RAG systems, reason about payer policies, and generate compelling appeals. This is a greenfield opportunity to build a production agentic system that directly impacts the financial health of healthcare practices. You should be comfortable (and excited!) working in a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup environment where you’ll wear many hats and take on new challenges as they arise. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to work on something extremely challenging at the intersection of AI and healthcare. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** ------------------ * Design and build the architecture for our agentic AI system that autonomously resolves insurance claim denials. * Develop specialized AI agents for denial classification, root cause analysis, evidence retrieval, policy reasoning, and appeal generation. * Implement multi\-agent orchestration frameworks that coordinate complex workflows across research, decision\-making, and document generation. * Build and optimize RAG systems to retrieve relevant clinical documentation, billing records, and payer policy information. * Create evaluation frameworks and feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance and reliability. * Design prompt engineering strategies and fine\-tuning approaches to optimize LLM behavior for healthcare billing workflows. * Work closely with billing managers to understand denial resolution workflows and translate them into agent behaviors. * Collaborate with the engineering team on production infrastructure for deploying and monitoring AI agents at scale. * Actively contribute to building the team’s AI/ML vision and technical roadmap. * Collaborate on code reviews and technical design documents to ensure code quality and distribute knowledge. **WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF…** ---------------------------------- * **You’re passionate about Joyful Health’s mission.** You want to solve real, pressing problems for providers and put them in control of their businesses. You naturally empathize with users and enjoy building with their needs in mind. * **You have 4\+ years of experience in machine learning or AI engineering,** with a focus on building production AI systems and deploying models at scale. * **You have strong technical execution.** You view coding as a craft, not just a task, and you care about building a product that works at scale, with the user at the forefront. You’re proficient in: + Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) + LLM technologies, including prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and RAG systems + Vector databases and semantic search systems + Building reliable, production\-grade AI systems with proper evaluation and monitoring + MLOps practices, including model versioning, A/B testing, and performance tracking + Working with APIs and integrating AI systems into broader product workflows * **You have a radical sense of ownership.** You have the ability and desire to own technical roadmaps and refine ambiguous problems. * **You have a low ego and a growth mindset,** and you’re excited to shape our engineering team and culture as an early team member, leading by example and growing your impact as the product and team scale. * We care more about your drive, hustle, and passion than a college degree from a shiny institution or experience at name\-brand companies. **Bonus points** * You have experience working with healthcare data or an understanding of medical billing workflows. * You’ve been a founder or an early engineer at a startup. **WORKING AT JOYFUL** --------------------- **Meaningful impact.** You’ll work on one of the most hair\-on\-fire problems providers face, so they can focus on caring for patients. **Autonomy and ownership.** As an early team member, you’ll shape the company from the ground up. **Growth and learning.** You’ll get direct access to experienced founders and advisors, plus stipends for professional development courses and books. **Competitive compensation and equity.** $150K \- $275K base, plus strong equity in Joyful Health. **Be your best self.** Comprehensive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO (with a minimum of 10 days off a year), flexibility, and regular team off\-sites and events. Please apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. Nobody checks every box every time, and we’d love to talk with you about how you see yourself growing into this role. We’re also very open to candidates with non\-traditional experience. Joyful Health is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Understand with robotics, vision systems, and automated equipment. + Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and mechanical CAD drawings. * **Software Knowledge:** CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), Microsoft Office. C**ore Competencies** * Analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Attention to detail and accuracy in technical documentation. * Effective communication and teamwork in cross\-functional environments. * Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement. * Adaptability in a fast\-paced manufacturing setting. **Working Conditions and Physical Demands** * Work is primarily performed in a **manufacturing and assembly environment** involving exposure to machinery, moving mechanical parts, electrical systems, and occasional high noise levels. * May require work in **cleanroom or ESD\-controlled areas** and adherence to static control procedures. * **Physical Requirements:** + Frequent standing, walking, bending, stooping, crouching, and climbing ladders or platforms. + Regular lifting and carrying of objects up to **50 pounds**; occasional lifting of heavier components with mechanical assistance. + Manual dexterity and fine motor skills for handling tools and delicate mechanical parts. + Visual acuity to read mechanical drawings, detect equipment malfunctions, and inspect parts. + Ability to work in varying temperatures and occasionally confined spaces. * **Work Hours:** + May require **rotating shifts, weekend coverage, overtime, or on\-call availability** to support production uptime and critical repairs **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** * Equipment uptime and reliability metrics (MTBF / MTTR). * Preventive maintenance completion rate and schedule adherence. * Reduction in unplanned downtime or recurring failures. * Compliance with safety and EHS standards. * Quality of maintenance documentation and improvement initiatives supported.

With an expanded Line of insurance products and a growing ten\-state footprint in the western United States, CopperPoint embodies stability for policyholders in Alaska, Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Utah, and Washington. CopperPoint’s culture of compassion extends to the community through employee volunteerism, corporate matching, Board service, program sponsorships, and in\-kind contributions. ANSI/ISA S5\.1 P\&IDs; working knowledge of **UL508A** \& **NFPA 79**. * **Networks:** Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, CANopen, J1939\. * **Commissioning:** Startup/troubleshooting of automation systems; calm, customer‑facing guidance. * **Broader tech:** Databases; jobs.title: Full stack Developer - Exotic/Classic Car Prediction Markets
jobs.description: **About Bidfinite** Bidfinite is a fantasy auction game for car people. It’s a prediction market for enthusiasts who can accurately guess what collector cars will sell for on auction sites. It’s fantasy football for gearheads, DraftKings for people who own a torque wrench and have opinions about 996 headlights. It'll be better than both, because of you. Why are we building it? Because somewhere out there is a jamoke lobbing car value comments without consequence. Who will hold him accountable? With your help, he can put his money where his mouth is. We also publish a shitty YouTube show that reviews, predicts and ridicules the collector\-car auction world. Fact, none of your friends are subscribed. **About the role** Still reading? We're hiring a contract developer, or a fractional full\-stack dev to join us as a trusted partner, to take Bidfinite from test mode through two launches: a public free\-play launch, then a launch with paid contests. The work is across three build phases. You choose how you're paid, from all cash to a mix of cash and equity that vests when each launch ships. We have had a POC running, tested it with car clubs and friends, but it was done on a tactical foundation. It was uglier than a 1 gen Honda Ridgeline, but it helped us improve game play. **What you'll build** You'll work directly with the founders to turn a working test\-mode game into a product ready for thousands of players hungry to put their useful and useless car knowledge to the test. Working from a Figma board and our working POC, you'll own features end to end, from design notes through shipped code, and help us make practical calls on architecture and tooling. **What we're looking for** * You've shipped at least one web app or game with real users and live, time\-sensitive data. * You've built secure sites with cash payments, ledgers, etc. * You're a beast in modern full\-stack web development: a front\-end framework, an API layer, and a relational database. Note: We have a solid front\-end dev, so if you're a car enthusiast with back\-end chops, reach out anyway. * You've built features that depend on outside data sources, such as scraped or third\-party listing data, and kept them reliable. * You've built real\-time or near\-real\-time features: countdowns, live updates, scoring, and leaderboards. * You work well in a small team: you scope, estimate, and flag risks early. * You can deal with two lifelong friends who sling slander and sarcasm, but it (probably) won't be aimed at you. Nice to have: payments integration, fantasy sports or contest platforms, and a soft spot for collector cars. Bonus points if you've ever yelled at a Bring a Trailer listing! **Engagement and pay** This is a contract role. We'd love to have someone in the tri\-state or Boston area \-\- founders are based in NY and Boston. You can work remotely, but we will have to meet in person in NY, CT or among the Massholes. Flexible on cash v. equity, but this is a boot\-strapped endeavor. Final hours, equity, and IP terms will be set out in a written agreement. **How to apply** You made it this far? Then you should email paul@bidfinite.com with the subject "Bidfinite contract developer" and include: * Links to one or two apps or games you shipped, and what you built on each * The pay option you'd lean toward, or questions about the options * Your availability and start date * 3 cars you hate, 3 cars you’ll buy when we all strike it rich We'll reply within 24 hours. Shortlisted applicants will have a quick call with the founders and, ideally, an IRL meetup. We do not discriminate on race or sex, but we’re douchey about car preferences. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of professional hands\-on software development experience, with back\-end work in Python and front\-end work in React.js * Bachelor's degree * Familiarity with development in the AWS cloud and with services including Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda * Skill in applying data modeling, design patterns, and object\-oriented design to turn a defined specification into tested code that works, then owning that code through production * A background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle * A background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB * Sound analytical judgment, applied through strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills * A history of Agile delivery, whether Scrum, Kanban, or similar, with work tracked in Jira or a comparable tool * The ability to communicate exceptionally well, collaborate directly with non\-technical stakeholders at the client, and translate requirements from the business into technical solutions * Reliable estimates for the tasks assigned to you and the effort they take * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Familiarity with the practices used in DevSecOps and with CI/CD pipelines * Hands\-on experience delivering production workloads in AWS, or certification in Python or AWS * Experience providing consulting services while interacting with clients * Prior work in information technology for the federal government * Familiarity with tools that use AI to help developers **Who you are** You care about your work and assess it by how well it serves those who depend on it. You adapt when priorities change and develop enough depth in new tools or domains to make your own judgments instead of relying on instructions. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Hands\-on fluency in modern cloud development, with the breadth to improve a system already in place or to create something new. * Delivery habits that cover secure coding, accessibility, code review, unit and integration testing, and version control. * Plain, clear communication with everyone who relies on your work, and an ear for what they actually need. * A meticulous streak wherever accuracy and auditability cannot be compromised. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $150,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Product Engineering (Enterprise)
jobs.description: **Build the execution layer for the agent era.** ================================================ Runta builds runtime infrastructure for long\-running AI agents: efficient execution, enforceable access controls, and complete execution records. We’re a small, well\-funded team based in the San Francisco Bay Area and Singapore. High talent density. High ownership. **About Runta** --------------- Runta builds runtime infrastructure that lets AI agents execute reliably over long time horizons: run agents efficiently, govern what they can reach, and record what they did. Workloads that run for hours or days break the assumptions web infrastructure is built on. An agent can fan out fifty sub\-tasks in a second and then go idle for ten minutes, must survive instance recycling mid\-run, and needs to snapshot, resume, and branch its execution state the way developers branch code. We’re building the substrate that makes this possible. We’re a small, well\-funded team, moving fast. **The Role** ------------ Our runtime team builds the engine. You make it work inside real companies. You own Runta's relationship with our design\-partner and enterprise accounts from the engineering side. You sit with the customer's agent and infra teams, figure out what they actually need, decide which requests are worth building, and ship it. You act as your own PM, and what you learn shapes what the runtime team builds next. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Work directly with customer engineering teams to get their agents running on Runta in production. * Judge which customer requests are reasonable and turn the right ones into product, not one\-off hacks. * Build what accounts need to adopt Runta and stay: integrations, storage and signal interfaces, secrets and access controls, audit and compliance surfaces. * Debug production issues across the customer's stack and ours. * Help shape a repeatable process from first technical call to production rollout. * Bring the customer's view back into the team and push for it. **The Problems You'd Be Solving** --------------------------------- * A customer wants every agent to reach their internal Vault. Is that a feature, an integration, or a sign we've got the product wrong? * An agent fails in the customer's environment but not in ours. Where do you look first? * Five accounts ask for five different things. Which one becomes a product? **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * You've built internal infra or platform products for engineering teams at a mid\-size or large company, or you were a founding engineer who did that work. * Deep infra understanding: containers, scheduling, networking, identity and access, observability. * You can talk to a customer's staff engineer as a peer and say no when a request doesn't make sense. * You've been the buyer. You've run an internal platform, or built an AI app or infra company that didn't make it, and you know why tools get adopted or dropped. * You write clearly and act as your own PM. * You build with AI agents and understand what breaks when they run for hours. **Nice to have:** forward\-deployed or solutions engineering at a devtools or infra company, experience with enterprise security reviews. **This Role Is Probably Not for You If** ---------------------------------------- * You want to stay heads\-down and never talk to customers. * You'd rather take requests than push back on them. * Your experience is mostly end\-user web or mobile apps. **How We Work** --------------- Small team, high trust, high ownership. We value people who are hungry, humble, and sharp. We look for clear communicators who hold strong opinions loosely and use AI\-native workflows in their daily engineering. You’ll work directly with the founder, alongside the core runtime and isolation teams. Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Kernel Performance & Automation
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for a founding engineer to own kernel\-level performance across our inference stack. You will identify bottlenecks, write and fuse GPU kernels, use agents to automate kernel optimization, and carry improvements through to production. This is a deeply hands\-on role with wide ownership. You will define projects from first principles, work across the hardware–software boundary, and pursue the performance gains that matter most, whether on conventional GPUs or emerging custom accelerators. There is no management layer between you and the work: you will set the direction and ship it. **About you** ------------- * You work close to the metal and reason deeply about performance and system design * You work fluidly across the hardware\-software boundary, and optimize as readily for traditional GPUs as for custom accelerators * You are drawn to the risk and upside of an early\-stage startup * You embrace ambiguity and have a strong bias for action * You operate with a tech\-lead mentality regardless of title or years of experience * You treat AI as a force multiplier: fluent with coding agents and modern AI/ML workflows, you fold them into how you ship, and you are willing to push the boundary of what’s possible with agents **Requirements** ---------------- * Deep expertise in GPU and hardware performance optimization * Hands\-on experience with low\-level GPU kernel programming using CUDA, Triton, or PTX * Experience optimizing inference through kernel fusion, quantization, speculative decoding, or sparsity * Proficiency with profiling and tracing tools, including Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute (nsys, ncu) * Working knowledge of modern LLM and multimodal model architectures * Experience optimizing kernels and communication for LLMs on modern GPU systems like B300 and GB300 NVL72 **Bonus** --------- * Familiarity with custom accelerators and non\-CUDA backends * Experience with GPU kernel libraries such as CUTLASS, cuBLAS, NCCL, CuTe DSL, and others * Familiarity with kernel\-optimization agents and orchestration tools, such as KDA, AKO, Humanize, and agent frameworks for coordinating evaluation, iteration, and deployment **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Highly competitive salary and equity * Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents * Strong 401(k) match * Meals and snacks on us \+ discretionary productivity budget *Strong preference for in\-person in Palo Alto or Brooklyn.* **About Inco** ============== Inco AI (inco.ai) builds the agent\-native inference platform for tomorrow's token economics. We build the inference layer that makes advanced AI fast enough for real workflows and affordable enough to use at scale. Agents are at the center of our work: when a single task chains dozens of model and tool calls, every gain in speed, cost, and reliability compounds. We’re the researchers and engineers behind AWQ, DFlash, and TensorRT\-LLM, with decades of combined leadership in AI efficiency and prior successful exits. Our team connects frontier research with the engineering needed to bring fast, reliable inference to production at scale. We operate on five principles: * **Operate at the frontier.** The field moves every day, and so do we. We reinvent ourselves constantly and push the frontier forward with our research. We keep process light and decisions fast, so a good idea reaches production in days, not quarters. Legacy doesn’t slow us down. * **Mission over individuals.** We are obsessed with our customers and humble in pursuit of the goal. We share credit, name mistakes early, and change our minds when the evidence says so. The question is always what moves the mission forward, never who was right. * **Amplify with agents.** Code is free now; architecture and process aren’t. We hand agents everything they can own, from code to operations, and spend our own time on design, judgment, and the problems only people can solve. * **Protect the maker’s time.** Focus is our scarcest resource. We keep meetings few and protect long, uninterrupted stretches of work. We automate overhead, cover meals, and handle logistics, so our hours go to research and product. * **Be a team player.** We win as one team. We share context generously, step in wherever we’re needed, and hold each other to a high bar, because exceptional work comes from exceptional peers. Compensation Range: $200K \- $350K

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python, React)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will take cloud\-native Python services from refinement through production on Amazon Web Services (AWS), retaining ownership of each service's design and delivery throughout. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Expect your first project to make you the one who decides how a solution's components fit together, and the one who carries it through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * For your portion of the platform, design Python services and application components and carry them through delivery. * Produce the design of the React.js front end where users do their work, and define the standards other developers follow when they build it. * Determine how your services connect to the wider platform by designing their data flows, integrations, and application programming interfaces (APIs). * Use Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), and AWS Lambda to create automated workflows. * Make application security standards, code reviews, and test\-driven development part of the quality development practices you lead. * Create and improve your team's automated tests, the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines it uses for releases, and the practices it uses to support production. * Mentor fellow developers, conduct code reviews, work through difficult production problems, and settle design tradeoffs. * Estimate projects accurately, and play a part in planning them, forecasting delivery, and allocating resources. * Make implementation and review faster with AI\-assisted development tools, and remain responsible for the code you ship. You deliver a unified solution in which the components work together and meet the same quality standard. You automate spreadsheet\-based validations and workflows, and the developers around you improve because of how you work. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 7\+ years of professional hands\-on back\-end software development experience in Python * 5\+ years of hands\-on front\-end software development experience in React.js * Bachelor's degree * A strong practical background developing cloud\-native applications on AWS with Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda * An advanced understanding that spans database design, data modeling, object\-oriented programming, design patterns, distributed systems, and software architecture * A strong background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle * A strong background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB * Strength in analysis, troubleshooting, and solving problems * A background directing Agile delivery in Scrum or Kanban, with the work tracked in Jira or a similar issue tracker * An established record of directing a team of developers and mentoring them * Direct, practical use of AI\-assisted developer tools, for example GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer * Excellent communication skills that let you engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leaders * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * A background in putting CI/CD pipelines in place and following DevSecOps best practices * Certification in either Python or AWS * Prior work in information technology for the federal government * Experience heading technical delivery teams on consulting engagements involving direct client interaction **Who you are** You are accountable for what you build and invest time in helping fellow developers improve through code reviews, explanations of your reasoning, and the standard you establish. Others turn to you for difficult decisions because your judgment is sound, and you maintain a steady, productive team as priorities change. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Deep expertise in modern cloud development, broad enough to enhance systems that are already running or to create something new. * Judgment to compare competing solutions, resolve design tradeoffs between components, and take ownership of technical direction in the area assigned to you. * Strong delivery discipline covering accessibility, secure coding, code review, automated testing, and version control, with the standing to establish these practices for a team. * The ability to explain your work in plain terms to those who depend on it, and to listen carefully for their needs. * Uncompromising rigor whenever accuracy and auditability are on the line. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.description: **Software Engineer** Location: Remote Level: Mid\-level (3\+ years) **Company Summary** NourishedRx is the first operating system for Food is Health, providing a comprehensive platform that enables partners—including non\-profits, counties, and states—to operationalize and scale their own clinically integrated nutrition programs. Founded in 2019, we are a high\-growth digital health company built on the conviction that diet\-related disease – the single largest influenceable category of healthcare spending – is best solved by treating diet as a root cause rather than a downstream symptom. We provide the interoperable infrastructure that turns nutrition from a fragmented, manual effort into scalable healthcare infrastructure. By serving as the underlying operating system, we empower health plans and government entities to design, launch, and measure clinically integrated nutrition programs with a focus on outcomes\-based reimbursement to drive meaningful health improvements. Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through food. **The Role** NourishedRx is seeking a Software Engineer who already works the way modern engineering teams now work: with AI coding agents doing much of the typing, and the engineer doing the thinking. You will build across our TypeScript platform — member, clinician, and partner experiences, the services behind them, and the integrations and data that make outcomes\-based reimbursement possible. Here, being a software engineer means owning the problem, not just the code. You decide what should be built and how, write the plan and the guardrails, direct tools like Claude Code and Cursor to do the implementation, and then prove the result is correct before it ships. In healthcare, “the agent wrote it” is never an excuse: you are accountable for every line that reaches production, and for the members and clinicians who depend on it. You will work closely with Product, Clinical, and Operations, including on our new ACCESS product for Medicare beneficiaries, and help shape how our team builds with agents as the tools keep changing. **Responsibilities** Building with Agents * Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) as your primary way of building: plan the change, direct the agent, and steer it when it goes wrong. * Write the clear specs, acceptance criteria, and constraints that let agents produce correct work the first time — and recognize when a task is faster or safer to do by hand. * Review agent\-written code as carefully as a teammate’s: check the logic, edge cases, security, and whether it fits the codebase, not just whether it runs. * Keep our codebase easy for both people and agents to work in: clear structure, good project instructions and context files, and tests that tell an agent when it is wrong. * Share what works. Help evolve the team’s practices, prompts, and tooling as agentic tools improve. Product \& Platform Engineering * Own features end to end across our TypeScript/Node services and React web apps, from understanding the need through release and follow\-up. * Build and maintain integrations with health plans, partners, and clinical data sources, and the data pipelines behind outcomes and performance reporting. * Contribute to ACCESS, our AI\-enabled offering for Medicare beneficiaries, including the agentic guide that helps members reach clinical goals. * Work directly with Product, Clinical, and Operations to turn real workflows into simple, reliable software — including human\-in\-the\-loop steps where judgment matters. * Ship small changes often, watch how they behave in production, and fix what you find. **Quality, Safety \& Reliability** * Verify before you ship: automated tests, running the real app, and checking results against what was asked — not just trusting a green build or an agent’s summary. * Protect member data. Apply HIPAA\-aware practices in everything you build, and never let sensitive data reach tools or services that shouldn’t have it. * Build guardrails, logging, and escalation paths into AI\-enabled features so that failures are caught and handled safely. **Qualifications** Required * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production web applications. * Hands\-on, daily experience building with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc... not just autocomplete. You can describe how you plan work for an agent, how you review its output, and a time it confidently got something wrong and how you caught it. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills, and experience building React front ends. * Experience with relational databases (such as Postgres), APIs, and integrating with third\-party systems. * Experience deploying and running services in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or similar). * Solid fundamentals that let you judge code you didn’t type: data modeling, debugging, testing, security, and performance. * A habit of verifying your work — you test the real behavior, not just the happy path. * Clear written communication. Much of the job is writing precise plans, specs, and reviews for both people and agents. * Comfort with ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, ask the right questions, and turn it into working software. **Preferred** * Experience in healthcare, digital health, or another regulated industry, including working with HIPAA or similar data\-protection requirements. * Familiarity with healthcare data and interoperability (FHIR, HL7, EHR integrations, eligibility or claims data). * Experience building with LLM APIs, AI agents, or conversational products, including evaluation and guardrails. * Experience with data pipelines, analytics, or outcomes and performance reporting. * Experience setting up team\-level practices for AI\-assisted development (project context files, custom commands, review workflows, CI checks). * Experience at a startup or growth\-stage company. * Side projects or open\-source work built with agentic tools that you can walk us through. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage. * Access to the agentic coding tools you need to do your best work. * The chance to build a new AI\-enabled, outcomes\-based product for Medicare beneficiaries from early stages through launch and scale. * A collaborative environment in which you can learn, grow, and contribute meaningfully to the success of a dynamic and innovative organization.

jobs.description: POSITION: Software Engineer, Applied AI DIRECT REPORT: Sr. Director, AI and Architecture COMPENSATION: Pursuant to state regulations, the salary range is $120,800\-$133,300 plus bonus potential. Eligible to participate in the company benefits plan (https://cardinalgroup.com/wp\-content/uploads/2025\-Benefits\-Guid\-Eng\_SPA.pdf). We offer health, vision, dental, and pet insurance. We offer a 401(k) retirement plan, student loan assistance, licensing and continuing education reimbursement, parental leave, and housing allowances or gifts. SUMMARY The Software Engineer, Applied AI is responsible for designing, building, and supporting production software and AI solutions that solve business problems across Cardinal. Working across the full software development lifecycle, this role owns solutions end\-to\-end, including web applications, APIs, integrations, and AI agents. The engineer works AI\-natively, using agentic development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as everyday collaborators, while bringing the engineering mindset and computer science fundamentals needed to direct, review, and verify AI\-generated work so that what ships is secure, tested, and maintainable. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role moves quickly from prototype to production, partners with senior engineers on architecture, and helps raise the technical bar across the team. RESPONSIBILITIES (Including but not limited to) * Translate business requirements into well\-designed technical solutions, including web applications, APIs, integrations, automated workflows, and AI agents, and own their delivery end\-to\-end, from rapid prototypes that validate ideas with stakeholders to hardened production releases. * Build backend services and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI, and front\-end applications using TypeScript and Angular. * Use agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of the daily workflow, from planning and specification through implementation, testing, and documentation, including delegating well\-scoped tasks to coding agents and rigorously reviewing the results. * Build and maintain the team's shared AI development assets, such as agent instruction files, reusable skills and commands, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, to make AI\-assisted development faster and more consistent. * Design, build, and operate AI agents and LLM\-powered features using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or LangGraph, applying tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, and multi\-agent patterns where appropriate. * Bring the same rigor to AI features that the team applies to conventional software: build evaluation datasets and automated evals, instrument tracing and monitoring, and track quality, cost, and latency in production. * Write and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including automated quality gates and AI\-assisted code review. * Deploy and operate solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, and Vertex AI, using containers and infrastructure\-as\-code where appropriate, and participate in production support, including troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and reliability improvements. * Design data models and build integrations with internal and third\-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven messaging, ensuring reliable data flows. * Apply secure\-by\-design practices, including authentication and authorization, secrets management, least\-privilege access for agents and their tools, protection of resident and team member data, and mitigation of AI\-specific risks such as prompt injection. * Contribute to architecture and technical design discussions alongside senior engineers, documenting decisions and trade\-offs. * Perform thorough code reviews of both human\- and AI\-authored code, contribute to team coding standards, and help mentor associate team members. * Collaborate directly with business stakeholders and cross\-functional partners, including data engineering, to clarify requirements, demo working software early, and communicate technical decisions in accessible terms. * Participate in sprint ceremonies, provide estimates, and surface technical risks and dependencies early. * Evaluate new AI models, tools, and frameworks through small proofs of concept, and assess platform, framework, and model updates (including model deprecations) for impact on existing solutions. * Support Cardinal OKRs as needed. * Participate in Cardinal U training as required. QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Three (3\) to five (5\) years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and supporting applications in production. * Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) and software design skills (API design, data modeling, design patterns), with the judgment to recognize when AI\-generated code falls short. * Proficiency in Python and TypeScript, with experience building RESTful APIs (FastAPI preferred) and front\-end applications with a modern framework (Angular preferred). * Demonstrated daily use of agentic AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including the ability to plan, direct, and verify AI\-generated work. * Experience building and shipping LLM\-powered applications or AI agents, including tool calling, RAG, and prompt and context engineering, using Google ADK, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. * Experience with automated testing, Git\-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred). * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating applications on a major cloud platform (GCP preferred), including containers (Docker) and serverless services. * Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred); experience with BigQuery or another analytical data platform is a plus. * Working knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2\.0/OpenID Connect, secrets management, the OWASP Top 10, and LLM\-specific risks such as prompt injection. * Familiarity with MCP, LLM evaluation and observability practices, and the capability, cost, and latency trade\-offs across major model families (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI) is preferred. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), event\-driven architectures, C\#/.NET, Azure, or property management platforms such as Entrata is a plus. * Ability to work independently through ambiguity, break problems into deliverable increments, and know when to pull in senior team members. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * A continuous\-learning mindset and genuine curiosity about the rapidly evolving AI landscape. * Champion the Cardinal Culture and Cardinal Core Values every day. WORK ENVIRONMENT The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Incumbents work in an office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. PHYSICAL DEMANDS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description: **This Isn’t Your Typical Engineering Job** Imagine this: you’re backstage at the NFL Super Bowl, making sure a physical AI agent is ready to go live in front of millions—and NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell walks by to check it out. A few weeks later, you’re at San Jose International Airport deploying AI alongside City Mayor Matt Mahan. Then you’re at NVIDIA GTC, the world’s biggest AI conference, and you bump into Jensen Huang himself. ***That’s not a hypothetical. That’s what our team actually did.*** At LiveX AI, we build physical AI agents—intelligent, embodied systems that interact with people in the real world. Not chatbots on a screen. Real AI that lives in airports, stadiums, conference halls, and beyond. We’re looking for a bold, driven Solution Engineer to join our core team full\-time and help us deploy these systems on the world stage. **About LiveX AI** LiveX AI is a fast\-growing startup headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, building the next generation of physical AI agents. Our technology combines advanced large language models, multimodal AI, and purpose\-built hardware to create AI experiences that people interact with face\-to\-face. We’re backed by leading investors and trusted by enterprises, cities, and major event organizers worldwide. **What You’ll Do** You’ll be embedded in our core deployment team—the people who take our AI from the lab to the real world. Here’s what the role looks like: * **Ship Physical AI Agents:** Build, test, and deploy AI\-powered hardware systems to real venues—airports, stadiums, conference centers, retail spaces. You’ll own deployments end to end and see your work in action, not just in a staging environment. * **Get Your Hands Dirty with Hardware:** Set up screens, sensors, networking gear, and edge compute devices. Debug on\-site. Make AI work in the physical world where Wi\-Fi drops, power flickers, and thousands of people walk by. * **Write Real Code:** Build software that powers our AI agents—Python, TypeScript, APIs, integrations. Contribute to the same codebase the rest of engineering works in. Your commits go to production. * **Work the World’s Biggest Stages:** Lead and support deployments at marquee events and high\-profile locations. Previous team deployments include the NFL Super Bowl, San Jose Airport, and NVIDIA GTC. You could be next. * **Talk to Real Humans:** Present demos to customers, partners, and VIPs. Explain how our AI works to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Your communication skills matter as much as your code. * **Shape the Product:** Feed real\-world observations back to engineering and product. When you notice something in the field, your input directly influences what we build next. **Where Our Team Has Been** **NFL Super Bowl** Physical AI agent deployed at the biggest sporting event in America. Commissioner Roger Goodell experienced the demo firsthand. **San Jose International Airport** AI agent deployed in a live airport environment, unveiled alongside San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan. **NVIDIA GTC** Live deployment at the world’s premier AI conference. Our team had an encounter with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang. **How We Evaluate Candidates** We hire for the traits that make someone thrive in fast\-moving, high\-stakes deployments. Every candidate is evaluated on four things: * **Responsibility \& Dedication.** You take full ownership of your work and follow through. When a deployment is on the line, you do whatever it takes to get it right—and you can be counted on. * **Speed of Learning.** Our stack, our hardware, and our customers change fast. You pick up new tools, technologies, and contexts quickly and turn them into results without hand\-holding. * **Multi\-Tasking Capability.** You juggle code, hardware, customers, and live events at once—often in the same day—and keep all of them moving without dropping the ball. * **Communication Skills.** You explain technical concepts clearly to anyone—a mayor, a CEO, a teammate, or a curious bystander—and you keep the team aligned under pressure. **Who You Are** * Ideally, you’ve delivered enterprise software at a startup, or run enterprise projects at a consulting firm—you know how to ship for demanding customers and manage delivery end to end. * You code. Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or both. You’ve built and shipped things that went beyond the spec. * You’re genuinely excited about AI—not just the hype, but how LLMs, computer vision, and multimodal models actually work under the hood. * Hardware doesn’t scare you (or it does, but you want to learn anyway). You’re willing to carry a monitor, run cables, and troubleshoot on\-site. * You communicate clearly—to a mayor, a CEO, or a curious bystander at a trade show. * You thrive in chaos. Startups are messy. Deployments have surprises. You stay calm, figure it out, and keep going. * You’re a team player who brings energy, not ego. **Bonus Points** * Experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), prompt engineering, or RAG pipelines. * Familiarity with edge computing, IoT, AV systems, or robotics. * Prior startup or hackathon experience where you shipped something under pressure. * Background in CS, EE, information systems, or a related technical field. **Why You’ll Love This** * **World\-Stage Experiences:** Your LinkedIn won’t say “updated Jira tickets.” It’ll say “deployed AI at the Super Bowl.” * **Full\-Stack, Full\-Real:** AI \+ software \+ hardware \+ customer\-facing—you’ll build a skill set most engineers don’t reach until years into their careers. * **Silicon Valley, Front Row:** You’ll work at the center of the physical AI movement, with the connections and momentum that come with it. * **Mentorship That Matters:** You’ll work directly with founders and senior engineers who want to see you grow—not hand you busywork. * **Real Ownership \& Growth:** Top performers take on more scope fast—leading deployments, owning customers, and shaping the product.

jobs.title: Sr. Systems Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Senior Systems Engineer serves as the senior escalation point for infrastructure, identity, and platform issues raised by the Service Desk, Desktop Support, and Implementation teams, and is accountable for driving those issues to root cause. The role also owns design work: translating requirements into build documents, configuration standards, and reference patterns that other engineers execute. Identity, Cloud \& Microsoft 365 * Administer and engineer Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, conditional access, and privileged access configurations. * Design and maintain Azure infrastructure, including subscriptions, networking, compute, storage, and governance controls. * Engineer and maintain Microsoft 365 workloads, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, and Purview. * Maintain tenant separation, delegation models, and administrative boundaries appropriate to a multi\-client environment. Resilience, Security \& Compliance * Design, implement, and test backup, replication, and disaster recovery for critical systems against documented recovery objectives. * Harden systems against established benchmarks, and remediate vulnerabilities and configuration drift on a defined cadence. * Implement and maintain patching, monitoring, alerting, and logging across supported infrastructure. * Support HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC 2 evidence requirements by producing accurate technical documentation and control artifacts. * Participate in incident response for infrastructure and security events, including root cause analysis and corrective action. Escalation \& Operational Support * Serve as the senior escalation point for infrastructure, identity, and platform issues raised by the Service Desk, Desktop Support, and Implementation teams. * Perform advanced troubleshooting on complex, multi\-system problems, and drive them to root cause rather than restoring service and moving on. * Execute changes through the defined change management process, including risk assessment, testing, rollback planning, and post\-change validation. * Support major incidents outside business hours as part of an on\-call rotation. Automation, Documentation \& Standardization * Automate repetitive administrative and deployment work using PowerShell and infrastructure\-as\-code tooling. * Build and maintain runbooks, build documents, as\-built records, and infrastructure diagrams. * Reduce manual effort and configuration variance across client environments through standardization and tooling. Technical Leadership \& Collaboration * Provide technical direction and mentorship to engineers, implementation staff, and support teams, and review their designs and proposed changes with substantive feedback. * Partner with the Implementation Engineer, IT Manager, Security, and Applications functions on work that crosses team boundaries. * Support client\-facing technical discussions when senior infrastructure expertise is required. **EDUCATION** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience will be considered. * Industry certifications preferred, including Microsoft Azure or Microsoft 365 certifications, VMware or Hyper\-V credentials, and ITIL Foundation. **EXPERIENCE** * Seven or more years of progressive experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or enterprise IT operations. * Deep hands\-on experience with Windows Server administration, configuration, and troubleshooting. * Deep hands\-on experience with virtualization, including VMware or Hyper\-V. * Production experience with Azure infrastructure and Microsoft 365 administration at scale. * Experience designing and testing backup and disaster recovery for production systems. * Experience operating within formal change management and serving as a senior escalation point. * Experience in a managed services or multi\-client environment preferred. Healthcare IT experience strongly preferred. **REQUIREMENTS** * Must reside within a HOPCo corporate or clinical market. * Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation and to work after\-hours and weekend maintenance windows. * Ability to document work to a standard that other engineers and auditors can rely on. * Position is based in the United States and supports United States operations. Legal authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship is required. **KNOWLEDGE** * Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, and identity and access management. * Virtualization, storage, and backup and recovery technologies. * Azure infrastructure and governance, and Microsoft 365 workload administration. * Networking fundamentals sufficient to troubleshoot across the systems and network boundary, including routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and firewalls. * Security fundamentals, hardening benchmarks, vulnerability management, and patching practice. * Scripting and automation, including PowerShell, and infrastructure\-as\-code concepts. * IT service management practice covering incident, problem, and change management, and the technical control expectations of HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC 2\. SKILLS * Strong analytical and diagnostic skills across complex, multi\-system problems. * Strong design and documentation skills, including build documents, diagrams, and runbooks. * Strong scripting and automation skills. * Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong organizational skills across concurrent engineering and escalation work. **ABILITIES** * Ability to drive problems to root cause rather than restoring service and moving on. * Ability to make and defend design decisions, and to change position when the evidence warrants. * Ability to mentor and influence engineers without direct authority. * Ability to work carefully in production environments where downtime affects patient care. * Ability to learn unfamiliar client environments quickly and work within their constraints. **ENVIRONMENTAL WORKING CONDITIONS** * Normal office or remote environment, with occasional work in data centers and network closets * Limited regional and national travel required * Requires after\-hours and weekend work during maintenance windows and major incidents **PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS** * Requires sitting and standing associated with a normal office environment. * Manual dexterity using a calculator and computer keyboard. * Requires occasional lifting and positioning of server and network equipment, and work in server rooms and network closets. **ORGANIZATIONAL REQUIREMENTS** * HOPCo Mission, Vision and Values must be acknowledged and adhered to * Must complete all required annual training for HOPCo This description is intended to provide only basic guidelines for meeting job requirements. Responsibilities, knowledge, skills, abilities and working conditions may change as needs evolve. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Bay Area **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering **Staff/Principal Fullstack Software Engineer** =============================================== Location: Mountain View, CA \| Hybrid, 2 days/week in office **About Us:** ------------- WitnessAI is the unified AI security and governance platform enterprises trust to govern and protect all AI activity. We provide complete, network\-level visibility into every interaction including employees and autonomous agents, even in native apps where legacy tools are blind. Unlike security that relies on outdated keywords, our platform understands intent, enabling intelligent policies that stop novel threats like prompt injection while empowering productivity. WitnessAI transforms security from a bottleneck into the enabler of your AI strategy as the confidence layer for enterprise AI. **The Role** ------------ This is a Staff/Principal role with org\-wide scope. You’ll work hand in hand with the Head of Product Engineering on technical strategy and help grow the engineers around you. That work centers on our web platform, which customers rely on to see, control, and secure AI activity across their company. You’ll shape its architecture end to end, from the React UI to the Go/Rust services and data stores behind it. This is an individual contributor role, and you’ll be in good company: nobody here has stopped coding. We all ship code every day alongside our AI Agents, which feels fitting to a team whose job is keeping AI in check. You’ll lead technical work across the stack, from the UI to the ingress pipeline and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentoring, and the example you set in your own code. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Architecture.** Design and own the end\-to\-end architecture of the product application: frontend, APIs, services, and data model. Write ADRs for the big decisions and see them through to production. * **Build across the stack.** Ship features in full\-stack TypeScript (React Router), Rust and Go services. Take a feature from a rough idea to a running release. * **API and data design.** Define API contracts and schemas that stay stable as the platform and customer base grow. Own multi\-tenant concerns like isolation, performance, and migrations. * **Performance and reliability.** Find and fix bottlenecks in page load, query time, and service latency. Set standards for testing, observability, and release safety. * **Make complex data usable.** Work with product and design to turn dense security and policy data into dashboards and workflows that a busy admin can understand in seconds. * **Technical leadership.** Lead design reviews, review code across teams, and mentor senior and mid\-level engineers. Settle technical disagreements with clear reasoning. * **Cross\-team work.** Partner with product, design, platform, and security engineers to plan and deliver work that spans teams. Break large projects into pieces others can pick up. * **Hands\-on AI work.** Be an advocate for building an AI native SDLC and PDLC with associated tooling. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 10\+ years building production web applications, with at least 3 years in a senior, staff, or principal technical leadership role. * Deep experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Experience with React Router or Remix, or another server\-rendered full\-stack framework. * Strong backend skills. Production experience with Go or a comparable language, and with building services and REST or GraphQL APIs. * Solid SQL and data modeling skills. Experience designing for multi\-tenant SaaS. * Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, and of CI/CD pipelines. * Demonstrated mastery in architecture design, enterprise scalability, and cross\-domain tech stacks. **What Will Make You a Stellar Candidate** ------------------------------------------ * **You have owned a platform, not just features.** You can point to a system you designed, ran in production, and lived with for years, including the parts you would change. * **You are equally good at the UI and the service behind it.** You care about what a user sees and about what happens to the request after they click. * **You have built for enterprise customers.** You know what role\-based access, audit logs, and tenant isolation require, and you plan for them early. * **You write things down.** Your design docs and ADRs are clear enough that someone new can follow the reasoning a year later. * **You have shipped with LLM APIs or AI\-assisted tooling.** You have a view on where it helps and where it does not. * **You have worked in a startup.** You are comfortable with unclear scope and changing priorities, and you pick a direction and move. **Why This Role** ----------------- * You set the technical direction for the product application at a company growing fast in AI security. * Enterprise customers use what you build to govern real AI activity, so the work matters from day one. * You work directly with product, design, and the CEO's leadership team, with few layers between you and the decision. * The problems are new. jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Appl****y here:** https://10fed\-careers.vercel.app/ **About 10 Federal Storage** ---------------------------- 10 Federal Storage is a commercial real estate and self\-storage company and the nation's leading high\-tech self\-storage operator. With a portfolio of 130\+ properties across 17 states and millions of rentable square feet, we specialize in fully automated facilities that redefine the storage experience. We use advanced technology, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making to streamline operations, make storage more convenient for customers, and maximize returns for investors. **Position Summary** -------------------- The Systems Software Engineer builds the technology that runs 10 Federal. This is a hands\-on engineering seat, not a people\-manager role: you design, build, and own production systems across the company and report directly to the Chief AI Officer. Title at offer (Senior, Staff, Principal, or Director) is set to the candidate based on proven work. Most self\-storage operators bolt together third\-party tools that don't talk to each other. 10 Federal builds in\-house instead, and every system is modular: a self\-contained piece with a clean interface that can be swapped, extended, or reused without breaking what's connected to it. At the center is the Unified Data Platform (UDP), the company's single source of truth, which every system feeds and every new product is built on. The role spans Technology, Construction, Marketing, Operations, Accounting, and any team with a process worth automating, plus outward\-facing products such as the website, web app, APIs, and DaVinci Solutions, our sister company's lock and access\-control platform. Every system you build should move 10 Federal toward its North Star: higher operational efficiency and a better customer experience at the same time. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Architecture \& Engineering Standards** * Define the architecture for every system before code is written, with specs that document the design and the reasoning * Design modular services with clean interfaces that can be replaced or reused without a rewrite * Instrument everything with full logging and debugging from the start * Connect systems to MCP servers so they can be queried through an AI front end * Own each system full stack, from data layer to interface, and ship it deployed, documented, and tested ### **Cross\-Functional Delivery** * Gather requirements with department leaders and solve the real problem, not just the first version of it * Evaluate requests by time cost, dollar cost, scaling impact, and difficulty to build * Take work from spec to proof of concept to a full breakdown for leadership (steps, timeline, cost, and ownership) to production * Build tools people can operate without an engineer standing next to them * Use AI tools across code, documentation, research, and communication, and review, test, and own everything they produce **What You'll Actually Build** ------------------------------ This isn't theoretical. Here's what's already on the table: * The Unified Data Platform: build and extend the pipelines, connections, and architecture that keep it the one place where everything in the company connects, instead of letting it become another silo * Real\-time voice AI: build and extend our own voice AI, running on live speech\-to\-speech models and trained on 10 Federal's own data, instead of leaning on an expensive, generic voice vendor * Chat and SMS: fix or fully replace the customer\-facing experience running across 130\+ properties. Right now it's a generic tool with none of our actual business logic in it * System connections: keep connecting the systems that run this company (the FMS, the camera network, BI and reporting, and marketing) into the UDP instead of leaving them as disconnected logins * Platforms for every part of the company: build systems for Operations, Accounting, Marketing, Investing, Construction, and any other part of the business that can be made faster or smarter. Each platform should own its domain, fit into one cohesive orchestration, and feed the UDP * DaVinci Solutions: optimize, re\-implement, integrate, and extend the lock and access\-control platform for a software and SaaS business serving the broader self\-storage industry The UDP is the operating system of this company. The platforms around it are modular parts of one coordinated machine. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * A strong technical foundation in software, hardware, computer science, computer engineering, or an adjacent field (no degree required) * Full\-stack range: comfortable owning a service end to end, from backend and data layer to interface * Architecture thinking: you can draw a clean boundary around what a system owns and defend it * Modular design as default practice, with real work you can point to that was built that way * Debugging and observability instincts: you instrument what you build so it tells you why it broke * Self\-directed execution: you can take an ambiguous business problem, write the spec, and ship a working system * Proof over credentials: a portfolio, GitHub history, or systems you can walk through in depth ### **Preferred** * Microsoft ecosystem and Azure experience * C\# and .NET experience (relevant to DaVinci Solutions) * Experience building AI\-powered systems such as agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP integrations * Hands\-on experience with AI development tools such as Grok, Cursor, Claude, Codex, or Windsurf * Experience shipping public\-facing products, not just internal tools ### **Current Stack** The stack changes when something better can be proven. Today it includes: * Backend: Python and Go * Front end: TypeScript and React * Real\-time voice AI: LiveKit with xAI Grok * SMS: Twilio * Data: Postgres and Redis * Hosting and identity: Microsoft and Azure * Reporting: Power BI, Fabric, and internally built dashboards * AI integration: MCP servers connected to business systems * DaVinci Solutions: C\# and .NET **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Ship production systems that are deployed, documented, tested, and modular enough to reuse * Complete the first 90 days, a mutual evaluation period, in the office, shipping, and building reusable work * Replace or substantially cut the cost of third\-party vendors with in\-house systems * Move 10 Federal up and to the right on its North Star: better operational efficiency and customer experience **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment** --------------------------------------------- * Work in office at Raleigh, NC headquarters five days a week; this role is not remote or hybrid * Standard office environment with extended periods of sitting and computer use * Relocation assistance can be negotiated if needed **Benefits** ------------ * Base salary and title set to the candidate based on proven work * Compensation reviewed quarterly, with increases based on demonstrated impact rather than tenure * A written share of the savings when you fully replace or substantially cut the cost of a third\-party vendor, paid as a raise or bonus at leadership's discretion * Eligibility for equity grants under 10 Federal's equity incentive plan once performance is proven (no equity in the starting offer; awards reviewed annually at leadership's discretion) * Several no\-cost premium health insurance options, plus a Health Savings Account with up to $1,200 in annual employer contributions * Dental, vision, life, and short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 401(k) with up to a 3% employer match and immediate vesting (eligible after 90 days) * 10 paid holidays and paid time off that grows with tenure * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Employee Recognition Program * Employee discounts on auto, home, and pet insurance, travel, electronics, and entertainment **Our Core Values** ------------------- Everything we do at 10 Federal is rooted in five core values. We look for team members who live them every day: * Master Your Craft — Take pride in your work, your process, and your performance. Own your results. * Commit to the Climb — Show up, keep growing, and pursue continuous improvement. * Lead the Way — Set the standard for customer experience and quality, regardless of title. * Be the Solution — Approach challenges with resourcefulness and a can\-do attitude. * All In All Together — Support your team, your customers, and your community as one unified force. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- 10 Federal Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. **Apply here:** https://10fed\-careers.vercel.app/
