jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Data Centers - Remote (U.S.)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking to hire a highly skilled **Mechanical Engineer** for the Data Center and Mission Critical team for our east region. The ideal candidate for this position should be familiar with the tech sector, mission critical and data center industry, understanding the requirements of scale, speed, and consistency in data centers. *This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.* ***Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance***. **AECOM** is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high\-profile, fast\-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility. Responsibilities, required experience, and qualifications are summarized below: **Responsibilities:** * **Data Center Heat Rejection and HVAC System Design:** Developing and designing Heat Rejection and HVAC systems specifically tailored for data centers, considering factors such as type of cooling requirement as air cooled or direct fluid cooled, associated cooling loads, future flexibility of the system to accommodate variable heat distribution scenarios, phased construction and operation, airflow management, humidity control, system redundancy providing concurrent maintainability, energy efficiency, and compliance with industry standards and best practices. * **Cooling System Selection:** Selecting appropriate air/water side cooling systems for data centers, including Fan wall units, computer room air handlers (CRAHs), chilled water systems, DX systems and CRAC units, in\-row cooling, and containment solutions, based on the specific cooling requirements of the data center and the criticality of the equipment. * **Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Analysis:** Conducting internal CFD simulations to optimize airflow distribution, transient period analysis, identify hotspots, and ensure efficient cooling throughout the data center. Conducting external CFD on individual buildings and/or campus\-wide to simulate effects of different electrical and mechanical components on each other and effects on design day selection criteria capacity of each component. For both types, prepare and/or direct preparation of models and analyse the results to recommend design modifications and optimize the Heat rejection and HVAC system performance. Coordinate the required changes and resulting effects with other trades on project. * **Redundancy and Fault Tolerance:** Designing HVAC systems with redundancy and fault\-tolerant features to ensure continuous operation of the data center in the event of equipment failure or maintenance activities. This includes the design of backup cooling systems, automatic switchover mechanisms, and monitoring systems. * **Heat Load Calculation and Capacity Planning:** Performing heat load calculations for data centers to determine the cooling requirements based on the IT equipment, power density, anticipated growth, and phasing of the construction and operational steps. Conducting capacity planning to ensure the HVAC system can accommodate future expansions and upgrades. Performing HVAC loads for admin and common sections of the facility. * **Energy Efficiency and Sustainability:** Implementing energy\-efficient HVAC design strategies, such as utilizing economizers, variable speed drives, energy recovery systems, and optimizing airflow management techniques, to minimize energy consumption and support sustainability initiatives. * **Air Quality and Filtration:** Ensuring the data center's air quality is maintained at optima tems and implementing air quality monitoring mechanisms. Addressing concerns related to particulate matter, humidity control, and contaminant removal to protect sensitive IT equipment. * **Coordination with Electrical and Mechanical Systems**: Collaborating with electrical engineers and mechanical engineers to integrate the heat rejection and HVAC system seamlessly with the electrical infrastructure, UPS systems, emergency power systems, fire suppression systems, and other critical infrastructure components. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree with 6\+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education. * Experience in data center mechanical and electrical equipment installation and operation. * P. E. registration is required **Preferred Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, HVAC engineering, or a related field from an accredited university is typically required. Preference would be given to candidates with a master's degree or advanced coursework in HVAC systems or energy management. * Knowledge of data center TER Standard Topology as per Uptime Institute, TIA 942, ANSI/BICSI 002 * Professional certifications related to HVAC engineering, such as Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Building Energy Modeling Professional (BEMP), or Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) accreditation, would be advantageous. **Additional Information** * Relocation is not available for this position * Sponsorship for US Employment Authorization is not available for this role now or in the future. * **THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY FEBRUARY 9, 2027\.** At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Application Systems Engineer
jobs.description: The Application Systems Engineer is responsible for the infrastructure administration, operational support, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement of a mission\-critical FAST platform hosted in an on\-premises environment. This role supports the application and its underlying Windows\-based infrastructure, including application servers, web services, databases, reporting components, batch processes, file and image services, integrations, and monitoring tools. The Engineer will work closely with application developers, database administrators, network and security teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and other technical teams to maintain system availability, resolve complex incidents, implement upgrades, strengthen security, and improve platform performance. The position requires hands\-on expertise with Windows Server administration, Microsoft IIS, enterprise application support, PowerShell automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and infrastructure lifecycle management. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- **1\. FAST Platform Infrastructure Support** -------------------------------------------- * Administer and support the on\-premises infrastructure hosting the FAST platform and its related application services. * Maintain Windows application servers, Microsoft IIS, clustered services, file and image servers, reporting services, batch processes, and supporting middleware. * Perform server builds and configure application software, Windows roles and features, folder structures, service accounts, access controls, and security settings. * Maintain platform stability, availability, capacity, performance, and operational readiness across production and non\-production environments. * Coordinate infrastructure activities with FAST platform resources, internal technical teams, and third\-party vendors. **2\. Production Support and Incident Management** -------------------------------------------------- * Provide advanced, top\-tier support for complex platform, server, application, performance, and connectivity issues. * Take ownership of incidents from detection through resolution, including stakeholder communication, escalation, root\-cause analysis, and follow\-up actions. * Use logs, performance counters, packet captures, SQL performance information, application monitoring, and server diagnostic tools to isolate issues. * Develop proactive monitors, alerts, and automated recovery procedures to improve uptime and reduce customer impact. * Participate in after\-hours, on\-call, evening, or weekend support as required for critical incidents, releases, maintenance, or disaster recovery. **3\. Monitoring, Performance, and Capacity** --------------------------------------------- * Monitor server health, resource utilization, application performance, capacity, security events, system efficiency, and failure indicators. * Use enterprise monitoring and analytics tools such as Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Windows performance tools, and related platforms. * Analyze trends, identify bottlenecks, recommend corrective actions, and provide recurring health and performance reporting. * Collaborate with application developers and database administrators to optimize application and database access performance. **4\. System Maintenance, Patching, and Upgrades** -------------------------------------------------- * Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain Windows\-based application infrastructure and commercial off\-the\-shelf software. * Assess upgrade dependencies, risks, benefits, rollback requirements, and implementation schedules before production changes. * Maintain documented procedures for server, database, application, and platform patching. * Coordinate releases and configuration changes across application, database, network, security, and infrastructure teams. **5\. Automation and DevOps** ----------------------------- * Create and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate administrative tasks, configuration, data gathering, troubleshooting, deployment, and maintenance activities. * Reduce manual configuration errors by developing repeatable Infrastructure\-as\-Code and configuration automation practices where appropriate. * Use Azure DevOps or equivalent tools for source control, work tracking, release coordination, and deployment support. * Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, consistency, recovery time, and supportability through automation. **6\. Security and Access Management** -------------------------------------- * Implement and maintain secure infrastructure configurations in accordance with organizational and applicable government security standards. * Manage infrastructure\-level access, permissions, service accounts, certificates, and related controls supporting the FAST platform. * Review security findings, patch vulnerabilities, respond to malware or intrusion events, and coordinate remediation with security teams. * Maint alling and maintaining third\-party applications on Windows Server. * Two (2\) or more years of PowerShell scripting experience. * Experience with Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Wireshark, Tidal Workload Automation, or comparable monitoring, packet analysis, and batch scheduling tools. * Experience with clustered application and database environments, Microsoft SQL reporting, file and image platforms, and enterprise interfaces. * Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code, automated configuration, or repeatable deployment practices. * Experience supporting high\-availability systems in government, regulated, financial, licensing, public safety, or other mission\-critical environments. * Familiarity with hybrid cloud technologies and integration between on\-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure services. **Recommended Certifications** ------------------------------ * Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert * ITIL Foundation or equivalent IT service management certification * CompTIA Security\+, Network\+, or equivalent infrastructure and security certification **Core Competencies** --------------------- **Technical Competencies** -------------------------- * Enterprise Application Infrastructure * Windows Systems Administration * Application and Server Troubleshooting * Monitoring and Performance Analysis * PowerShell Automation * Incident, Problem, and Change Management * Security and Risk Management * Disaster Recovery and Operational Resilience **Professional Competencies** ----------------------------- * Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving * Ownership and Accountability * Customer Service Orientation * Written and Verbal Communication * Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Planning and Organization * Attention to Detail * Adaptability and Continuous Learning **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * Full\-time schedule, generally Monday through Friday, with flexibility for planned maintenance and incident response. * On\-call availability and occasional evening, weekend, or extended\-hours work may be required. * Work may include time in data center or server room environments and extended work at a computer workstation. * Occasional travel to data center or related technical facilities may be required. * A valid driver’s license and successful completion of a background check may be required. **Position Success Factors** ---------------------------- The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to maintain a stable, secure, and high\-performing infrastructure environment for a mission\-critical on\-premises FAST platform. Success will be measured through system availability, timely incident resolution, effective monitoring and automation, disciplined change and patch management, reliable disaster recovery readiness, accurate documentation, and strong collaboration across technical and business teams. **Benefits** AG Consulting Partners, Inc. is a Redmond\-based boutique consulting firm. Our mission is to embrace the entrepreneurial spirit to relentlessly deliver an exceptional experience and results for our people and our clients. We put our people first. Our excellent benefits to full\-time employees include medical, dental, vision, PTO, 401K matching, education reimbursement, community and philanthropic events and flexible career paths. We’re humbled to be consistently acknowledged by local and national organizations for our success, including Consulting Magazine, Puget Sound Business Journal, and Inc. 5000\. The compensation for this position is tailored to reflect your unique skill set, relevant experience, and the current dynamics of the job market. We strive to ensure that our compensation package is competitive and fair, taking into account various factors to provide a rewarding opportunity for our team members. The annual salary range for this role is: 80000 \- 95000 USD annually.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II – Scientific Instrumentation and Process Engineering
jobs.description: ***Software Engineer II – Scientific Instrumentation and Process Engineering*** The Allen Institute accelerates science for a healthier world through large\-scale research designed to answer some of the most complex questions in biology. respond to changing priorities, and complete assigned work with increasing independence **Preferred Education and Experience** * Experience developing software for scientific instrumentation, laboratory automation, robotics, industrial systems, or other hardware\-integrated environments * Experience integrating software with cameras, motion systems, sensors, actuators, data\-acquisition infrastructure automation, deployment, telemetry, logging, or system health monitoring * Experience developing user interfaces and data collection, management, or transfer workflows * Exposure to interprocess communication, event\-driven systems, state machines, hardware abstraction, machine vision, or image processing * Experience supporting integration, verification, troubleshooting, or operation of prototype or production systems * Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly for development, testing, documentation, or maintenance **Work Environment** * Work is performed in office, software\-development, engineering, and laboratory environments * Regular onsite work with automated scientific instruments, robotics, imaging systems, and electromechanical prototypes * Possible exposure to laboratory materials or chemical, biological, mechanical, electrical, or other hazards; use of required personal protective equipment and adherence to established safety procedures are expected **Physical Demands** * Occasional lifting up to 30 pounds * Fine motor movements in fingers and hands to operate computers, instruments, and other office or laboratory equipment * Occasional pushing or pulling of laboratory carts or equipment up to 50 pounds * Occasional stooping, bending, crouching, and reaching while integrating or servicing equipment **Position jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. **Working at Abbott** At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You'll also have access to: * Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. * An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution. * Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit \- an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree. * A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. * A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists. **Position Overview** As a Sr. Software Engineer, this seasoned professional will demonstrate competence and creativity in a wide range of technical areas. This role will have a lead role in the design, development, and testing of software applications for Abbott Cancer Diagnostics, creating expert design concepts and foolproof debugging. This role will be able to resolve most issues and problems effectively with minimal oversight, communicate effectively with business stakeholders and mentor junior team members. This role will routinely make key decisions for the team, be accountable for application quality, and be highly productive. Working in our Software Engineering team, you will be responsible for developing, enhancing, and sustaining software systems in a cross\-functional team environment through adherence to established design control processes and good engineering practices. You will design and create engineering specifications for building software programs based on a broad knowledge of information systems and determine what development methodology to use after documenting software requirements. An ideal candidate will be comfortable growing others on the team as an informal leader. They would have very strong competency with Java and be knowledgeable about Spring Boot and Spring as it relates to building out microservices. Experience with Maven is a plus, as is experience with Kafka and/or HL7 and FHIR. This position can be based in our Madison, WI or Redwood City, CA office location. **Essential Duties** Include, but are not limited to, the following: * Demonstrate strong working knowledge, skills, and understanding of practices for complex programs and initiatives demonstrating creativity and substantial understanding of specialized techniques, processes, procedures. * Troubleshoot issues and problems of medium complexity for major software applications; break down complex tasks, make reasonable decisions, investigate and fix bugs, and operate independently. * Initiate independent designs that impact and influence the department’s delivery and approach. Lead reviewing design alternatives, problems, and solutions with an eye on limiting the need for later problem solving. * Consistently influence and make significant decisions within a project, demonstrating good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions based in a solid understanding of business strategy and best practices with minimal instructions for difficult or unpredictable situations. * Contribute individual capabilities to the achievement of group objectives, and work effectively with others in a group setting. This includes mentoring, coaching, and technical guidance for junior members of the team. * Build successful internal and external partnerships with peers, SMEs, stakeholders, and decision\-makers. * Communicate clear and concise project plans/designs and status updates for a project. * Ability to work nights and/or weekends, as needed. * Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork. * Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures. * Maintain regular and reliable attendance. * Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Engineering. * 6\+ years of experience in the Software Engineering discipline. * Complete knowledge and full understanding of software development design and development, and relevant domain specific skills. * Understanding of and significant experience with object\-oriented programming. * RESTful web services, Relational Databases (Postgres, SQL Server), and ORM technologies (JPA2, Hibernate, Entities Framework). * Demonstrated experience designing and developing apps that access and or utilize cloud\-based frameworks (e.g., Azure, Amazon AWS Services/SDKs, etc.). * Agile development tools; including, but not limited to, JIRA, Confluence repository. * Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL, PL/SQL, .NET, Google Web Toolkit. * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in country where work will be performed on a full or part\-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time. * Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position with or without accommodation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR. * Experience using Java as a core language * Experience using Spring Boot or Spring to support Microservices * Experience using Maven * Experience using Kafka or other queuing systems The base pay for this position is $78,000\.00 – $156,000\.00\. jobs.description: **ABOUT ADVANCED ENERGY** Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission\-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado. **WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY?** Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best\-in\-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together. **POSITION SUMMARY:** We are seeking for a Senior Firmware Engineer based in Wilmington, MA. In this position, you will lead the embedded firmware architecture for the next generation platform using C\+\+ object\-oriented programing and real time embedded systems. The individual in this role needs to have strong embedded design experience to design and modify to evaluate embedded software, programmable logic, electronic apparatus, components, or circuitry for use in electronic equipment and devices. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Participates in all phases of the embedded program development life cycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, and test of all products * Applies sound engineering principles in the development of digital design/architecture for the target application * Ownership of design and development of embedded real time software to work with application specific hardware * Works with Systems Engineers and Program Management to decompose system level requirements * Develop code and architecture documentation * Conducts design reviews of team members work products * Works closely with cross functional members of the engineering organization to develop and evaluate interfaces between hardware and software, and operational performance requirements and design of the overall system * Designs product architectures to meet specific parameters. adjoining lab **QUALIFICATIONS****:** Proficient in embedded C/C\+\+ software development for one or more microcontroller platforms, including TI C2000, STM32, dsPIC33, or equivalent embedded processors. **EXPERIENCE:** * 5\-10 years of experience in C\+\+ software development. * Experience developing software applications and automation tools using C/C\+\+, LabVIEW, Python, or similar programming environments to: + Develop graphical user interfaces (GUIs) for system configuration, control, monitoring, and data visualization. + Automate testing and characterization of power electronics and power supply products, including measurement and logging of voltage, current, power, efficiency, and temperature. + Interface with laboratory instruments such as oscilloscopes, digital multimeters (DMMs), power analyzers, electronic loads, and power supplies through USB, Ethernet, GPIB, RS\-232, CAN, and other communication interfaces. + Develop software to communicate with peripherals and external devices using GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART, CAN, and other standard embedded communication protocols. + Develop interfaces for data exchange with sensors, data loggers, and external control systems. + Implement data acquisition, processing, analysis, and automated report generation to support engineering validation and production testing. + Develop automated test frameworks for design verification, manufacturing test, product qualification, and reliability testing. * Experience collaborating effectively with cross\-functional hardware and software engineering teams. * Hands\-on laboratory experience, including hardware troubleshooting and debugging. **Preferred:** * Experience with signal integrity and power integrity analysis of embedded digital designs. * Experience developing specifications and resource requirements for digital and FPGA\-based designs. * Experience with industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, PROFIBUS, and DeviceNet. * Experience interfacing with Xilinx FPGAs and SoCs. * Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) practices. * Experience working with embedded microprocessors within FPGA architectures. * Experience with Xilinx development tools and FPGA HDL coding. **EDUCATION:** * B.S. or M.S. in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related field. **COMPENSATION:***As required by multiple state pay transparency laws, Advanced Energy provides a reasonable range of compensation for each job posting. jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Software Services (Applications)
jobs.description: Agility's commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher\-value work. With industry\-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential. **About Agility Robotics** -------------------------- Agility Robotics builds Digit — the first humanoid robot doing real, paid work in warehouses and distribution centers today. Our mission is to build robot partners that augment the human workforce, and Digit is already working alongside people at real customer sites through our Agility Partner Program. Humanoid robotics is one of the most closely watched spaces in tech right now, and very few engineering teams get to write the software that commands and manages a fleet of humanoid robots operating in the real world. **About the Team** ------------------ You'll join the Software Services (backend) team, part of the broader Applications \& Platform Software Engineering organization building **Arc** — our cloud application for robot fleet management, robot operations, and fleet data collection. The team spans Senior Staff to SWE III, so you'll have direct access to experienced engineers as you ramp up: you'll get an assigned mentor for your first 90 days, and after that you'll work closely with whichever senior or staff engineer is leading your project. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build backend APIs and services for Arc, our cloud\-based robot fleet management platform. * Own well\-scoped features end\-to\-end, and contribute to larger ones alongside senior engineers. * Turn product requirements into technical designs — write design docs, build proof\-of\-concepts, and ship code. * Help redesign our system and refactor services as we scale and evolve. * Work cross\-functionally with product, UX, front\-end, robot hardware/software, customer solutions, and operations teams. * Support what you build through its full lifecycle, including a flexible, team\-designed on\-call rotation (roughly once every 3\-4 weeks). **Technical Skills \& Requirements** ------------------------------------ ### **Core Requirements** * BS or MS in computer science or related field or equivalent industry experience. * At least 4 years of experience in a software engineer role. * Strong proficiency in Java and Python and Rust or Go. jobs.title: Bilingual Forward Deployed Engineer (English/Spanish)
jobs.description: **About AiPrise** ----------------- AiPrise is a YC\-backed (S22\) global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80\+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're building AI\-powered compliance agents to transform KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring, enabling customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime. We operate across 200\+ countries. **The Role** ------------ This is not a typical engineering role. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll work directly with AiPrise's largest and most strategic customers to understand their compliance challenges, build custom integrations, and ship solutions that make the platform indispensable. You won't be waiting for a ticket to land in your queue. You'll be in the room with the customer, scoping the problem, writing the code, and deploying the fix, sometimes in the same day. This role is ideal for engineers who get energy from solving real problems for real people, and who want their work to have visible, immediate impact. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Customer\-facing engineering.** Embed with key customers to understand their onboarding, KYB, and compliance workflows. Translate their pain points into technical solutions, whether that's a custom integration, a new API endpoint, or a workflow tweak. **Build and ship fast.** Design and deploy customer\-specific configurations, integrations with third\-party compliance and identity vendors, and custom data pipelines. Own the full lifecycle from scoping through production. **Bridge product and engineering.** Bring customer insights back to the core product team. Identify patterns across customer needs that should become platform features. Help shape the roadmap based on what you're seeing in the field. **Technical problem\-solving under pressure.** Debug production issues in real time. Troubleshoot complex vendor integrations across 80\+ providers. Be the person customers trust to get things working. **Scale what works.** Turn one\-off solutions into reusable patterns. Write internal tooling, documentation, and runbooks that make the next deployment faster for everyone. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. You've written code that real users depend on. * Written and spoken proficiency in Spanish, as you will be working with our customers in the LATAM region. * Strong backend fundamentals. Proficiency in at least one modern language (Python, Go, Java, Node.js). Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL). * Customer\-facing comfort. You can hold your own in a call with a VP of Compliance at a fintech. You listen well, communicate clearly, and know how to translate business language into technical requirements (and vice versa). * Spanish fluency required. You can read and write in Spanish to support our Spanish\-speaking customer base directly. * Bias toward action. You don't wait for perfect specs. You scope, build, and iterate. You're comfortable with ambiguity and thrive when given ownership. * Cloud experience. Hands\-on with AWS (preferred), GCP, or Azure. Familiar with CI/CD, Docker, and modern deployment practices. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience in fintech, regtech, payments, or fraud/risk detection * Familiarity with compliance workflows (KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening) * Experience integrating with third\-party APIs at scale * Frontend skills (React, TypeScript) for building internal tools or customer\-facing dashboards * Background working with ML/AI systems or data\-intensive applications **Why This Role** ----------------- * Your work has direct, measurable impact on customers and revenue. No abstraction layers between you and the outcome. * You'll learn the compliance and fintech space deeply, working across diverse customer environments. * You're joining a 70\-person, fast\-moving team where your code hits production in days, not months. * Competitive compensation with meaningful equity in a YC\-backed company with strong momentum. * In\-person team in San Jose, working alongside the founders and core engineering team. Compensation Range: $115K \- $130K

jobs.title: SIPRNET System Administrator
jobs.description: Akira Technologies, Inc. is seeking an experienced SIPRNET System Administrator to support the Georgia Army National Guard (GA ARNG) at the Clay National Guard Center (CNGC) in Marietta, GA. The successful candidate will provide hands\-on administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and cybersecurity support for systems operating within the Secret Internet Protocol Router Network (SIPRNET) environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the availability, reliability, security, and operational readiness of classified servers, workstations, and associated enterprise infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience administering secure DoD enterprise systems, implementing Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), remediating cybersecurity findings, and coordinating with Information System Security Managers (ISSMs) and Information System Security Officers (ISSOs). The position will also support Continuity of Operations (COOP) planning, testing, and recovery activities to maintain mission\-critical services. **Key Responsibilities** * Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot SIPRNET\-connected servers, workstations, operating systems, and supporting enterprise infrastructure in accordance with DoD and Army cybersecurity requirements. * Perform daily system administration activities, including user account management, privileged access administration, system configuration, software installation, patch management, and performance monitoring. * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms, databases, and associated infrastructure supporting classified operations. * Conduct DISA STIG assessments, identify Category I, II, and III (CAT I–III) findings, implement corrective actions, and validate remediation to maintain system security and compliance. * Coordinate with ISSMs, ISSOs, and cybersecurity personnel to document security findings, update Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms), track remediation progress, and provide supporting evidence for compliance assessments. * Support Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, security control assessments, configuration baseline reviews, vulnerability scanning, and ongoing authorization requirements for classified systems. * Monitor system health, availability, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying and resolving technical issues that could affect SIPRNET operations. * Perform advanced troubleshooting across multiple Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) layers, conduct root\-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to restore and maintain system functionality. * Support LAN/WAN connectivity, routing and switching, network integration, and coordination with Army Network Enterprise Technology Command (NETCOM) and other enterprise service providers. * Manage technical incidents, service requests, and escalations through the Army Enterprise Service Management Platform (AESMP), or other authorized service management systems, ensuring timely resolution and accurate documentation. * Support Continuity of Operations (COOP) planning and execution, including system backups, restoration procedures, disaster recovery testing, alternate operating capabilities, and recovery of mission\-critical services. * Develop, maintain, and test system recovery procedures, backup schedules, configuration documentation, and operational readiness plans to support continuity requirements. * Implement enterprise configuration management, system hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation, and change management processes within classified environments. * Develop, test, troubleshoot, integrate, and maintain custom applications, scripts, utilities, and automated solutions to improve system administration, monitoring, reporting, and mission business processes. * Support approved programming, scripting, database, robotic process automation (RPA), and Microsoft Power Platform technologies, where applicable to the authorized environment. * Assist with enterprise modernization and migration initiatives, including infrastructure assessments, system integration, workload transition planning, testing, cutover, and post\-migration stabilization. * Translate DoD and Army enterprise technical directives into local implementation requirements while identifying technical risks, security implications, and operational impacts. * Maintain accurate technical documentation, including system configurations, network diagrams, security assessment records, STIG checklists, POA\&M updates, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and COOP documentation. * Collaborate with government leadership, ISSMs, ISSOs, network engineers, cybersecurity teams, and other technical stakeholders to ensure secure and reliable SIPRNET operations. **Required Qualifications** * Eight (8\) or more years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise infrastructure, systems administration fications** * Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) certification. These certifications do not replace the mandatory Security\+ and applicable DoD 8140 requirements. * Experience supporting SIPRNET environments within the Army National Guard, U.S. Army, DoD, or other federal government organizations. * Familiarity with DISA Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) tools, STIG Viewer, vulnerability scanning platforms, and enterprise security compliance reporting. * Experience supporting RMF authorization activities, maintaining POA\&Ms, and coordinating security remediation with ISSMs and ISSOs. * Experience developing and executing COOP, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, and system recovery procedures for classified enterprise environments. * Experience with Army 365 (A365\), Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Azure, or comparable DoD\-authorized cloud environments. * Experience supporting enterprise cloud migration and modernization efforts involving secure or classified infrastructure. * Familiarity with NETCOM coordination, Army enterprise service management processes, and AESMP ticket escalation procedures. * Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting and automation technologies used in enterprise system administration. **Salary Range: $120,000 to $135,000** Akira’s pay range for this position considers various factors including skills, years of experience, training, licenses, certifications, alignment with market data, and internal equity in the organization. This pay range estimate is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary, which Akira believes to be done in good faith in compliance with local laws. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. **General Description of Benefits** Akira offers its employees multiple options for medical plans (some with Health Savings Account), dental plans, and vision coverage, and a 401(k) plan with employer match. To promote work/life balance, Akira offers paid time off, including vacation and sick time, holidays, paid parental leave, military leave, bereavement leave, and jury duty leave. We also offer short and long\-term disability benefits to protect employee income in the event of sickness or injury, life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, and critical illness insurance. Akira also offers tuition, training, and certification reimbursement for professional development and career advancement. Akira regularly reviews our total rewards package to ensure our offerings remain competitive and reflect the values and needs expressed by our employees. **About Akira Technologies** Akira strives to meet and exceed the mission and objectives of US federal agencies. As a leading small business cloud modernization and data analytics services provider, we deliver trusted and highly differentiated solutions and technologies that serve the needs of our customers and citizens. Akira serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies across the intelligence, cyber, defense, civilian, and health markets. Every day, our employees deliver transformational outcomes, solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. *Akira is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*

jobs.title: Lead Backend Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Company Description** At Alertus, protecting people from harm is our mission and our passion. As the leader in mass notification, we are committed to providing customizable, scalable, and cost\-effective solutions, as we know even a few seconds of warning can help save lives during an emergency. Our employees are integral to the company’s success and impact countless people's lives, safety, and well\-being. We aim for a positive, collaborative environment that allows employees to work across departments easily and effectively. ### **Job Description** As a Lead Engineer, you will be the primary architect and steward of our "Identity\-as\-a\-Service" platform, the bedrock upon which every other product team builds. This isn't just about managing logins; it’s about ensuring that our entire ecosystem is secure, performant, and seamlessly integrated. You will lead the team responsible for the critical infrastructure that handles User Management, SSO, EntraID, and our Public API. Your mission is to ensure that while the product scales, our "base" remains rock\-solid, providing high throughput and millisecond\-latency for our most critical services. If you thrive on solving complex distributed systems problems and take pride in enabling other engineers to move faster, this role is for you. ***Candidates must be located within driving distance from our Baltimore HQ.*** ### **A Day in the Life:** * Architect Core Services: Design and evolve the platform’s "Identity\-as\-a\-Service" layer, ensuring high availability and consistency across user onboarding, SSO, and API key management. * Optimize High\-Scale Systems: Build and maintain data retrieval systems capable of accessing millions of records in milliseconds. * Drive Reliability \& SLAs: Implement rigorous monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning to meet and exceed strict reliability and low\-latency targets. * Lead API Strategy: Own the development and lifecycle of our Public API, ensuring it is intuitive for customers and robust under heavy load. * Set the Engineering Standard: Serve as a technical mentor and example for the broader engineering organization, championing best practices in asynchronous communication and system design. * Innovate through Infrastructure: Strategically utilize caching layers and database optimizations to solve for high\-concurrency challenges ### **Required Skills \& Abilities:** * **Node.js \& PHP Ecosystems:** Expert\-level proficiency in **Node.js** for building high\-concurrency services, paired with professional experience in **PHP** to manage and migrate legacy logic. * **High\-Performance Database Architecture:** Mastery of **Relational Databases** **(PostgreSQL/MySQL)**, specifically in designing schemas that maintain strict ACID compliance.Proven ability to execute **zero\-downtime migrations** and complex query optimizations that reduce CPU/IO overhead. * **Sub\-Millisecond Caching Strategy:** Deep experience with **Redis or Memcached** to build "speed layers" for notification systems and session management. Sophisticated understanding of **cache invalidation patterns** to ensure data consistency across a distributed environment. * **Distributed Systems \& Scalability:** Practical experience implementing **Read/Write splitting,** **horizontal sharding, and multi\-region failover** to ensure "five nines" (99\.999%) availability. Architectural fluency in the **CAP Theorem**, with the ability to make informed trade\-offs between strong and eventual consistency based on the specific needs of Identity vs. Reporting. * **Asynchronous Data \& Eventual Consistency**: Expertise in **Event\-Driven Architecture** using message brokers like **Kafka or RabbitMQ** to handle high\-volume data flows. jobs.title: Director, Detection & Threat Response
jobs.description: At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. **Job Description** The Director, Detection \& Threat Response is the enterprise’s senior leader for intelligence\-led detection and response. The role is accountable for how Allstate anticipates, finds, and stops adversaries before they affect customers, data, or operations. This leader sets the strategic direction for three global functions: D\&R Engineering \& Automation, Threat Intelligence, and Threat Hunting. The goal is to unite them into one system in which intelligence sets priorities, hunting tests those priorities against the environment, detections are engineered and shipped as code, and response runs at machine speed under clear governance. As a Director, you won’t just deliver results – you drive our culture and shared purpose. You can work remotely and will commute to a nearby office and/or travel for meaningful connection opportunities.**Imagine this.** * **7:02 a.m.** A new intelligence report describes an MFA\-bypass technique being used against financial services firms. Within two minutes it is scored against Allstate’s priority intelligence requirements and flagged as relevant, and an automated hunt launches across identity and email telemetry. * **7:09 a.m.** The hunt gets a hit: one account shows the technique’s pattern. An AI agent opens the investigation immediately, pulls identity and device context, runs the pivots a senior analyst would run, and reaches a high\-confidence verdict with a full evidence trail. * **7:11 a.m.** Contained. The verdict meets the bar for a pre\-approved, reversible response, so the system acts on its own: active sessions revoked, credentials reset, account temporarily locked. Nine minutes from first intelligence to containment. * **7:16 a.m.** An analyst reviews the evidence and the actions taken, confirms the call, and reaches out to the employee. Humans stay accountable for every automated action, without being the bottleneck for it. * **8:02 a.m.** An AI\-drafted detection for the technique is waiting in an engineer’s review queue. It uses the real attack telemetry from the hunt as its test case, and has been backtested against 30 days of history for false positives. It arrives linked to the intelligence that prompted it, the attack path it closes, and its expected alert volume. The engineer approves it and the pipeline promotes it. Next time, nobody has to go hunting. It fires on its own. **Now imagine you lead the teams that made that possible.** Your intelligence team set the priority. Your hunters tested it against our environment. Your engineers built the automation that contained it in minutes and the pipeline that turned it into durable coverage within the hour. And you know it worked because you inspected the data, not because someone said so. That’s the job, and it’s what we’re building at Allstate. **What we’re building** ======================= Allstate is building a Cyber Response organization designed for the speed of AI\-enabled threats. The work underway is the kind most security teams are still only talking about: * **An AI\-assisted detection\-as\-code pipeline.** Every detection version\-controlled, peer\-reviewed, tested, tied to the attack paths that matter most to Allstate, and promoted through CI/CD, with AI agents accelerating how detections are created and validated. * **Agentic investigation and governed response.** AI\-driven triage and investigation paired with orchestrated response, with human decision gates where the business impact is real. * **Automated threat intelligence.** Pipelines that turn global threat reporting into fast, relevant action for exposure management, incident response, hunting, and leadership. * **Intelligence\-led threat hunting.** Hypothesis\-driven hunts, AI\-assisted scoping, and findings that flow straight into durable detections. * **Continuous adversarial validation.** Breach\-and\-attack simulation and purple teaming that prove coverage against real attacker behavior. We need a leader who can bring these together into one system and take it to enterprise scale. **Why this matters** ==================== Allstate exists to protect people from life’s uncertainties. In security, that promise now runs into a math problem: adversaries are using automation and AI to scale, and human hours do not. If analyst capacity decides what we detect, risk ends up in the alerts no one had time to look at. Our goal is to predict, detect, and disrupt threats before they reach our customers and our data, with coverage we can prove, detections we can trust, response at machine speed, and automation to turn that into measurable coverage of the attack paths that matter rather than a color\-coded matrix. * The ability to explain the math to a CFO and the TTP to an engineer, in the same afternoon. * Empathy and candor. You own the problem before you solve it, and you build teams where people can say “I was wrong.” **Skills** Cyber Defense, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, People Leadership, Production Automation**Compensation** Compensation offered for this role is 187,500\.00 \- 258,375\.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications. The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation. **Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.** Allstate generally does not sponsor individuals for employment\-based visas for this position. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Sponsored Products and Brands
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) helps millions of advertisers reach shoppers across Amazon's stores worldwide. Behind every ad we show are machine learning models that predict click\-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR). These predictions decide which ads are relevant, how they rank, and how advertisers get value. Our team builds and runs the ML infrastructure behind those models, end to end: * Offline feature engineering: a multi\-tenant platform used by several ML teams. It runs thousands of daily feature jobs over petabyte\-scale data and produces the features that train models in every marketplace we serve. * Model training: the standard system that retrains CTR and CVR models every day. How fresh these models are directly affects advertiser results and Amazon's revenue. * Online feature store and feature retrieval: low\-latency, high\-throughput services that provide features when a model makes a prediction. These predictions feed the scores used in real\-time ad ranking. * Next\-generation research platform: a platform that uses AI agents to help scientists explore, test and launch new model ideas faster. As an SDE II, you'll design, build and run distributed systems that work at very large scale, both in offline batch processing and online serving. You'll work closely with applied scientists and engineers to make models fresher, help scientists try ideas faster, and keep the systems that support ads ranking reliable. Key job responsibilities * Design and develop ML infrastructure for advanced recommendation models, from training through real\-time inference, that delivers highly relevant ads to shoppers worldwide * Improve the scalability, automation and efficiency of large\-scale training and real\-time inference systems * Work closely with applied scientists to optimize the performance of ML models and infrastructure, and take models from experimentation into production * Deliver ML solutions end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment and operations * Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to build systems that serve ads across all Amazon platforms and surfaces * Participate in design and code reviews and mentor peers A day in the life You might start the day checking the health of the overnight feature and training pipelines. Then you'd work with scientists on how to support a new model architecture, and spend the afternoon building a performance improvement for the online feature store. You'll ship often, see your work affect ads served around the world, and influence how ML infrastructure grows across the organization. About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. We're the team behind the full ML lifecycle for Sponsored Products recommendation models, from raw data to features, training and real\-time serving. Licenses \& Certifications** * Practical understanding of transformer architectures and how modern LLMs work * Experience building agentic orchestration using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain/LangGraph, Microsoft Copilot Studio, OpenAI/Anthropic tool\-calling patterns, or equivalent internal frameworks * Proficiency in prompt engineering: systematic prompt design, few\-shot learning, chain\-of\-thought, and prompt optimization for foundation models * Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Chroma) and RAG architecture patterns * Experience with LLM evaluation methods, including LLM\-as\-a\-judge, automated benchmarking, and regression testing for model outputs * Proficiency in post\-deployment model maintenance, including observability, monitoring, cost optimization, and drift detection * Experience developing and implementing governance frameworks and controls for responsible AI * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) is a plus * Knowledge of experimentation and measurement: A/B testing, KPI instrumentation, and operational analytics * Strong proficiency in Python; working knowledge of Java or another enterprise language * Proficiency in object\-oriented design techniques and principles * Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and cloud\-native development patterns * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps toolchain: Git, GitHub, Jenkins, ADO Pipelines, or equivalent * Experience with RESTful API design and integration patterns (JSON, microservices) * Experience in Agile methodologies, such as SCRUM **What you'll get** ------------------- Feel free to take advantage of all that American Airlines has to offer: * Travel Perks: Ready to explore the world? You, your family and your friends can reach 365 destinations on more than 6,800 daily flights across our global network. * Health Benefits: On day one, you’ll have access to your health, dental, prescription and vision benefits to help you stay well. And that’s just the start, we also offer virtual doctor visits, flexible spending accounts and more. * Wellness Programs: We want you to be the best version of yourself – that’s why our wellness programs provide you with all the right tools, resources and support you need. * 401(k) Program: Available upon hire and, depending on the workgroup, employer contributions to your 401(k) program are available after one year. * Additional Benefits: Other great benefits include our Member Assistance Program, pet insurance and discounts on hotels, cars, cruises and more **Feel free to be yourself at American** ---------------------------------------- From the team members we hire to the customers we serve, inclusion and diversity are the foundation of the dynamic workforce at American Airlines. Our 20\+ Team Member Resource Groups are focused on connecting our team members to our customers, suppliers, communities and shareholders, helping team members reach their full potential and creating an inclusive work environment to meet and exceed the needs of our diverse world. Are you ready to feel a tremendous sense of pride and satisfaction as you do your part to keep the largest airline in the world running smoothly as we care for people on life’s journey? Feel free to be yourself at American.

jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description: * This position is located in Liberty Lake, WA and you must be willing to relocate to this area to be considered for the position. ABOUT US Amphenol Network Solutions, headquartered in Liberty Lake, Washington, is a division of Amphenol Corporation, one of the world’s largest manufacturers of interconnect products, with global headquarters in Wallingford, Connecticut. Guided by a bold vision to connect people with technology, Amphenol serves a wide range of markets including IT Datacom, Mobile Devices, Mobile Networks, Broadband, Industrial, Automotive, Commercial Aerospace, and Military. At Amphenol Network Solutions, we are at the forefront of global connectivity, delivering a high quality, seamless portfolio of fiber distribution, cable management, power solutions, racks, passives, and enclosures. From fiber crossing oceans to networks spanning continents, our technologies enhance the performance of our customers’ products, systems, and networks—one connection at a time. Recently recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in the Inland Northwest, we believe that coming to work every day is a choice—and a meaningful one. We foster an environment where innovative, hard working, passionate, honest, and fun loving people thrive. If you’re looking to be part of a global force shaping the future of communication and connectivity, you’ve found it. POSITION SUMMARY The Embedded Systems Engineer contributes to the development, integration, and support of software for embedded platforms used in Amphenol Network Solutions’ connectivity products. This role works across low level firmware, embedded Linux components, and system interfaces to ensure reliable operation and seamless communication between hardware and higher level applications. The engineer collaborates closely with cross functional teams on new product development, assists with hardware bring up and debugging activities, and helps maintain consistent software quality as technologies and product requirements evolve. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES The duties of the Embedded Systems Engineer include developing, integrating, and supporting software for embedded platforms used in connectivity products. Responsibilities span low\-level firmware, embedded Linux components, and system interfaces to ensure reliable hardware and application communication. The engineer collaborates with cross\-functional teams for new product development, contributes to hardware bring\-up and debugging, and helps maintain software quality as technology evolves. * Experience working with embedded Linux systems including board support package development and driver development. * Working knowledge of low\-level programming in C; exposure to Rust is a plus * Familiarity with common embedded communication protocols including Ethernet, USB, I2C, and SPI * Exposure to microcontroller firmware development tools including Eclipse based IDEs * Basic understanding of Linux concepts such as device trees, drivers, and user\-space vs. kernel\-space responsibilities * Experience or interest in containerized environments on embedded platforms (e.g., Docker) * Ability to interface low\-level embedded code with higher\-level application layers, including C\#\-based services * Foundational debugging and troubleshooting skills using standard embedded tools (e.g., JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes) * Ability to write readable, maintainable code and follow established coding standards **Education/experience:** * 3\+ years of experience in embedded systems development, or equivalent hands\-on experience through internships, academic projects, or personal work * Experience developing software for embedded or hardware\-adjacent systems in a Linux environment * Working knowledge of low\-level programming concepts, including memory management and basic concurrency * Experience integrating and debugging hardware peripherals over I²C, SPI, RS\-485, and Ethernet * Ability to support hardware bring\-up and assist with debugging early\-stage designs under guidance from senior engineers * Comfortable collaborating with cross\-functional teams, including software, electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing engineering * Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and hardware platforms as products evolve * Familiarity with modern development workflows such as version control and issue tracking (i.e., Git) **Preferred qualifications (not required):** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field * Prior exposure to embedded Linux distributions such as Torizon or Yocto\-based systems * Experience with Docker or containerized deployment in embedded or resource\-constrained environments * Experience integrating embedded systems with higher\-level applications or services written in C\# or similar languages LANGUAGE AND PEOPLE SKILLS Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential for effectively collaborating with multidisciplina rocesses is required. This role also demands the capacity to interact professionally with colleagues, management, and external partners, adapting communication style as needed for diverse audiences. In the context of Amphenol Network Solutions’ environment, these skills support cross\-functional teamwork, continuous learning, and successful project outcomes by fostering open dialogue, mutual respect, and the sharing of ideas. COMPUTER SKILLS Proficiency in modern development tools is central to this role. Candidates should demonstrate strong experience with version control systems such as Git and issue tracking platforms, which are critical for managing software projects and supporting collaborative workflows. Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker), embedded Linux environments like Torizon or Yocto, and integration with higher\-level applications or services is highly valued. Collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint are important for efficient team communication and project coordination. Adaptability to new software and technology platforms is essential, reflecting the dynamic nature of this environment. Basic competency with Microsoft Office applications may be beneficial but is considered a lower priority for this position. PHYSICAL \& MENTAL DEMANDS This role requires extensive periods of computer work, including sitting, typing, and phone use for extended durations. The position may also involve occasional lifting of materials or equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. Candidates should be able to maintain focus and productivity during prolonged desk\-based tasks, and safely handle manual lifting as needed. Reasonable accommodation may be provided for qualified individuals with disabilities. WORK ENVIRONMENT This position is primarily based in the office, with the potential for hybrid work flexibility depending on business needs. The workspace features an open office environment designed to foster collaboration and includes access to dedicated labs for hands\-on work with hardware components. Onsite presence is expected for activities that involve lab access, equipment testing, or close team interaction. In addition, occasional travel—up to a couple times per year—may be required to our manufacturing facility in Mexico to support business operations or project needs. COMPENSATION **Pay Range:** $85,000\-$100,000/year **Status:** Exempt Please note that the salary information shown above is a general guideline only.
