jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Internal Products
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As Anthropic grows, more of the work our own teams do every day runs through internal software, and that software has to keep up. We are building that software, and we are building it Claude\-first: Claude should take on as much of the repetitive, multi\-step work as it safely can, and people decide what needs a human. We’re looking for Staff\+ full\-stack engineers to drive this work. You’ll build across the stack: the products people use and the agents that work alongside them. You’ll work directly with the teams who rely on what you build. Many of these workflows write to business\-critical data, so correctness matters as much as speed. This is a greenfield opportunity: you’ll shape the underlying systems, ship agents that take real work off people’s plates, and design how people and agents get the right context to make good decisions. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and ship internal products end to end, from the data model to the UI, for workflows that teams across Anthropic depend on. * Put Claude to work on real tasks, such as gathering the context a decision needs, drafting the next step of a multi\-step process or keeping records consistent across the systems teams already use, and decide where an agent should act and where a well\-designed UI is the better answer. * Make agents safe to trust with real work: scoped access to data, guardrails, evals, audit trails, and clear points where a person confirms before anything happens. * Build one set of shared capabilities that people and agents both use, exposed as APIs and MCP tools, so the same rules and approvals apply to whoever makes the call. * Treat speed and polish as product requirements. Spend time with the people who use what you build, find where their work slows down, and remove those steps. * Build for correctness. When a workflow writes to business\-critical data, a mistake travels into other systems, so you’ll know where idempotency, reconciliation and audit trails matter and where they don’t. * Integrate with the third\-party systems teams already rely on, and build the layer on top of them where people and agents get their work done. * Set technical direction for a product area over multiple quarters, lead engineers across teams through large, ambiguous projects, and make the engineers around you better through design reviews, code review and mentorship. * Operate what you ship: own the reliability of the workflows people depend on and be on call for them. **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Experience shipping production software as a backend\-leaning full\-stack engineer, comfortable designing a data model, an API and the UI on top of them. * Experience building software on LLMs or agents, and a point of view on when an agent should act on its own and when it should ask first. * Experience leading the design and delivery of complex, user\-facing products across the full stack, through requirements that shifted while you built. * Experience designing for correctness and data integrity from the start, in systems where errors are costly and hard to undo. * Experience working closely with non\-engineering partners, turning ambiguous needs into clear requirements and reaching decisions together. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience building internal tools or platforms that other teams rely on. A plus, not a requirement; strong product generalists are just as welcome. * Experience taking an agent into production for a high\-stakes workflow, including the evals and guardrails that made it safe to ship. * Experience building a zero\-to\-one product, or rebuilding one that people already depended on every day. * Experience building on top of third\-party platforms through their APIs, and knowing when to extend a system and when to build your own. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 \- $485,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Sr. AI Perception Engineer
jobs.description: * ### **About Anyware Robotics** Anyware Robotics builds general\-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending. ### **Description** About Anyware Anyware Robotics builds general\-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending. The Role The robots run on **AnywareOS**, our industrial physical intelligence system. Its architecture is modular and designed to generalize across applications without reprogramming. We are seeking a **Sr. AI Perception Engineer** to advance Anyware's production 3D AI perception stack for warehouse automation robots, with a focus on object localization, pose estimation, scene reconstruction, and deployment on robot compute within application cycle\-time constraints. This role is for an engineer who builds AI perception that works on real sensor data and physical systems — not only on benchmarks — and who wants to take it through production and real\-world operation. You will own perception capabilities end to end within your area — problem definition, model and pipeline development, deployment on robot hardware, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement — and make pragmatic tradeoffs across accuracy, reliability, latency, compute, data, maintainability, engineering effort, and delivery timelines. This is a hands\-on senior individual\-contributor role. You will own the design decisions in your area, contribute to architecture and design reviews, and work closely with the Perception Team Lead and Staff engineers who set technical direction across the perception stack. What you'll do * **Build 3D AI perception on physical systems, hands\-on** — develop robust object localization, pose estimation, and scene reconstruction models and pipelines using RGB\-D and other sensing modalities, running on robot compute within application cycle\-time constraints. * **Own perception capabilities end to end** — from problem definition and prototyping through deployment, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement within Anyware's existing perception stack. * **Improve perception reliability on physical robots** — diagnose and fix failures caused by difficult scenes, changing lighting, sensor noise, and gaps between training data and customer environments. * **Strengthen production readiness** — better data, evaluation, regression testing, release criteria, observability, and systematic root\-cause analysis of field failures. * **Make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs across the robot system** — balance accuracy, robustness, latency, compute cost, data availability, maintainability, and delivery timelines while integrating perception reliably with planning, manipulation, controls, and system software. Required Skills * BS, MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Vision, Computer Science, or a related field. * **3\+** years of professional experience developing **AI perception systems** for physical robots or comparable real\-world machines. * **Hands\-on proficiency building AI perception models** (PyTorch or similar) and real\-time perception pipelines in Python and C\+\+. Nice to have * Experience deploying and operating AI perception in production on physical robots — running models under latency and compute constraints on robot hardware and owning reliability in the field. * Strong foundation in 3D geometry, camera models and calibration, RGB\-D or point\-cloud processing, and 3D object localization, segmentation, or pose estimation. * Experience with ROS or ROS2 for real\-time robotic perception pipelines, including sensor\-data processing and model integration. * Experience deploying robotic perception systems in warehouse, logistics, or other industrial environments. Why Anyware * **An A\+ Team:** Anyware is built by top talents. Collectively, our team has won six Best Paper Awards and Finalists, including the ICRA 2025 Best Paper Award and ICRA 2024 Best Paper Award. * **An A\+ Robot:** Our robot, Pixmo, won the Best Innovation Award (top\-1\) at both ProMat 2025 and MODEX 2026 — the two largest logistics automation exhibitions in the world. Pixmo also won the RBR50 Robotics Innovation Award. * **Real Impact:** Your perception work does not stop at a demo. It ships into real customer sites, directly affects robot reliability and throughput, and must perform under real\-world variation. * **Fast Growth:** You will have strong ownership and real responsibility in a growing robotics company. * **Generous Equity:** We offer generous equity in addition to salary and benefits. Compensation The expected salary range for this role is 150K\-240K USD/year, depending on experience and qualifications. Additional compensation may include equity, benefits, or other incentives, where applicable. Benefits \& Perks * Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid sick leave * 401(k) plan support * Daily meal credit Equal Opportunity Statement Anyware is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. How to Apply Please submit your resume and any relevant materials through the **Anyware Career platform**. We look forward to learning more about your experience and interest in joining our team. #### **Salary** $150,000 \- $240,000 per year

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Biomolecular Structure Software
jobs.description: **About Astera** ---------------- Astera is a private foundation on a mission to steer science and technology toward a better future. We believe the coming years will bring an era of unprecedented scientific and technological advancement as exponential progress in AI converges with central advances in other fields to accelerate innovation. This inflection point provides an unparalleled opportunity to fundamentally rethink the institutions, systems, and tools that drive progress. We have committed a $3\.5B endowment to that work and fit the form of our support to the function it serves: grants, investments, and in\-house research programs. We accept meaningful risk in the research we back and expect some of it to fail because transformative ideas are rarely the ones already proven. Our projects, and the foundation itself, operate like high\-velocity startups, with a high performance bar and competitive compensation to match. We are searching for leaders who are compelled by the challenge of driving high\-impact change in the way science is funded, conducted, and communicated. You can read more about our mission, vision, and programming at astera.org/vision. **Team Overview** ----------------- Prism is making protein motion measurable, predictable, and actionable. Proteins are always moving, and that movement drives their function: binding, catalysis, allostery, selectivity, and mutational effects all emerge from conformational ensembles, the distribution of states a protein moves between. Yet most structural data rests on static snapshots that capture form, not function, because motion has been hard to measure and interpret. That has left us without critical levers to correct proteins in disease or engineer them for new purposes. We are building a team of structural biologists, computational scientists, and engineers to develop open tools, methods, and infrastructure for studying protein dynamics from experimental data. By combining experimental measurement, ensemble modeling, and machine learning, we aim to move structural biology from describing what proteins look like to predicting how they behave. Prism sits within Radial, Astera's life sciences division (https://astera.org/radial/). **Position Summary** -------------------- The Astera Institute’s Prism project seeks a full\-time on\-site software engineer to lead design and development of new software tools for working with biomolecular structures and experimental data used for biomolecular structure determination in a machine\-learning friendly way. The successful candidate will be involved in API design, architecture, and implementation of the package, as well as refactoring existing software to use the new tools. This position reports to the Machine Learning Team Lead. This is a full\-time position. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Reviewing existing APIs and codebases to identify constraints and needs * Reviewing existing requirements and translating them into a final API, and building consensus both within Prism and externally around that API * Working with scientists to define requirements. * Working with Prism and external scientists to identify where existing software libraries can be used and what must be built new. * Working with Prism and external scientists to ensure correctness of any calculations performed on structures and data. * Writing Python code to implement software, and possibly C/C\+\+ libraries as needed for high performance, including GPU kernels written with CUDA **Qualifications and Experience** --------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field with at least 5 years of work experience. * Experience building new software packages from the ground up. * A track record of building software for critical scientific applications. * Experience collaborating with scientists from diverse backgrounds. * Experience working with machine learning pipelines, data preparation, etc. (experience training ML models is not required). * Nice to have: experience with structural biology data. **Cultural Alignment** ---------------------- * Surprising problem\-solver – you love finding unexpected solutions to problems we don't even know we have, and see options where others only see constraints. * Flexible by default – you don't draw hard lines around your job description and expect requirements to evolve. * Bias to action – when in doubt, you build and test an idea. * High standards, internally driven – you don’t settle for the first thing that seems to work, you come up with new ways to break it to make sure it is correct. * Open to feedback – you create opportunities to give and receive honest feedback, staying focused on both personal and team growth. * Operate with the highest levels of integrity, judgment, and stewardship — you treat peers, collaborators, and vendors with genuine respect for their time and contributions. * Embrace the tools that define great work today – Astera is building for an AI\-driven future and equips the team accordingly. **Location** ------------ This position is on\-site at our Emeryville, CA location. Some travel (10%) may be required from time\-to\-time for in\-person collaboration and work. **Compensation** ---------------- **This role's pay range is $240,000 – $280,000 per year, based on experience, skills, and location.** **Benefits** ------------ Benefits include: * Top tier health insurance plans with 99% of premiums covered by Astera for employees and dependents * Daily lunch that brings the full office together, plus a well\-stocked fridge and pantry * Licenses for frontier AI tools and software * 403(b) retirement plans, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, commuter benefits, and health and dependent care FSAs **Equal Opportunity Employment \& Accommodations** -------------------------------------------------- Astera Institute is an equal opportunity employer and is invested in fostering a culture where everyone can thrive. We are committed to equity and inclusion, and we encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, older members of society, and others from minority communities and diverse backgrounds to apply. Astera Institute is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in the job application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please contact us at recruiting@astera.org and we will work with you to meet your needs. Compensation Range: $240K \- $280K

jobs.title: Materials Engineer
jobs.description: Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI\-native, all\-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro\-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex\-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date. Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara. ### **About The Role:** We are seeking a curious, hands\-on materials engineer to help develop and integrate materials and processes into market\-defining commercial devices. You will apply materials science fundamentals to understand how processing affects the structure and properties of metals and ceramics, working alongside experienced engineers to develop processes that meet device requirements. Your work will span materials processing, characterization, and property testing, with opportunities to build experience in heat treatment, thin\-film deposition, bonding, and other fabrication techniques. You will help evaluate incoming materials, investigate how processing changes their behavior, and use experimental results to improve process consistency and performance. You will also collaborate with adjacent teams to transfer established processes from our prototyping fab to our digital, autonomous manufacturing platform. This full\-time position is based in our Emeryville site within the Process Engineering organization. ### **What You'll Do:** * Plan and execute experiments to understand processing–structure–property relationships across a range of materials, with a focus on metals and ceramics. * Own assigned process development tasks and projects, troubleshoot issues, and contribute improvements to procedures and tool capabilities. * Operate materials processing equipment for applications such as rolling, forming, alloy heat treatment, thin\-film deposition, and bonding. * Apply bulk and surface characterization techniques to evaluate materials and monitor process outputs. * Help evaluate incoming materials through supplier documentation review and in\-house testing, and contribute to refining material specifications. * Collaborate with engineers, technicians, and operators to develop processes and transfer materials, procedures, and supporting documentation into fabrication workflows. * Follow established processing and safety protocols, analyze experimental data, document procedures, maintain accurate records, and communicate key findings. ### **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field, with 2–3 years of relevant experience, including research or internships. * Working knowledge of physical metallurgy and processing–structure–property relationships in metals and alloys. * Hands\-on experience processing or characterizing metals, alloys, or coatings. * Experience with one or more materials characterization techniques (e.g., metallography, SEM, EDS, EBSD, XRF, XRD) or material property tests (e.g., tensile, hardness, fatigue, micro\- or nanoindentation). * Ability to plan systematic experiments, interpret results critically, and communicate findings clearly. Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI\-assisted tools.

measurable outcomes. * **Market Development \& Customer Discovery:** Identify and validate ideal customer profiles, understand scientific and engineering user needs, and develop effective approaches positioning around Axiomatic AI's core principles of verifiable, reliable, and physics\-grounded artificial intelligence. * **Commercial Expansion:** Identify opportunities to extend product applications beyond photonics and semiconductors into additional scientific and engineering domains, collaborating with product teams to translate market requirements into product development priorities. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with founders, product leadership, scientists, and engineers to align business development activities with technical capabilities and long\-term product strategy. * **Performance \& Accountability:** Own and track key commercial and product adoption metrics, regularly communicate progress to leadership, and proactively identify opportunities to improve results. #### **Key requirements** * **5\-10 years of relevant experience** in software business development, software sales, or commercial growth roles, with a demonstrated track record of bringing technical software products to market and driving adoption. * **Educational background in physics, applied physics, mathematics, engineering, or a closely related scientific or technical discipline,** combined with practical experience in scientific or engineering environments. * Experience commercializing technical software products, ideally SaaS platforms, AI\-powered tools, scientific software, or engineering applications. * Strong understanding of the software go\-to\-market lifecycle, including customer discovery, segmentation, positioning, acquisition, and commercial execution. * Demonstrated ability to develop strategic partnerships, establish relationships with technical stakeholders, and navigate complex sales or adoption cycles. * Ability to understand sophisticated technical products and translate their capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions for scientific and engineering audiences. * Strong commercial judgment, analytical skills, and the ability to define priorities, measure outcomes, and adapt strategies based on market feedback. * Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively with founders, senior leadership, and highly technical teams. * **Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability,** with the ability to independently navigate ambiguity, solve problems, and drive initiatives forward. * Fast learner with intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to operate effectively in an early\-stage, rapidly evolving deep\-tech environment. #### **Nice to have** * Experience in the semiconductor, photonics, scientific computing, or broader deep\-tech ecosystem. * Previous experience as a scientist, physicist, or engineer before transitioning into business development, technical sales, or other customer\-facing commercial roles. * Experience with scientific software platforms, computational tools, or AI products comparable in application to Mathematica or emerging AI\-powered research assistants. * Background in forward\-deployed engineering, technical solutions engineering, or customer\-facing AI implementation, combined with commercial experience. * Established relationships within academic research institutions, scientific organizations, or engineering communities. * Experience developing go\-to\-market strategies for early\-stage software products or expanding technical products into new markets. * Familiarity with user acquisition and engagement strategies for self\-service or product\-led SaaS platforms. #### **What we offer** * **Competitive Compensation:** A competitive compensation package reflecting your experience and contribution. * **Stock Options Plan:** Empowering you to share in our success and growth. * **Cutting\-Edge Technology:** The opportunity to bring next\-generation, verifiable AI technology to scientific and engineering markets. * **Strategic Ownership:** A high\-impact role with significant autonomy and direct involvement in shaping the commercial growth of a core Axiomatic AI product. * **Collaboration with Leading Experts:** Work directly with founders, AI researchers, physicists, engineers, and product leaders at the forefront of scientific AI. * **Professional Growth:** Opportunities to build partnerships across leading research institutions, industry organizations, and emerging technical ecosystems. * **Impact\-Driven Culture:** Join a team focused on solving some of the most challenging problems at the intersection of AI, science, and hardware engineering. #### **Work model \& location expectations** * **Primary location:** Singapore or Boston, Massachusetts, USA * **Employment jobs.title: Control Systems Specialist I
jobs.description: **Accelerate Your Career in Automation \& Controls at BW SYSTEMS, INC.** **Controls Engineer ? Early Career** Have a passion for figuring out how things work? Curious about technology, automation, and solving complex problems? Ready to turn what you've learned into real\-world engineering solutions? BW Systems is looking for an emerging engineering professional who is eager to learn, take initiative, and grow their career in industrial automation and controls. Join an experienced engineering team where you'll have the opportunity to work on complex, customized automation solutions that power manufacturing equipment and industrial processes. You'll gain hands\-on experience with PLC programming, electrical control systems, motion control, robotics, and advanced automation technologies while learning from experienced engineers. You don't need to know everything coming in. We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, a curious mind, sound problem\-solving skills who thrives on the thrill of mastering new challenges. **What You'll Work On** You'll be involved in projects from initial design and programming through testing, commissioning, and startup. As your knowledge and experience grow, so will your responsibilities. Assist with the design, development, and programming of PLC and HMI systems using Allen\-Bradley platforms. Learn to develop and troubleshoot automation programs using Studio 5000 / RSLogix 5000\. Work with industrial control hardware, electrical schematics, sensors, instrumentation, and control devices. Gain exposure to motion control systems, servo drives, robotics, and automated material handling equipment. Help develop control strategies for manufacturing processes and automated equipment. Learn how industrial communication networks connect machines, controllers, and devices. Participate in factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), equipment commissioning, and system startup. Assist with troubleshooting electrical and controls issues, developing practical solutions, and improving system performance. Develop engineering documentation, including electrical drawings, I/O lists, functional specifications, and control system documentation. Collaborate with experienced engineers, electrical designers, technicians, and project teams. Take ownership of assigned tasks and progressively assume greater responsibility as your technical skills develop. **What You Bring** We're more interested in your potential, curiosity, and ability to learn than the number of years you've been in the industry. Education \& Technical Foundation Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering field. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Understanding of basic electrical principles, control systems, and engineering fundamentals. Exposure to PLCs, automation, programming, robotics, or industrial control systems through coursework, internships, co\-ops, or personal projects is a plus. Familiarity with electrical schematics, circuit design, or electrical components is beneficial. **How You Think \& Work** Naturally curious and interested in understanding how things work. Strong critical\-thinking and problem\-solving skills. You enjoy working through challenges rather than simply looking for the answer. Self\-motivated and capable of independently researching, learning, and working through unfamiliar technical problems. Comfortable asking questions, seeking feedback, and learning from experienced professionals. Takes initiative and follows through on commitments and assigned responsibilities. Able to break down complex problems, think logically, and consider different approaches to finding solutions. Adaptable and comfortable working on different projects, technologies, and challenges. Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others. Most importantly, we want someone who is excited to learn, willing to challenge themselves, and motivated to become an excellent controls engineer. **Why BW Systems?** BW Systems, Inc., located in South Saint Paul, is a premier automation solutions company specializing in custom, complex projects that power manufacturing equipment and industrial processes. At BW Systems, you won't be working on the same project every day. You'll have the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, explore a variety of automation technologies, and see your engineering work become real operating equipment. We're known as a "hidden gem" employer because we give talented engineers and technicians the opportunity to build meaningful careers while working on diverse projects across multiple industries. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who can help you develop your technical skills, expand your knowledge, and build a career in an exciting and evolving industry. If you enjoy figuring things out, learning new technologies, and seeing your ideas turn into real\-world solutions, BW Systems could be the place to launch your engineering career. **What We Offer** BW Systems believes in rewarding employees with competitive pay, strong benefits, and opportunities to grow. Salary Range: $85,000?$110,000 annually, depending on qualifications, experience, and demonstrated skills. Eligible employees receive: Medical, dental, and vision insurance Health Savings Account with annual employer contribution Nice Healthcare Employer\-paid life and AD\&D insurance Voluntary supplemental insurance 401(k) plan with company match Paid time off and paid holidays Minnesota ESST and applicable paid leave benefits Professional growth and technical development opportunities Collaborative, team\-oriented work environment Exposure to diverse automation, controls, and manufacturing projects

jobs.title: Fulfillment Automation Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. As a Fulfillment Automation Solution Engineer, you will be a founding member of FAST, the Fulfillment Automation Solutions Team. FAST's mandate is to deliver Beacon Platform tools and automation to Beacon's fulfillment centers and clinical sites, so that forward and reverse logistics and fulfillment flows can scale. You will work closely with Beacon's Platform and Device Engineering teams as well as fulfillment center employees, partners and customers to design and ship self\-serve tools and automation to support efficient and reliable operation of our fulfillment programs. This role is part of Platform Engineering and reports to the Head of Reliability and Security. It is an individual contributor role at the Software Engineer IV (IC4\) level that will act as FAST's first tech lead, helping to set the roadmap, coordinating initiatives, and helping hire and onboard the engineers who join after you. This role does not have direct reports. The role is based in Boston or Chicago, and some travel to fulfillment centers and customer sites around the US is required. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York and Paris. **What success looks like:** * You regularly visit Beacon's fulfillment centers, channel partners, and customers to observe and map their workflows first\-hand to inform FAST's roadmap. * You lead design and architecture for FAST's automation and tooling, weigh implementation tradeoffs using engineering principles and data, and anticipate the long\-term impact of those decisions so they translate into outcomes for Beacon, its partners, and customer sites. * You ship Beacon Platform automation for the highest\-impact opportunities you uncover, so that Beacon's forward and reverse fulfillment and logistics flows run reliably and efficiently. * You know everything that goes into a successful, high quality release, from validation and documentation to training and communication, and you work to make adoption of new tools and workflows successful by building repeatable playbooks for onboarding and change management. * You recognize that not all tools should be built from scratch. You weigh building against integrating with the systems warehouses, partners, and sites already use such as warehouse and logistics management systems, enabling them to continue using the tools they've already optimized for their workflows while expanding support for Beacon devices and services. * You and your team have taken over intake and triage of fulfillment and device\-return issues from the engineers who cover them manually today, with clear runbooks and a tracked backlog of every issue type. * You plan and prioritize your own work and the team's work, collaborating with key stakeholders. You make reasoned tradeoffs between speed, generalizability and debt, based on the needs of multiple stakeholder teams, and you can explain how FAST's work affects other teams. * You work across our partner engineering teams, debugging ambiguous problems across systems beyond your team's purview and turning recurring field issues into root\-cause fixes. * You leave the codebase better than you found it by improving structure, test coverage and development tooling. * You coach and mentor other Beaconeers, give actionable feedback that drives improvement, recommend improvements to team practices, and help set timelines and methods for new assignments as team or tech lead. * You measure what matters, such as the number of cases that still need an engineer and time to resolve, or the time it takes to onboard a new site or partner, and use it to decide what to build next. **What you will bring:** * 5\-8 years of professional software engineering experience, including building internal tools, workflow automation or system integrations. * High proficiency in at least one technical area, with a record of writing correct, well\-tested code that others can easily understand and maintain. * Experience efficiently debugging and profiling ambiguous problems across systems and codebases, including data pipelines and device or upload workflows. * Experience leading design and architecture for complex projects and systems, and backing up decisions with data. * Experience working across teams and domains, and directly with non\-engineering users or external partners, to understand their workflow and ship tools they can use on their own. * Experience coaching and mentoring less experienced engineers, and leading or coordinating the work of others as a team or tech lead. Direct management experience is not required. * Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience] * Preferred: experience with logistics, warehouse or fulfillment systems, or with returns and reverse\-logistics flows. * Preferred: experience in a regulated environment, such as medical devices, where traceability and compliance matter. * Traits and behaviors: curious, biased toward simple solutions, comfortable in a new team where the process is still being defined, a strong written communicator in an async environment, and empathetic to the people who rely on your tools. The base salary range for this role is $170,000 – $190,000\. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits. At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and \- most of all \- a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Engineering Simulation & Design Exploration
jobs.description: **About the Role** Engineering simulation is undergoing a structural shift. What used to be a slow, solver\-driven process is becoming a fast, exploration\-driven workflow, enabled by surrogate models, physics\-informed AI, and GPU\-accelerated methods. This changes not just how simulations run, but how engineers design—moving from evaluating a few options to exploring entire design spaces. We are looking for a **hands\-on Applied AI Engineer** to experiment with these emerging technologies. Your role is to try new tools, test them, benchmark them, integrate them into prototypes, determine what actually works in practice, and give an informed decision on its viability in Bentley’s products. The goal is to develop a clear understanding of where these approaches can realistically transform engineering workflows—and where they cannot. This is an experimental role. You will spend most of your time building and testing prototypes, not writing reports or maintaining production systems. \*\****This role does not offer sponsorship*** **What You Will Do:** * Keep track of new technologies in the field * Evaluate emerging simulation and AI tools through hands\-on prototyping * Build and benchmark surrogate models against traditional FEM/CFD workflows * Test robustness, limitations, and failure modes of new approaches * Prototype hybrid pipelines (e.g., surrogate \+ high\-fidelity validation) * Explore how these approaches can integrate into real engineering workflows * Report to stakeholders with clear recommendations **What We Are Looking For:** **Requirements:** * Strong programming ability (Python required) * Experience with PyTorch, JAX, or similar ML frameworks * Solid understanding of numerical simulation: + FEM, CFD, or multiphysics modeling * Familiarity with: + Deep learning, surrogate modeling, reduced\-order models, or optimization workflows + Good communication skills and collaborative mindset **Highly Valued** * Experience building experimental or research prototypes * Understanding of design space exploration (DOE, parameter studies, combinatorial optimization) * Exposure to physics\-informed ML or scientific machine learning * Experience working with GPU or high\-performance computing environments * Experience working with machine learning for physics simulations * Hands\-on experience developing Multiphysics simulation code **Mindset** * Hands\-on, experimental, and comfortable working with incomplete tools * Curious but skeptical—focuses on what works, not what is claimed * Naturally tests limits and edge cases, not just happy paths * Thinks in terms of workflows and iteration loops, not isolated tools Able to quickly move from idea prototype* insight * Good business acumen; able to understand what brings value to Bentley **What Success Looks Like** * You build prototypes that demonstrate new ways to accelerate design workflows * You identify where AI\-based approaches are genuinely useful—and where they fail * You provide clear, evidence\-based insights grounded in experiments, not assumptions . This is a Hybrid role. **What We Offer:** * Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success. * An attractive salary and benefits package. * Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice. * Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform. * A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. * Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact. **Who We Are:** Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry\-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: *Please note that we are not currently accepting resumes or additional support from talent agencies or third\-party sources. Any resumes received from these sources will be considered unsolicited. We value integrity and clear communication with our partners, and appreciate your understanding in this matter.* **The role, at a glance:** Biamp is bringing a SaaS web application in\-house from a third\-party development partner, and we’re hiring a DevOps Engineer to lead the technical side of that transition. You’ll migrate the build and deployment pipelines from GitHub Actions to our internal Bitbucket and Jenkins environment, then own the resulting CI/CD infrastructure and 24x7 production operations going forward. This is a high\-leverage role: you’ll set the patterns that govern how our Software Operations team runs this platform for years, and you’ll do it with executive visibility because the in\-sourcing itself is a strategic initiative. **How you'll contribute:** * **Lead the migration.** Move build and deployment pipelines from GitHub Actions to Bitbucket and Jenkins with a clear cutover plan, validation gates, and rollback path. Capture institutional knowledge from the outgoing partner along the way. * **Own CI/CD.** Architect and maintain the Jenkins pipelines, shared libraries, and supporting tooling that the development teams rely on every day. Continuously cut build and deployment times. * **Run production.** Take responsibility for 24x7 availability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Define SLOs and SLIs, drive incidents to resolution, and reduce toil through automation. * **Manage cloud infrastructure as code.** Stand up and evolve the underlying cloud infrastructure using Terraform (or equivalent IaC), with consistent, repeatable, reviewable changes. * **Keep us secure and compliant.** Build pipelines and artifact\-management practices that hold up under our security and regulatory commitments, including secure build, signing, and provenance. * **Plan for failure.** Maintain disaster\-recovery and business\-continuity plans, run DR drills, and meet defined RTO and RPO targets. * **Partner with developers.** Work directly with the application teams to shape a workflow that’s fast and pleasant to use, and document it well enough that newcomers can self\-serve. **A successful candidate should have:** * 3\+ years in DevOps, SRE, or a closely related role, including production responsibility for a SaaS application. * Hands\-on experience with both GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines — enough to confidently translate workflows from one to the other. * Strong Jenkins fundamentals: pipeline\-as\-code (Jenkinsfile), shared libraries, and the plugin ecosystem. * Comfort with Git workflows and repository management across GitHub and Bitbucket. * Working knowledge of a major cloud platform (AWS or Azure) across compute, storage, networking, and managed services. * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, or similar. * Solid scripting in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or comparable. * Experience deploying .NET applications (MSBuild, NuGet, IIS or Kestrel). * Working knowledge of containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience with monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana. * Track record on an on\-call rotation, including running or contributing to incident response. * Clear written and verbal communication — you’ll be working closely with both internal teams and an outgoing third\-party partner. **Some nice\-to\-haves:** ------------------------- * Familiarity with JFrog Artifactory, JFrog Xray, or JFrog Advanced Security. * Experience with SonarQube or comparable code\-quality tooling. * Exposure to NIST SSDF, EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), SOC 2, or similar frameworks. * Prior experience moving a product from third\-party management to in\-house operations. * Configuration management with Ansible, Puppet, or Chef. * Application security tooling (OWASP, SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning). * Database and data\-migration experience (SQL Server, PostgreSQL). * Log aggregation and analysis (ELK, Splunk). * CDN configuration, feature flags, or progressive delivery. * AWS or Azure certification. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent experience is fine. **What we offer:** * Medical, Dental, and Vision * 3 weeks annual PTO and 9 paid holidays * 401(k) \+ matching * Employer\-paid base life insurance, short, and long\-term disability * Health savings accounts (with Biamp contribution) and flexible spending accounts * Tuition reimbursement * Charitable donation matching * Discretionary company achievement bonus * Referral bonuses **Who is Biamp?** We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space. As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences. **About our company:** At Biamp, we believe the employment relationship should be reciprocal. We want you to love your job, and we want your expertise and knowledge to help drive our business forward. We champion a supportive and dynamic environment filled with passionate people who choose continuous improvement over perfection. We insist on clear, explicit decision making, believe in taking calculated risks, and celebrate tough decisions even when they don’t succeed. We look for people who desire the best from themselves and encourage the same from their coworkers. Our commitment to one another and to the common goal is the most consistent reliable path to recurring success for all of us.

jobs.description: It all started with an idea at Block in 2013\. Initially built to take the pain out of peer\-to\-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50\+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible. Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy. **The Role** The Advanced Insights and Modeling (AIM) team is a high\-impact, business\-savvy group of builders: machine learning engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and business strategists who combine technical skills with deep product and financial expertise. We hold high standards, move fast, and own our models end to end. AIM runs on curiosity, bold thinking, and collaboration, and we keep the culture decidedly non\-corporate. Teams across Block come to us when they need insight, speed, and real business impact. AIM sits within Block’s Foundational organization and is sponsored directly by the CFO, but our mandate runs well beyond Finance. We own most of the measurement and predictive modeling at Block: forecasting across Cash App, Square, and Afterpay, customer lifetime value, marketing incrementality and spend optimization, sales pipeline and prospect value, and actives and network\-effect measurement. Finance, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Risk all plan against numbers we produce. We also own the data foundations those models run on, and corporate functions including Finance, Accounting, Treasury, SFS, and Procurement increasingly come to us when they want to rethink how their work gets done with AI. **Automation across the enterprise.** AIM leads Block’s Foundational Automation program, a CFO\-sponsored effort to rebuild how Finance, Accounting, Treasury, SFS, and Procurement operate. Rather than layering AI on top of existing workflows, we rebuild the underlying data and process layer so that agents can take on the work itself: monitoring pipelines, reconciling positions, triaging exceptions, and escalating only the decisions that need a person. In Treasury, you will define and build the data systems and controls that make this automation reliable. **The Treasury opportunity.** Block moves money through hundreds of bank accounts across multiple legal entities, and Treasury’s view of that position today is stitched together from bank portals, a liquidity tool, portfolio accounting, and the general ledger, with the gaps closed by hand. No single system tells Treasury, in near real time, where every dollar sits and whether the books agree. You will build that system from the ground up. **Your mandate.** You will own the technical direction and hands\-on development of Treasury’s data foundation. Treasury manages Block’s own cash, liquidity, and investments across its businesses and legal entities. You will work directly with Treasury and Accounting to understand how they operate, identify what needs to change, and turn those needs into a technical roadmap. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will make architecture and build\-versus\-buy recommendations, decide what to tackle first, and personally build and operate the core data systems. We’re looking for someone who can take an open\-ended business problem through to a working solution, bringing clear recommendations when decisions need broader agreement. Treasury is the first function to get this treatment. The architecture, controls, and operating model you establish will become the template for Accounting, Procurement, and the rest of Foundational. **Your initial priorities.** You will shape the roadmap around three connected needs: * **A trusted liquidity position.** Bring bank, custodian, portfolio accounting, and general ledger data into a reliable entity\-level view in Snowflake. Define the architecture, reconciliation approach, and data quality controls, then build the pipelines and data models. * **A foundation for forecasting.** Partner with AIM’s ML engineers to establish the datasets, features, and data contracts for predicting cash inflows and outflows. Own the underlying data systems through production. * **A clear direction for Treasury systems.** Lead the technical recommendation for Block’s 2027 Treasury Management System decision: what to build, what to buy, and how the pieces should fit together. Define the integration and migration approach for the chosen direction. If you already have a Candidate Account, please Sign\-In before you apply.** **Job Description:** -------------------- We are looking for an experienced **AI Systems Thermal Engineer** to lead the end\-to\-end thermal design, simulation, optimization, and physical validation of Direct\-to\-Chip (D2C) liquid cooling solutions for next\-generation AI accelerators and high\-density compute platforms. In this role, you will own the thermal\-hydraulic performance of custom cold plates, interface materials, and fluid delivery subsystems—ensuring our high\-power ASICs operate within safe thermal limits at peak workloads. You will collaborate closely with silicon package designers, board layout teams, mechanical housing engineers, and manufacturing partners from concept through mass production. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Thermal \& CFD Modeling:** Build and run detailed Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and thermal\-resistance network models to evaluate temperature distribution, pressure drop, and flow balancing across cold plates, trays, and racks. * **Advanced Technology Implementation:** Research advanced cooling technologies and develop integration and test plans to validate these technologies and convert them into production solutions. * **Cold Plate Design \& Optimization:** Co\-design high\-performance liquid cold plates with strategic industry partners to cool high\-heat\-flux AI processors. * **Thermal Interface Materials (TIM):** Specify, select, and qualify thermal interface materials for large, high warpage, devices to minimize contact resistance between silicon dies and cold plates on large devices * **System \& Hydraulic Integration:** Design coolant flow paths, quick\-disconnects (QDs), hoses, and cold\-plate retention/loading mechanisms in alignment with server chassis and OCP (Open Compute Project) standards. * **Lab Validation \& Testing:** Plan and execute physical thermal testing in the lab—including thermocouple instrumentation, pressure/flow mapping, thermal test vehicle (TTV) bring\-up, and simulation\-to\-test correlation. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with mechanical, electrical, firmware (thermal control algorithms), and supply chain teams to drive PCBA, tray and system level designs from NPI (New Product Introduction) to high\-volume manufacturing. **Qualifications \& Requirements:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Mechanical or Thermal Engineering** (M.S. preferred), or equivalent. * **Experience:** Bachelors plus 8\+ years of experience, or Masters plus 6\+ years of experience. Hands\-on experience in thermal/mechanical design for high\-power electronics, AI hardware, servers, or HPC systems. * Proven, direct experience designing and deploying **Direct Liquid Cooling (DLC)** systems, specifically **liquid cold plates**, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and manifold loops. **Technical Skills:** * **Electronics Cooling:** Deep understanding of single\-phase and/or two\-phase heat transfer, fluid dynamics, pressure drop calculations, and electronics packaging interactions. Experience with air cooled systems also an asset. * **Simulation Tools:** High proficiency in CFD and thermal analysis software (preferably Flotherm, FloEFD, and MacroFlow.). * **Lab Instrumentation:** Experience with thermal data acquisition systems, flow meters, pressure transducers, and lab automation (Python, MATLAB, or LabVIEW). * **CAD \& Mechanical Design:** Experience with electronics packaging and CAD platforms, preferably CREO, an asset. **Compensation and Benefits** The annual base salary range for this position is USD To USD As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements. Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. The company follows all applicable laws for Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence. **Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law.** **If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence.**

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data & AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Your Job** Brooks is advancing its enterprise AI, data, analytics, and innovation capabilities to help teams make better decisions, move faster, improve operations, and create meaningful value for runners, teammates, and the business. The Senior Manager, Data and AIEngineering will lead the technical teams responsible for building the trusted data foundations, scalable AI engineering capabilities, and production\-ready platforms that power Brooks’ next generation of data and AI solutions. This role is accountable for leading the engineering function that turns business opportunities into reliable, secure, scalable, and reusable technical capabilities. The Senior Manager will oversee data engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, integration patterns, platform engineering practices, engineering standards, and production operations for AI and data\-enabled products. **Your Responsibilities** **Lead Data Engineering and AI Engineering Strategy** * Own the engineering strategy for data platforms, AI solutions, machine learning systems, AI\-enabled applications, data pipelines, APIs, and reusable engineering patterns. * Partner with Brooks Enterprise AI \& Data Solutions (BEADS) leadership, product management, architecture, governance, security, cloud operations, and business stakeholders to define engineering priorities and delivery plans. * Translate Brooks’ AI and data strategy into a practical engineering roadmap that supports trusted data, practical AI, disciplined innovation, and measurable business value. * Set overarching objectives and ensure engineering investments support scalable data foundations, reusable AI capabilities, self\-service analytics, experimentation, automation, and production\-grade delivery. * Help Brooks move from one\-off AI and data projects to repeatable engineering capabilities that can scale across business functions **Manage and Develop Engineering Talent** * Lead, coach, and develop data engineers, AI engineers, ML engineers, solution engineers, platform engineers, and related technical contributors. * Build a high\-performing engineering culture based on technical excellence, ownership, continuous learning, collaboration, and Brooks values. * Set clear expectations for engineering quality, documentation, maintainability, delivery discipline, production readiness, and operational support. * Establish technical direction and mentor engineers on architecture, design patterns, code quality, data modeling, MLOps, LLMOps, observability, testing, security, and responsible AI delivery. * Own workforce and resource planning for the function, identifying capacity, capability, and skill gaps and recommending hiring, development, or external partnership strategies. * Support hiring, onboarding, role clarity, career development, performance management, and skill growth across the engineering team. **Build Data Foundations** * Lead the design, development, and modernization of enterprise data pipelines, data products, data models, integration patterns, and analytics\-ready datasets. * Ensure data engineering practices support quality, reliability, lineage, governance, access controls, and business usability. * Support scalable data delivery across domains such as product innovation, supply chain, marketing, retail experience, finance, HR, legal, and IT. * Establish engineering patterns that make data easier to discover, access, understand, and use responsibly. **Scale AI and ML Engineering Capabilities** * Lead the engineering practices required to move AI and machine learning solutions from prototype to production. * Establish reusable patterns for model deployment, model integration, API development, orchestration, monitoring, retraining workflows, and operational handoff. * Partner with data scientists, AI solution engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to convert promising use cases into production\-ready capabilities. * Support engineering for generative AI, predictive models, recommendation engines, optimization models, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, semantic search, and workflow automation where appropriate **Establish Engineering Standards and Production Discipline** * Define and reinforce engineering standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, version control, documentation, data quality checks, monitoring, logging, alerting, and release readiness. * Ensure teams build production\-minded solutions that can be operated, supported, maintained, and improved over time. * Partner with architecture and cloud operations to ensure solutions align with enterprise technology patterns, cloud standards, security requirements, and platform strategy. * Drive technical debt management and ensure engineering work balances speed, quality, scalability, and long\-term maintainability. **Partner Across Product, Program, Architecture, and Business Teams** * Work closely with Product Managers and Technical Product Managers to ensure engineering wor  and responsible AI expectations. * Partner with AI governance and data governance stakeholders to ensure sensitive data, intellectual property, model behavior, vendor integrations, and AI outputs are managed responsibly. * Ensure engineering teams understand and follow Brooks’ policies, architectural standards, security practices, and responsible AI expectations. * Help create a culture where innovation and governance work together rather than against each other. **Drive Value, Reliability, and Continuous Improvement** * Measure engineering success based on business value delivered, platform reliability, engineering throughput, solution adoption, quality, reuse, and operational health. * Use metrics, retrospectives, incident learnings, stakeholder feedback, and delivery data to continuously improve engineering practices. * Identify opportunities to reduce delivery friction, improve developer experience, automate manual work, and increase reuse. **Work Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field. MBA, master’s degree, or advanced technical degree preferred, but not required. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree. * 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, platform engineering, analytics engineering, or related technical disciplines. * 5\+ years of people leadership experience, including direct or matrixed leadership of technical teams. * Experience leading teams that design, build, deploy, and operate scalable data platforms, data pipelines, AI/ML solutions, APIs, integrations, or enterprise technology platforms. * Strong technical fluency across data engineering, cloud platforms, data modeling, APIs, software development, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, system integration, and production operations. * Experience with Snowflake, AWS, Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, semantic layers, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, orchestration tools, or enterprise integration platforms. * Experience with generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, AI agents, embeddings, vector databases, model serving, prompt management, or AI application development. * Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, model monitoring, feature stores, data observability, logging, alerting, and production support. * Ability to translate business needs into practical technical direction and help teams make sound architecture and implementation tradeoff decisions. * Experience in agile, iterative, test\-and\-learn, or product\-based delivery environments. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated ability to embody and role model Brooks values **Benefits** Brooks is proud to offer a robust benefits package to our employees and their families! * Benefits\- including medical, dental, vision, life and AD\&D insurance, disability insurance, HSA and employer contribution, FSA, family \& fertility assistance, 401K Savings Plan and match, employee assistance program, and transportation assistance. * Paid Time Off\- Brooks offers generous time off including five weeks of paid time off, eleven paid holidays, paid sick and parental leave. * Bonus\- in addition to base pay, Brooks employees may also be offered an annual bonus based on company performance. * Perks\- including product discounts, employee recognition, fitness discounts, volunteer and donation benefits. * Location\- You will spend 4 days per week in our Seattle offices, as we believe our organization flourishes when connections, collaboration, creativity, problem\-solving, and celebrations happen in person. **Compensation:** The pay range for this position, based out of the Brooks Seattle HQ, is $169,246 \- $270,815 per year. Base pay offered will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Analyst - Phoenix, AZ or Remote
jobs.description: **Please send a link of something you have built, such as a project on GitHub or a similar site. It can be big or small, the more unique the better. Please send to Tommy.Grace@livebryten.com** At **Bryten,** we're more than just a place to live—we're a community where residents feel welcomed, valued, and connected. We are seeking a data\-driven **AI Solutions Analyst** to join our team and help transform the way we work through innovative AI solutions, intelligent automation, and data\-driven insights. This role will play a key part in leveraging emerging technology to streamline operations, enhance decision\-making, and create smarter, more efficient experiences across our organization. We build and run our own business apps and reporting on Domo, with AI agents doing a lot of the building. The apps are in daily use by the people who run the portfolio. This role owns a handful of those apps from the first conversation to the thirtieth release: sit with the operators, learn how they work, ship what they need, and keep it running well after launch. **What You’ll Be Doing** * Own a set of apps or dashboards end to end, such as portfolio performance reporting, construction management billing, property and client lists, contracts and transitions tracking, and payroll tools. * Work directly with the operators who use them (asset directors, accounting, construction admin, property operations, HR) to gather requests, run walkthroughs, and get sign\-off before anything ships. * Build new features and fixes in our Domo custom apps and App Studio apps, using AI coding tools and agents. * Build internal automations and AI agents that take manual steps out of someone's week, using Domo Workflows, Code Engine and AI services. * Be the ongoing support: triage questions and bugs, keep a clear backlog, and release small and often. * Document what you build in our shared team notes so anyone can pick it up. * Ship every change through a reviewed pull request. **Tasks*** Own a set of apps or dashboards end to end, such as portfolio performance reporting, construction management billing, property and client lists, contracts and transitions tracking, and payroll tools. * Work directly with the operators who use them (asset directors, accounting, construction admin, property operations, HR) to gather requests, run walkthroughs, and get sign\-off before anything ships. * Build new features and fixes in our Domo custom apps and App Studio apps, using AI coding tools and agents. * Build internal automations and AI agents that take manual steps out of someone's week, using Domo Workflows, Code Engine and AI services. * Be the ongoing support: triage questions and bugs, keep a clear backlog, and release small and often. * Document what you build in our shared team notes so anyone can pick it up. * Ship every change through a reviewed pull request. **How we build*** Research, then shape the idea with the operator, then a go decision, then scaffold, build, publish and document. Nothing is built before it is shaped. * React and Vite for custom apps, published to Domo. Domo App Studio, cards, Workflows, Code Engine and AppDB for the rest. * Git from the first line, small commits, pull requests with a reviewer. * Claude Code and other AI tools are part of the normal workflow, along with a shared team playbook and notes so the AI and the people work from the same facts. **What we are looking for** * Comfortable talking with non\-technical business users and turning what they say into something that works. * Has built apps or internal tools, in any stack, and is excited to build with AI tools. * Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, SQL and React, or the ability to pick them up fast. * Extensive knowledge of front end visual elements and when to use them for impactful design. * Willingness to research and stay on the forefront of ever\-evolving agentic tools and procedures. * Understanding of collaborative cloud development environments like GitHub. * Good judgment about scope: small, useful, finished beats big and late. * Reliable, curious, and likes owning something after it launches. **Nice to have*** Domo experience (App Studio, Magic ETL, custom apps). Preferred, not required. We will teach it. * Experience with Yardi, RealPage, Paycom or other property management or accounting systems. * Real estate, property management or finance background. * Prior work building or using AI agents and automations. **Please send a link of something you have built, such as a project on GitHub or a similar site. It can be big or small, the more unique the better. Please send to Tommy.Grace@livebryten.com** **\*\* Must reside in one of the states Bryten does business in. \*\***
