jobs.title: Principal Project Systems & Execution
jobs.description: Position: Principal Project Systems \& Execution Salary: $160,000\-$200,000 On Site Reports to VP of Operations/Director of Engineering **Basic Function** The Senior Manager, Technical Programs leads Bullen's most important cross\-functional projects and builds the simple, repeatable system the whole company uses to start, run, and finish important work. Working with the leadership team, this person turns strategic priorities ("rocks") into clearly chartered, well\-resourced projects. They personally lead Bullen's most complex capital, technical, and cross\-functional projects. They build on the team charter work already proven in engineering to create a project framework that fits Bullen's size and culture. They give leadership clear visibility into project health and resource capacity. The role leads mainly through influence. Functional managers keep responsibility for their people, technical decisions, and departmental deliverables. This person makes ownership clear, surfaces risks early, and develops managers and emerging leaders so smaller projects can run well inside their own departments. The goal is not the most sophisticated system possible. It is a practical, well\-documented, low\-burden system that people choose to use, introduced at a pace Bullen can sustain. This person leads the Bullen way, through teamwork, excellence, humility, and integrity, so that projects bring people together, everyone knows their role, and every voice is heard. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Lead Strategic and Cross\-Functional Projects*** Partner with the leadership team to translate Bullen's rocks into chartered projects with clear scope, sponsors, owners, timelines, resources, and measures of success. * Personally lead Bullen's highest\-priority capital, technical, and cross\-functional projects from charter through closeout. * Work with functional managers to build integrated schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans. * Run effective project meetings, communication routines, action tracking, and follow\-up. * Identify schedule, resource, technical, and execution risks early, and work with managers on practical solutions. * Facilitate decisions while keeping technical decisions with the right subject\-matter experts and functional leaders. * Run a disciplined process for reviewing and approving scope changes. * Use data to respectfully challenge unrealistic commitments, and bring leadership alternatives and recommendations. * Choose Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid methods based on what each project needs. * Build structured problem\-solving and risk tools (DMAIC, FMEA, risk register, root cause analysis, DOE, SPC, value stream mapping) into planning and execution where they add value. * Lead project closeout and lessons learned to improve future work. **Build Bullen's Project System and Capability** Learn how projects are run at Bullen today, and work with the managers and employees who lead them now. * Design, document, and own Bullen's team and project charter process, from idea intake and approval through kickoff, execution, and closeout. * Build on what already works, including engineering's team charters and the existing project charter template. * Set up a tiered project classification, aligned with PMI/PMBOK practices, that matches planning and oversight to a project's size, cost, and risk (approval authority, charter requirements, reporting cadence). * Define how team charters capture purpose, scope, roles, norms, decision rights, and working agreements, with inclusion and psychological safety built in from the first meeting. * Create simple shared templates (charters, kickoff agendas, RACI, risk registers, status reports, lessons learned) usable from the production floor to the leadership table. * Design and deliver training on the charter process and project fundamentals for managers, engineers, supervisors, and emerging leaders, partnering with HR \& Culture on curriculum, reinforcement, and follow\-up. * Coach project leads one\-on\-one through their first chartered projects: model first, then guide, then step back. * Build a bench of internal project leaders so project capacity does not depend on a few people. * Mentor engineers and technical staff and support their individual development plans. * Start a community of practice where project leads share lessons, celebrate wins, and solve problems together. * Introduce new processes in small steps, keep paperwork to a minimum, and improve the system using PDCA and feedback from project teams. **Project Visibility, Resource Planning, and Tools** Keep visibility of the company\-wide project portfolio, and help leadership prioritize, sequence, and resource work. * Set up project\-health reporting with clear green/yellow/red status and escalation criteria. * Build resource\-capacity views by person and skill to show current and future constraints. * Show leadership the resource and schedule impact of adding, delaying, or reprioritizing  in engineering, engineering technology, manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. * At least 8 years of manufacturing, engineering, or technical experience, including at least 5 years leading complex cross\-functional projects and teams. * Strong understanding of manufacturing and engineering environments. * Experience with project scheduling, risk management, resource and capacity planning, scope management, and project governance. * Experience managing capital projects and several concurrent projects with competing priorities. * Demonstrated ability to lead teams and influence outcomes without direct reporting authority. * Demonstrated experience teaching, training, or mentoring others, with examples of people who grew under your leadership. * Ability to make clear, persuasive presentations on complex topics to production personnel, senior leadership, and outside groups. * Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries or concerns. * Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of practical problems. * Proficiency with project\-management software (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, monday.com), spreadsheets, and Microsoft 365\. **Preferred** * Master's degree (MBA, Engineering Management, or similar). * Six Sigma Green Belt; Black Belt a plus. * Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. * Experience building a process, system, or program from the ground up, or significantly improving organizational project\-management processes, and getting it adopted across an organization. * Experience in precision or advanced manufacturing, with working knowledge of GD\&T, DFM, DFMEA/PFMEA, DOE, and SPC. * Experience with dashboards and data tools such as Power BI, Minitab, or JMP, and familiarity with CAD. Software\-development experience is not required. **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear and taste or smell. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is frequently required to lift up to 10 pounds and occasionally required to lift up to 50 pounds. Vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. **Performance Indicators** Success in year one means major projects run well, Bullen has a working project framework, and managers choose to use it. **First\-year milestones** **By** **Milestone** Month 3 Current project practices reviewed with the managers who lead projects today; draft framework and project tiers shared for feedback Month 6 Charter process documented and pilots beginning on at least 3 projects; project\-health reporting in place for major projects Month 12 Framework in use for all qualifying projects; first cohort of project leads trained; resource\-capacity view available to leadership **Ongoing measures** * Percentage of qualifying projects launched with an approved charter. * On\-time, on\-budget, and in\-scope delivery of major projects, with issues surfaced early enough to respond. * Number of employees trained, and project leads coached to independent leadership. * Project team feedback on clarity, inclusion, and collaboration. * Manager feedback that the system adds value rather than paperwork. * Reduced project load on functional managers, so they can focus on leading their teams. * Achievement of assigned PMD goals and objectives. * Cohesive teamwork within the company and professionalism in the performance of duties and responsibilities.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description: Junior Software Developer \[NO RELOCATION] PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NEEDING TO RELOCATE. WE ARE ONLY HIRING IN PHOENIX. Phoenix, AZ — onsite · $60,000–$80,000 BusinessRate turns public customer reviews into scores and rankings for local businesses. We collect review data at scale, score each business, rank it against its local competitors, and recognize the top performers in their market. We're profitable and growing, with an engineering team of six. Everything — the data pipelines, the web applications, the payment flows, the internal tooling, the infrastructure — is built and maintained in house. The role You'd be writing code day to day, working closely with our senior engineers, who review your pull requests and are there when you get stuck. We're a small team, so you won't be handed a narrow slice of the product and left there — you'll see how the whole thing fits together, and you'll get more ownership as you show you're ready for it. The work is genuinely interesting. The data side involves large partitioned tables, queries that need to stay fast as volumes grow, and pipelines processing substantial amounts of data. There's also a customer\-facing web application, payment flows, and internal dashboards, all of which need to be reliable. We're looking for someone who wants to get good at this, not just someone who can already do it. What you'll do \- Build and maintain backend services and APIs, with support on the design decisions \- Work on our Next.js and tRPC frontends — customer\-facing pages and internal dashboards \- Write SQL against large datasets and learn what makes queries fast or slow \- Fix bugs and ship improvements across the product \- Have your pull requests reviewed carefully, and start reviewing others' as you grow \- Take smaller projects from idea through to production What we're looking for You should have: \- Working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js, and something real you've built with them — a job, an internship, a personal project you can walk us through \- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases; you don't need to know how to optimize a query against a partitioned table yet, but you should want to learn \- Experience building with React, ideally Next.js \- Comfort with AI\-assisted development tools alongside solid engineering practices — we use them regularly and expect the same care with code written that way \- A willingness to ask questions early rather than disappear for three days Nice to have: \- tRPC, Fastify, or similar typed API layers \- Docker and modern deployment pipelines (we use Render) \- Stripe or other payments experience \- Any exposure to data pipelines or ETL \- A CS degree, a bootcamp, or no formal background at all — we care about what you can do Compensation and process Base salary is $60,000–$80,000, depending on experience. Health insurance included. This role is onsite in the Phoenix area. Our process is only two steps: an intro video call, an onsite visit PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NEEDING TO RELOCATE. WE ARE ONLY HIRING IN PHOENIX. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off Application Question(s): * We are ONLY looking for people CURRENTLY living in Phoenix Metro area \- no relocation. Are you currently located in the Phoenix Metro area? Ability to Commute: * Tempe, AZ 85282 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: ***Title:*** Microsoft 365 Engineer ***Location:*** The position will be based in Princeton NJ \- 2 days per week in the office required. Exact compensation will vary based on experience ***Other:*** Vaccination against COVID\-19 is a prerequisite for employment at CHDI Management ***About CHDI Foundation, Inc.*** CHDI Foundation, Inc. is a privately funded nonprofit biomedical research organization exclusively dedicated to collaboratively developing therapeutics that will substantially improve the lives of those affected by Huntington’s disease (HD). Our scientists work closely with a network of more than 700 researchers in academic and industrial laboratories around the world in the pursuit of these novel therapies, providing strategic scientific direction to ensure that our common goals remain in focus. This helps bridge the translational gap that often exists between academic and industrial research pursuits and that adds costly delays to therapy development. In its role as a collaborative enabler, CHDI seeks to bring the right partners together to identify and address critical scientific issues and move drug candidates to clinical evaluation as rapidly as possible. Our activities extend from exploratory biology to the identification and validation of therapeutic targets, and from drug discovery and development to clinical studies and trials. More information about CHDI can be found at www.chdifoundation.org. ***Job Description:*** CHDI Management is seeking a skilled and highly motivated Microsoft 365 Engineer to administer, optimize, and expand CHDI’s Microsoft 365 environment. This individual will serve as the internal expert on the M365 platform, ensuring that all services are secure, well\-governed, and performing optimally for the organization. Beyond day\-to\-day administration, this role carries a forward\-looking mandate: actively evaluating and promoting new Microsoft 365 capabilities, driving user adoption across the organization, and championing best practices that help CHDI’s staff work more effectively. single sign\-on (SSO) configurations. * Administer Microsoft Intune for device enrollment, compliance policy enforcement, application deployment, and endpoint configuration management across Windows and macOS devices. * Evaluate, pilot, and promote new Microsoft 365 services and features, develop rollout plans and communication strategies to support successful adoption across the organization based on end user input, and present cost\-effective options to management. * Partner with departmental stakeholders to translate functional needs into scalable M365 solutions. * Drive user adoption of M365 tools by developing training materials, hosting internal workshops, and serving as a go\-to resource for staff seeking to get more value from the platform. * Work with the Security and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to monitor and maintain security configurations including MFA enforcement, identity protection policies, data loss prevention (DLP) rules, and Microsoft Defender for Microsoft 365 workloads. * Configure and manage SharePoint Online sites, permissions, and governance policies in coordination with departmental stakeholders. * Manage Microsoft Teams environments including team provisioning, guest access policies, meeting configurations, and telephony/calling integrations as applicable. * Manage Microsoft 365 licensing lifecycle including assignment, optimization, and cost control, while tracking usage, adoption trends, and license efficiency to provide data\-driven recommendations aligned with organizational needs and budget. * Create and maintain thorough documentation of system configurations, administrative procedures, and change records. * Provide Tier 2/3 support for M365\-related issues escalated from the helpdesk, troubleshooting connectivity, authentication, and application\-level problems. * Other duties as assigned. ***Qualifications:**** 3–5 years of hands\-on experience administering Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive. * Demonstrated experience managing Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including conditional access, identity governance, and MFA. * Experience administering Microsoft Intune for device management, compliance policies, and application deployment across Windows platforms. * Proven ability to evaluate and promote new technology services, including developing adoption strategies and delivering end\-user training. * Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance features, including Defender for M365, DLP, and information protection. * Experience with Entra, Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users. * Strong customer service orientation and demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organization. * Ability to self\-initiate, manage competing priorities, and effectively solve problems in a fast\-paced environment. ***Preferred Qualifications:**** Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and Microsoft Graph API to support workflow automation, reporting, and system integrations. * Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Purview, or other M365 security and compliance tools. * Knowledge of ITIL best practices and IT service management frameworks. ***Education / Certifications:**** A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is required. Key Responsibilities * Enterprise GenAI Solution Architecture: Design and govern scalable, secure architectures embedding LLMs and foundation models into core business platforms and microservices backends. * Modern Java \& Microservices Ecosystems: Architect and standardize microservices utilizing Java 17\+ / Java 21, Spring Boot 3\.x, and reactive patterns (Spring WebFlux), ensuring low latency, high throughput, and seamless integration with distributed caches and databases. * RAG \& Agentic Workflows: Design and implement robust RAG pipelines, semantic caching, vector search indexing, and agent orchestration patterns (using frameworks like LangChain4j, Spring AI, Semantic Kernel, or custom orchestrators). * AI Governance, Security \& Guardrails: Establish architectural guardrails for model security, prompt injection defenses, PII masking, data loss prevention (DLP), token cost optimization, and model evaluation/observability. * Distributed Scalability \& Deployment: Champion event\-driven integration using Apache Kafka, container orchestration via Docker and Kubernetes/Helm, and cloud\-native AI deployments (AWS/GCP/Azure). * Technical Governance \& Mentorship: Drive code quality, technical roadmaps, architecture review board (ARB) approvals, and guide engineering leads and delivery teams through complex integration challenges. Required Technical Skills \& Qualifications * Core Languages \& Frameworks: Extensive enterprise experience in Java 17 or above, Spring Boot 3\.x, Spring Cloud, and Spring Data. * GenAI \& LLM Tooling: Hands\-on experience integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, or open\-source models) using Java\-native AI frameworks (e.g., Spring AI, LangChain4j) or REST/gRPC wrappers. * RAG \& Vector Stores: Deep understanding of embeddings, chunking strategies, hybrid search, and vector databases (e.g., pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant). * Microservices Architecture: Proven expertise in distributed system patterns (SAGA, CQRS, Circuit Breaker, Event Sourcing) and real\-time streaming architectures using Apache Kafka. * Databases: Hands\-on proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis). * Cloud \& DevOps: Solid background in cloud architectures (AWS/GCP), container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD automation pipelines. Job Description: Technical Lead – GenAI \& Java Microservices Role Overview We are seeking a hands\-on Technical Lead specializing in Java 17\+ and Spring Boot microservices with practical experience implementing Generative AI features. You will bridge architecture and execution, guiding a team of engineers in building, optimizing, and deploying AI\-augmented microservices, fine\-tuning RAG retrieval systems, and ensuring clean, resilient enterprise code. Key Responsibilities * Hands\-on Engineering \& Delivery: Lead the technical implementation of Java\-based microservices integrating GenAI capabilities, intelligent automation pipelines, and enterprise data connectors. * RAG \& Prompt Engineering Execution: Build and maintain RAG pipelines, fine\-tune retrieval algorithms, implement semantic vector lookups, and design structured prompt templates with robust validation. * Microservices Development: Write and review production\-grade, high\-performance code in Java 17\+ and Spring Boot, implementing REST/GraphQL endpoints, Kafka consumers/producers, and asynchronous event processing. * Testing \& Quality Assurance: Drive high code coverage with JUnit 5, Mockito, and TestContainers; establish automated testing for GenAI outputs (groundedness, hallucination detection, prompt regression testing). * Team Leadership \& Sprint Governance: Conduct PR code reviews, mentor engineers on best practices (including developer productivity tools like GitHub Copilot/Claude Code), manage sprint deliverables, and resolve technical blockers. * Production Operations: Partner with SRE/DevOps to monitor service health, token usage, latency bottlenecks, and logging/observability using tools like Splunk, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. Required Technical Skills \& Qualifications * Programming \& Core Stack: Strong proficiency in Java 17\+, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture. * GenAI Frameworks \& Integrations: Practical experience using Spring AI, LangChain4j, or Python AI service wrappers to interface with foundational models and build agentic/RAG workflows. * Vector Databases \& Search: Working familiarity with vector search extensions and engines (e.g., pgvector, OpenSearch, ChromaDB, or Elasticsearch). * Data \& Messaging: Practical experience with PostgreSQL or Oracle, alongside message brokers like Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ. * Testing \& Modern Engineering: Strong foundation in unit, integration, and contract testing (JUnit, TestContainers), Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions). * Leadership \& Collaboration: Demonstrated success in leading a team of 4–8 engineers, conducting code reviews, estimating technical stories, and collaborating across distributed teams. What are the top skills required for this role? * Modern Java \& Microservices Core: Extensive hands\-on expertise in Java 17\+, Spring Boot 3\.x, REST/Reactive APIs, and distributed microservices architecture. * Enterprise GenAI \& LLM Integration: Practical experience with LLM orchestration, frameworks like Spring AI or LangChain4j, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and guardrails/security. * Vector Databases \& Data Ecosystem: Proficiency in semantic search tools and vector stores (e.g., pgvector, OpenSearch), alongside messaging queues (Apache Kafka) and enterprise databases (PostgreSQL/Oracle).Years of Experience:12\.00 Years of Experience Pay: $45\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) Experience: * AMS for Apache Kafka: 10 years (Preferred) * Claude: 2 years (Preferred) * Spring WebFlux: 10 years (Preferred) * Langchain: 2 years (Preferred) * Large Language Model (LLM): 2 years (Preferred) * Springboot Microservices: 10 years (Preferred) * MongoDB: 10 years (Preferred) * Prompt Engineering: 3 years (Preferred) * Grafana: 10 years (Preferred) * Spring Cloud: 10 years (Preferred) * Spring Cloud Data flow: 10 years (Preferred) * Angular: 10 years (Preferred) * Lead Full Stack Developer: 10 years (Preferred) * GenAI Architect : 3 years (Preferred) * Java (17\+): 5 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Fintech Startup)
jobs.description: **About CRED iQ** CRED iQ is a commercial real estate data, analytics, and valuation platform providing actionable intelligence to CRE (Commercial Real Estate) and capital markets investors. Launched in 2020, our proprietary platform was developed with leading\-edge technologies, and delivers real\-time commercial real estate data through a user\-friendly interface. CRED iQ leverages big data, machine learning technologies, and geospatial analytics to provide solid lead generation opportunities and analytics to the CRE finance community. Subscribers to CRED iQ use this platform to identify opportunities for leasing, refinancing, mezzanine lending, distressed debt, and acquisition. The founders have a successful history of developing commercial real estate analytics platforms. CRED iQ leverages big data, machine learning technologies, and geospatial analytics to deliver its breakthrough data, analytics and user experience. **Senior Data Engineer** We are seeking a **Senior Data Engineer** with 5\+ years of experience to own the pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver our commercial real estate data, and to bring down what they cost to run. You will run our Airflow orchestration, tune our PostgreSQL databases, and manage data delivery to clients through Snowflake and other delivery methods. Cost is a first\-class engineering metric here: you will be measured on spend per pipeline and per delivery alongside reliability and data freshness. This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will decide where the money and compute go, make the case with data, and ship the changes yourself. **Candidate Qualifications** The ideal candidate is a hands\-on data engineer who has owned production pipelines end to end and treats cost as an engineering metric alongside reliability and data freshness. You will be experienced with large loan, property, and financial datasets, write expert SQL, and have strong knowledge of PostgreSQL internals. You can show, with numbers, what you measured, what you changed, and what it saved. You will have a degree in CS, CE, EE or have the equivalent practical experience. **Key Responsibilities** **Pipelines \& Orchestration** * Design, build, and maintain Airflow DAGs that ingest, validate, and transform large volumes of loan, property, and financial data from internal and third\-party sources. * Make pipelines incremental and idempotent, so reruns and backfills are safe and reprocess only what changed. * Right\-size scheduling, concurrency, pools, and worker resources so jobs finish on time without idle or oversized compute. * Own monitoring, alerting, and on\-call triage for pipeline failures and late data. **Database Performance \& Cost** * Tune PostgreSQL for both speed and spend: query plans, indexing, partitioning, vacuum and bloat, and connection management. * Find and fix the most expensive queries and jobs using pg\_stat\_statements, EXPLAIN plans, and database performance metrics. * Right\-size instances, storage, and read replicas, and set retention and archival policies for data that no longer needs hot storage. * Review schema and data model changes for their performance and cost impact before they ship. * Monitor database usage and access for audits. **Snowflake Delivery** * Build and operate client data deliveries in Snowflake, including secure data shares and scheduled loads. * Control Snowflake spend: warehouse sizing, auto\-suspend, clustering, incremental loads, and resource monitors with budgets. * Guarantee delivery quality with row\-count, schema, and reconciliation checks between PostgreSQL and Snowflake. **Cost Ownership** * Build cost visibility: attribute compute, storage, and warehouse spend to individual pipelines, datasets, and client deliveries. * Set cost baselines and targets, report on them regularly, and lead the work that closes the gap. * Weigh cost against freshness and reliability, and explain the trade\-off clearly to engineering and business stakeholders. * Mentor other engineers and set standards for cost\-aware pipeline and SQL design through code review. **Cross\-Team Collaboration** * Partner with product managers, engineers, and research teams to meet evolving data needs. * Create automated data exports and views for CRE Research and external clients. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of data engineering experience, including ownership of production pipelines end to end. * Deep Apache Airflow experience: DAG design, scheduling, backfills, retries, resource tuning, and debugging failed runs. * Expert SQL and strong PostgreSQL internals knowledge: query planning, indexing strategies, partitioning, locking, and vacuum behavior. * Hands\-on Snowflake experience delivering data to external consumers, including data sharing and warehouse cost management. * A track record of cutting data infrastructure cost, with numbers: what you measured, what you changed, and what it saved. * Strong Python for pipeline code, data validation, and tooling. * Experience running data workloads on a major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and reading its billing and usage data. * Sound data modeling judgment and a habit of building data quality checks into every pipeline. * Clear written communication. You can explain a cost or performance trade\-off to a non\-engineer in a paragraph. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with commercial real estate, CMBS, or other structured finance and loan\-level data. * Experience building client data feeds with delivery SLAs and audit requirements. * Infrastructure as code (Terraform) and containerized workloads. * FinOps practice: cost tagging, chargeback or showback reporting, and budget alerting. * Experience working in a SOC 2 environment, including access controls and audit logging for data systems. **Tech Stack** **Area** **Tools** Orchestration Apache Airflow Databases PostgreSQL Client delivery Snowflake, Amazon S3, and other delivery methods Languages Python, SQL Cloud AWS We are seeking candidates who are self\-motivated professionals and are eager to help grow a burgeoning business. **Compensation and Comprehensive Benefits Package** * Salary of $115,000 \- $140,000 per year * Equity Options * Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term Disability, HSA, and 401K * Flexible Work Schedule / Remote Work (CRED iQ is a fully remote company) * A work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect. CRED iQ is an equal opportunity employer and fintech startup that thrives in a fast\-paced dynamic environment. If you would like to apply or learn more about this opportunity, please contact us at careers@cred\-iq.com. **CRED iQ does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.** Pay: $115,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

seeking, aiming to learn more about the science than to prove your ideas are correct * Experience with RL algorithms for language models, scaling laws, or building RL environments and evals * * An excellent programmer and software engineer, comfortable working across the research stack in Python and PyTorch or JAX * Hands\-on experience training large models, through pretraining, jobs.description: Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come. **Job Purpose and Impact** -------------------------- The Director, Metabolic Engineeringleads a high\-performing team applying metabolic engineering, molecular biology, microbiology, bioinformatics and biotechnology to advance research programs aligned with portfolio and business priorities. The role translates strategy into focused research plans, establishes technical direction, aligns people and resources, and delivers reproducible scientific outcomes that progress from discovery through development, scale\-up and commercialization. The director builds an inclusive and accountable team culture, ensures safe and compliant laboratory operations, and partners across scientific, business and manufacturing functions to accelerate innovation, manage technical risk and communicate clear recommendations to stakeholders. **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ * Build and lead a high\-performing, inclusive and accountable team by setting clear expectations, aligning goals, coaching employees, managing performance, recognizing achievement, developing talent and creating conditions for people to thrive. * Allocate people, laboratory capacity, external services, operating budgets and capital across priorities. Identify capacity gaps before they affect delivery and develop platforms, automation\-enabled workflows, technologies and partnerships that improve research efficiency, reliability, transferability and business impact. * Provide technical direction across metabolic engineering, molecular biology, microbiology, bioinformatics and related biological sciences. Ensure experimental strategies generate reproducible, scalable and decision\-relevant outcomes with appropriate controls, statistical rigor, traceability and data integrity. * Translate business, customer and portfolio needs into research priorities, technology roadmaps, and milestone plans. Incorporate market opportunity, technical feasibility, manufacturing constraints, regulatory needs and commercialization timelines into prioritization and trade\-off decisions. * Partner with business leaders, customers and cross\-functional teams, including product development, analytical science, fermentation, process development, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, intellectual property, commercial and data science. Integrate research activities, enable effective technology transfer and communicate clear recommendations to stakeholders. * Lead biological research programs from discovery through development, pilot readiness and commercialization transfer. Establish clear deliverables, success criteria, stage\-gate expectations and transfer requirements that enable downstream teams to meet business and commercialization objectives. * Ensure safe, compliant and efficient laboratory operations, including equipment readiness, biosafety, quality systems, standard operating procedures and training. Identify and manage technical, biological, analytical, regulatory, scale\-up and operational risks; prioritize experiments that reduce uncertainty; investigate variability and failure modes; and drive corrective and preventive actions. * Other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience * Minimum of six years of related work experience * Experience in enzyme biochemistry or fermentation organism development * Previous experinece leading technical programs ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous supervisory experience * Ten or more years of experience in biotechnology, industrial microbiology or biomanufacturing * Advanced degree in metabolic engineering, molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, biotechnology or a related field * Experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence or data science to biological research **Compensation Data** --------------------- The expected salary for this position is $140,000\-$180,000\. jobs.company: Center for a New American Security
jobs.title: AI Engineer/Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Policy research needs to catch up to AI. Researchers at the Center for a New American Security (CNAS) are pushing today’s AI tools to their limits, and the next generation of research and product tools for national security analysis hasn’t been built yet. CNAS is seeking an AI Engineer / Senior AI Engineer to embed with some of the nation’s top AI and national security researchers, editors, and designers. You will prototype AI\-enabled tools and products, refine the ones that work, and scale the best of them across the Center. CNAS is making a substantial investment in its well\-established AI and national security team by launching the AI Policy Lab, and the AI Engineer / Senior AI Engineer will be instrumental to that effort. You will report to the Vice President of Strategy and Communications. As an early member of the AI Policy Lab, you’ll help shape how the lab operates from the ground floor. In this role, you’ll design, build, and deploy custom software, applications, and AI agent workflows that expand what CNAS researchers can accomplish in their work on AI policy, national security, and AI\-related economic competition. You will serve as a technical partner embedded with CNAS research and business teams to build out innovative solutions to increase productivity and maximize policy impact. The ideal candidate has a software engineering or computer science background, is highly proficient at using AI coding tools and agents to build applications and automated workflows and has a genuine interest in AI policy and national security. You enjoy working alongside non\-engineers, turning research questions into durable, reusable tools, and teaching colleagues to get the most out of what you build. This is a hands\-on technical role with significant autonomy. This is not a research position. You might be well\-suited for this role if you’re: * Experienced at building working software with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Cursor, from quick prototypes to tools colleagues rely on daily. * Excited to work alongside researchers, learn how they work, and build custom tools and agent workflows that take their research further. * Skilled at explaining technical concepts to non\-engineers and helping colleagues become more capable AI users. * Interested in how AI is reshaping national security. * Comfortable with shifting priorities in a field that moves fast. * Able to juggle short\- and long\-term projects while building durable tools others can use. * Motivated by seeing your work used, not just shipped. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Build Custom Software and Tools** + Embed with CNAS researchers to build custom code, applications, and AI agent workflows that support their research and analysis. + Rapidly prototype tools and refine them based on how colleagues use them. + Build agents and pipelines that gather, process, analyze, and visualize documents, transcripts, and datasets for CNAS research. + Build custom tools and software to automate business functions and accelerate productivity. * **Train and Empower Staff** + Train staff to use, adapt, and build on the tools you create, and document best practices for advanced AI use. + Help CNAS researchers who are already proficient AI users push their work further with code, agents, and advanced AI capabilities. + Track new AI models, harnesses, systems, and capabilities and assess which are worth adopting. * **Sustain AI Integration** + Standardize AI\-enabled workflows for recurring tasks such as baseline research, copy editing, citations, contact management, and data tracking. + Test, refine, document, and maintain AI tools for durable use. + Test AI\-assisted outputs for accuracy, objectivity, and sourcing to meet CNAS’s quality standards for independent, fact\-based research. + Ensure tools meet CNAS standards for data security and responsible AI use. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor) and demonstrated ability to explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the resulting code. * Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) including work with APIs and software integration. * Full\-stack engineering experience building and deploying custom software, agent workflows, or data pipelines with AI coding tools. * Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and train non\-technical colleagues. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities. * Legal right to work in the United States. **Preferred:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Interest in AI policy, national security, or AI safety and security. * Experience with think tank, government, or academic research analysis and workflows. * Experience with data visualization and web development. **COMPENSATI \& BENEFITS** * $125,000 – $215,000, depending on qualifications and experience. * CNAS offers a complete and competitive benefits package for employees which includes medical, dental, vision, life and AD\&D insurance, short\- and long\-term disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, 403(b) retirement accounts, transportation subsidies, and an employee assistance program. **LOGISTICS** * This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in Washington, D.C. * Occasional travel to the San Francisco Bay Area and other locations may be required. * This role is within the CNAS AI Policy Lab and reports to the Vice President of Strategy and Communications. * This is a two\-year, term\-limited appointment. * We are open to hiring a range of experience levels. Title and compensation will be commensurate with experience. * Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. Candidates are encouraged to apply early. * Candidates may start as soon as available. **About the CNAS AI Policy Lab** AI progress is fast outpacing policy. The opportunities and challenges of the AI age demand bold new ideas for U.S. national security that meet the moment. The CNAS AI Policy Lab fuses in\-depth AI and national security expertise to produce cutting\-edge, technically informed policy analysis. The United States and its allies must harness the benefits, manage the risks, and ensure democracies lead in this era\-defining technology. The AI Policy Lab integrates CNAS’s technology, defense, regional, and economic expertise to address how AI is reshaping every dimension of national power and geopolitical competition. The Lab will serve as a hub for curated workshops, discussions, partnerships, and other convenings to bring industry, researchers, and the national security community to develop policy solutions. By bridging the divide between innovators and national security policymakers, the Lab will ensure that policy can match the unprecedented pace of technological innovation, harnessing the transformative power of AI while managing risks. The AI Policy Lab builds on a sustained track record of CNAS leadership in AI policymaking. CNAS experts and alumni have written the rules for how the Pentagon incorporates autonomous systems, developed policies intended to preserve the United States’s AI lead, and served in the highest levels of AI policymaking. **About CNAS** The Center for a New American Security develops bold, innovative, and bipartisan national security and defense policies that promote and protect American interests and values. Building on the deep expertise and broad experience of its staff and advisors, CNAS engages policymakers, experts, and the public with innovative fact\-based research, ideas, and analysis to shape and elevate the national security debate. jobs.title: AI Agent Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Overview:** We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day. We are seeking an AI Agent Developer to design, build, and deploy AI agents that transform how teams at Chatham work. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants to apply modern AI to real business problems and see the impact firsthand. You will report to one of our Software Engineering Directors to maintain alignment with our organizational AI objectives. In each role, you will embed with a partner team as a forward\-deployed engineer. You will review past work, shadow team members on live tasks, and map where time is spent and why. From there, you will identify and prioritize the highest\-value opportunities, then build, evaluate, and release agents that triage requests, research and draft answers, investigate issues across systems and data, and prepare work for review. The team’s experts stay in the loop throughout, and people review agent output before it reaches a client or a production system. Once a team’s agents are running reliably, you will hand them over to the people who own the work and bring the same approach to the next team. Over time, you will partner with teams across the firm, from engineering and operations to client service and Marketing, wherever repetitive work can be improved through agentic means. You will work closely with Chatham’s AI evaluation and platform teams and help set the standards that other teams adopt. This is a new role at Chatham and an opportunity to help define how the firm builds and scales agentic capabilities. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic engineer who enjoys learning new domains from the people who do the work, collaborates easily with technical and non\-technical colleagues, and measures success by the problems solved for users. **In this role you will:** Discovery \& Partnership * Embed in a partner team and learn how it works. Review past work, shadow live tasks, and map the steps that the team repeats. * Find and rank the tasks where agents can save the most time or improve quality and agree on priorities with the team’s leaders. * Work closely with the team’s experts. They supply the domain knowledge and test cases, and they review agent output. Agent Development * Design, build, and deploy cloud\-native AI agents that do repetitive work from documented processes, with a person in the loop where judgment is necessary. * Build agents that triage and route incoming requests, research questions and draft answers, and investigate issues across systems, logs, and data. * Build agents that prepare work for people to review, such as draft responses, reports, and code changes as merge requests. * Turn each team’s playbooks and procedures into agent instructions and tools and keep them current as processes change. Evaluation \& Quality * Create evaluation sets from real past work. Measure each agent’s accuracy before release and whenever models or techniques change and monitor the results in production. * Partner with our AI evaluation team, and adopt its tools, techniques, and processes as they mature. * Follow Chatham’s standards for security, data handling, and the responsible use of AI. Reuse \& Handover * Document each agent’s purpose, tools, and limits so that other teams can adopt and extend it. * Build reusable tools and patterns that make each new team’s agents faster to deliver. Hand each team’s agents over to the people who own the work, then move to the next team. * **Your Impact:** For each partner team * Agents do a growing share of the team’s routine work correctly, and people review the output. * The team spends less time on repetitive tasks and more time on work that needs judgment. * Requests that wait in a queue today get faster and more consistent answers. * Each agent meets its accuracy targets before release and keeps them in production. Across Chatham * Each agent has documentation and tests, and other teams reuse its tools and patterns. * Each engagement ends with a clean handover to the people who own the work. A ranked list of agent opportunities is ready for the next team before you move to it. * **Contributors to your success:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong proficiency in Python or C\#, with experience in APIs, services, or automation. * Hands\-on experience with applications built on large language models (LLMs), including prompt and context design, tool use, and agent workflows. * Experience with evaluation of AI output: test sets, accuracy measures, and regression checks for systems that do not always return the same answer. * Solid SQL skills, and comfort with logs and telemetry to find the root cause of a problem. * Experience with Git, code review, and CI/CD. * Curiosity and patience to learn complex business domains from the people who do the work. * Ability to turn a business process into clear steps that an agent can follow, and to judge where a person must stay in the loop. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Experience with tools and integrations built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience with platforms or frameworks for AI agents, such as Microsoft Foundry or the Claude Agent SDK. * Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot. * Experience in a forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, or internal tools role, or a background in operations, technical support, or site reliability engineering. * Experience with Azure. Familiarity with tools such as GitHub, Grafana, Jira, and Confluence. * **About Chatham Financial:** Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight. **It’s clear ahead.** Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve. We help guide the way—giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Us:** We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better. ChiroHD (https://www.chirohd.com/) is the cloud\-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication \- everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force\-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product\-market fit \- prepped, proven, and ready for scale! ### **Role Overview:** You are a go\-to\-market operator with a technical mindset who builds the complex. You understand how pipeline, forecasting, attribution, and quota actually work, and you are just as comfortable writing the script, API call, or Claude workflow that makes them rock\-solid and reliable. Sitting inside Revenue Operations, you will own the technical build layer behind our GTM engine: the integrations between HubSpot, Maxio, Stripe, Intercom, data platforms, and beyond—including the automations that keep them in sync and the AI tools our reps and leaders rely on daily. This is a go\-to\-market role with a technical edge, not a product engineering role. Your primary customers are our GTM individual contributors (AEs, BDRs, CSMs) and GTM leaders. ### **Why This Role:** We've proven the use cases. Our data pipelines, automations, dashboards, and AI tooling already work, and the revenue team relies on them daily. You take them to production grade and build what comes next. You will multiply what both RevOps and our GTM teams can do. RevOps continues leading on strategy, definitions, governance, and cross\-functional alignment, and still owns a significant portion of the hands\-on building. You take on the technical, code\-heavy work, translating ad\-hoc business requests into clean technical systems and efficient processes. ### **What You'll Do:** * **Data Infrastructure \& Identity:** Build and maintain the GTM data layer: pipelines, data models, and identity matching that connect CRM, product telemetry, billing (Stripe/Maxio), and market data into one trusted, unified view of every account. * **Event\-Driven Systems \& Integrations:** Build monitored, documented integrations and automations in place of manual workarounds and one\-off fixes. Manage routine technical administration across key systems, handling webhooks, rate limits, and error alerting. * **A Reporting Foundation Leaders Can Trust:** Deliver accurate, timely, warehouse\-backed data reflecting shared business definitions for pipeline, funnel velocity, sales activity, and multi\-touch attribution. * **Production AI Tools \& Agents:** Build Claude skills, internal apps, and LLM workflows for prospect research, enrichment, scoring, summarization, deal hygiene, rep enablement, and key handoff milestones. Ensure workflows are production\-grade, durable, and actively deliver value over time. * **Signals to Action:** Convert customer usage signals, prospecting triggers, account intent, and enrichment data into prioritized, automated routing and actionable tasks for sales and CS teams. * **Measurement \& Iteration:** Track the tangible impact of the systems and tools you build (rep hours saved, user adoption, data quality, pipeline influence). Scale what drives revenue and aggressively retire what doesn't. ### **Who You Are:** * **GTM Fluency:** You have 3–6\+ years of experience across RevOps, Sales Ops, or technical GTM roles. You have a strong, working grasp of pipeline, funnel conversion, quota, forecast models, and attribution mechanics. * **Deep HubSpot Mastery:** You have hands\-on architectural depth with HubSpot: custom objects, properties, advanced workflows, and the HubSpot API. * **Hands\-On Coder \& Builder:** You possess strong SQL skills for querying and data transformation, paired with working Python (or an equivalent scripting language) for interacting directly with REST APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines. * **Proven AI Builder:** You have direct, hands\-on experience building practical workflows with Claude or other LLMs—with a track record of builds that are still active and relied upon today. You integrate AI coding tools into your daily workflow to ship faster. * **Systems Architect \& Translator:** You excel at turning ambiguous, ad\-hoc business requests into clean, scalable technical systems and efficient operational processes. You explain technical trade\-offs back to commercial leaders in plain language. * **Relentless Documenter \& Outcome Owner:** You document your architecture, instrument monitoring so syncs never fail silently, and take end\-to\-end ownership of business outcomes rather than just checking off tasks. ### **Nice\-to\-Have:** * Experience modeling Stripe, Maxio, or recurring subscription billing data. * Hands\-on experience with modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) and dbt. * Familiarity with automation and orchestration engines (n8n, Clay, Temporal). * Prior experience operating in a multi\-product SaaS environment or navigating data consolidation post\-acquisition. ### **Probably Not a Fit (Disqualifiers):** * **No\-Code Only Admins:** Operations admins whose experience is strictly limited to point\-and\-click UI configurations and who do not write scripts, SQL, or code. * **Core Product Software Engineers:** Developers who want to own a customer\-facing product roadmap and sprint backlog rather than GTM systems and revenue infrastructure. * **Task\-Takers:** People who prefer to wait for pre\-scoped engineering tickets and hand back finished tasks without understanding or owning the underlying business outcome. * **Candidates Lacking GTM Literacy:** Anyone lacking a moderate understanding of pipeline stages, rep quotas, and funnel math. ### **Why ChiroHD?** **Impact \& Growth** * Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market. * PE\-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively. * Established product\-market fit; scaling outbound\-led growth engine now. * High\-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth. * Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility. **Culture \& Values** * Customer\-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do * Low\-ego, builder\-first environment where the best ideas win * High\-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results * Commitment to work\-life balance and professional development **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive salary * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Flexible PTO and remote\-first culture **Equal Employment Opportunist** ChiroHD is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or disability status.

jobs.title: AI Safety & Reasoning Engineer (Reasoning Transparency)
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 12/30/2026Meet the Team Join Cisco’s Enterprise AI team, the core group enabling Generative AI powered experiences across Cisco. Our mission is to build secure, scalable AI platforms that empower teams to safely develop, deploy, and operationalize AI\-powered solutions. We operate at the intersection of applied AI, cloud infrastructure, and security, partnering across engineering, security, compliance, and product teams to bring trusted AI to life at enterprise scale. We are a fast\-growing, highly collaborative team of platform engineers, AI engineers, and data scientists who value technical depth, ownership, and pragmatic execution. What makes this team exciting is the opportunity to define how secure Generative AI is built and governed inside a global technology leader. In this role, you will connect AI safety research with production engineering. You will develop methods and infrastructure to assess whether model behavior reflects its internal state, and help ensure deployed AI systems remain reliable, honest, and aligned as they use increasingly complex inference\-time computation. Your Impact You will operationalize transparency by translating concepts from mechanistic interpretability and eliciting knowledge into scalable pipelines that run alongside model inference. You will build infrastructure to extract, map, and interpret model activations and latent representations, supporting analysis of how internal signals relate to model outputs. You will design red\-teaming frameworks and automated behavioral auditing stress tests to identify misalignment, sycophancy, deceptive behavior, and coordination risks across models or agents. You will partner with ML engineering to integrate transparency probes while managing inference latency, memory use, reliability, and operational cost. Additionally, you will track relevant AI safety research to rapidly prototype, evaluate, and deploy promising transparency methods, while defining evaluation methods to communicate evidence, limitations, and actionable findings to research, engineering, and product partners. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. **Position Overview:** The Site Reliability Engineer is based in North America (NAM) to serve as the regional pillar of our global reliability engineering function within Markets Technology. In this role, you will be part of a distributed, high\-impact three\-person global team, working closely with your counterparts in EMEA and APAC to provide resilient, round\-the\-clock ("follow\-the\-sun") operational excellence, infrastructure automation, and architecture reliability for mission\-critical enterprise systems. As a VP\-level Individual Contributor, you will operate as a technical authority for the NAM region. n8n and Power Automate, that move data between City systems, vendor platforms, and other data sources. * Performs data analysis, including conceptualization, modeling, and presentation of data. * AI\-enabled solutions, including testing results for accuracy and consistency before changes are put into use. * Monitors, troubleshoots, and maintains production data pipelines, reports, and automations. * Develops procedures for data validation, analysis, and presentation. * Handles sensitive and confidential data, including Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) and customer data, in accordance with City, state, and federal requirements. * Manages assigned projects from request through completion, including tracking status, milestones, and business value (e.g., staff time or costs saved). * Coordinates with vendors and IT staff on data access, integrations, and issue resolution, and works under the direction of vendor and contractor specialists on larger projects. * Trains staff on updated tools and data processes. * Reviews and provides technical assistance to users’ requests for new data elements and systems, and identifies and coordinates changes to the existing shared data environment. * Works with IT staff on database structures, data modeling, storage, backup and recovery, software upgrades, and test environments to ensure data integrity and security. * Assists in the evaluation of and recommendation for data management and reporting software. Coordinates and supports migration to new data management systems and reporting platforms. * Researches and recommends modern data tools, including AI\-enabled platforms, to support modernization. * Maintains documentation of solutions, processes, and procedures so that others can operate and support them. * Reviews and approves changes submitted by other staff through version control (git) pull requests. * Performs related duties as required. * Responds regularly and promptly to work. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Data/Business Analytics, Statistics, or similar field of study plus two (2\) years of professional experience in data, reporting, or automation, including SQL and use of data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI or similar); OR an Associate’s degree plus four (4\) years of directly related experience as previously listed. Internships and co\-ops in these areas count toward the required experience. * Experience supporting municipal government applications is a plus. * Experience with data engineering, workflow automation (e.g., n8n, Power Automate), version control (git), and/or applied AI/ML is a plus. *Equivalent combinations of related education, experience, training, and certification may also be considered.* **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** **Knowledge of:** * Principles, methods and techniques used in designing, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining computer software systems. * Data processing, integration, and automation techniques. * Basic project management principles and techniques. * Structured analysis and database concepts. * Relational database concepts, including tables, keys, relationships  requirements and design or modify an application or system to solve a business problem. * Organize workload; establish priorities; and meet established deadlines. * Prepare clear, concise and complete reports, correspondence and other written materials. * Anticipate, identify and effectively resolve various issues and problems. * Provide management with sound, positive advice and information concerning job tasks. * Explain technical information and data findings clearly to non\-technical staff and management. * Work independently and take ownership of solutions from design through ongoing support. * Display regular and timely attendance (report to work on time, work scheduled hours, utilize leave responsibly to ensure sufficient coverage of departmental operations, etc.). * Comply with City and department administrative directives, policies, and procedures. * Establish and maintain positive and cooperative working relationships with all levels of City staff and the general public. **Skills:** * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Strong customer service skills with City staff and vendors. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and time\-management skills. **Licenses, Certifications \& Special Requirements** **Licenses:** * Texas Class C driver’s license with a good driving record as measured by the City’s evaluation system. **Special Requirements:** * On\-call technical support is required on a rotating basis for all systems; distribution. * **Technical Leadership:** Provide architectural direction and technical oversight across Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Data Engineering, Data Science, and Software Development teams. * **Systems Integration:** Ensure interoperability across distributed systems, cloud environments, data pipelines, APIs, and mission applications. * **Architecture Governance:** Establish technical standards, design principles, and engineering best practices to ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability. * **Solution Development:** Evaluate architectural alternatives, identify technical risks and dependencies, and develop solutions aligned with mission objectives. * **Security \& Compliance:** Collaborate with cybersecurity and compliance stakeholders to incorporate appropriate security controls, data governance, and regulatory requirements into system architecture. * **Technical Roadmapping:** Support technical planning, capability prioritization, We control a portfolio of more than 1\.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low\-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever\-changing world. Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**. **Job Overview** The Senior Director, Data Center Design \& Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner\-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in\-house engineering capabilities. Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines * Define and approve system architecture for medium\-voltage and low\-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high\-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N\+1, 2N) and associated trade\-offs * Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path\-to\-power planning * Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single\-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate * Lead constructability, value engineering, and design\-for\-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre\-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project\-team authority * Own the owner\-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness * Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as\-builts, O\&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements * Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long\-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work * Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans * Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums * Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance * Build and mentor the in\-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows * Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team\-oriented, inclusive environment. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline * 15\+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission\-critical, or large\-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role * Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high\-density compute * and energization planning for large loads * Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission\-critical projects * Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners * Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred * Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid\-cooled and high\-density rack deployments * Owner\-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer * Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites * Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9\.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes * Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA * Experience in a fast\-growth owner organization building in\-house technical capability This position may involve duties that jobs.title: Junior Legal AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Cleary Gottlieb is a pioneer in globalizing the legal profession. We have 14 offices in major financial centers around the world, but we operate as a single, integrated global partnership and not as a U.S. firm with a network of overseas locations. The firm employs approximately 1,100 lawyers from more than 50 countries. Since 1946 our lawyers and staff have worked across practices, industries, jurisdictions, and continents to provide clients with simple, actionable approaches to their most complex legal and business challenges, whether domestic or international. We support every client relationship with intellectual agility, commercial acumen, and a human touch. Cleary Gottlieb’s AI Acceleration Team combines frontier AI with elite legal expertise to redesign legal work from first principles. We are AI engineers, data scientists, software engineers and lawyers. We began as Springbok AI, a startup, and still run like one: we ship bespoke AI workflows, co\-pilots and tools that lawyers choose to use, backed by a world\-class law firm. Responsibilities: **The Role:** We’re hiring a Junior Legal AI Engineer fluent with both lawyers and technical teams. In the morning you’ll analyze a workflow with a partner; in the afternoon you’ll discuss knowledge graphs with our data scientists and engineers. You translate between them, and the product improves as a result. Ideally, you’ve trained and worked as a lawyer, however, we are considering alternative legal / legaltech backgrounds. You don’t need to code, or to have used code editor; you do need to be willing to learn both. **What You’ll Be Doing:** * **Design legal workflows**: Turn legal processes into automations lawyers adopt and find where automation can save time or reduce errors. * **Engineer prompts**: Write, review and refine prompts with our NLP specialists until outputs meet a lawyer’s standard. * **Bridge law and engineering**: Translate legal requirements into technical specifications, and technical constraints into terms lawyers trust. * **Configure and test**: Tailor our AI tools to real legal use cases; test and iterate until they work in practice, not just in a demo. * **Champion our users**: Provide first\-line support to our lawyers and turn their feedback into prioritized input for engineers. * **Get hands\-on**: Work alongside our engineers with AI coding assistants and at the command line: edit templates and configuration, run scripts and inspect outputs. We’ll teach you the tools. Qualifications: **What You Bring:*** 3\+ years’ experience in or alongside legal teams, including drafting, review, summarization and data extraction * You meet the requirements but don’t have a JD or extensive legal experience beyond the minimum * Command of the principles of legal work: accuracy, explainability, confidentiality and privilege, rigor, risk\-awareness and accountability * Working knowledge of AI concepts such as agents, retrieval, chain\-of\-thought prompting and few\-shot learning, and the ability to discuss them with data scientists and engineers. We’ll make you an expert within 90 days. * Familiarity with the legal AI landscape (Harvey, Legora, Thomson Reuters, LexisNexis) and a view on its direction * Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain a model’s limitations to a partner and a lawyer’s risk concerns to an engineer * Self\-direction: you build processes where none exist and dig in when something isn’t working * Willingness to learn how to use a code editor and basic scripting; no prior experience required **Bonus Points:*** Experience in practice development, knowledge management, legal operations or legal service delivery * Startup or legal tech experience, ideally in agile or product\-led teams * Experience with no\-code or low\-code builders (e.g. Framer, Squarespace) * Existing comfort with code editors or scripting, or something real you’ve vibe\-coded **Why You’ll Love It Here:*** Build from the ground up and change how lawyers at a world\-class firm practice * Join a small, ambitious team * Learn across AI, product, design and engineering * Have a voice: we want your ideas, not just your execution The estimated base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on a variety of job\-related factors, including skills, education, training, credentials, experience, scope and complexity of role responsibilities, geographic location, and performance. This role is exempt meaning it is not overtime pay eligible. Cleary provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health care benefits. More information can be found here: Benefits We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination based on any category protected by law. Cleary provides reasonable accommodations to enable otherwise qualified employees to perform the essential functions of their position, provided the accommodation does not pose an undue hardship to the Firm.
