jobs.title: Client Support QA Engineer
jobs.description: **Opportunity Overview:** We're looking for a Quality Engineer with healthcare experience to own the quality of our FHIR\-based APIs and clinical workflows from end to end. You'll plan and execute test strategies that validate how patient data moves through our platform — ensuring every resource, every integration, and every handoff meets the standards that healthcare demands. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and client experience, working closely with Solution Architects, Implementation, Engineering, and Product to catch issues before they reach the people who rely on our technology to get patients the care they need. If you're someone who thinks in edge cases, cares deeply about data integrity, and wants to shape QA practices on a growing team — this is the role. This is a remote\-first role that may require travel to Boston, MA for new hire onboarding and occasional in\-person team meetings and company events. **What you'll do:** * Plan, author, and execute test plans for FHIR\-based APIs — validating schema conformance, resource structure (Patient, Observation, Encounter), and alignment with implementation guides. * Perform manual and automated testing on RESTful healthcare web services, identifying, documenting, and tracking defects through resolution. * Develop and maintain QA protocols and procedures that keep pace with evolving healthcare standards and compliance requirements. * Analyze test results and provide clear, detailed reporting to stakeholders across engineering, product, and implementation teams. * Participate in test case reviews and provide feedback to developers to improve code quality and catch issues earlier in the development cycle. * Continuously improve testing processes and methodologies to increase coverage, reduce cycle time, and strengthen reliability. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Solution Architects, Engineering, Implementation, and Product to ensure quality is built in — not just tested after the fact. **What you'll need:** * 2\+ years of experience in quality engineering within healthcare technology * Client\-facing experience strongly preferred — you should be comfortable communicating quality findings, test results, and status updates to external stakeholders, not just internal teams * Hands\-on experience testing APIs built on interoperability standards used to exchange clinical data — you should know how to validate that resources like patient records, encounters, and observations are structured correctly and conform to the implementation guides the industry runs on. This role is not eligible for hire in CA. **Interview Process\*:** * Connect with Talent Acquisition for a Preliminary Phone Screening * Meet your Hiring Manager! * Peer Interview * Case Study * Subject to change **About Cohere Health:** Cohere Health's clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI\-powered solutions connect health plans' strategic goals and providers' needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer\-provider decision\-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction. With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we've further enhanced our platform by launching our Payment Integrity Suite, anchored by Cohere Validate™, an AI\-driven clinical and coding validation solution that operates in near real\-time. By unifying pre\-service authorization data with post\-service claims validation, we're creating a transparent healthcare ecosystem that reduces waste, improves payer\-provider collaboration and patient outcomes, and ensures providers are paid promptly and accurately. Cohere Health's innovations continue to receive industry wide recognition. We've been named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list and in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022\-2025\), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 \& 2024\. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners. The Coherenauts, as we call ourselves, who succeed here are empathetic teammates who are candid, kind, caring, and embody our core values and principles. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Claims & AI Billing
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ Running a healthcare practice is hard. It's a highly regulated, low\-margin business. Practices deliver care upfront, then have to navigate a complex insurance system to get paid. Much of that work is manual, and it isn't always clear which claims or tasks are worth tackling first. When a practice can't operate efficiently, patients are impacted through reduced access to care or unexpected out\-of\-pocket costs. Our Claims team builds software that helps clinics and hospitals get paid for the care they deliver. We build automations that can be configured to fit each practice's needs, ensuring their entire business pipeline functions smoothly. We also build tools that help billers and administrators figure out where their time will have the biggest impact. We help them go after the highest ROI work first, work claims in bulk, and spot trends early that need their attention. We're also building AI agents as coworkers that can take on work between fixed automations and fully manual workflows and make customer onboarding and billing setup more accurate and automated. The end goal is to help clinics and hospitals work more efficiently and collect more of the revenue they've earned. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll work across the stack, from data\-dense workflows in the UI to the backend pipelines, integrations, and rule engines that power them. You'll own important projects and subsystems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and help us solve the right problems for the people working through claims every day. Our scope is broad: you might build a CDC pipeline, design an API, or create a new automation workflow on any given day. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own multi\-component projects where requirements may be incomplete or evolving. You'll define the approach, sequence the work, anticipate failure modes, and own problems from the first conversation through launch and beyond. This role is for someone who likes working with messy real\-world data, cares about the people using their software, is looking for high levels of ownership, and enjoys turning a complicated problem into something useful. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Build fast, intuitive claims workflows in Air that help billers find, understand, correct, and prioritize work, whether they're working one claim or thousands. * Design and build full\-stack features with React, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, from user experience and APIs to data models and production operations. * Build and scale the claims generation and submission pipeline, transforming encounter data into valid electronic claims across professional, institutional, and dental formats, as well as paper claims when needed. * Integrate with clearinghouses and handle the varied responses, verification requirements, and errors that come with getting claims to payers. * Improve coverage and payer routing, with guardrails that protect against using the wrong person's coverage information. * Build configurable automations and AI\-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work. Give billers and administrators the visibility and control to manage agents and correct mistakes. * Use LLMs and agents to streamline customer onboarding and billing setup, helping each customer get configured accurately with as much automation as practical and appropriate human review. * Design and build reliable subsystems with clear interfaces and data models. Improve their maintainability and operational stability over time. * Solve hard reliability and scale problems, including bulk operations, partial failures, idempotency, performance, observability, and auditability. Find root causes and prevent recurring issues. * Work closely with product, design, billing operations, and other engineers to understand real user problems, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and measure improvements in user experience and operational outcomes. * Lead technical discussions and design reviews within the team, and coordinate dependencies with other teams. * Make decisions that account for downstream dependencies, persisted data, and the long\-term health of the system. * Mentor other engineers, including peers and those earlier in their careers. * Raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, clear documentation, and practical patterns other engineers can use. **What You Have** ----------------- * 5\+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production applications. * Strong full\-stack engineering skills, including experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React and backend development in Python or Go. Our primary stack includes TypeScript, React, Python, and PostgreSQL. * Experience designing and building production subsystems, including their interfaces, reliability, and evolution. * Strong technical judgment in ambiguous situations. You can balance speed, correctness, performance, compliance, and simplicity while considering downstream dependencies and future changes. * A track record of leading complex work from problem definition through delivery and ongoing operation, with measurable improvements to user experience, reliability, or operational outcomes. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills, including using monitoring, logging, and alerting to identify root causes and prevent problems from recurring. * Product\-mindedness and empathy for users: you want to understand how people actually work and build software that makes their jobs easier. * Clear communication and collaboration skills. You can explain decisions and tradeoffs, lead team\-level technical discussions, and coordinate with stakeholders across teams. * Experience mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and practices others adopt. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building data\-dense operational tools, workflow automation, bulk operations, or high\-volume transaction systems. * Familiarity with healthcare billing, claims, EDI, or clearinghouse integrations, or a demonstrated ability to learn a complex domain quickly. * Experience shipping AI\-assisted features in real workflows, with good judgment about where automation is appropriate and where people need visibility and control. * Experience improving React performance, building interactive analytics, or designing intuitive experiences for non\-technical users. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and modern observability tools. * Experience working in a regulated industry with a focus on security and compliance. * A passion for improving healthcare and healthcare operations in America. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $180K \- $230K

jobs.title: Data Engineer: Merchant Intelligence Agent
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **About Us** Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI\-first e\-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e\-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. **About the Team** We build the AI agent that helps merchandisers, product managers, and executives grow their e\-commerce business: it finds opportunities in their data, tailors insights to each person's role, and takes routine work off their plate by delivering answers where they already work. We are transforming how digital merchandising teams work: instead of digging through reports and configuring rules by hand, they ask in plain language, get answers grounded in their own data, and approve the changes the agent prepares. Customers already rely on the agent to save time and make better decisions. We own the agent end to end, from the first question a merchant asks to the answer they act on. We also own the analytics behind it: the pipelines and cubes for search, browse, and recommendation performance, and the metric definitions merchants rely on. That is why we build the agent and the Customer Dashboard as a platform that every Constructor team extends. We create the foundation that other teams build on: the agent framework, shared components, and infrastructure. jobs.title: AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: ConRes helps organizations adopt AI across public cloud, government cloud, and local and air\-gapped data centers. As clients move AI from pilots into production, their security, compliance and audit teams need an independent answer to one question: is this AI system safe to run? The AI Security Engineer provides that answer. You will assess, test and help govern our clients' AI systems, and turn findings into prioritized, defensible remediation they can act on. **Responsibilities** AI Security Assessments * Lead AI security assessments of LLM applications, RAG pipelines and AI agents: architecture review, data flows, identity, tenancy and data separation, logging and model\-provider configuration. * Run threat\-modeling workshops using STRIDE with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Agentic AI guidance and MITRE ATLAS. * Map findings to AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and to the client's control baseline (NIST SP 800\-53, NIST SP 800\-171 / CMMC, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001\) so stakeholders can defend severity and remediation decisions and produce audit\-ready evidence. * Write executive\-ready reports and present results to client security, compliance and leadership teams. Adversarial Testing * Plan and execute AI red\-team exercises: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, system\-prompt and data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency and tool abuse in agents, RAG and vector\-store poisoning. * Validate that guardrails and content filters (native guardrail services in public and government cloud, and self\-hosted guardrail models in air\-gapped environments) actually hold under attack. Local and Air\-gapped AI Deployments * Define and verify security controls for self\-hosted and air\-gapped AI: inference servers (i.e., vLLM, Ollama, NVIDIA NIM), GPU hosts, local vector stores and the networks around them. * Secure the model supply chain without internet access: provenance and hash/signature verification of model weights, scanning for unsafe serialization, and an approved internal model and package registry. * Design and audit controlled data\-transfer processes for moving models, updates, containers and datasets across the air gap. * Harden hosts and containers; ensure logging, monitoring and incident response work without cloud services. * Assess data\-isolation guarantees and document them for accreditors and auditors. AI Governance and Risk * Help clients develop AI acceptable\-use, data\-handling and model/vendor risk standards suited to their regulatory obligations. * Assess the AI vendors and SaaS tools clients are adopting: data residency, retention, training\-data use, SOC 2 / ISO 42001 posture. * Define AI security requirements and acceptance criteria for client solutions, working with the client's teams and ConRes delivery teams. * Help clients detect and manage shadow AI and AI\-related data loss (data classification, DLP and AI threat\-protection tooling). Incident Response and Enablement * Support clients in investigating and responding to AI\-related incidents: data leakage, model abuse, compromised AI identities or keys. * Track emerging AI attack techniques and regulation, and keep client assessments and test cases current. * Deliver AI security training and workshops for client teams, and help shape ConRes's AI security services and thought leadership. The pay range for this position begins at $180,000 up to $200,000 per year. This range reflects the annual salary that Continental Resources reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of posting, consistent with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Law (M.G.L. c. 149, § 105E). \#ConRes \# of Hires Needed 1 Exemption Type Exempt Hiring Manager Job Requirements **Requirements** * 5\+ years in information security (application security, cloud security, penetration testing or security architecture), including 2\+ years focused on AI/ML or LLM security. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM applications or agents for prompt injection, jailbreaks and data leakage. * Strong, hands\-on experience securing local and air\-gapped AI deployments: self\-hosted open\-weight models, offline model and package supply chains, cross\-domain transfer, and host hardening. * Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS and NIST AI RMF. * Familiarity with compliance frameworks and audit evidence: NIST SP 800\-53, NIST SP 800\-171 / CMMC, FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001\. * Strong understanding of how LLM apps, RAG and agent frameworks (including MCP) are built, enough to find where they break. * Security experience across public cloud, government cloud (FedRAMP / DoD IL environments) and local or air\-gapped data centers: identity, network isolation, key management, logging. * Python scripting for test automation and analysis. * Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable leading client workshops and presenting technical risk to executives and auditors. **Preferred** * Prior consulting or professional\-services experience. * Experience with healthcare (HIPAA/PHI), financial\-services or defense/government compliance, including supporting an ATO or CMMC assessment. * Certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, CISSP, CCSP, IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor, CompTIA SecAI\+ or cloud\-provider certifications. * Published AI security research, CVEs, bug\-bounty findings or AI CTF participation.

jobs.title: E11 Bio - Machine Learning Scientist I/II
jobs.description: E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards the scale of whole mammalian brains. We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable brain mapping. E11 Bio is a non\-profit Convergent Research focused research organization located in Alameda, California, pursuing blue\-skies neuroscience research yet operating like a nimble, tight\-knit start\-up. Read our technology roadmap. We are seeking a creative and mission\-driven Machine Learning Scientist to develop scalable automatic proofreading methods leveraging barcode and shape information. In this role, you will own core ML pipelines for automated proofreading of neuron and synaptic reconstructions in optical connectomics datasets, working closely with wet lab scientists, microscopists, and domain experts to ensure biological fidelity and scalability. Your work will directly support E11’s goal of making reliable connectomic data accessible to the broader neuroscience community. In this role you will be focused on decreasing segmentation and proofreading costs for optical connectomics datasets that we are generating at E11, a critical bottleneck in the connectomics field. You will be responsible for improving initial segmentations using large spatial contexts with rich data features, and ingesting resulting datasets into scalable proofreading software for dissemination to the scientific community. ### **Responsibilities** * Contribute to developing innovative ML approaches for automatic proofreading of segmentations in large PB\-scale optical connectomics volumes, leveraging shape and barcode information * Own the deployment of scalable workflows to ingest large connectomic datasets into standard proofreading software (WebKnossos, CAVE) * Collaborate with academic and industry experts on building and extending tools for automated proofreading and interactive visualization * Develop, implement, and evaluate scalable pipelines for synapse detection and partner assignment in large\-scale optical connectomics datasets, integrating morphological and protein labeling information * Identify and build ML\-based image processing tools that remove key bottlenecks in our data processing and analysis pipeline * Maintain excellent laboratory science practices, communicate results through reports and presentations, and contribute to and assist in preparation of manuscripts, abstracts and other scientific documents. ### **Required qualifications** * Ph.D. in computer science, machine learning, applied math, computational biology or a related field in science and/or engineering or Ph.D.\-equivalent publication history * 3\-5 years of relevant work or research experience, with strong history of independent and autonomous execution of novel ML solutions * Strong background in computer vision and applying ML tools to the analysis of large microscopy data sets * Experience with software engineering best practices (e.g. version control, code reviews, etc) * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, record keeping ability, and attention to detail ### **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with graph, sequence, or point based ML methods (GNNs, Transformers, Pointnets, etc.) * Experience with processing large chunked data (e.g Zarr) in the cloud (e.g. AWS or GCP) * Experience with large scale connectomics data and tools (e.g. Neuroglancer, WebKnossos, CAVE, CATMAID, etc.) * Strong record of publications in peer reviewed scientific journals a plus. ### **In the first six months, you will:** * Become familiar with our existing ML and distributed processing code bases * Own the processing (segmentations) of a new dataset end\-to\-end and identify areas for improvement (accuracy and efficiency) * Integrate internal graph\-based methods for automatic proofreading into standard block\-wise workflows for PB\-scale optical connectomics volumes * Optimize ingestion of smaller segmentation graphs into standard proofreading software (e.g WebKnossos, CAVE) for improving efficiency of ground truth generation ### **In 12 months, you will:** * Develop novel innovative ML approaches for automatic proofreading of neuron segmentations, leveraging both shape and barcode information * Contribute to algorithmic development across the segmentation pipelines increasing computational throughput * Contribute to achieving cubic\-mm scale reconstruction at 100x lower proofreading costs * Scale ingestion of PB\-sized optical volumes into proofreading software and pilot proofreading and dissemination of large connectomic subgraphs ### **You would love this job if…** * You are passionate about moonshot neuroscience, and want to broadly accelerate science through long\-term commitment to a high\-impact project with a tight\-knit team * You have a strong desire and intrinsic motivation to work collaboratively and inclusively as part of an interdisciplinary team science effort * You are committed to the ethos of open science, and want to see your work transparently disseminated * You’re mission\-driven, and are seeking an environment where you can take long\-term risks on moonshot science, shielded from academic or for\-profit incentives * You’re seeking a high\-leverage, non\-traditional opportunity to maximize the impact of your science, establishing relationships with key stakeholders in the neuroscience community ### **We Offer** * An opportunity to help change the world and work with a world\-class interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers on a field\-defining moonshot * Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan; parental leave. * Generous time off \+ paid holidays. * 401K matching up to 6% of base salary * Ample healthy and energizing food including daily lunches. * Stipend for fitness and wellness activities. Base Salary Range: $130,000 \- $225,000 Bonus: Performance\-based, up to 20% of base salary 401k match: up to 6% of base salary Total potential compensation range: $163,800 \- $283,500 E11 Bio, LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender\-identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Palo Alto Networks Security Engineer
jobs.description: Cornerstone is hiring an expert\-level Palo Alto Networks Security Engineer for a two\-year, full\-time consulting engagement at a major international airport in the San Francisco Bay Area. **About the role** The airport is modernizing its network as part of a Next\-Generation Network program. The program includes a 400 Gbps backbone and a new Palo Alto Networks Next\-Generation Firewall (NGFW) architecture. This architecture segments the airport's airline, concession, enterprise, and critical operations networks. You will lead the security side of this work. You will assess the current firewall setup, check the new design, run the migration, set up monitoring, and train the airport's staff to run the new system. You will work closely with network, security, and project management teams. **Key responsibilities** **Assessment** * Assess the current and planned Palo Alto Networks architecture, NGFW configurations, and Next\-Generation Internet Edge design. * Review Panorama and firewall baselines, including interfaces, zones, routing, and high\-availability (HA) design. * Evaluate security policies, security profiles, and Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) settings. * Write findings, gap and risk analyses, and remediation recommendations. **Migration** * Build migration strategies, implementation plans, and test plans. * Clean up existing configurations and migrate firewall rules and policies to the new environment. * Configure firewalls, Panorama, security zones, segmentation, and HA, and validate failover. * Run functional, failover, performance, and connectivity testing. * Support cutovers, including after\-hours work when needed. * Track risks, issues, and dependencies, and support change management. Submit weekly status reports. **Best practices and monitoring** * Apply Palo Alto Networks best practices to policies, profiles, and threat prevention. * Set up dashboards, alerts, and weekly and monthly reports using native tools such as Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, and Strata Logging Service. * Configure historical trending and performance analysis. * Troubleshoot issues and open and escalate tickets with Palo Alto Networks. **Documentation and knowledge transfer** * Deliver as\-built documentation and standard operating procedures (SOPs). * Lead knowledge\-transfer sessions for airport staff. **Required qualifications** * 10\+ years of expert\-level Palo Alto Networks experience in large enterprises. This means campuses with 5 or more locations and 20,000 or more users. Your work must cover design, assessment, setup, migration, and ongoing support of NGFWs and Panorama. It must include HA deployments, firewalls with more than 10G of throughput, and multi\-zone environments with 1,000 or more policies. * Hands\-on experience with PA\-7500, PA\-5450, or PA\-3000 series firewalls (or equivalent platforms). * 10\+ years of enterprise cybersecurity assessments. This includes firewall architecture and configuration reviews, policy reviews, threat\-prevention checks, and gap, vulnerability, and risk analysis. * Large firewall migrations of at least 5 HA pairs (10 firewalls) in one program. jobs.description: **Job Title** Director of Architecture, Advisory Technology **Job Description Summary** Cushman \& Wakefield is hiring a Director of Advisory Architecture to lead architecture for its advisory business, improve the tools and processes that speed up development, and champion forward deployed engineering (FDE). The Director is an architect first, and the role has three parts: sound architecture for advisory solutions, ongoing optimization of development tools and processes (including accelerators such as AI Studio), and championing the FDE model of embedded, prototype\-first delivery. **Job Description** Cushman \& Wakefield is hiring a Director of Advisory Architecture to lead architecture for its advisory business, improve the tools and processes that speed up development, and champion forward deployed engineering (FDE). The Director is an architect first, and the role has three parts: sound architecture for advisory solutions, ongoing optimization of development tools and processes (including accelerators such as AI Studio), and championing the FDE model of embedded, prototype\-first delivery. The role combines deep solution and cloud architecture, including platforms such as Salesforce, with hands\-on experience in agentic architecting and rapid, embedded development. The goal is for fast prototypes and AI\-assisted work to be promoted into production by Engineering without rework, and for the architecture behind them to hold up. The Director reports to the Head of Architecture and partners closely with Product, Business Analysis, Solution Architecture, and Engineering. Our customers are internal: brokers, other employees, and contractors who need technology that fits how they work. **What you will do** * **Own architecture for the advisory business.** Set the target architecture, standards, and roadmap for advisory solutions, and make sure designs are sound, secure, and consistent with company architecture standards. * **Optimize tools and processes.** Continuously improve the tools, templates, and ways of working that shorten the development lifecycle from idea to production, including accelerators such as AI Studio. * **Practice agentic architecting.** Define how AI agents are used to draft requirements, design solutions, and generate code, with human review, clear patterns, and quality controls at each step. * **Champion FDE.** Lead and grow an embedded team that works with brokers and delivery teams to build working solutions quickly, iterate live on feedback, and decide with the business sponsor whether each effort is productized, handed off, or retired. * **Protect the path to production.** Work with peer architecture leaders and Engineering on the guardrails prototypes are built within, a promotion gate to production, and shared source control, environments, and standards. * **Triage with Product.** Agree on criteria for which requests enter the FDE lane and which follow the standard requirements, design, and build path, and cap FDE capacity so it does not become a help desk. * **Close the loop to the roadmap.** Identify patterns the team sees repeatedly and bring them to Product as candidates for roadmap features. * **Measure outcomes.** Track broker adoption, time from idea to release, time saved, the share of prototypes that reach production, and how much rework they need. * **Be a visible advocate.** Show the business what is possible, and help Engineering and Architecture colleagues see these accelerators and the FDE lane as partners that remove ambiguity and delay from their work. **Leadership and team** You will lead a team of about four to six, made up of forward deployed engineers, architects, and UI/UX designers, with room to grow as the model proves out. People leadership matters as much as technical depth in this role. You will hire for judgment and range rather than narrow specialty, coach builders to work comfortably with non\-technical users, and set clear expectations so the team can move quickly without creating work for others. You will work alongside peer architecture leaders who cover the other business lines. Together you share common standards and a joint view of what moves from prototype to production. Key partners include: * Product leadership, for intake, triage, and the roadmap * Business analysts, who turn validated prototypes into formal requirements * Solution architects, who set patterns and run the promotion gate * Engineering leadership, who own hardening, release, and support **What you bring** The role blends two skill sets: traditional solution architecture on cloud platforms, and the rapid, embedded building style of forward deployed engineering. We expect real depth in the first and demonstrated experience in the second. **Architecture foundation** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 10 or more years in solution or software architecture or engineering, including delivery of production systems at a large organization * Experience architecting cloud\-based business solutions, with hands\-on knowledge of a CRM platform such as Salesforce, including its data model, flow automation, integrations, and security model * Working knowledge of core architecture disciplines such as integration, data, security, and governance, and the discipline to keep fast work inside those guardrails * 3 or more years leading and developing people, ideally including managers or senior individual contributors **Forward deployed and rapid development** * Experience prototyping with business users, showing working software early and changing it on the spot * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted development and agentic coding tools to build quickly, and designing AI\-enabled workflows such as agent orchestration and tool use, with a clear view of their limits and risks * Comfort with modern rapid\-build approaches, including low\-code, AI\-assisted coding, and lightweight deployment, and the ability to learn new tools quickly as they change * Strong communication with non\-technical audiences, including senior leaders and revenue\-generating teams * The judgment to say no, prioritize, and explain trade\-offs to stakeholders who want everything now **Nice to have** * Experience in commercial real estate, professional services, or another broker\- or advisor\-driven business * Background as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, or similar customer\-embedded role * Hands\-on use of AI\-assisted coding and rapid build\-and\-deploy tools, such as Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or Railway (examples only; we value the ability to pick up new tools over any single product) * Salesforce depth beyond the basics, such as Flow, Lightning Web Components, Apex, or Salesforce certifications * Experience partnering with UX and design teams to shape broker\-facing tools * Familiarity with CI/CD and source control practices for CRM platforms * Experience building a new team or capability inside an established enterprise Cushman \& Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements. The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications. The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role. The compensation for the position is: $ 161,500\.00 \- $190,000\.00 Cushman \& Wakefield is an Equal Opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position at Cushman \& Wakefield, please call the ADA line at **1\-888\-365\-5406** or email Accommodations@cushwake.com. jobs.description: **About the role** CyberStorm Defense is hiring a senior engineer to extend an open\-source scientific data curation platform built on Python, Django and MongoDB so it can specify, generate and measure agentic AI workflows. You will connect the platform to large language models through REST APIs, design schemas that describe agentic AI systems, prototype multi\-agent applications with ZeroMQ messaging, and capture LLM sessions and traces as analyzable datasets. **What you will do** * Extend the Configurable Data Curation System (CDCS) with LLM connectivity and agentic AI specification templates. * Prototype an agentic application using ZeroMQ, and integrate it with an ongoing LLM demonstration. * Write design documents, schemas and tested code, and present demonstrations to research staff. **Minimum qualifications (all required)** * M.S. in computer science or a related field. * 10\+ years in information technology or standards development. * 5\+ years each in: data exchange standards (XML and JSON), Unified Modeling Language, and software testing. * 4\+ years each in: Java and Python; JavaScript; XML, XML Schema and XSLT; JSON and JSON Schema; HTML5 and CSS; the Django framework; MongoDB; and working across Linux, Windows and macOS. * 7\+ years with databases. * 2\+ years each in: Docker; GitLab and GitHub; the CDCS platform (or its MDCS/NMRR components); ZeroMQ; and LLM experimentation and implementation. * Able to pass a federal NACI background check. **Strong signals:** contributions to NIST's CDCS, MDCS or NMRR repositories on GitHub; prior work at NIST or a materials\-data program; published agentic AI or LLM evaluation work. **How to apply:** Send your résumé, a link to relevant GitHub work, and a yes/no for each minimum qualification. This position is contingent upon contract award. **Job Summary Location:** Gaithersburg, MD (federal research campus) As a Senior Research Software Engineer, CDCS and Agentic AI (Contingent), you’ll build and advance research software that enables complex AI and computational research. You’ll partner with researchers to translate questions into scalable systems, develop and evaluate AI models, and move promising methods toward deployment. This role combines hands\-on software development with machine learning research, quantitative applied research, and research and development. **Responsibilities** * Design, implement, test, and maintain research software, algorithms, and distributed systems for large\-scale AI models and agentic applications. * Develop, train, evaluate, and deploy AI models using machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch; apply deep learning, generative AI, natural language processing, computer vision, unsupervised learning, and data mining as appropriate. * Analyze research data using statistical analysis, SQL, and methods including signal processing; support work spanning robotics and quantum engineering. * Collaborate with research teams to shape experiments, interpret results, and communicate findings. **Your impact:** Reliable, scalable research tools help researchers test ideas efficiently and turn findings into useful advances. * Document and share results through technical reports, conference papers, and papers in peer\-reviewed journals. **Requirements** * Degree or equivalent background in computer science or a related field, with experience in a research setting and software development. * Demonstrated experience in machine learning, research, model training, model deployment, and machine learning/AI\-based analysis. * Strong programming skills in Python and experience with Linux; familiarity with AWS and one or more of Java, R, C\#, C, C\+\+, or MATLAB. * Knowledge of algorithm design, distributed systems, and machine learning frameworks; experience developing large\-scale AI models is preferred. * Research publications and experience in quantitative applied research are preferred. Pay: Up to $145,000\.00 per year Education: * Master's (Required) Ability to Commute: * Gaithersburg, MD (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: General Manager, Data Operations
jobs.description: **About David AI** ------------------ David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R\&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high\-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in. David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors. Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight\-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI. **About our Data Operations team** ---------------------------------- Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high\-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale. This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large\-scale production systems. **About this role** ------------------- As General Manager of Data Operations, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high\-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently. **In this role, you will** -------------------------- * Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high\-quality audio data at scale. * Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs. * Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end\-to\-end. * Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next. * Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans. * Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities. * Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale. **Your background looks like** ------------------------------ * 5–10 years of experience in high\-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture\-backed startup). * Prior experience scaling large\-scale operational efforts at high\-growth startups or fast\-paced companies. * Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required. * Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines. * A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail. * Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment. * Low\-ego, collaborative, and mission\-driven, focused on team and company success. **Bonus points if you have** ---------------------------- * Experience in data, ML, or large\-scale operations. * Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited PTO. * Top\-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans. * FSA \& HSA access. * 401k access. * Meals 2x daily through DoorDash \+ snacks and beverages available at the office. * Unlimited company\-sponsored Barry’s classes. **Visas** --------- We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H\-1B *transfers*, H\-1B1, O\-1, E\-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world. Compensation Range: $205K \- $235K

Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability\-ensuring high\-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. * **Technical Leadership and Advocacy:** Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production\-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. * **Engineering Craftsmanship:** Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre\-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability\-codified, version\-controlled dashboards and SLO\-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient\-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. jobs.description: Diamond Foundry Inc. is solving the thermal limitation at the foundation of today's most exciting tech industries \- AI \& cloud compute, electric\-car power electronics, and 5G/6G wireless. We have managed to produce the world's first single\-crystal diamond wafers and are now on a mission to put a diamond behind every chip. We are the rare unicorn that has grown fast and profitably. We received $515m in funding and are executing a multi\-$B expansion plan for one of the greenest forms of tech manufacturing: converting greenhouse gas into diamond wafers using zero\-emission energy. We are looking for an experienced, communicative Senior Software Engineer to own the data pipelines, internal systems, and APIs that power our real\-time manufacturing and R\&D operations. What we need from you is deep, production\-grade Python expertise and the ability to own a project end\-to\-end: partnering directly with material engineers, technicians, and hardware engineers to turn ambiguous operational challenges into working production software. This role will be on\-site 5 days a week in either our South San Francisco office or our Fremont, CA office. ### **Responsibilities** * Own technical initiatives from inception to delivery: translate operational needs into technical roadmaps, architectural specs, and deployable code. * Architect and scale end\-to\-end Python backends, spanning high\-throughput event pipelines, internal REST APIs, and automated data processing tools. * Interface directly with internal clients (production technicians, metrology specialists, and R\&D engineers) to diagnose workflow bottlenecks and validate solutions on the floor. * Optimize database performance and schema design for high\-frequency telemetry, process metrics, and traceability data. * Partner with our front\-end engineers to define clean API contracts and data models for operator\-facing UI’s. ### **Requirements** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with production Python as your primary language *(experience with industrial protocols like MQTT, Modbus, OPC\-UA, or PLCs is a strong plus).* * Proven end\-to\-end project ownership with the ability to define roadmaps, write specs, and execute code independently *(experience working in manufacturing, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, or physical R\&D environments is a plus).* * Full\-lifecycle Python backend expertise across REST APIs, event/data pipelines, and automation scripts *(hands\-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, or async processing is a plus).* * Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to run discovery directly with non\-software stakeholders like scientists, technicians, and operations teams *(experience scoping technical requirements directly from physical shop\-floor workflows is a plus).* * Strong querying skills with schema design fundamentals. evolve. **Our Products: Business Media** **Byte: Video Communication Without Another Meeting** Byte enables asynchronous video communication through browser\-based screen and camera recordings. * Record and share video messages instantly. * Provide feedback with time\-specific comments, reactions, and annotations. * Catch up quickly through transcripts, AI\-generated chapters, and summaries. * reactions, stickers, Magic Markers, and feeds. * Organize communication with threads, mentions, and private conversations. * Stay informed through Catch\-Me\-Up and notifications. **Value threads, reminders, and calendars. * Connect chat, meetings, and scheduling across web, desktop, and mobile. **Value Proposition:** Bring communication and collaboration together in one connected workspace. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full\-stack web applications. * Build reusable frontend components using modern JavaScript frameworks. * Develop backend services, REST APIs, and database integrations. * Independently own features from technical design through production deployment. * Investigate and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, and production issues. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and engineering teams to deliver customer\-focused solutions. * Participate in architecture discussions, code We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our team and translate our customers’ goals into working software throughout the stack from automated configurations to model definitions, calculation APIs, and building intuitive user interfaces. The most important qualifications are a passion for quality software and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and approaches. You may be a fit for this role if you: * Are open\-minded, curious, and resourceful * Are passionate about/stay current with modern technologies * Solve problems systematically and transparently * Share ideas, solicit/integrate feedback, design and solve collaboratively * Take a software engineering approach and demonstrate automation and security mindsets What you might work on: As a full stack engineer at Dimensional, you will have the opportunity to understand the users’ needs and solve problems at all levels of the stack from automating infrastructure and deployments to complex calculation engines in an ETL pipeline to designing user friendly web applications. * Collaborate with subject matter experts in a variety of areas to drive the success of our clients * Participate in software architecture and design * Develop software solutions using back\-end and/or front\-end technologies * Demonstrate and apply software engineering best practices and participate in code reviews * Develop configurations and automations to enable testing, infrastructure and deployments The successful candidate will be self\-motivated and have a strong drive for learning and self\-improvement. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience * 5\+ years of software development experience in a professional and/or academic setting * Experience with Python, Ruby, JavaScript, or equivalent dynamic languages * Experience with C\#, Java, C/C\+\+, Typescript, or equivalent static languages * Experience with any of the following: data engineering, web/mobile application development, systems/security software development Preferred Competencies: * Interest and ability to learn other coding languages as needed * Ability to write in English fluently and idiomatically * Advanced degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science or other related technical field * Experience with agile/scrum methodologies * Financial services industry experience * Experience with any of the following: * Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLServer * Airflow, Kafka, AWS, serverless/microservice architecture * TDD, BDD, Numpy/Scipy/Pandas, React, Angular, Vue.js, Node, Ansible * New Relic, ELK While this position is remote\-work eligible, you are required to report to the Company’s offices for orientation and your first week of work, and on a periodic basis thereafter. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ In this role, you will be a member of the Storage and Data Pipeline Infrastructure development team. We are responsible for building reliable systems that ingest, process, store, and serve data across Docusign products and internal engineering platforms. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to develop backend infrastructure and data pipeline capabilities in a scalable, secure, and operationally sound manner. You will use your experience with production software, cloud services, data stores, and distributed processing to design, implement, and maintain ingestion workflows, storage integrations, data processing jobs, and service interfaces. You will help build reusable infrastructure that supports batch and incremental data movement, data quality, schema evolution, retention, and governed access to data. A successful person in this role will want to work in an environment where you are challenged to continue learning and growing, where your voice and opinions are heard, and where you can make a meaningful difference. You will work closely with Product Management, Core Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, and internal business and partner teams to deliver value to customers faster. Docusign is transforming the way that customers create, commit, and manage agreements. Our teams are building highly visible and impactful infrastructure to make agreement data more useful, accessible, secure, and actionable, and we need talented engineers to help us get there. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Software Engineering Manager. **Responsibility** * Design, develop, test, and maintain storage and data pipeline infrastructure * Build reusable ingestion, transformation, and serving components for data from multiple source systems * Develop batch and incremental workflows across cloud storage, distributed processing, and database technologies * Deliver secure, performant, scalable, and reusable enterprise\-quality code using Agile practices and a continuous integration and deployment CI/CD pipeline * Implement data validation, schema handling, deduplication, checkpointing, retry, backfill, and error\-handling capabilities * Collaborate through code reviews, pair programming, design reviews, and online communication to help ensure we deliver reliable and maintainable software * Develop logging, monitoring, alerts, dashboards, and runbooks to detect and diagnose live issues * Investigate defects and production issues, including code and systems that are unfamiliar, and implement durable fixes * Apply access control, tenant isolation, data retention, deletion, and privacy requirements to infrastructure and data workflows * Partner with Product Management, Core Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, and partner teams to define and deliver solutions * Keep current with software engineering, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and data engineering practices and share knowledge with the team * Contribute to technical documentation, estimates, operational procedures, and continuous improvement **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or another related engineering field, or comparable industry experience within a software organization * 2\+ years of experience implementing and maintaining production software * Experience with server\-side development, data stores, APIs, or data pipelines * Experience with Python, Java, Scala, C\#, Go, or another modern programming language * Experience with software development fundamentals, including testing, vers \-solving, analytical, and communication skills * A demonstrated willingness to assist other team members through brainstorming, mentoring, pair programming, knowledge sharing, and creative problem solving * Knowledge of data privacy, access control, data retention, data residency, or right\-to\-forget requirements **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $111,900\.00 \- $162,250\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Work Authorization Notice:** Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance. **AI in Our Hiring Process** At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human\-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy. We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

jobs.title: Principal Visual Designer, Merchant
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ At DoorDash, design means making experiences for the people who order, the people who prepare, and the people who deliver. As a Designer at DoorDash, you want to build things that matter to real people. You're at your best when you can move from idea to shipped product quickly, bringing experiences to life that reach and influence users at massive scale. You'll care about whether the product you make solved a real problem for real people, or changed how someone experiences their day. You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Engineering and Product Management, dig into the data, and use LLM\-powered tools alongside traditional design tools. If the LLM powered tools don't exist yet, you build them. **About the Role** ------------------ Restaurants are the heart of every neighborhood, yet most run on a patchwork of disconnected tools. We're building DashOS, the operating system for the restaurant of the future. It's one platform that connects delivery, in\-store dining, reservations, and loyalty, across software, kiosk and POS hardware, and agentic experiences that take work off operators' plates. As Principal Visual Designer, you'll set the look, feel, and identity of DoorDash's merchant products. You'll own the visual direction for DashOS and give merchants a recognizable identity across every surface, including hardware, where no design conventions exist yet. These products already work. Your job is to make merchants love using them. Visual craft is the center of this role, and you'll ship it yourself. You'll prototype and use AI tools like Cursor and Claude to generate and refine UI, so your ideas reach production with full fidelity. You'll also define the visual foundation of the design system (tokens, components, guidance, and examples) so designers, engineers, and AI tools all produce on\-brand, high\-quality UI. Engineering partners build and maintain the tooling, and you set the rules and the quality bar. You'll report to the Senior Director, Product Design for Merchant. This role is hybrid, with 1–2 days a week in a Design Hub. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * **Set the visual direction for merchant products across DashOS** and bring multiple teams around a shared vision, so the work compounds instead of duplicating. * **Ship high\-craft interfaces with a clear point of view**, turning complex, data\-dense workflows into screens merchants can read at a glance in a busy kitchen or at the counter. * **Own the visual foundation of the design system**: define the tokens, components, usage rules and examples that both people and AI tools apply. Review generated UI against that bar, record what good looks like, and improve the system based on how teams actually use it. * Design for new surfaces. Create visual systems for points\-of\-sale, handhelds and agentic experiences where no existing paradigm applies. * **Influence through the work.** Earn trust with prototypes and shipped products instead of decks, and keep your prototypes production\-ready. * **Raise the bar across the team.** Mentor senior designers, help close strong hires, and help people sharpen their sense of what to build and why. **We're excited about you because…** ------------------------------------ * You've designed interfaces that defined or reshaped a product's look and feel, and your portfolio shows top\-of\-bar visual craft with range across brands and styles. * You can build what you design. You work in React, TypeScript or similar, and use AI tools to explore directions and refine UI faster than you could by hand. * You've set direction across a product area, and people adopted your work because it was good, not because you told them to. * You'd rather build a visual system that makes 20 designers faster and more consistent than ship one great screen yourself. * You've worked on complex, information\-dense products such as point\-of\-sale, fintech, marketplaces or platform teams, and you've shipped with product and engineering partners, including pushing back constructively. * Bonus: you've designed for devices or contexts with no existing design paradigm and built the visual system from scratch. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. The DriveTime Family of Brands spans across DriveTime, Bridgecrest and SilverRock. You can find us at the intersection of technology and innovation as we use our proprietary tools and over two decades of industry knowledge to redefine the process of purchasing, financing, and protecting your vehicle. **That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?** ***This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time.*** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **In short,** as our Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise\-grade Pega solutions that support critical business operations. You'll partner closely with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performing applications while helping shape technical strategy, solve complex challenges, and drive innovation through modern software engineering and AI\-assisted development practices. **In Long, as the Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:** * Designing and implementing high\-quality Pega applications that power critical business processes and align with enterprise architecture standards. * Translating complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable Pega solutions, including workflows, case designs, integrations, and user experiences. * Serving as a hands\-on technical expert who can troubleshoot complex production and development issues, optimize system performance, and promote engineering best practices. * Collaborating with product owners, architects, stakeholders, and cross\-functional engineering teams to define technical solutions and support strategic initiatives. * Developing and maintaining integrations with APIs, data sources, and external systems to ensure secure and seamless data exchange. * Providing technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, helping elevate team capabilities through coaching, knowledge sharing, and development support. * Participating in architecture discussions and contributing to technical direction, roadmap planning, and solution design decisions. * Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement across applications, processes, and engineering practices. * Staying current with emerging software development trends, architectural patterns, and advancements in generative AI technologies. * Leveraging AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, documentation, and research while maintaining high standards of quality and security. * Collaborating within an innovative, team\-oriented environment focused on continuous learning and operational excellence. **So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking For?** --------------------------------------------- * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges and develop effective solutions. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high\-quality work. * Self\-motivated and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Passion for learning new technologies and staying current with industry trends. * Natural mentor who enjoys supporting and developing other engineers. * methodologies, and application lifecycle management. * Experience working in Agile development environments. **Nice To Have** ---------------- * Experience developing RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, or .NET Web APIs. * Familiarity with the Cosmos React and Constellation UI frameworks. * Experience integrating Pega applications with third\-party platforms and enterprise systems. * Hands\-on experience with Pega Infinity. * Exposure to cloud\-based environments and modern application architectures. * Experience utilizing generative AI tools to improve software development productivity and quality. \#LI\-JW5 **So What About the Perks?
