Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug\-free, tobacco\-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high\-energy environment!

jobs.title: Senior IT/OT Controls Engineer
jobs.description: At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward\-thinking experts. We're one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals \& Mining, Warehousing \& Distribution, and CPG/Food \& Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site. We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced an IT/OT Controls Engineer to lead and contribute to the design and delivery of Unified Namespace (UNS) and IT/OT integration projects. This role is responsible for defining architecture requirements, developing detailed software design specifications, building and contextualizing industrial data models, and architecting DataOps solutions using platforms such as Cirrus Link and Ignition for both Data Lake and on\-campus controls. You will design and configure scalable, secure communications (MQTT/Sparkplug B, OPC UA, REST, and vendor\-specific protocols) that connect shop floor equipment via Industrial applications and SCADA to Vendor Data Lakes, AWS, Azure, and other business systems. This is a fantastic opportunity to own projects from concept through commissioning in a Mission Critical environment. You will: * Design, develop, and implement Unified Namespace (UNS) solutions using Cirus Link, MQTT/Sparkplug B, and Ignition. * Model and contextualize plant\-floor data into standardized, ISA\-95\-aligned payload structures adapted for Mission Critical Infrastructures for consumption by Data Lake, AWS, Azure, historians, and other business systems. * Integrate shop floor equipment and control systems with Ignition Gateway and enterprise applications using MQTT, OPC UA, REST APIs, and vendor\-proprietary protocols. * Configure and maintain edge connectivity to PLCs, SCADA, Ignition Edge IPC's, and legacy systems (including OPC DA sources) and manage the flow of data northbound into the UNS. * Utilize scripting languages such as Python (including Ignition/Jython scripting) for automation, data transformation, and integration tasks. * Collaborate with cross\-functional IT and OT teams to ensure seamless, secure integration across network layers. * Provide technical leadership and support for project implementation, testing, commissioning, and startup. * Develop and evaluate alternative architectures and system solutions that meet stated requirements. * Maintain and update project documentation of the environment and provide regular status updates to management and stakeholders. * Work successfully in a team environment focused on customer service and continuous improvement * Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates. You have: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in a similar role. * Strong understanding of Unified Namespace concepts and MQTT/SparkplugB. Hands\-on experience with Cirus Link or comparable brokers. * Experience with Ignition (gateway configuration, tag structures, scripting); Ignition certification a plus. * Experience with SQL/Postgres (For alarm/event and other interactions) * Proficiency in Python; familiarity with REST APIs, JSON payloads, and integrating web services. * Familiarity with SCADA systems and industrial data structures; experience with OPC UA and legacy OPC DA connectivity. * Experience integrating shop floor systems with Ignition, historians, or ERP. * Working knowledge of ISA\-95 models and terminology adapted for Mission Critical Infrastructures, particularly as applied to UNS hierarchy design and MES integration. * Ability to work in a hybrid IT/OT environment, including an understanding of OT network \& server architecture with segmentation. * Working knowledge of control system networks and controllers (Modbus/IP, BacNet/IP, Ethernet/IP, CIP, etc.). * Proficiency in troubleshooting control systems and an understanding of process controls. * A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork. **Benefits \& Perks:** * 401k \+ match \+ prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry. * Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits. * Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off. * Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities. *E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable* *accommodations* *to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.* *\#LI\-PV1*

jobs.title: Senior Healthcare AI Engineer, Analytics Hub
jobs.description: Overview: With over 50 years of proven success, ECG, ranked as a Best Midsized Firm to Work For 2026 by *Consulting Magazine*, is the most experienced healthcare consulting firm in the US. Working exclusively in this space, our people consistently demonstrate their ability to solve challenges for providers and achieve better patient outcomes. Across our seven office locations, we’re seeking individuals who will show the courage to find innovative solutions and make a direct impact on the delivery of healthcare services nationwide. **About ECG** ECG is a national consulting firm that is redefining healthcare together with its clients. We provide a broad range of strategic, financial, operational, and technology\-enabled consulting services to the full continuum of care, including hospitals, health systems, medical groups, academic medical centers, children’s hospitals, cancer centers, ambulatory surgery centers, investors, and payers/health plans. Our work focuses on creating practical, tailored solutions that help clients maximize resources and achieve sustainable results. We value collaboration, integrity, and innovation, and are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment. Job Details: **Join Our Analytics Hub** Our growing Analytics Hub works with our consulting teams to deliver new insights, streamlined analysis, and world\-class intelligence to the healthcare organizations we serve as clients. Combined with our consulting teams, you will be helping physician and executive leadership make informed decisions that can alter the course of their enterprises in areas such as physician alignment, mergers and acquisitions, service line planning, provider compensation, financial performance, transforming care models, patient access, managed care portfolio optimization, digital health expansion, and more. ECG uses a Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment, with Microsoft Power BI as ECG’s current analytics visualization platform. Our detailed plans incorporate qualitative findings with data\-driven strategic, operational, and financial considerations that enable organizations to pursue realistic change. Our consultants bridge the gap between strategic thinking and operational implementation with sensible action plans and tactical recommendations. This approach allows us to stretch our clients’ thinking while ensuring that initiatives with the broadest and deepest impact are prioritized and implementable. Our wide\-ranging engagements often focus on helping our clients: * Position themselves for value\-based care delivery. * Align hospitals and physician organizations. * Strengthen financial performance. * Enhance clinical programs. * Develop strategic partnerships and/or mergers. **Your Opportunity with ECG: Senior Healthcare AI Engineer** As a senior healthcare AI engineer, you will help drive the firm's AI strategy by designing, developing, and deploying intelligent solutions that enhance client delivery, accelerate internal operations, and create new service offerings. Working closely with consultants, healthcare subject matter experts, data engineers, and business leaders, you will transform complex healthcare and business challenges into scalable AI\-powered applications. In addition, you will partner with internal teams including IT, learning and development, business development, and analytics engineering to establish AI best practices, evaluate emerging technologies, and build secure, governed, and scalable AI capabilities across the organization. Here, no two days or projects are alike, which means you’ll have a lot to learn and plenty of support to help you succeed. We are seeking an innovative and technically skilled senior healthcare AI engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI solutions that improve healthcare operations, clinical decision\-making, and business performance. This individual will work at the intersection of healthcare, data science, software engineering, and generative AI, developing scalable solutions that utilize healthcare data to create actionable insights and automate complex workflows. **Your Responsibilities May Include** *AI and Machine Learning (ML) Development* * Design and develop production\-grade generative AI, ML, and agentic AI solutions for healthcare and business applications. * Collaborate with IT and Hub members to deploy solutions. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation systems, intelligent assistants, AI agents, and workflow automation solutions using enterprise and healthcare data. * Develop evaluation frameworks that measure solution quality, accuracy, groundedness, reliability, and business impact. * Contribute to the creation and improvement of automated testing methodologies, benchmark datasets, and regression testing processes to ensure AI solutions remain stable as prompts, models, and data sources evolve. * Partner with business stakeholders (consultants, clients, business development, HR, etc.) to define success metrics and o ensure secure deployment of AI solutions. *Collaboration and Innovation* * Partner with division leaders, healthcare consultants, clinicians, and operational stakeholders to identify AI opportunities. * Translate business requirements into technical AI solutions. * Present findings, recommendations, and system capabilities to both technical and nontechnical audiences. * Stay current with emerging AI technologies, healthcare innovation, and industry best practices. **Qualifications*** Strong knowledge of and passion for the healthcare industry * Bachelor’s degree in either computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, statistics, health information management, or a related degree that relies heavily on critical thinking, logic, and math + A master's degree is a plus * 5\+ years of professional experience working in data engineering or data science + Healthcare or consulting experience is preferred * 2\+ years of recent experience developing production AI, ML, or advanced analytics solutions * Strong proficiency in: + Python, SQL, and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn) + Microsoft Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS, or Google Cloud AI; strong preference for Azure AI Services * Experience developing and deploying LLM\-based applications * Experience with agentic AI frameworks and LLM evaluation frameworks * Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and cloud architecture * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills *Preferred* * Work with healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, DICOM, ICD\-10, CPT, and revenue cycle data * Experience working with healthcare data, healthcare technology, healthcare consulting, health systems, payer organizations, or digital health companies * Experience deploying agents from Azure AI Foundry and/or Microsoft Copilot Studio * Experience using the Microsoft Fabric platform **Job Locations*** Preferred locations: Chicago or Washington, D.C. * Other locations: Boston * We will consider remote hires, but prefer an in\-office presence through our hybrid model **Schedule** Full time/exempt : **What You Can Expect of Us** To reward our driven, innovative, and passionate employees, we’ve built a company culture that’s centered on performance. We offer an attractive compensation package, challenging work, and an entrepreneurial environment where you can take ownership of your career—and get out as much as you put in. : The estimated base salary range for this job is $170000\.00 \- $190000\.00 annually. It represents a good faith estimate of the range that ECG reasonably expects to pay at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to years of experience, special skills, and market changes. This job is eligible to participate in ECG’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects ECG’s pay\-for\-performance philosophy. The job is also eligible to participate in ECG’s benefit plans, which include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) matching program, unlimited PTO, and other wellness programs. : **Apply now and make an impact for years to come.** To begin the recruitment process, please submit your resume via our career site at https://careers.ecgmc.com. *ECG provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, age, disability, pregnancy, medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We participate in E\-Verify as part of our onboarding process. Having the permanent legal right to work in the United States is a condition of employment. ECG is not currently able to provide assistance to candidates requiring sponsorship or a visa.* : \#LI\-SC1 \#LI\-Hybrid

Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives, to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality solutions while fostering a culture of continuous improvement. corporate projects, department projects, and Enhancement project initiatives. **Required knowledge and experience:** * Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or equivalent directly related experience * 5\+ years of experience in programming or full stack development * Hands on experience working with the following: + C\#/.NET core development + Entity Framework + REST APIs + Angular, TypeScript, and client\-side frameworks + JavaScript, HTML, and CSS + SQL and Relational Databases. * Knowledge and experience working with Responsive Design and Single Page Applications (SPA) * Experience working with Power Automate or similar automation tools * Experience working in a collaborative, team\-oriented environment with a strong emphasis on mentorship, knowledge sharing, and cross\-functional support * Microsoft or other development certifications preferred * Logical, analytical problem solver * Highly self\-motived and directed * Ability to absorb new ideas and concepts quickly * Excellent analytical and problem solving abilities * Effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment * Ability to conduct research into software development and delivery concepts, as well as technical application issues * Ability to present ideas in a business\-friendly and user\-friendly language * Very strong customer service orientation * Excellent jobs.title: Senior Embryologist
jobs.description: **ABOUT eGENESIS** ------------------ eGenesis is a clinical\-stage biotechnology company developing human\-compatible engineered organs to address the severe global organ shortage. The Company’s proprietary genome engineering platform enables extensive, multiplex gene edits to remove key biological barriers, add protective human transgenes, and inactivate endogenous retroviruses. EGEN\-2784, a genetically engineered porcine kidney, is the Company’s lead program and is currently being evaluated in a multi\-patient Expanded Access study at MGH. eGenesis is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. At eGenesis, our core values—innovation, collaboration, compassion, resilience, and passion—are at the center of how we work. We engineer hope and bring passion to everything we do. We collaborate and learn from one another, combining diverse expertise to tackle complex challenges. We innovate boldly, pushing boundaries and science to new heights. where no pig organ has gone before. With resilience, we navigate challenges and celebrate progress together. And in all we do, we lead with compassion—for our patients, our people, and our pigs. ### **POSITION SUMMARY** We are seeking a motivated senior embryologist for the Wisconsin production facility. The ideal candidate will report to the Director of Embryo Production and provide embryology support for GMP production within the GMP production facility while adhering to regulatory bodies' requirements, the company's GMP facility standard operating procedures (SOPs), and carry out responsibilities in keeping with the organization's mission. ### **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Carry out GMP laboratory activities and functions in a manner that is consistent with the eGenesis’ operating procedures. + Perform and assist in daily laboratory processes under GMP conditions, including handling porcine oocytes, embryo production, and embryo transfers. + Implementation of improvements into our GMP production process. + Follow SOP’s and maintain the highest standards in performing daily laboratory duties. + Operate and maintain all equipment necessary to perform designated laboratory tasks. + Provide general support and upkeep of the laboratory, including maintaining inventory of stock of media, reagents, solutions, and aliquots. * Support eGenesis activities, primarily in vitro embryo production in porcine including documenting GMP records into an electronic laboratory notebook. * Promote and adhere to safety in the workplace. + Follow safe work practices and enforce health and safety regulations. Report unsafe acts and conditions and ensure equipment is properly maintained. Report all accidents/incidents. Inspect own area and take remedial action to minimize or eliminate hazards. Complete required training assignments, forms, and other paperwork. * Collaborate with the Process Development Team to improve our embryo production. + Perform other duties and assume other responsibilities as assigned. ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** * Master's degree in Embryology, Animal Science or related field * 6 years of experience in assisted reproductive biotechnologies including: (1\) In vitro embryo production and embryo culture; (2\) Handling and manipulation of mammalian oocytes and embryos; (3\) Embryo transfer procedures; and (4\) Operation and maintenance of laboratory equipment used in embryology and assisted reproductive technologies. * Any amount of experience with the following: (1\) following, interpreting, and executing laboratory SOPs and controlled documentation practices; and (2\) documentation and recordkeeping using electronic laboratory notebooks and/or GMP\-compliant documentation systems. * Alternatively, will accept a PhD degree and 3 years of stated experience. * Experience can be pre\- or post\-degree * Must be willing o occasionally travel (\<5%) between company facilities as needed in the Midwest \- locations to be determined. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer. This role is based out of Raleigh, NC We are seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to support the development, integration, and maintenance of UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) and Lithium\-Ion Energy Storage System solutions. This role will focus on embedded software development, battery system integration, communication protocol implementation, and sustaining engineering activities for commercial and industrial power conversion products. The successful candidate will be responsible for integrating Battery Management Systems (BMS) with UPS platforms, supporting fielded products, troubleshooting complex system issues, and contributing to the development of next\-generation energy storage solutions. The expected annual salary range for this role is $94000 \- $138000 a year. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- **In this role you will:** * Develop, integrate, test, and maintain embedded software for UPS and Energy Storage System products. * Integrate Lithium\-Ion battery systems and Battery Management Systems (BMS) with UPS control architecture. * Design, implement, and validate communication interfaces between UPS controllers and external battery systems. * Troubleshoot communication, interoperability, and system\-level integration issues between UPS, ESS, and associated control systems. * Support software releases for new product development and sustaining engineering activities. * Investigate and resolve customer\-reported and field\-observed software issues. * Perform root cause analysis and corrective action development for product issues. * Collaborate with controls, systems, hardware, and test engineering teams to ensure successful product integration. * Participate in software architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews. * Develop software requirements, design documentation, test procedures, and validation reports. * Support laboratory testing and validation activities involving UPS systems, batteries, and power electronic equipment. * Contribute to cybersecurity, reliability, and product lifecycle maintenance initiatives. **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution. * Minimum 3 years of industry experience developing or supporting embedded software for industrial, energy storage, power electronics, or UPS products. * Experience developing embedded software in C/C\+\+. * Experience troubleshooting and supporting released embedded products. * Experience working in multidisciplinary product development environments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline. * Experience with UPS, energy storage, power conversion, or electrical power system products. * Experience integrating Lithium\-Ion battery systems and Battery Management Systems. * Experience integrating communication protocols in embedded systems. * Experience implementing and troubleshooting MODBUS RTU and MODBUS TCP communications. * Experience with CAN, CANopen, RS\-485, Ethernet, and related industrial communication protocols. * Experience with real\-time embedded operating systems. * Knowledge of power electronics, battery charging systems, and energy management systems. * Experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model\-based development. * Experience supporting products through the full development lifecycle from concept through field support. * Familiarity with UL, IEC, and industry standards applicable to UPS and energy storage systems. * Experience with Software Configuration Management and Git\-based development workflows. * Experience with LLM coding tools such as Copilot, Claude, or other harnessing * Experience with Hardware in the Loop systems such as OPAL RT or Typhoon All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Many structural heart patients suffer from heart failure with limited options. Our Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) team is at the forefront of addressing these unmet patient needs through pioneering technology that enables early, targeted therapeutic intervention. Our innovative solutions are not just transforming patient care but also creating a unique and exciting environment for our team members. It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey. We’re seeking a Data Engineer with strong enterprise experience delivering data product solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. The ideal candidate brings hands\-on expertise building scalable, governed, production\-grade data pipelines and analytics products using Databricks, Apache Spark, SQL, and CI/CD practices. This role focuses on transforming raw data into trusted, reusable data products that support analytics, reporting, and downstream applications across the enterprise. **How you’ll make an impact:** * Apply hands\-on expertise in Python, cloud technologies, Databricks, Apache Spark, SQL, and AI to build scalable and innovative data solutions * Design, build, and maintain scalable, well\-documented enterprise data products and ETL/ELT pipelines supporting batch and near\-real\-time processing * Monitor, optimize, and tune data infrastructure and Spark/Databricks workloads to improve performance and cost efficiency * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Data Science, Analytics, DevOps, Product, and Platform Engineering teams to deliver new features and data products * Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues; ensure data quality through testing, monitoring, and CI/CD best practices * Ensure compliance with data privacy standards, including the handling of Patient Health Information (PHI), and adhere to enterprise security and governance policies * Contribute to architecture discussions and implement best practices such as layered data modeling and Lakehouse design patterns Perform other incidental duties as assigned * **What you’ll need (Required):** * Bachelor’s degree in a related field, plus experience in Data Engineering, DevOps, or Software Development * Strong hands\-on Databricks experience * Advanced SQL skills for data transformation, analytics, and data modeling This is an onsite role based in Irvine, CA. Relocation assistance is not provided, and candidates must reside within a 50\-mile radius of Irvine to be considered. * **What else we look for (Preferred):** * Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, Lambda; Azure or GCP also acceptable) * Experience with Databricks Workflows, Repos, Jobs, and cluster configuration * Proven experience building and deploying production\-grade data workloads * Proficiency in Spark (PySpark or Scala) with strong understanding of performance tuning and internals * Experience with Delta Lake (e.g., schema evolution, time travel, optimization) * Understanding of Lakehouse architecture, medallion design, and enterprise data modeling standards * Strong foundation in databases, ETL processes, and data structures * Experience with data governance and security practices (RBAC, data masking, PII handling) * Familiarity with data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom validation checks) * Understanding of data contracts, SLAs, lineage, and data ownership models * Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI) and version control using Git * Experience delivering end\-to\-end data products (not just pipelines) for analytics, BI, and application use cases * Experience working in regulated environments (e.g., healthcare, finance, or life sciences) preferred * Eligibility to work in the U.S. or EU, with the ability to travel as required Ability to comply with company policies, including Environmental Health \& Safety and applicable workplace protocols * Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance\-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families. For California (CA), the base pay range for this position is $87,000 to $123,000 (highly experienced). The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website. Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

A team where everyone makes play happen. Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. From our roots as an indie studio to joining the expansive roster of studios at Electronic Arts, this remains our guiding principle. We truly love what we do and want to share our passion with players worldwide. Our shipped titles include critically acclaimed multi\-platform games Apex Legends, Titanfall, Titanfall 2, Star Wars™ Jedi: Fallen Order, Star Wars™ Jedi: Survivor, and Medal of Honor: Above and Beyond. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and long\-term cash programs. ***About Electronic Arts*** We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY SUMMARY** Empire State Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: ESRT) owns and operates a New York City portfolio of well\-leased, top of tier, office, retail, and multifamily assets. ESRT’s Empire State Building features an Observation Deck. The Company is a recognized leader in sustainability. As of November 2, 2026, ESRT’s portfolio is comprised of approximately 7\.7 million rentable square feet of commercial space and three residential properties. More information about Empire State Realty Trust can be found at esrtreit.com and by following ESRT on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and LinkedIn. The dedicated team at ESRT is a collection of diverse individuals with a shared passion for excellence and a keen eye toward future growth. Headquartered in New York City, we harness the energy of the city in everything we do. We care for one another, work hard, and have a lot of fun doing it! We are Certified™ as a Great Place to Work® by the global authority, Great Place to Work®, on workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership behaviors. We prioritize and invest in the health and wellness of employees to attract, develop, and retain top\-tier talent. ESRT values continuous employee development and encourages colleagues to excel in their roles and adapt to emerging business needs. From our crown jewel, The Empire State Building, to incredible buildings modernized for the 21st century, to outstanding customer service, and our decade\-long leadership position in sustainability and energy efficient portfolio that is 100% fully powered by renewable wind electricity, we take pride in our work. ESRT seeks an equally passionate colleague to join the team, understand the vision and help achieve that vision. **POSITION SUMMARY** The Applied AI Engineer I supports, maintains, and enhances ESRT’s portfolio of AI\-enabled enterprise applications. This early\-career role offers recent graduates hands\-on experience with large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and intelligent automation, and helps them develop software engineering skills for production applications. The role works closely with senior engineers and technical leadership to learn the application portfolio and codebase and complete well\-defined tasks, such as bug fixes, small enhancements, tests, and documentation. Regular mentorship and code review support skill development and greater responsibility over time. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Support software design, development, tests, and deployment under senior guidance, and help build applications that incorporate large language models and other AI capabilities * Support retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, such as document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, and retrieval * Help develop AI agents, agent tools, and tool\-calling workflows, and convert approved prototypes into production\-ready features under senior guidance * Implement small, well\-defined features and components under close guidance, with code review by senior engineers * Learn the architecture and codebase of AI applications, such as model integrations, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, evaluation systems, and observability, through structured orientation, documentation, and work with experienced engineers * Write unit and integration tests and help develop automated tests and application monitoring * Learn and apply safeguards for data privacy, access control, and responsible AI practices * Help build APIs, backend services, and data processing workflows that connect AI solutions with internal systems, with support for data ingestion and extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes * Write clean, well\-documented code, use Git for version control, participate in peer code reviews, and follow the team’s continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices * Maintain technical documentation, communicate progress and blockers clearly, and collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and business stakeholders in an agile environment ### **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** * Complete orientation within the first 3 months, demonstrate familiarity with the team’s tools and development processes, and help resolve small, well\-defined bugs and tasks under close supervision * Complete assigned tasks and small features within the first 6 months, incorporate regular feedback from senior engineers, and contribute reliably to team sprints * Handle well\-scoped tasks with greater independence within the first year, apply foundational AI engineering practices, and take on greater ownership with continued mentorship ### **REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS / ABILITIES** * Solid foundation in Python; exposure to at least one additional language (e.g., C\#, Java, TypeScript) through coursework or projects * Exposure to large language models, APIs, or other AI services through coursework, internships, or personal projects * Basic knowledge of software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), tests, and code r  or comparable AI platforms, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), or traditional machine learning ### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times ### **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT** At ESRT, like our tenants, our employees come from everywhere. We foster a collaborative work environment that captures top talent and cultivates the best ideas. As a Great Place to Work® Certified employer, we are committed to maintaining our positive work culture where employees are engaged and can grow and develop. In addition, ESRT employees embody our **Company Culture \& Success Factors** \- * **Adaptable** – you are a self\-starter who’s able to quickly digest and execute new processes to work both collaboratively and independently * **Dynamic** – you are solutions\-oriented, aim to improve processes and implement efficiency, and offer insightful feedback to improve ESRT * **Dependable** – you take a strong sense of ownership and accountability over your work * **Passionate** – you keep up with industry trends and are excited about the potential to propel the industry forward with a “roll\-up\-your\-sleeves” attitude * **Curious** – you consistently look for new ways to work smarter, not just harder * **Ethical** – you treat others with respect, act with integrity in how you perform your work, and embrace our collaborative culture * **Positive** – you possess a service\-oriented attitude with excellent follow through ### **BENEFITS** * Competitive base salary and bonus * Health/Dental/Vision insurance * Company sponsored Life, AD\&D, STD (with Salary Continuation), and LTD Insurance * Voluntary Enhanced LTD Program * Voluntary Hospital, Accident, and Cancer Programs * 401(k) with 100% match up to 5% * Paid parental leave * Pre\-tax transit accounts * Employee Assistance Program for emotional, financial, and legal support ### **WELL\-BEING** * Generous paid time off * Flex remote work time * Flex Summer Fridays * Employee engagement programs * Volunteer time off * Continuing education * Complimentary Empire State Building Observation Deck access * Complimentary gym membership and other wellness benefits * Employee Discount Programs Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, job location, size of property where applicable, and/or certifications. In addition to your base salary, ESRT provides discretionary annual bonuses. ESRT is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We celebrate the unique differences of our employees because they drive curiosity, innovation, and the success of our business. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, creed, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, reproductive choices, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, caregiver status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, training, working conditions, transfer, job assignments, benefits, layoff, and termination. Reasonable accommodations that do not create an undue hardship for the Company are available for applicants and employees with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI/Machine Learning Experience Engineer
jobs.description: ### **AI/Machine Learning Experience Engineer** * JR\-164652 * Hybrid * Toronto * Dallas * Technology * Full time **Who are we?** Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective. Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. **Job Summary** Designs, builds and improves the user and builder experience of Equinix’s AI products and platforms, including conversational AI, agents and agent\-building tools. Combines interaction design with engineering: prototypes working interfaces and conversation flows, tests them with real users and builders, and ships the results into production. Makes AI behavior understandable and controllable: clear responses, visible sources, graceful failure, human escalation and easy feedback. Measures experience quality with data and converts findings into product and engineering changes. Works in a team with senior engineers, designers and product managers, and with platform, security and business partners. Knowledge and Application Applies solid knowledge of human\-AI interaction principles, conversation design and front\-end engineering, plus working knowledge of LLM and agent concepts (prompting, retrieval, tool calling, orchestration). Understands usability research methods, accessibility standards (WCAG) and experience metrics. Understands what builders need from agent and platform tooling: clear APIs, documentation, debugging and observability. Follows established design and engineering standards and suggests improvements. Complexity and Problem Solving Works on problems of defined scope where analysis requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Diagnoses why users or builders struggle (unclear responses, wrong expectations, missing controls, poor tooling) using usage data, session traces and feedback, and applies existing patterns to fix it. Judges whether a metric reflects real experience quality. Escalates unusual or high\-impact issues. Work is reviewed at defined checkpoints. Collaboration and Interaction Works with AI engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, platform and security teams. Explains usability findings and design tradeoffs to partners who are not familiar with the subject. Gathers input from end users and builders, and shares knowledge with the team. **Responsibilities** Experience engineering * Build interactive prototypes and production interface components for AI products: chat and voice flows, agent workspaces, builder consoles and admin tools * Design and implement conversation flows and response patterns: tone, structure, clarifying questions, source citations, confidence cues, error handling, and handoff to a person * Implement controls that keep users in charge: review and edit before action, confirmation for high\-impact steps, undo, and clear scope of what the AI can do * Capture feedback inside the product (ratings, edits, dismissals) and route it to the teams that act on it * Contribute to a shared component library and design system for AI interfaces * Write unit and end\-to\-end tests for interface components Builder and developer experience * Improve the experience of people who build on the platform: onboarding, documentation, templates, SDKs, and tools for testing and debugging agents * Reduce time to first working agent, and track where builders get stuck Research and measurement * Plan and run usability tests, interviews and session reviews with users and builders * Define and track experience metrics: task completion, time to complete, adoption, retention, escalation rate, satisfaction, and builder time to first use * Work with evaluation engineers to add experience criteria (clarity, helpfulness, appropriate tone) to evaluation rubrics and acceptance tests * Turn findings into prioritized recommendations and backlog items Quality and responsible practice * Apply accessibility, localization and inclusive design requirements * Work with InfoSec and Legal on disclosure, consent, data\-handling notices and AI\-generated\-content labeling * Check that interface behavior matches model and policy behavior (what the AI says it can do, versus what it can do) **Qualifications** Required * 1\-4 years in front\-end, full\-stack, design engineering, UX engineering or AI/ML engineering * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, human\-computer interaction, design, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience * Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern front\-end framework (e.g., React), and working Python for prototyping with models and APIs * Portfolio or work samples jobs.description: The world’s largest organizations rely on Evident to help them protect their business and brand from third\-party risk. Our game\-changing technology \- which enables the secure exchange of risk data like proof of insurance, identity, business registration, and other information \- helps our customers verify that their partners have all of the required credentials to do business. In today’s new remote\-first, ever\-changing regulatory environment, our secure, privacy\-first enterprise platform, accessible via web portal or API, provides a highly scalable and configurable solution to manage communications, storage, decisioning, and ongoing monitoring of credentials. Evident is a VC\-backed technology startup, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Learn more at evidentid.com. ### **About the Role** Most engineers live on one side of the stack. The best ones are dangerous on both. At Evident, we're looking for a full stack engineer who can own a feature from database to UI — someone who gets uncomfortable when they can't see the whole picture, and who uses AI tooling to close gaps fast when they do. You don't need to be a master of everything. But you should be the kind of engineer who follows the problem wherever it goes, is honest about where they need to grow, and is energized by a team that'll push you to get there faster. The role will be based in our office in Atlanta (hybrid work model with two days in the office and three days remote). ### **What You'll Work On** **Full ownership, front to back** * Build complete features end\-to\-end: APIs, business logic, data models, and the interfaces that users actually touch. * Move fluidly between backend services (Java, Python) and modern frontend work without needing a handoff to unblock yourself. * Ship features you can point to — visible, real, in production. **AI\-native development as a core skill** * Use AI coding assistants and LLM\-powered workflows as a genuine part of how you build — across the stack, across the lifecycle. * Lean on AI to accelerate the parts of the stack that are less familiar: generate a solid starting point, validate your approach, and iterate from there. * Develop one of the most marketable engineering skillsets available right now — with the team and the mandate to go deep on it. **Hard problems in a meaningful domain** * Work at the intersection of identity, trust, and compliance — problems with real stakes and technical depth. * Design and build systems where correctness matters: data integrity, verification workflows, and integrations with external providers. * Contribute to architecture discussions with a practical point of view, and grow your instincts by working alongside engineers who've seen these patterns before. **Continuous growth** * Pair with senior engineers who are invested in your development, not just your output. * Participate actively in code reviews and design conversations — your perspective matters here. * Build fluency across the stack in a production environment, with real feedback loops. ### **What We're Looking For** **Must\-Have** * 3\+ years of professional experience building and shipping software across both frontend and backend. * Solid backend fundamentals in Java and/or Python — you understand what's happening under the hood. * Hands\-on frontend experience with a modern framework (React preferred) — you can build a functional, clean UI without it being your primary identity. * Comfort with REST APIs, data modeling, and connecting the layers of a system end\-to\-end. * Curiosity about AI development tools and at least some hands\-on experience — you're building the habit even if you're not fully there yet. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and comfort collaborating in a hybrid environment. **Nice to Have** * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, or containerized deployments. * Exposure to LLM integrations in production environments. * Background in identity, privacy, or compliance\-adjacent products. * Experience in fast\-moving startup or scale\-up environments. ### **What You'll Get Out of This** * **Full stack fluency, for real**. Most roles keep you siloed. This one will stretch you across the entire product surface — by design. * **Mentorship from people worth learning from**. The team is small, experienced, and the kind that shares what they know. * **AI skills that actually matter**. You'll build genuine depth in AI\-assisted development inside a production environment, on a team that takes it seriously. * **Ownership without bureaucracy**. Small team, real decisions, no ticket factory. * **Work worth caring abou**t. Identity verification sits at the center of trust online — the problems have weight. * Competitive compensation, benefits, and a hybrid work setup based out of Atlanta, GA. **Why Evident?*** Our team solves a crucial problem with huge business potential together, and we are able to see exactly how our contribution affects customers! * Competitive pay package, including base pay and stock options * Full medical, dental, vision benefits and 401K * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave to support you and your family * Home internet stipend, virtual events, \& more! * Recently named one of Atlanta's Coolest Companies \& 50 on Fire by Atlanta Inno * Recently named one of the Top 10 Fastest Growing Companies in Atlanta \& one of the Best Places to Work in Atlanta by Atlanta Business Chronicle We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Developer, Digital AI Solutions
jobs.description: **Who are We** Galleon Advisors is an Implementation\-Based Management Advisory Firm. Leading hospitality owners and operators turn to us to help them achieve their most ambitious performance objectives. Our approach is designed to achieve lasting improvements by partnering our team of advisors with our client’s team of experts to equally strengthen profit, service, and engagement of their assets. 65 years of executive experience, $1\.8B in Annual Profit Improvement and experience serving 28 countries – *We know Hospitality* We foster an environment that supports and promotes inclusion and mutual respect to allow for optimal professional performance. Galleon Advisors promotes work\-life balance through various programs while providing a competitive compensation package. **Travel and schedule** Full\-time, remote within the United States or Canada, with periodic travel to client properties and team sessions across North America. Based on program needs and client operations, the role requires flexibility for early morning, late evening or weekend work when necessary. **Availability** This role is being recruited on an ongoing basis. The start date will be set in alignment with key program dates. **General role description** The Developer, Digital AI Solutions actively participates on how things are built: the architecture, code and data behind our platform, our client automations and the workflows our consultants use every day. The role reports to the Lead, Digital Solutions. The team builds the software, data and AI behind our consulting programs and delivers AI and automation work directly to hospitality operators and ownership groups. Most build work runs through agentic coding tools such as Claude Code and Codex. The Developer, Digital AI Solutions directs those agents, reviews their output as they would a colleague's pull request, and overrules them when the code, architecture or data model is wrong, including deciding where a human\-in\-the\-loop is required. Time on client sites is periodic: enough to see how an operation runs before automating any part of it. At Galleon Advisors, professional growth is viewed as a shared responsibility given the autonomy provided. **Role responsibilities** The responsibilities of the Developer, Digital AI Solutions include but are not limited to the following. ***Architecture and engineering standards*** * Participates in architecture and data\-model decisions for the firm's platform and client builds, and record the reasoning * Review agent\-generated and human\-written code for correctness, security, maintainability and cost * Participates in setting the team's engineering standards, including how coding agents are configured and governed: testing, code review, CI/CD, secrets handling and guardrails on client data ***Internal builds*** * Build and maintain features on the firm's platform * Build data pipelines and dashboards that turn data into benchmarks, findings and client\-ready outputs * Build and maintain the skills, agents and tools that turn manual consulting processes into automated, repeatable pipelines ***Client AI and automation delivery*** * Collaborates with internal operations teams, on property and remotely, to map how a department works: who does what, in which systems, and where there is opportunity * Scope technical work in consulting terms: requirements, solution design, estimates, delivery plan, risks and status reporting to engagement leads * Build automations, agent workflows and dashboards for hotel and ownership teams, from first prototype through handover * Collaborates with internal operations teams to train clients on what was built and document it so they can run it without us ***AI enablement and currency*** * Collaborates with the Lead, Digital Solutions to support the training of internal operations consultants on AI tools and workflows, and evaluate new tools against the firm's data\-handling and AI use policies before adoption **Required qualifications** The success of Galleon Advisors is rooted in our team's multidisciplinary backgrounds. We encourage experienced candidates who are curious about hospitality and applied AI to apply. The below requirements are necessary: * **Proof of work:** a portfolio, public repository or recorded walkthrough of software, data systems or agent workflows you designed or built and put into real use * **Education:** bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience as a software developer or architect * **Administrative requirements:** valid passport, drivers license * **Languages:** fluency in English is required; multilingualism is a strong asset, specifically Spanish and/or French * **Travel:** willingness to travel periodically to client properties across North America; an interest in travel and hospitality is a plus * **Professional attributes:** strong work ethic (hardworking, demonstrates initiative); ability to work effectively in both team\-based and independent environments * **Culture fit:** alignment with a collaborative, respectful, transparent and accountable team environment; thrives in fast\-paced and evolving environments * **Availability:** ability to start work as soon as required, in alignment with key program dates **Role requirements** * **Experience:** 1\-3\+ years as a software developer, engineer or architect, including architecture decisions that others built on; technology consulting or other client\-facing delivery experience is a strong asset, as is hospitality experience, but neither is required * **Agentic development:** daily, hands\-on use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code and Codex, configured beyond the defaults (skills, subagents, hooks or MCP/CLI/API integrations), and a working understanding of how agents fail: context, evaluation, cost and security * **Engineering and data:** Understanding of Python and SQL, plus a web stack such as TypeScript or JavaScript; designs data models and pipelines on a cloud data warehouse; fluent with Git, code review, automated testing and CI/CD * **Communication:** explains an architecture decision to a client\-leader in plain language, pushes back with reasons, and writes clear documentation * **Strong assets:** Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) or another cloud certification; Microsoft 365 and Power Platform automation; Power BI or Tableau; Excel and PowerPoint fluency; exposure to hotel systems such as property management, point of sale or labor management is considered an advantage **Hiring range:** $90,000\-100,000 **Application process and equal opportunity** Apply with your resume and a link to one system you designed or built: a repository, a recorded walkthrough or a live tool. Add two or three sentences on the problem it solved, who used it, and what you would build differently today. Applications without a work sample will not be reviewed. Galleon Advisors is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a work environment that promotes diversity, equity and inclusion. Candidates requesting accommodation during the recruitment process should advise us of this in their application to ensure we can meet their needs. While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Ads
jobs.description: **About GameChanger:** We believe in the life\-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports. So if you love sports and their community\-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote\-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today. **The Position:** We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the Ads team, which builds the systems that power display and video advertising across GameChanger’s Android, iOS, and web apps, including live game streams. This is a backend\-first role with opportunities to deliver features through to our Android app. Most of your work will focus on building services and APIs in Node.js and TypeScript as we move more advertising logic from our apps to the server. You’ll help build server\-driven ad experiences and expand our integrations with advertising partners, contributing to systems that support our growing advertising business. You’ll bring strong backend experience and hands\-on experience shipping Android features. As priorities shift, you’ll contribute to our Android codebase with support from a senior Android engineer. You’ll partner with staff and senior engineers, product, and our media sales team, with room to deepen your expertise and take on greater ownership over time. You will report to the Engineering Manager on our Ads team. **What You’ll Do:** * Design, build, and operate backend services in Node.js and TypeScript that power ad targeting, eligibility, and delivery across our apps. * Develop server\-driven APIs and configuration that move advertising logic out of our apps and allow us to update ad experiences without waiting for an app release. * Build and maintain integrations with ad\-serving and programmatic advertising partners, including Google Ad Manager, and contribute to new header bidding capabilities. * Implement and ship Android features in Kotlin, connecting backend services to advertising experiences in our app. * Partner with staff and senior engineers to turn technical designs into reliable, maintainable services and features. * Improve the performance, reliability, and observability of our advertising systems through testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting. **Who You Are:** * You have 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in building and operating backend services in production. * You have strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript, including API design and working with relational or NoSQL databases. * You have hands\-on experience shipping features in a production Android app using Kotlin and can explain your implementation decisions. * You can take a defined technical problem from design through implementation, testing, and release, working independently and seeking input when needed. * You enjoy working across backend and mobile, collaborating with teammates, and learning new parts of a system as priorities evolve. * Bonus: You have experience with advertising technology—such as Google Ad Manager, IMA, VAST, header bidding, or Prebid—and/or live video streaming. **Perks:** * Work remotely throughout the US\* or from our well\-furnished, modern office in Manhattan, NY. * Unlimited vacation policy. * Paid volunteer opportunities. * Technology stipend \- $4,000 every 2 years after your start to make sure you have the latest and greatest technology. * WFH stipend \- $500 annually to make your WFH situation comfortable. * Monthly physical, mental, wellness \& learning stipend offered through Holisticly. * Monthly lifestyle stipend offered through Fringe. * Full health benefits \- medical, dental, vision, prescription, FSA, HRA, HSA, and coverage for family/dependents. * Retirement savings \- Traditional and Roth 401K plans are offered through Vanguard, with an immediate company match. * Life insurance \- basic life, supplemental life, and dependent life. * Disability leave \- short\-term disability and long\-term disability. * Company paid parental leave \- up to 20 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non\-birthing parents. * Family building benefits offered through Progyny. * DICK'S Sporting Goods and their family of brands teammate discount. *The target salary range for this position is between $120,000 and $140,000\. This is part of a total compensation package that includes incentive, equity, and benefits for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by several factors including experience, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We constantly review all teammate pay to ensure a great compensation package that is fair and equal across the board.* * *DICK'S Sporting Goods has company\-wide practices to monitor and protect the company from significant compliance and monetary implications as it pertains to employer state tax liabilities. Due to said guidelines put in place, we are unable to hire in AK, DE, HI, IA, LA, MS, MT, OK, and SC.* We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **Our Interview Process \& AI** We recognize that AI has become a common part of everyday life and professional work, and its use continues to evolve rapidly. Our perspective on AI in the hiring process will evolve as well. At this time, we ask that candidates please refrain from using AI tools during interviews and assessments, as we want to see your authentic self. We will clearly indicate if and when AI use is acceptable in the process. If you have any questions or need accommodations, we're here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone! **IMPORTANT NOTICE:** All official recruitment communications from GameChanger will come from an email address ending in @gc.com or no\-reply@ashby.hq.com. If you receive communication from any other domain, please be cautious, as it is likely fraudulent. Compensation Range: $120K \- $140K

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Who we are** Gatik is in the business of autonomous freight, and that business is already on the road. Every day, Gatik's autonomous trucks move freight for Fortune 50 retailers, grocers and consumer brands across Texas, Arizona, Arkansas and Canada, connecting distribution centers and stores and keeping goods moving. At the heart of it all is the Gatik Driver™, our proprietary Level 4 autonomous driving system, powered by scalable, interpretable AI and engineered to deliver safe, reliable, high\-frequency freight operations. Gatik's momentum is real. With more than $600 million in contracted revenue and $200 million raised in our August 2026 Series D round, Gatik has taken one of the toughest challenges in autonomous technology and turned it into a proven commercial business. And the market is paying attention. In 2026, Gatik earned a place on Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers list, and the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies. The Gatik Driver™ won an Edison Award for Advancements in Autonomous Driving, and Inc. named our Co\-founder and Chief Engineer, Apeksha Kumavat, to its Female Founders 500 list. There's a lot more road ahead, and some of the brightest, most driven minds in autonomous technology are building the next chapter at Gatik. We're taking on hard engineering problems, pushing the limits of what's possible and building on a commercial foundation that's already proven itself in the real world with some of the biggest companies in the world, like PepsiCo and Loblaw. If you're ambitious, love solving problems that matter and want to see your work make a real difference, you'll find plenty to get excited about here. **About the role** ------------------ As a Senior Data Engineer, you will own the data platform that turns raw fleet and simulation logs into training\-ready, searchable, and versioned datasets. You will work closely with perception, prediction, planning, simulation, and safety teams to make data fast to find, easy to trust, and cheap to process at scale. This role sits at the center of Gatik's data flywheel: logs from our trucks drive scenario mining, model training, closed\-loop testing, and the safety evidence we need to expand driverless operations. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Design, build, and operate production\-grade pipelines that ingest, decode, transform, and store multi\-sensor logs from Gatik's autonomous truck fleet and simulation environments. * Build internal tools and services for data labeling, curation, indexing, and cataloging, so engineers can find the right drives, events, and scenarios in minutes. * Partner with ML researchers, autonomy engineers, and data scientists to design schemas and APIs that power model training, evaluation, and debugging. * Develop and maintain feature stores, metadata systems, and dataset versioning for both structured data (events, metrics, vehicle signals) and unstructured data (camera, lidar, radar). * Integrate synthetic and simulated data with real\-world logs to support hybrid training, scenario replay, and simulation workflows. * Build scenario\-mining and event\-tagging pipelines that surface rare and safety\-relevant situations on our routes, such as unprotected turns, dock approaches, and adverse weather. * Optimize pipelines for cost, latency, and traceability, with full lineage from raw log to trained model and evaluation result. * Partner with simulation, cloud platform, and safety teams to automate closed\-loop testing, regression analysis, and fleet performance analytics. * Set data quality and observability standards, and mentor other engineers through design reviews and code reviews. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years building data\-intensive software systems, ideally in autonomous driving, robotics, or large\-scale ML environments. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, and working familiarity with C\+\+. * Hands\-on experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines with modern frameworks such as Apache Spark, Flyte, Union, Ray, or Airflow. * Strong knowledge of cloud\-native architectures on AWS (S3, EC2, EKS, Glue, Athena) or Google Cloud equivalents. * Familiarity with sensor data (camera, lidar, radar, GPS/IMU) and serialization formats such as Protobuf, ROS/ROS 2 bags, and MCAP. * Deep understanding of data quality, observability, and lineage in high\-volume systems. * A track record of building reliable, performant infrastructure that supports both ad\-hoc exploration and repeatable production workflows. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in AD/ADAS, autonomous trucking, or robotics, especially with perception, prediction, or planning datasets. * Familiarity with ML orchestration platforms such as Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Vertex AI. * Experience with temporal and spatial data, including geospatial indexing (H3, S2, PostGIS), HD maps, and multi\-sensor time\-series alignment. * Exposure to synthetic data generation, simulation logging, or scenario replay pipelines. * Experience with lakehouse and table formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Parquet at petabyte scale. * Familiarity with safety\-critical development practices and data traceability for safety cases or regulatory requirements. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: CI/CD, testing, code review, and service deployment best practices. * Experience working with cross\-functional, distributed teams across research and production organizations. **Salary Range:** $180,000 \- $260,000 **More about Gatik** Founded in 2017, Gatik has grown into a commercial force in autonomous freight, operating trucks daily in live customer networks across the United States and Canada. We're headquartered in Santa Clara, California, but our impact is felt on the roads and in the supply chains that keep essential goods moving for some of the biggest companies in North America. Our trucks do some of the most demanding work in freight, running high\-frequency, time\-sensitive routes between distribution centers and stores, where reliability matters every single day. For our customers, that means more capacity, better service and products arriving where they need to be, when they need to be there. Behind it all is AI\-first technology built from the ground up for autonomous trucking, capable of navigating highways and surface streets and tackling the complexity of real\-world logistics at scale. Visit Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles. **Notable News** For the latest company news, visit the Gatik newsroom. Recent media coverage: * TechCrunch: Self\-driving truck startup Gatik raises $200M following PepsiCo deal * Reuters: Gatik secures $200 million in funding as autonomous freight market accelerates * Bloomberg: Driverless Trucks Can Save Lives on America's Roads * PepsiCo website: PepsiCo and Gatik announce multi\-year agreement to deploy autonomous freight in North America * Wall Street Journal: Driverless Trucks Are Here \- and They're Delivering Bags of Doritos * CBS News: Pepsi deploys self\-driving delivery trucks * Bloomberg: Autonomous Trucking Firm Gatik Inks Contracts Worth $600 Million * Forbes: Hundreds' Of Gatik Robot Delivery Trucks Headed For U.S. Roads * CNBC\-TV18: No more test runs: Gatik says driverless trucks are now a real, money\-making business * Forbes: Gatik And Loblaw Announce Largest Commercial Deployment Of AV Trucks **Taking Care of Our Team** At Gatik, we connect people of extraordinary talent and experience to an opportunity to create a more resilient supply chain and contribute to our environment's sustainability. We are diverse in our backgrounds and perspectives yet united by a bold vision and shared commitment to our values. Our culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect and agility. We at Gatik strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that together we can do great things. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. **E\-Verify Notice**: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Gatik participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E\-Verify program.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer | Robotics
jobs.description: **What We Do** ============== Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall\-climbing robots, industry\-leading sensors, and an AI\-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real\-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure. **Role at a Glance** ==================== We’re looking for a **Full Stack Software Engineer, Robotics** to own and improve the software that supports robotic inspections, from the application operators use on their laptops to software deployed on the robot. This full\-stack role spans user interfaces, Python services, and hardware integration, with most software running locally on field laptops and robot computers. You will work closely with field operators to improve robot controls, inspection monitoring, and visibility into data quality. The application allows operators to monitor live camera feeds and view ultrasonic thickness measurements mapped onto 2D or 3D models of the asset as the robot scans it. Projects may include extending support to new asset types, integrating sensors and cameras, and improving calibration and diagnostics. This role is based in our Pittsburgh office, with potential for occasional field visits. **What you will do** ==================== * **Partner with field operators.** Understand inspection workflows, gather feedback, and translate operational needs into software improvements. * **Develop across the software stack.** Build and maintain the operator application and software deployed to the robot, integrating user interfaces, backend services, and hardware. * **Expand inspection capabilities.** Extend support to additional asset types, such as tank roofs and horizontal tanks, and integrate new sensors and cameras, including LiDAR. * **Improve operator controls and visibility.** Develop robot controls, live camera feeds, 2D and 3D data views, calibration workflows, and inspection monitoring and review tools. * **Integrate and troubleshoot connected systems.** Coordinate robot motion, localization, cameras, sensor data acquisition and processing, calibration, and inspection management. Diagnose issues across hardware communication, services, and the operator interface. * **Deliver reliable field software.** Test and release software for field laptops and robot computers. Improve logging, recording, and diagnostics, and support recovery from dropped connections, disconnected sensors, and interrupted inspections. **Technologies We Use** ======================= * Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript * Svelte and FastAPI * Message\-based services, real\-time data streaming, and 3D visualization in the browser * ROS, ZMQ, and Docker * Linux, macOS, and Windows, including embedded Linux computers on robots **About You** ============= **Required Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years developing user\-facing desktop applications. * 2\+ years working on distributed systems for real\-time data processing. * Experience building and maintaining production applications or services in Python that communicate with hardware and process sensor data. * Experience developing user\-facing applications with a modern JavaScript frontend framework, such as Svelte or React. * Clear written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and collaborate across software, hardware, and field operations teams. **Preferred Skills** * Robotics software development experience, including software that interacts with embedded Linux computers, hardware, or sensors. * Experience with real\-time or streaming data, where information arrives continuously and timing matters. **Who We Are** ============== At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender\-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. We’re an office\-first culture but understand that sometimes you may need to work from home. Many people are in the office five days a week, others need a bit more flexibility. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve \- and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact. Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our critical mission, we’d love to hear from you.
