jobs.description: General Foundry Service is a high mix, low volume aluminum foundry with 5 complementary casting processes (2 types of sand, plaster, investment \& permanent mold), and a machine shop specializing in precision components for various industries including medical, biotech, robotics, military, semi\-con. and gps device. We are looking for a Foundry Process Engineer. **Overall Job: C**ontribute and help manage the team responsible for the overall operations in the pattern shop, foundry \& cleaning room (including but not limited to): gating design \& simulation, NPI, engineering trouble shooting, safety, quality of product, productivity, scheduling/planning, purchasing, work flow, continuous improvement, etc. **Job Responsibilities/Requirements:** · Efficiently help multiple foundry processes/departments, while understanding internal deadlines and requirements. · Understanding of foundry industry best practices from metal handling to mold making. · Create clear and concise work order instructions for team members. · Review work order instructions; recommend and implement changes when needed. · Translating previous learnings into suggestions/ideas to improve jobs/foundry operations (continuous improvement). · Understand documentation required for each job, experience working in an ISO environment; production and quality requirements/logs/work orders. · Consistently maintain/promote a safe, clean, lean and collaborative work atmosphere. · Ability to work independently while maintaining a high attention to detail. · Performs other related responsibilities, as requested. **Education/Experience:** · Bachelor’s degree in field of application preferred, with at least 3\+ years of experience · Associate’s degree in field of application, with at least 6\+ years of experience · A complete \& proven understanding of the foundry (sand, die or permanent mold) processes/environment: ingot control, melting, molding, creating cores, pouring, remove gates, etc. · Computer literacy, good verbal and written communication · Patternmaking, gating/rigging \& simulation experience a plus All applicants must be U.S. persons. Working mix is around 20% office / 80% floor. Compensation for Foundry Process Engineer is based on skills \& experience. General Foundry Service offers medical, dental \& vision insurance. Company offers profit sharing/retirement plan, 401K, paid vacations, paid holidays, paid sick leave \& other benefits. Specific opportunity is full time. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: IT Operations Analyst
jobs.description: **Job Description** **IT Operations Analyst** ========================= **Hybrid:** This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to either Austin TX or Warren MI 3 days per week (T\-W\-Th) . GM is seeking a detail\-oriented, data\-driven IT Operations Analyst to help modernize application operations through data\-driven insights, statistical methods, Agentic AI, automation, and process improvement while supporting business\-critical applications across dealer operations, vehicle engineering, finance, purchasing, supply chain, and other business functions. This role combines IT Operations, data, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies to identify patterns, improve operational processes, reduce repetitive manual work, and improve the reliability and efficiency of application support across multiple business units. The role is well suited for individuals with a strong technical, quantitative, or business foundation who are interested in applying data, automation, and emerging technologies to IT Operations. Prior professional IT Operations experience is not required. Relevant coursework, projects, internships, certifications, research, and other practical experience can provide the foundation for success in this role. **The Role** The IT Operations Analyst helps ensure the stability, reliability, and accuracy of business\-critical applications and operational processes through data\-driven insights, statistical methods, intelligent automation, and production support. Working within established IT operating practices, you will support incident triage, data validation, operational monitoring and reporting, release verification, and application health assessment. A significant focus of the role will be looking across operations to identify patterns, recurring issues, repetitive work, and opportunities where Agentic AI, data, and automation can improve efficiency, reliability, and support quality. You will collaborate with application engineers, database administrators, infrastructure teams, business analysts, and business stakeholders across multiple business units to understand operational challenges, develop data\-driven insights, automate repeatable activities, and help implement intelligent solutions. Complex technical issues will be escalated to appropriate engineering or subject\-matter experts as you develop deeper knowledge of enterprise applications and production operations. **What You’ll Do** * Support and monitor business\-critical applications and operational processes across multiple business units, using alerts, logs, dashboards, job results, reports, and system metrics to identify issues and operational risks. * Triage incidents, perform initial investigation, apply documented procedures or workarounds, and escalate complex technical issues with clear supporting information. * Evaluate operational data, including incident volumes, error rates, response and resolution times, application availability, service\-level performance, MTTR and MTTD, using statistical methods, trend identification, forecasting, and other quantitative techniques. * Use SQL, Python, R, PowerShell, Shell/Bash, or comparable tools to work with data, investigate issues, validate information, and automate repeatable operational activities. * Use approved generative and Agentic AI tools to develop or improve workflows for incident triage, diagnostics, information retrieval, health checks, reporting, documentation, data validation, and other repeatable processes. * Partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify operational pain points and opportunities where data, intelligent automation, and process improvements can reduce manual effort and improve consistency, quality, reliability, and efficiency. * Build dashboards, operational metrics, reports, and automated reporting using Power BI, Python, Excel, Power Query, or comparable data platforms, and communicate meaningful trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Support releases and change activities, maintain operational documentation and runbooks, and continually identify opportunities to improve monitoring, observability, automation, operational reliability, and SLA performance. * **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)** * Bachelor's degree in one of the following fields: Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Finance, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related technical, quantitative, or business field. * Strong quantitative and problem\-solving foundation, with the ability to interpret data and identify patterns, trends, anomalies, relationships, and improvement opportunities. * Coursework, academic projects, internships, certifications, or practical exposure involving one or more of the following: SQL, Python, R, PowerShell, Shell/Bash, or comparable programming, scripting, statistical, or data to ence is not required for this role. * **What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)** * Coursework, projects, internships, certifications, or research involving data analytics, statistics, academic, internship, certification, research, or personal projects. * Experience creating dashboards, quantitative models, forecasts, automated reports, AI agents, or automated workflows. * Exposure to Agentic AI, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted data exploration, or business\-process automation, including validation of AI\-generated outputs and responsible use practices. * Familiarity with jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AV Data & Analysis Tools
jobs.description: **Job Description** General Motors is a global leader in advanced driver assistance. With Super Cruise hands\-free technology in more than 500,000 Super Cruise–equipped vehicles on the road and over 700 million hands\-free miles driven, GM is proving that automation can be trusted, intuitive, and helpful. GM has the global reach to bring cutting\-edge advances to everyday drivers at unprecedented scale. Join us to help deliver the next generation of safe and delightful personal autonomous vehicle experiences. **About the Team** Every autonomous\-driving engineer at GM eventually asks the same questions: *What happened on that drive? Where else has this happened? Why did the vehicle do that? Did my change fix it?* The AV Analysis team builds the tools that answer them, across the full life of AV data: * Record and catalog new data as it comes in from the fleet, so engineers know what exists, where it came from, and whether it's ready to use. * Index and mine road data alongside simulation output, so engineers can find the scenes that matter using structured filters, similarity search, and natural\-language queries. Analyze what happened by replaying sensor data, perception output, and planner decisions in synchronized 3D, camera, plot, and map views. Engineers do this to triage and diagnose an issue, or to validate a new change. * Perception, planning, simulation, mapping, validation, and data teams use these tools every day. That work spans next\-generation autonomous development vehicles, Super Cruise programs, and autonomous mobile robots in GM factories. We're part of AV Tooling, which also builds GM's fleet\-operations tools and AI\-assisted triage. We share one goal: shorten the loop from collecting data, to understanding it, to fixing the vehicle. **About the Role** Our senior engineers don't wait for a spec. Demand for our tools outpaces any roadmap, so the most valuable thing you'll do is decide what to build. That means finding the problem that's quietly costing engineers hours every week, designing the tool that removes it, and shipping it. You'll own a major part of the data lifecycle end to end, such as how engineers search and mine data, or how they analyze and debug it. You'll also help connect cataloging, search, and analysis into one workflow. **What You'll Do** * Find the highest\-leverage gaps in how engineers find, analyze, and debug AV data. Work alongside users, read support channels and bug reports, and notice where teams are building their own workarounds. Then turn those gaps into tools people adopt. * Record and catalog new AV data as it arrives, with the context engineers need to trust and use it: vehicle, software version, location, and ingestion status. * Index and mine road data alongside simulation output. Build search that combines structured metadata queries in SQL with embedding\-based similarity search in vector databases, plus natural\-language queries and LLM\- and VLM\-powered curation. * Build high\-performance tools for analyzing what happened, with synchronized replay of camera video, lidar, 3D scenes, plots, and maps. Engineers use them to triage and diagnose issues, to validate new software changes, and to debug live in the vehicle during testing. * Take ambiguous requests from idea to shipped. Write requirements and design docs that weigh options, build consensus with stakeholders, and deliver iteratively so users are unblocked early. * Serve as technical lead for a multi\-project workstream. Plan and break down the work, delegate, hold a high bar in design and code reviews, and guide engineers across GM who contribute to our tools. * Keep tools fast and reliable in production, and raise the bar for the team's engineering systems: tests, CI speed, developer experience, observability, and on\-call. Mentor engineers, and use AI\-assisted development and agentic workflows to multiply what a small team can deliver. * **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years building complex, data\-intensive web applications with TypeScript/JavaScript and React. * A track record of spotting an unmet user need yourself, building the tool or feature that addressed it, and driving it to real adoption. * Hands\-on experience building on both SQL and vector databases, including data modeling, indexing, and query performance (e.g., PostgreSQL or BigQuery, and Vespa, Milvus, pgvector, or OpenSearch). * Comfort working across the stack, designing APIs and building services in Node.js or Python. * Deep experience diagnosing and fixing web application performance problems (rendering, memory, large\-data and streaming throughput) through profiling and measurement. * Demonstrated technical leadership: leading multi\-person projects, writing design docs, and driving decisions across teams. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical users whose needs differ widely, from perception researchers t cataloging at scale: metadata, provenance, and lineage for large sensor datasets; workflow engines such as Temporal; Kubernetes and Google Cloud. Owning internal developer tools in production: SLOs, monitoring, incident response, and on\-call. * **Compensation:** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of New York, Colorado, California, or Washington. * **The salary range for this role:** is $144,700 to $261,300\. You will translate complex business and engineering needs into practical system solutions, evaluate opportunities to apply AI, and guide capabilities from discovery through production. You will work across requirements, architecture, data, APIs, applications, and operational processes with a strong focus on business value, security, quality, performance, and reliability. This role is primarily focused on systems thinking, solution definition, integration, and technical leadership rather than day\-to\-day application development. You will partner with engineering, data, AI, architecture, and business teams to identify high\-value AI opportunities, define system requirements and solution approaches, assess risks and dependencies, and guide delivery teams toward successful outcomes. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead discovery, systems analysis, solution definition, and continuous improvement for AI\-enabled systems supporting Global Design and Product Development engineering teams. * Facilitate discussions with business and technical stakeholders to understand needs, define problems, identify opportunities, and translate them into clear objectives and delivery plans. * Identify and assess potential AI/ML and large\-language\-model (LLM) use cases, including business value, data readiness, feasibility, risk, security, privacy, and responsible\-use considerations. * Analyze current\-state processes, applications, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies to identify gaps, risks, jobs.title: Senior Systems and Network Engineer - Part Time Position
jobs.description: **Senior Systems and Network Engineer** **Position Summary** We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems and Network Engineer to manage, secure, and continuously improve our IT infrastructure. This role is responsible for the reliability and performance of servers, workstations, storage systems, printers, laboratory instruments, and network infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong hands\-on technical expertise with sound judgment, clear communication, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. You will collaborate with internal teams, management, and external vendors while contributing to infrastructure planning and technology decisions. **Key Responsibilities** **Systems Administration and Maintenance** * Administer, monitor, and maintain servers, workstations, printers, storage systems, laboratory instruments, and other network\-connected devices. * Install, configure, and support Windows Server and desktop operating systems, with Linux or Unix support as required. * Manage Synology storage devices, endpoint protection, antivirus solutions, system services, and related infrastructure. * Monitor system health, capacity, availability, and performance. * Troubleshoot issues proactively to minimize downtime and maintain business continuity. * Manage user accounts, permissions, access controls, and system policies. * Perform routine patching, firmware updates, and preventive maintenance. **Network Administration** * Manage and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, internet connections, and VPN services. * Configure and troubleshoot network services and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, and remote access. * Monitor network availability, traffic, capacity, and performance. * Diagnose and resolve connectivity, latency, and network security issues. * Implement network segmentation and access controls to protect systems and sensitive information. * Maintain secure connectivity for laboratory instruments and other specialized devices. **Infrastructure Upgrades and Projects** * Plan and execute hardware replacements, software upgrades, firmware updates, patch deployments, and system migrations. * Assess infrastructure needs and recommend technologies that improve reliability, security, performance, and scalability. * Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure compatibility and minimize operational disruption. * Participate in technology planning, purchasing decisions, implementation projects, and infrastructure improvements. * Validate systems after upgrades and document all material changes. **Backup, Disaster Recovery, and Business Continuity** * Implement, monitor, and maintain backup and disaster\-recovery solutions for critical systems and data. * Review backup jobs regularly and investigate failed or incomplete backups. * Conduct scheduled recovery tests to verify that systems and data can be restored successfully. * Maintain disaster\-recovery procedures and supporting documentation. * Assist with establishing and meeting recovery\-time and recovery\-point objectives. **Information Security and Compliance** * Implement and enforce security policies, technical controls, and industry best practices. * Support compliance with HIPAA and other applicable privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. * Perform vulnerability assessments and coordinate the remediation of identified risks. * Apply security measures such as least\-privilege access, multifactor authentication, system hardening, network segmentation, and endpoint protection. * Assist with security investigations, audits, risk assessments, and incident\-response activities. * Monitor security alerts and escalate or respond to incidents appropriately. **Laboratory and Specialized Equipment Support** * Support the network connectivity and IT\-related components of laboratory instruments and specialized equipment. * Coordinate with equipment vendors to troubleshoot hardware, software, interface, and connectivity issues. * Help maintain reliable communication between laboratory instruments, computers, printers, storage systems, and other connected platforms. * Follow applicable change\-control, security, and documentation requirements when working with regulated systems. **Documentation and Reporting** * Maintain accurate network diagrams, system configurations, inventories, procedures, and technical documentation. * Document incidents, resolutions, system changes, and recurring troubleshooting procedures. * Maintain records of hardware, software, warranties, licenses, and vendor information. * Provide management with reports on infrastructure health, system availability, network performance, security events, and identified risks. * Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and knowledge\-base articles. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * At least seven years of experience in systems administration, network administration, infrastructure engineering, or a comparable role. * Strong experience supporting Windows Server and Windows desktop environments. * Working knowledge of Linux or Unix systems. * Hands\-on experience with routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, wireless networks, and common networking protocols. * Experience with storage, backup, disaster\-recovery, endpoint\-security, and antivirus solutions. * Strong hardware, software, network, and application troubleshooting skills. * Understanding of cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, access controls, and infrastructure hardening. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a dynamic environment. * Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills. * Ability to communicate technical issues and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working in a healthcare, laboratory, clinical, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated environment. * Knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements. * Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper\-V. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, DNS, and DHCP. * Experience using PowerShell, Python, or similar scripting tools to automate administrative tasks. * Understanding of ITIL practices, change management, incident management, and IT service management. * Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator, Microsoft Windows Server, Cisco CCNA or CCNP, CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Security\+, VMware VCP, or equivalent. Pay: $40\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 15\.0 – 25\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Mobile Application Developer

Copilot) in daily development * Experience with Git and version\-control workflows * Self\-directed — able to take ownership of projects from requirements to delivery ### **Desired Qualifications** * Mobile Top 10 * Experience building features with AI APIs, such as the Anthropic Claude API * Experience with TypeScript, Vue 3, Nuxt, Node.js, or PostgreSQL * Experience with Epicor or another ERP system * Familiarity with geotechnical or environmental site data, such as CPT, HPT, or MWD **Benefits** * 401(k) * Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid Holidays * Profit jobs.title: Data and Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About this opportunity:** At GoEngineer, data connects nearly every part of the business. We’re looking for a Data \& Analytics Engineer who wants to understand those connections, improve them, and make sure the data behind our decisions can be trusted. Reporting to the Manager, Data \& Analytics, you’ll work across systems including HubSpot, Shopify, Streamline, NetSuite, and ChurnZero, helping manage the full lifecycle of data from source applications through the warehouse and into the hands of business users. This is a broad, hands\-on role combining data engineering, analytics, systems thinking, and business problem\-solving. You won’t spend your days building massive Spark or Snowflake pipelines. Instead, you’ll dig into how systems connect, troubleshoot where data breaks down, improve reliability, and translate real business questions into practical data solutions. You’ll share ownership of the data environment with the team and grow into primary ownership of key platforms and processes. **This role is fully remote within the United States.** **Key Responsibilities:** * Own the full data lifecycle, understanding where data originates, how it changes, and how it moves across business applications and the data warehouse. * Design, build, and maintain data models, transformations, pipelines, and scheduled processes that support reporting, analytics, and AI applications. * Manage data integrations between NetSuite, the warehouse, and other enterprise systems, including data written back to source applications. * Ensure data quality and reliability by monitoring pipelines, warehouse performance, and data flows, and resolving issues at their root cause. * Support warehouse operations, including job scheduling, access management, storage, and performance optimization. * Apply source control, testing, documentation, and controlled deployment practices to data code and processes. * Develop and support the data services and integrations behind AI tools and agents. * Partner with business stakeholders to understand their questions, identify available data and gaps, and translate needs into practical data and reporting solutions. * Look beyond the initial request to determine the underlying business problem and recommend solutions that deliver the right outcome. * Communicate scope, timelines, and trade\-offs clearly, using data to guide recommendations and decision\-making. * Identify opportunities to improve data processes, systems, and workflows, collaborating with teammates to turn ideas into practical solutions. **What You Bring:** * 2–4 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role. We’re open to candidates slightly outside that range with the right experience. * Strong SQL skills, ideally T\-SQL with SQL Server or Azure SQL, including stored procedures, query tuning, and working with large datasets. * Experience with data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including fact and dimension tables, incremental loads, and maintaining historical data through temporal tables or slowly changing dimensions. * Ability to monitor and troubleshoot warehouse health, including failed jobs, data freshness, and performance issues. * Working knowledge of Power BI, including building data models and dashboards. * Experience using Git and pull\-request workflows for source control. * Ability to understand and troubleshoot data flows across interconnected business applications and a central data warehouse. * A strong understanding of data quality and how changes in one system can affect downstream data and reporting. * Ability to translate business questions into data requirements, identify gaps, and constructively challenge assumptions when needed. * Clear communication with both technical and business stakeholders, including explaining recommendations, setting expectations, and recognizing when more information is needed. * Self\-direction and initiative, with the ability to investigate problems, identify improvements, and collaborate with the team to move solutions forward. ***We are looking for candidates with the below experience and skills, however, even if you do not meet all the listed requirements, very interested candidates should still apply:*** We're also looking for experience in at least 2–3 of the following areas. Comparable tools count; you don't need experience with every tool listed. * dbt or another SQL transformation framework. * NetSuite data, or another ERP or CRM such as Salesforce, Dynamics, or SAP. * Celigo or Stitch, or a similar integration tool such as Fivetran, Azure Data Factory, or Boomi. * Python, TypeScript, or PowerShell. * Azure services such as Functions, Key Vault, and app hosting, or AWS or GCP equivalents. * AI coding assistants or building data access for LLMs. **Competitive Compensation Includes:** $95,000 \- $110,000 USD **More about what GoEngineer offers:** At GoEngineer, we understand that our value comes from our employees, and we celebrate and respect their unique experiences. We are working to build a culture where both our employees and customers are centered in the work we do, and employees feel welcomed as they are from the first day. **Generous Benefits Include:** * Participation in GoEngineer’s unlimited PTO program from day one of employment. * 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 6% company match, 100% vested on day one. * Comprehensive medical coverage, including PPO and High Deductible plans with FSA/HSA options and employer HSA contributions. * Paid Family Leave, including paid pregnancy disability leave and paid parental bonding leave. * Employer paid Life Insurance policy, \& Short Term, and Long Term Disability insurance, with optional supplemental coverage. * Dental and Vision insurance * Mental health, telemedicine with 24/7 access to medical providers, and wellness programs, including virtual therapy, nutrition counseling, and physical therapy. * Fertility, adoption, and family building benefits. * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering free, confidential counseling and support for mental health, legal, financial, and family needs. * Optional voluntary benefits, including accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness coverage, identity theft protection, pet insurance, plus student loan repayment and prescription cost savings programs. *To support a fair and efficient hiring process, we may use AI technology to summarize interviews and help our teams review information consistently. AI does not evaluate candidates or make hiring decisions. All decisions are made by our human hiring team.*

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer, Multimodal Agentic AI for Glasses
jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Jose, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * 3 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field. * 3 years of experience with end\-to\-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging). * Experience with Generative AI. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience with Multimodal Machine Learning. * Experience with large\-scale infrastructure. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Our team is at the forefront of building the next generation of conversational AI. We are developing multimodal, agentic AI solutions for smart glasses, to create a unique, proactive, and trusted multimodal experience. This technology delivers instant, natural conversational intelligence directly to the user's eye and ear, allowing them to navigate and interact with their physical world more immersively than ever. As a Senior AI Engineer, you will play a technical leadership role at the forefront of developing groundbreaking multimodal agentic AI solutions for smart glasses. You will architect and ship trusted, real\-time conversational experiences that seamlessly blend voice, streaming vision, and physical\-world context. For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Director, Quality Engineering
jobs.description: HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community\-based care. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non\-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security\-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.** ### **Essential Job Duties** * **Enterprise Quality Leadership:** Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization. * **Standardize Testing Processes:** Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria. * **Tooling Ownership:** Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation. * **Automation Strategy:** Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing. * **Compliance, Accessibility \& VPAT Reporting:** + Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2\.1\+ + Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports + Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits * **Security \& Compliance Testing Support:** Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking. * **Customer UAT Support:** + Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments + Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles + Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements * **Quality Metrics \& Reporting:** Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership. * **Shift\-Left Quality Practices:** Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration. * **Incident \& Defect Management:** Oversee defect triage for high\-priority production and pre\-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root\-cause prevention. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases. * **Organizational Leadership**: Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers. * **Continuous Improvement:** Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence. * **Release Governance:** Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no\-go decisions. * **Coding agent advocacy:** **Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI\-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.** ### **Other Job Duties** * Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader. ### **Travel Requirements** * Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel ### **Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required. * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high\-performance systems. * 4\+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs. * Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments. * Hands\-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2\.1\+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs. * Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation. * Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes. * Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them. * Background working in cloud\-based architectures and microservices environments. * Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non\-technical partners. * **AI/ML fundamentals:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. jobs.title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Healthcare needs a better rhythm: one that keeps care continuous and deeply human. Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that works alongside clinicians to make that possible. We're a team of doctors, engineers, designers, researchers, and creatives building tools that help clinicians stay focused on what matters most: their patients. In just 18 months, Heidi has given back more than 18 million hours to healthcare professionals, supporting 73 million patient visits in 116 countries. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi worldwide. Backed by significant venture funding, we're growing rapidly across the US, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with leading health systems and thousands of clinicians globally. **The Role** ------------ As a **Clinical Solutions Consultant**, you’ll be the person who makes Heidi actually work in the real world. Serving as the technical counterpart to the Applied AI Managers, you’ll work to translate customer business needs into agentic solutions helping customers realize what's possible with our platform. You'll own the full technical lifecycle from first deployment through to a thriving, self\-sufficient customer: building custom clinical and operational workflows, debugging production issues, and becoming a trusted technical partner to the clinicians and operational teams you work with. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Work directly with clinical and operational stakeholders to design and build custom workflows that fit how care is actually delivered. * Be the escalation point for complex agentic issues — diagnosing problems, coordinating with engineering, and closing the loop with the customer. * Lead demos, technical discussions, and solution architecture for clinical AI workflows * Define what success looks like for each deployed workflow, then build the evaluations that prove it * Visit the clinics and hospitals we work with, so you understand the teams we're building for firsthand * Own the margin trade\-offs on when to build, customise or roll out existing knowledge flows * Run the safety audits and recommend constant eval refinements **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years in an implementation engineering, or customer\-facing technical role \- ideally in SaaS, healthtech, or enterprise software. * Comfortable owning ambiguous, high\-stakes problems end\-to\-end without a playbook. * Sharp communicator \- you can explain a complex integration failure to a CTO and a head nurse in the same breath. * Experience working embedded with enterprise customers or health systems is a strong plus. **Other Things To Know** ------------------------ * This role can be based in\-office in either New York or San Francisco. * You will work directly on North America's most important commercial problems. * You will have significant autonomy and ownership from day one. **The Way We Work** ------------------- * **Live Forever**: We build for healthcare's next decade, not next quarter. We set outrageous targets, lead healthcare forward, and follow the evidence, even when it's uncomfortable. * **Practice Ownership**: Everyone here carries the company. We raise the bar on hiring and excellence, own the outcome end\-to\-end, and focus on what matters over process. * **Move Fast, Fix Faster**: The more we do, the more we learn. We ship atoms daily, learn from every release, and stay precise at pace. * **Get Better**: The best clinicians teach. So do we. We live in clinicians' reality, bring warmth to the work, and choose clarity, not cleverness. **Why You Will Flourish With Us** --------------------------------- * Become an owner, with significant shares (equity) in the company. If Heidi wins, we all win. * Healthcare, Dental and Vision benefit options. * 401k with 3% match. * $100/month Healthy Heidi's budget. * $700/year learning and development budget. * $500 home office setup budget. * Recharge Days after major pushes. * The rare chance to create a global impact as you immerse yourself in one of the world's fastest\-growing healthtech companies. Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

management, monitoring, and secrets management. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including Git, automated testing, peer code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and secure development practices. * Ability to work independently through ambiguity, adapt quickly to unfamiliar technologies, troubleshoot across application and integration boundaries, and balance development priorities development languages, frameworks, and technologies. * Demonstrated experience partnering directly with business stakeholders and owning solutions from initial discovery and requirements definition applications or teams. * Hands\-on experience developing agentic applications using LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including tool calling, orchestration, and evaluation of agent behavior. * Experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool integrations that connect LLMs with enterprise applications and data. * Experience working with knowledge graphs, including modeling jobs.title: Senior Advanced Certification Engineer
jobs.description: As a Sr. Advanced Certification Engineer, you will provide cross\-portfolio technical leadership to align the Honeywell Technologies integrated cross\-business data\-center portfolio with the reference architectures, technical requirements, interoperability expectations, qualification frameworks and infrastructure roadmaps of leading accelerated\-computing technology providers, AI infrastructure technology providers, processor and compute ecosystem partners, and hyperscale and cloud technology providers. As a senior individual contributor with no direct reports, the Sr. Advanced Certification Engineer independently leads major technical workstreams and influences multidisciplinary teams without direct authority, helping ensure that integrated solutions are ready to participate in emerging AI\-factory, high\-density\-computing and next\-generation data\-center reference architectures. Engineering, Controls/Automation Engineering or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. * 10\+ years of relevant engineering experience. * Significant experience in one or more of the following: electrical/power systems, power and energy management, controls and automation, mechanical/thermal systems, systems engineering or multidisciplinary infrastructure engineering. * Experience with complex integrated engineering systems. * Experience translating external, customer or platform requirements into product\-level or system\-level engineering requirements. * Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical work across organizational boundaries. * Strong technical communication and documentation skills. * Ability to work effectively high\-density\-compute infrastructure experience. * Experience with data\-center electrical distribution and resilient power architectures. * Experience with thermal\-management systems, cooling interfaces or liquid\-cooling interfaces. * Controls, BMS, EPMS/PMS, automation or systems\-integration experience. * Experience with reference architectures, platform qualification or infrastructure\-readiness frameworks. * Systems\-engineering background, including requirements, interface and baseline management. * Experience developing compliance matrices, requirements\-traceability matrices and interface\-control documents. * Experience with model\-based engineering, BIM, simulation or digital engineering. * Experience working across multiple countries and regions. * Professional Engineer (PE) registration or relevant professional or industry credentials. Travel: up to 20% Relocation support may be provided. **BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL** In addition to a competitive salary, leading\-edge work, and developing solutions side\-by\-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Job posting date: November 13, 2026\. **ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES** Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of lif eeds into actionable portfolio requirements. * Assess readiness and identify gaps. Set remediation actions with the responsible Offering Management, Product Management and Engineering teams, and maintain traceability across requirements, owners, evidence, decisions and closure status. * Coordinate technical evidence and documentation. Document interfaces among electrical, power, thermal, controls, safety, security, software and operational systems; assemble the analyses, test results, certifications and performance data that demonstrate readiness; develop reusable application guidance, architecture documentation and readiness packages; and maintain controlled technical baselines with impact assessments as architectures, offerings or interfaces evolve. * Coordinate product enhancements. Coordinate product enhancements to meet the requirements of leading accelerated\-computing, AI infrastructure, processor, cloud and hyperscale ecosystems. * Integrated Solution Engineering * Architect coherent solutions. Connect power infrastructure, energy management, automation and controls, thermal interfaces, fire and life safety, physical security, software, operational intelligence and OT cybersecurity into an integrated data\-center architecture rather than independent products. * Define integration requirements. Define cross\-business system boundaries, data exchanges, operating and failure modes, and lifecycle considerations. * Apply systems engineering. Manage requirements, interfaces, risks, verification evidence and technical changes, and work with engineering teams to resolve interoperability, performance, reliability, cybersecurity and deployment\-readiness gaps. * Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Ecosystem Engagement * Lead major workstreams. Independently lead cross\-portfolio readiness and architecture\-alignment workstreams across business units and regions without direct authority. * Align stakeholders and drive closure. jobs.title: AI-First Software Developer - Softeon
jobs.description: **Company Description** IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 6,000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters, at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge. IFS Softeon builds warehouse management and supply chain execution software (WMS, WES, distributed order management and the Elastic UI platform) for some of the most demanding fulfillment operations in the world. At IFS, we are flexible, we are innovative, and we are focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive workforce that represents the many cultures, backgrounds and viewpoints of our customers, partners and communities. We are looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can \#MakeYourMoment, so that we can help others make theirs. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. **Job Description** Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works. Our applications run the warehouses that get orders out the door on time. We are changing how that software gets built: AI agents and AI\-assisted CI/CD help us deliver more functionality to our customers, faster, with higher quality. We are looking for an AI\-first developer: someone who treats AI agents as a team to direct, not a fancy autocomplete. You will pair deep Java engineering with hands\-on experience building through agents to deliver great new functionality across our applications, and you will help set the standard for how the rest of engineering works this way. You know that speed only counts if it comes with proof, so automated testing, validation and agent\-assisted review are part of how you ship every change. **What you will do** * Deliver great product functionality. Design and build new features and enhancements across our Java applications (receiving, inventory, picking, replenishment, shipping, integrations and user experience) that customers value and rely on. * Build with agents every day. Use Claude Code and similar coding agents to plan, implement, refactor and test features. Break work into clear specs, give agents strong context, and know when to delegate and when to step in. * Author and maintain agent skills. Write and refine skills, prompts, tool definitions and MCP servers that encode Softeon's domain knowledge, such as Elastic UI form and flow authoring, WMS configuration and integration patterns. * Own a fully automated delivery pipeline. Build and run CI/CD where every change passes automated builds, unit and integration tests, static analysis, security scanning and AI agent code review before a human approves it. * Make quality provable. Build and extend automated validation (unit, API and Playwright end\-to\-end tests) so that AI\-generated code, configuration and integrations are verified automatically, with evidence. * Operate what you ship. Build the telemetry, logging and monitoring your features need, and treat performance and reliability as product requirements rather than a late pass. * Modernize with confidence. Use agents to understand, refactor and modernize existing code, add missing test coverage, and pay down technical debt without slowing feature delivery. * Measure velocity and quality. Track cycle time, defect rates and escaped bugs, and use the data to keep improving how agents and pipelines are used. * Work with product and customers. Turn real warehouse and supply chain needs into well\-specified, testable software, and talk with product managers, customers and Ops teams in their language. * Raise the bar for the team. Share patterns, review others' agent workflows, measure what works, and help colleagues become effective AI\-first developers. **Why it is interesting** * Agents can write code faster than any team can review it. The hard part is no longer typing; it is deciding what to build, giving agents the right context, and proving that what comes back is correct in a domain where a plausible answer can still stop a warehouse. That means designing the specs, skills, tests and pipeline gates that let a small team ship enterprise software at a pace that used to need a much larger one, and there is no settled playbook to copy. * You will do this on mature, mission\-critical applications with real customers, real data and real operational stakes, which is a harder and more rewarding problem than a greenfield demo. **Frameworks and tools you will work with:** **Languages \& core** * Java 17\+, Spring / Spring Boot, REST and messaging APIs, SQL and relational databases **Front end** * TypeScript, Angular, and Elastic UI, our met  skills: clear written specs, structured prompts and the judgment to evaluate and correct agent output. * Comfortable across the boundary: you can write the front\-end, service and database code a feature needs end to end. * Solid fundamentals in relational databases and SQL, system design, and secure coding practices. * Permanent resident of the United States, legally authorized to work in the US without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. **Also valuable** * A platform where behavior is configured through data or metadata rather than written in code, such as low\-code, rules engines or schema\-driven UI. * Modern TypeScript and Angular (or React), including component architecture and design\-system work. * Direct experience with warehouse management (WMS), warehouse execution (WES), transportation management (TMS) or MRP/ERP platforms, as a developer, implementer or operator. * Experience with warehouse automation: conveyors, sortation, pick\-to\-light, AMRs, goods\-to\-person systems or their control software. * Mobile or progressive web applications, including RF/handheld devices, offline behavior and poor connectivity. * Experience building MCP servers, custom agent tooling or AI\-powered developer workflows. * Familiarity with XSLT and Groovy, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP). * Based in the US Eastern or Central time zone. **How we work** * AI\-first by default. Agents are part of the team; you are responsible for their output. * No change ships without proof. Automated tests, agent review and validation evidence on every pull request. * Close to customers. We learn from warehouse floors and Ops leaders, not just tickets. * Small, senior and fast. High ownership, low ceremony, measurable results. **What success looks like** * First 30 days: you ship production changes through the full agent\-assisted pipeline and know our Java platform and WMS domain. * First 90 days: you own a feature area end to end, have contributed new agent skills or pipeline checks, and have measurably sped up delivery without lowering quality. * First year: you have delivered significant product functionality and are a go\-to person for AI\-first engineering practices across Softeon engineering. **Location and eligibility** This is a remote, US\-based role. Candidates must be permanent residents of the United States. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones to support collaboration with our teams and customers. Occasional travel to customer sites or company offices may be required. **Additional Information** **What We’re Offering** * Salary Range: $114,000 to $152,500 annually \+ bonus * Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday * Medical, dental, \& vision insurance * 401K with Company contribution * Flexible spending accounts * Life insurance and disability benefits * Tuition assistance * Community involvement and volunteering events M/F/Disabled/Vet VEVRAA Federal Contractor. We are a Drug\-Free Workplace. Interested candidates should apply at: www.ifs.com/about/careers\-at\-ifs All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer *We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.* All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview** We are seeking a hands\-on **Controls Engineer** with a strong foundation in **mechatronics** to design, integrate, and maintain our manufacturing and production equipment. Because our facility operates a mix of off\-the\-shelf machinery and custom\-built automation systems, you will play a critical role in both building new controls architectures from the ground up and troubleshooting, upgrading, or retrofitting existing vendor equipment. **Key Responsibilities** * **Custom Machine Design \& Build:** Architect, program, and commission control systems (PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, and motion controllers) for custom, in\-house built machinery from concept through floor deployment. * **Vendor Equipment Integration \& Support:** Reverse\-engineer, troubleshoot, and modify control logic on purchased third\-party machinery to improve throughput, fix recurring faults, or integrate it into our broader plant network. * **Mechatronic Troubleshooting:** Diagnose complex electromechanical failures across sensors, actuators, pneumatics, hydraulics, servo systems, and robotics—bridging the gap between software logic and physical hardware. * **Electrical Design \& Documentation:** Create and update electrical schematics, panel layouts, and bills of materials (BOMs) using AutoCAD Electrical or EPLAN; ensure all documentation accurately reflects field modifications. * **Safety \& Compliance:** Design, implement, and validate machine safety systems (safety relays, light curtains, E\-stops, safety PLCs) in compliance with OSHA, NFPA 79, and ANSI/RIA standards. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with mechanical engineers, maintenance technicians, and machine builders during assembly, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). **Required Qualifications** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on industrial automation experience). * **Experience:** 3 to 7 years of experience in industrial controls, automation engineering, or machine building within a manufacturing environment. * **PLC \& HMI Programming:** Proven proficiency programming and troubleshooting industrial controllers (e.g., Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, Beckhoff, or Omron) and designing intuitive operator interfaces. * **Motion \& Robotics:** Hands\-on experience sizing, tuning, and integrating servo drives, stepper motors, VFDs, and multi\-axis motion systems. * **Hardware \& Schematics:** Ability to read, redline, and draft electrical and pneumatic schematics, as well as physically wire, debug, and test control panels when needed. * **Industrial Networking:** Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, or IO\-Link. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience integrating industrial robots (e.g., FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Universal Robots) or machine vision systems (e.g., Cognex, Keyence). * Familiarity with legacy equipment retrofits (e.g., migrating older PLC\-5/SLC\-500 systems to modern platforms). * Basic understanding of mechanical CAD (SolidWorks, Inventor) to collaborate effectively on custom machine builds. * Knowledge of SCADA systems, data collection, or IIoT protocols (MQTT, OPC UA). #### **Education** Preferred* Bachelors or better in Mechanical Engineering * Bachelors or better in Electrical Engineering Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **Who we are:** Integrated Home Care Services (IHCS) provides a comprehensive Integrated Delivery System in the home setting, offering Durable Medical Equipment (DME), Respiratory, Home Health, and Home Infusion services. Through our select network of Medicare and Medicaid Certified and Accredited providers, we are available 24/7 to meet the needs of our patients with compassion, expertise, and excellence. For more than 30 years, we have been dedicated to improving lives by delivering the highest quality in\-home care services. As a trusted market leader in value\-based Home Health, Durable Medical Equipment, and Home Infusion Services, we proudly serve more than 2 million lives across the United States and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Our integrated care model is trusted by leading Managed Care Organizations (MCOs), physicians, and healthcare partners because of our commitment to exceptional patient outcomes and coordinated care. At IHCS, our patients are at the heart of everything we do. We believe in creating a culture built on compassion, integrity, collaboration, and innovation. Every team member plays a vital role in fulfilling our mission of enhancing the quality of life for those we serve through Exceptional Customer Service, Proven Outcomes, and Seamless Care. If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are committed to excellence, we invite you to join our growing team. Together, we can continue transforming home healthcare while making a difference in the lives of our patients and the communities we serve. **Join IHCS where our patients are \#1, and our people make the difference. Apply today!** Offering a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to; * Medical, Vision, Dental, Short\- and Long\-term insurance * 6\+ Days of Holidays Pay * 17 days of PTO * Employer paid life insurance * 401K with employer contribution * Wellness program with reward incentives * Employee recognition and reward programs * Comprehensive paid training program **What will you be doing:** We're looking for a Director who has spent years in systems like this and has a track record of consistent high\-quality delivery. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades. Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter\-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years. This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies. Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. **Location** New York, NY (Hybrid). In office Monday to Thursday. Candidates must live in or be able to commute to New York City. **The Role** Most companies building with AI connect someone else's models to their software. Kaizen's AI\-native platform turns requirements into working applications, and today much of that intelligence comes from general\-purpose models that carry capabilities we don't need, lack knowledge we do, and leave us and our customers paying frontier\-model token costs for intelligence we don't control. This role changes that. You'll fine\-tune, adapt and distill open\-weight models into specialized intelligence Kaizen owns, and prove where it beats the general\-purpose alternative. The goal isn't the biggest model or the most papers: it's public\-sector software that works better, costs less to run, and is harder to replicate. **What You'll Do** * Fine\-tune, adapt and distill open\-weight models for requirements interpretation, code generation, repository understanding, structured output and software validation. * Own the experiment loop: curate datasets, build training pipelines, and test architectures and techniques until a promising idea becomes a working model. * Build evaluations on real software engineering tasks that set baselines, expose failure modes, and separate real gains from benchmark noise. * Work with platform engineers to find where current models fall short, then build the capabilities that close those gaps and ship them into production. * Experiment with supervised fine\-tuning, synthetic data, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve model behavior on specialized tasks. * Deliver applications built around each customer's needs without frontier\-model token spend, so public budgets go to residents, not inference. * Lay the groundwork (datasets, evals, research practices) for Kaizen to eventually train its own models from scratch. **What You'll Bring** * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning or adapting language models. You've worked with model weights, not just model APIs or prompts. * Strong software engineering fundamentals. You build reliable training pipelines, debug complex systems, and write code other engineers build on. * Strong Python and PyTorch, with a working understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization and language model training. * Something you've built that shows real model engineering ability: a fine\-tuned model, an original training approach, or a meaningful open\-source ML contribution. Industry, research or independent work all count; demonstrated ability matters more than years or credentials. **Strong Candidates May Also...** * Have fine\-tuned models for code generation, program synthesis or repository understanding. * Design experiments and evaluation sets that tell a meaningful improvement from noise or overfitting. * Bring experience with synthetic data, distillation, quantization, or preference optimization and RL with verifiable rewards. * Have contributed to open\-source model development, published applied ML research, or reproduced significant research results. **Don't Apply If...** * Your model experience is prompt engineering and API calls. * You'd rather publish a result than ship a model people use every day. * You hand off notebooks and expect someone else to make them run in production. * You assume the biggest model is the right answer and don't want to think about cost. Residents and public servants rely on the software we build because they don't have another option. The models underneath it have to earn that. **What Kaizen Offers** ---------------------- **Health \& Insurance** * 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents. * $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA. * One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city. * Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot. * 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match. **Family \& Time Off** * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents. * Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!) * Closed for all federal holidays. * Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas. * Company offsites throughout the year. **Office \& Remote Setup** * Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees. * $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution). * Expensed lunch while in the office. * Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm. * Company\-provided laptop of your choice. **Wellness** * NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. * Non\-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement. **Stipends** * $100/month utility stipend. * $250/quarter home cleaning stipend * $500/year professional development. * $250/year recreation. * $300/quarter pet care stipend. Compensation Range: $240K \- $280K

jobs.title: Help Desk Technician
jobs.description: Kelley Create is a dynamic and innovative business technology company dedicated to helping our partners grow their businesses while supporting the wild success of our co\-workers and ourselves. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service and are committed to driving growth and success in our industry. **Summary** The Help Desk Technician is primarily responsible for providing helpdesk support for client end users, which may include onsite or remote diagnosis and repair, performing planned system maintenance on client networks, and troubleshooting support requests and systems analysis, including consulting with users, to determine hardware, software, or system functional specifications. Communicate with customers as required including keeping them informed of incident progress or notifying them of impending changes or agreed outages. * Improve customer service, perception, and satisfaction * Work with the Service Desk Dispatcher to ensure requests are routed to the proper resource to be resolved quickly and efficiently * Escalate service requests that require engineer\-level support * Enter time and expenses in ConnectWise according to company procedures * Complete assigned training materials and blueprints on the ConnectWise University * Work through project tickets and phases in ConnectWise as assigned by a Project Manager * Enter all work as service or project tickets into ConnectWise * Maintain positive, cooperative, and team\-oriented relationships with co\-workers, supervisors, managers and others you come into contact with through your job. * Other duties as assigned. **Competencies:** To perform the job successfully, an individual must demonstrate the following competencies to perform the essential functions of this position. * **Customer Focus**: The individual needs to demonstrate understanding and compassion for concerns and issues.
