jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **AI Solutions Engineer \- Ken Garff Automotive Corporate Offices \- SLC, UT** **Position Summary** The AI Solutions Engineer will help business teams build their own apps with Claude Code, safely and inside company boundaries, and get them deployed. You pair program with the people closest to the problem, from a parts manager or service technician up to an executive vice president. The business unit owns the app. You make sure it is built securely, deployed correctly, and ready for a clear decision on its future. The work is almost entirely Claude Code and vibe coding. It suits you if you enjoy building quickly, teaching as you go, and knowing when to slow down. **Location and interviews** --------------------------- This is a hybrid role based in our Salt Lake City office. With the exception of an initial HR phone screen, all interviews will be conducted in person at our Salt Lake City office — no video interviews for subsequent rounds. Relocation assistance is not available; candidates must already be located in the Salt Lake metro area or be willing to relocate at their own expense before starting. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Help with intake: point each requester to the inventory checklist before any building starts, and help keep the app inventory current. * Pair program with business users of any technical level, using Claude Code to build working apps. * Build within company boundaries: handle data, credentials and access the way our security and AI governance standards require. * Keep all code in Git and through code review. * Deploy apps. * Support apps during business hours only. Anything that becomes mission critical moves to the enterprise tier. * Think through architecture twice: for the quick deployment, and for what it would take to productionize the app later with the main team. * Resume pairing with the business owner when an app breaks. * Help run the post\-launch and yearly reviews, and recommend whether to retire an app, promote it to the enterprise level, or keep it small. The same choice applies if an app’s owner leaves, or you help find a new owner. * Tell business users plainly when an idea is not worth building, or should not be built a certain way. * Document each app so someone else can pick it up. * When work is light, spend a sprint on the main AI team. **Required qualifications** --------------------------- The people part comes first, because it is the hard part of this job. * Excellent communication and teaching skills. You can pair with a service technician in the morning and an executive in the afternoon, and make both feel capable. * Good judgment and a willingness to push back respectfully when an idea is unsafe or not worth building, while staying someone people want to work with again. * Able to read, review, and explain the code Claude writes, and debug it when it breaks. * Strong Claude Code and AI\-assisted development skills. I want to see apps you have actually built and shipped. * Comfort with Git and code review. * Working knowledge of application security: secrets handling, access control, and protecting sensitive data such as customer information. * Basic architecture sense: able to tell a quick internal tool from something that must scale, and to explain the difference. **Nice to have** ---------------- None of these are required. * Experience building MCP servers or LangChain deployments. * Background in a regulated industry or with compliance requirements. * Experience with dealership operations or automotive retail. * Some HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Basic SQL, ideally with Snowflake. * Familiarity with Domo, including Pro Code Apps. **How I hire** -------------- There is no ATS on this listing. I’m the one reading your resume, and I will ask you about anything on it. I expect you to use AI. If you give it this posting, tell it: no keyword stuffing, don’t mirror the posting back to me, and only include what you can talk about in detail. I want to see the human behind the resume. **When you apply** ------------------ Skip the generic cover letter. Instead, submit your answer to one of these two questions as your cover letter, in your own words and in a few short paragraphs: * Tell me about a time you helped someone who was not technical build or fix something real. Then tell me about a moment it got hard, such as when they wanted something you thought was a bad idea. What did you do? * Tell me about one thing you built with AI that broke, and what you did about it. Pick one. Not both, and not neither. If you have something I can look at, such as a link, a demo, or a screenshot, include it. I read these.

jobs.title: Lead AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About Kendra Scott** We are a fashion\-lifestyle brand of big dreams, colorful confidence, and inspired design. Founded on Family, Fashion and Philanthropy, we believe that our employees and customers are the heart and soul of our brand, and that giving back is the truest form of success. Fashion meets innovation in the design of our two state\-of\-the\-art facilities based in the heart of Austin, Texas, and overflows into the design of our growing retail environment across the country. **Position Overview** Kendra Scott is seeking a Lead AI/ML Engineer to advance how we use artificial intelligence to improve business performance and reduce manual work. Your primary focus will be partnering with business teams to design and deliver AI\-enabled workflows. You will also maintain existing machine learning models and conduct prioritized advanced analysis to support business decisions. As a hands\-on technical lead, you will guide solutions from discovery through production support, working with shared data engineering, application development, DevOps and QA resources. You will help establish our AI engineering practices while building solutions directly. The Vice President, Digital Technology owns program direction and prioritization. Functional process owners remain accountable for business process decisions, acceptance and adoption. This role provides technical input into governance reviews and implements approved requirements. **Responsibilities** Build AI\-enabled workflows and applications * Partner with business process owners to understand current workflows, identify automation opportunities and establish measurable outcomes. * Determine when to use AI, conventional automation or existing enterprise capabilities. * Design and build workflows that connect enterprise applications and data through APIs and other integration methods. * Develop AI assistants and agents that retrieve information, support decisions and execute approved business actions. * Incorporate human review and approval where business judgment or risk requires it. * Work with business owners to validate solutions, support adoption and measure realized benefits. * Maintain deployed solutions and improve them based on operating performance and user feedback. Deliver applied data science and machine learning * Translate prioritized business questions into analytical approaches and predictive modeling opportunities. * Conduct advanced analysis to explain business performance and recommend actions. * Develop and validate machine learning models using appropriate statistical methods. * Maintain existing models, monitor performance and address changes in accuracy or business relevance. * Communicate findings, assumptions and model limitations in language business partners can use. * Partner with data engineering to ensure models and AI applications use reliable data. Establish production controls and support practices * Evaluate AI outputs and workflow behavior against defined acceptance criteria before deployment. * Implement approved access permissions, including limits on the actions automated workflows can perform. * Establish audit logs, monitoring and exception handling. * Design workflows so they can be stopped safely, with recovery or reversal procedures where feasible. * Apply data protection requirements in partnership with Information Security and designated governance owners. * Coordinate deployment and production support with shared technical resources, including clear escalation paths and backup coverage. * Monitor solution operating costs and recommend changes that improve value. Build a sustainable delivery capability * Establish reusable approaches for development, testing and documentation. * Maintain code in shared repositories with version control and appropriate review practices. * Document solution dependencies, operating procedures and known limitations. * Transfer knowledge to designated backup resources so production support does not depend on one person. * Work with PMO and business owners to estimate effort and manage delivery through a prioritized backlog. * Provide technical input into AI technology evaluations and governance reviews. **Our Ideal Candidate Will Have** * Typically five or more years of relevant experience in applied data science, machine learning engineering or software engineering, with ownership of production solutions. * Demonstrated production experience in both predictive modeling and AI\-enabled application or workflow development. * A strong foundation in statistics, model validation and interpretation of business results. * Strong Python and SQL skills. * Hands\-on experience building applications with large language models and evaluating their outputs. * Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs and working with cloud services. * Experience deploying and supporting production applications or models, including automated testing and monitoring. * Ability to design appropriate controls for unreliable AI outputs and automated business actions. * Ability to work directly with business partners, clarify requirements and explain technical tradeoffs plainly. * Sound judgment about when to build a custom solution and when an existing capability meets the need. * Ability to prioritize competing demands and communicate capacity constraints. * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience. **Experience that would be valuable** * Retail or ecommerce experience, particularly in customer analytics, merchandising, marketing or business operations. * Experience with AWS and Snowflake. * Experience with workflow automation platforms or enterprise integration tools. * Experience building applications that retrieve information from enterprise sources to inform AI responses. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Salesforce or Zendesk integrations. * Experience measuring automation benefits, including time saved and improvements in process quality. *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.*

jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack .NET Developer
jobs.description: Keyhole Software is looking for a seasoned Full Stack .NET Developer who builds modern web applications from the database to the browser and uses AI\-assisted development tools as a natural part of how they work every day. You'll join a team of senior consultants delivering high\-quality software for enterprise clients, where your experience, judgment, and ability to ship quickly with AI in your toolkit will make a real impact. * **Title:** Senior Full Stack .NET Developer Consultant * **Location:** Remote within the United States. Preference given to candidates in the Kansas City metro area, followed by Kansas, Missouri, or Nebraska. * **Eligibility:** Must be authorized to work and live in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship. We do not accept Corp\-to\-Corp (C2C), 1099, or third\-party candidates. Apply Now **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer Consultant, you'll design, build, and modernize business\-critical applications for Keyhole clients. Our engagements typically involve C\# and .NET on the back end, a modern JavaScript framework on the front end, SQL\-based data stores, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. We're looking for someone who is comfortable owning features end to end: understanding the business problem, designing the solution, writing clean and testable code, and seeing it through to production. **This is a client\-facing consulting role.** You'll work directly with client stakeholders, product owners, and technical leaders, often as the primary point of contact for your work. That means joining video calls regularly (camera on), leading conversations about requirements and technical decisions, giving demos, and keeping clients informed without needing someone else to translate for you. Strong spoken and written English communication is essential. **AI\-assisted development is a core expectation of this role, not a nice\-to\-have.** Keyhole consultants use tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and explore solutions faster. We need developers who already use these tools daily, know how to prompt and review AI output critically, and can explain how AI fits into their workflow without sacrificing quality, security, or maintainability. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications using C\#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core * Build responsive, user\-friendly front ends using Angular, React, or a similar modern framework * Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and third\-party services * Design and optimize relational databases, queries, and stored procedures (SQL Server or similar) * Use AI\-assisted development tools daily to write, refactor, test, and document code more efficiently * Critically review AI\-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability * Modernize legacy .NET Framework applications to current .NET versions and cloud\-ready architectures * Write unit and integration tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines * Deploy and support applications in Azure or AWS environments * Participate in code reviews and help raise the technical bar for the team * Serve as a trusted, client\-facing consultant, interfacing directly with client stakeholders, product owners, and technical leaders * Participate in and lead video calls (camera on) for standups, requirements sessions, design reviews, and status updates * Present demos and walk clients through completed work, technical approaches, and recommendations * Ask the right questions to clarify requirements, uncover the real business need, and recommend solutions * Communicate progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Write clear, professional emails, documentation, and status updates for client and internal audiences * Mentor other developers and share best practices, including effective use of AI tools **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * **7\+ years of professional software development experience**, with a strong focus on **C\# and .NET** * **Full stack experience** building production web applications on both the back end and front end * Hands\-on experience with **ASP.NET Core**, Web API, and Entity Framework * Strong front\-end skills with **Angular, React, or Vue**, plus JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS * Solid **SQL Server** (or comparable relational database) experience, including query optimization * **Demonstrated, daily use of AI\-assisted development tools** (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT) in professional work * Ability to describe specific examples of how you've used AI tools to deliver features, debug issues, write tests, or modernize code * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably **Azure** (AWS also considered) * Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing practices * Strong understanding of software design principles, design patterns, and clean code * Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams * **Excellent verbal and written communication skills**, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences * **Proven experience interfacing directly with clients or business stakeholders**, including leading meetings and presenting your work * Comfortable and professional on **video calls with your camera on**, including client meetings, demos, and team collaboration * Confidence to push back respectfully, raise risks early, and guide clients toward the right technical decisions **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience modernizing legacy .NET Framework, WebForms, or WCF applications * Experience with microservices, containerization (Docker), or Kubernetes * Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps tooling * Experience building or integrating AI/LLM features into applications (Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, etc.) * Familiarity with message queues and event\-driven architecture (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka) * Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as Cosmos DB or MongoDB * Familiarity with application security best practices (OWASP, authentication/authorization, OAuth/OIDC) * Prior consulting or client\-facing experience * Microsoft or cloud certifications **What It’s Actually Like to Work at Keyhole** ---------------------------------------------- Our average employee tenure is 5\+ years, and some of our developers have been here more than a decade. Here's why people stay: * **You're an employee, not a contractor.** Every Keyhole consultant is a full\-time W2 employee. When a client project wraps up, you move to the next Keyhole project, ideally one that adds to your skills, instead of starting a job search. * **You work on a team, not alone.** Most projects are staffed with 2 to 7 Keyhole developers, so you'll have teammates who share your standards, review your code, and have your back with the client. * **You stay in code, not politics.** Our culture is developer\-centric. jobs.title: Principal Engineer Data Center Controls
jobs.description: **Working at Knobelsdorff (KE)** Along with building state\-of\-the\-art projects, we build meaningful careers, lasting opportunities, and teams of dedicated individuals who truly own their work. As a leading turnkey specialty contractor specializing in Automation, Electric, Energy, and Power Services, our team tackles challenging, cutting\-edge projects that provide opportunities to build new skills, confidence, and gain valuable hands\-on experience in a variety of different industries. We tackle industrial electrical installations, advanced automation systems, and renewable energy solutions. Since our founding as a family\-owned company in 1988, we've grown while staying true to our core value. Starting your career with KE means joining a culture that values your contributions, moves quickly, takes calculated risks, and celebrates team members who step up and own their work. If you're ready to join a team where your voice matters, your growth is supported, and your impact is celebrated, KE is the place for you. **Job Purpose** This role supports KE Automation's Data Center team by providing senior technical expertise for complex data center controls projects. You'll be responsible for developing detailed controls designs, resolving complex integration challenges, reviewing engineering deliverables, and supporting commissioning and project handover. Success in this role means delivering high\-quality, coordinated controls solutions across BMS, EPMS, PLC, SCADA, and network interfaces while mentoring fellow engineers and upholding KE's commitment to Safety, People, Passion, and Performance. If you're someone who takes pride in technical excellence, enjoys solving complex problems, and thrives in a fast\-moving environment, this position is built for you. **What You'll Do** You'll be part of a team that gets things done, works with purpose, and takes pride in the results. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities may include: * Develop coordinated controls designs based on customer requirements and established project architectures, including control narratives, operating sequences, point schedules, and interface specifications. * Perform detailed PLC and supervisory\-system design, programming, and integration for complex controls packages. * Troubleshoot and resolve integration challenges across building management systems, power monitoring systems, controllers, and associated networks. * Review engineering drawings, specifications, software designs, equipment submissions, and other technical deliverables for accuracy and completeness. * Maintain consistent engineering standards for naming, alarming, graphics, interfaces, documentation, and system configuration. * Evaluate system failure and recovery scenarios, including communication interruptions, device faults, and restart behavior. * Prepare and review factory and site acceptance testing documentation and support commissioning and integrated systems testing. * Lead technical troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis, identifying solutions and coordinating approved corrective changes. * Support technical estimates, supplier evaluations, proposals, and project planning by identifying design assumptions, dependencies, and potential risks. * Mentor and support fellow engineers through technical reviews, workshops, and collaborative problem\-solving. * Maintain accurate engineering documentation, software versions, configuration records, and as\-built information to support project turnover and ongoing service needs. **What You Bring** You're someone who shows up ready to work hard, learn fast, and contribute to a team that takes pride in doing things right. Successful candidates typically bring: * 10\+ years of experience in controls or automation engineering, including **at least 3 years of direct data center controls experience**. * Previous experience working as a Principal Engineer, Lead Engineer, or in a senior technical leadership capacity on data center controls projects. * A degree in electrical, controls, automation, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent technical education and practical experience. * Demonstrated experience developing, integrating, testing, and handing over complex controls systems and engineering packages. * Strong PLC programming and BMS or SCADA engineering capabilities, with practical understanding of EPMS integration and industrial communications. * Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, mechanical controls documentation, network layouts, and sequences of operation. * Experience reviewing engineering deliverables, developing technical documentation, and maintaining configuration control. * Practical experience with resilient controls systems, commissioning, troubleshooting, and safe change management in critical environments. * Strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and coordinate across multiple disciplines. * Ability to mentor and provide constructive technical feedback to fellow engineers. * Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to travel up to 50%. **Pay Range** We believe in paying for the value you bring to the team, and we aim to be competitive in every market we hire in. **Pay Range: $161,754\.00 \- $180,691\.00** **Total Rewards Statement** As a full\-time employee at KE, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and future. * 100% employer\-paid health and dental coverage for employees * HSA contributions to support your medical expenses * Company\-paid life insurance and disability coverage * 401(k) with competitive company match * Paid weekly with competitive wages * PTO, six paid holidays, and education reimbursement * Exclusive employee discounts through Working Advantage We believe your work should be rewarded with more than just a paycheck. At KE, we invest in your total wellbeing. **Physical Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided for individuals with disabilities. Typical requirements may include: * Perform computer\-based work for extended periods, including reviewing project plans, schedules, reports, and technical documentation. * Participate in meetings and site reviews that may involve periods of sitting, standing, and walking. * Navigate manufacturing facilities and customer project sites, including stairs and uneven surfaces, as required. * Occasionally carry a laptop, project documents, and other materials needed for meetings or site visits. * Use required personal protective equipment when visiting manufacturing or project\-site locations. * Travel to customer and project locations as needed, potentially up to 50%. **Accessibility:** If you need accommodations as part of the employment process, please contact KE Human Resources at HR@KEway.com. **Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO)** KE is an EEO to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws: EEO is the Law (English/Spanish). **KE E\-Verify** KE participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. For more information about E\-Verify, please review the E\-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters. If you need accommodation during the hiring process, let us know and we'll work with you.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!** **Job Overview** ---------------- The key business reason for this position is to identify and reduce/eliminate quality related issues with the Komatsu America Corp. (KAC) facility of Chattanooga Manufacturing Operations (CMO) built products. The Quality Assurance Engineer functions as a liason between Suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, Komatsu Ltd. (KLTD), etc. to ensure a high quality product is the final result from our Manufacturing operation and in the Field. To confirm quality, core actions are: Collect failure data from warranty claims, TSI/ETSI information, feedback from Service Headquarters/Customers, etc. regarding specific machine failures. Summarize this data in terms of the number of failure occurences, affected machine models and lead in the Juhin (Serious Quality) process to resolve the issue effectively. The Quality Assurance Engineer must collect all relevant data (ex. in\-house data and external data) and prepare reports to outline how to move forward in the applicable area of quality improvement. Reports must be furnished to Quality Assurance Managers. Determine where corrective actions, design changes, process changes, etc. are required and follow through to closure of the actions. Support Suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, KLTD, etc. in the areas of countermeasures, verify effectiveness. Ensure progress through monitoring of repeat failures and react as necessary. Based on the above findings, Parts and Service News, Field Campaigns, etc. may be required to address machines that are in the field at customers of Distributors. **Scope** * Execute the Quality activities to reduce warranty expense and improving Customer acceptance by improving quality through the identification and elimination of machine quality problems. * Assist other Quality Assurance Staff, Suppliers and CMO Manufacturing personnel in basic quality control methods to enhance overall CMO capability in measurement of performance. * Review and manage field actions issued by KLTD and or KAC to address quality matters. * Manage CMO Quality Assurance improvement efforts with some supervision and make necessary decisions based on acquired background knowledge of Products and Issues. * Communicate the Komatsu Way to CMO employees. Provide help with 5S projects, QC circle actives, continuous improvement activities. * FOR REMAN FOCUS POSITION: Coordinate New Model release activity. This can be as many as 150\-200 new assemblies annually. This will entail gathering all manufacturing, assembly, testing, and BOM information in order to successfully perform the remanufacturing of these products. * Determine which Parts and Service News and other updates must be applied to Reman products through sound engineering judgments and review of warranty costs and update costs. **Key Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Review and summarize Field Campaign’s (FC’s) and Parts and Service News issued by KLTD – determine if applicable for KAC – if so, issue KAC versions. Manage creation of internal PSN’s applicable for CMO products – issue CMO drafts and KLTD version for creation and use by KAC. Summarize and report the status of FC’s monthly. * Register Juhin’s for failure issues found that meet the criteria. Summarize failure data in Juhin sheets, communicate failure to responsible parties. Coordinate root cause analysis, confirm C/M actions, Field actions if applicable to resolve and close issue. * Research field data (warranty claims, TSI/ETSI’s, etc.) to confirm quality issues and quantify seriousness. Facilitate action plan to countermeasure (C/M). Communicate with KLTD. Mother plant, Component plants, Suppliers, etc. to get corrective action steps enacted and reduce/eliminate future failures. * Coordinate failed parts recalls, conduct technical studies of parts, coordinate failed parts analysis with Suppliers, outside laboratories, and KLTD (Mother plants and Component plants), etc. * Inspection support (test methods, inspection standards, acceptance criteria, actual conducting tests). * Coordinate new model start\-ups – document problems found – hold meetings and oversee issues to closure. Manage technical data needed for inspections, sign offs, and traceability (ie: Assembly Check Sheets) for all CMO production machines. Review Engineering changes as they are released to judge effect on QA documents. * Other duties as required by Manager. **Qualifications/Requirements** ------------------------------- * BS Degree in Engineering or equivalent is required. Knowledge of quality control methods is desired. * Ability to manage multiple tasks, assess their current situation and develop necessary means to foster improvement. * Proficiency in software applications including SAP, Microsoft Excel, Word, and Power Point, at a minimum. * Proficiency in the use of applied standards and practices. Ability to understand and use Komatsu Engineering Standards and drawings. * A good personality and attitude are important for this job. You must be able to work and communicate effectively with all management, fellow staff, shop workers, suppliers, customers and other Komatsu America/Komatsu plants. * Occasional travel to distributor or supplier locations, KAC Locations or Japan plants. Proven leadership ability a plus. * Must comply with all environmental, quality and Safety rules, practices and standards. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Diversity \& Inclusion Commitment** At Komatsu we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. We are authentic, ambitious, and innovative in our pursuit of Diversity \& Inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. **Company Information** Komatsu is a world leader in manufacturing construction, mining, forestry, and industrial heavy equipment. Founded in 1921, Komatsu has a long history of quality, reliability, innovation, and excellence. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu facilities, distributors and dealers are in more than 140 countries and employ more than 60,000 people. Komatsu offers a diverse and challenging work environment, where you can grow your skills and career, and contribute to a sustainable, clean\-energy future. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, be a part of something big and join a team that is shaping the world! If you want to learn more about Komatsu, please visit our website at https://www.komatsu.com/ .

Micronaut experience is a plus. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code or similar) in your daily work, with the judgement to review and test what they produce. * Experience building and maintaining RESTful web services. Google Cloud experience is a plus. * Strong relational data modeling and SQL skills. PostgreSQL experience is a plus. * A track record of getting productive quickly in an existing codebase and delivering with limited ramp\-up time. * Experience with test automation, Docker, and CI/CD on an Agile team. * Clear, direct communication with fellow engineers and the Product Manager, including flagging blockers early. * Ability to work in a mostly remote team, with occasional in\-person sessions at our Beaverton, Oregon headquarters. * Authorization to work in the United States. * A strong, authentic passion for using technology to solve global environmental challenges. **More about Leanpath \& Our Team** Founded in 2004, we created the food waste measurement \& technology industry. Our team is connected through our core values which are woven into our culture: drive and productivity, excellence, fairness, humility, kindness, and teamwork. We are currently seeking an experienced: **INTEGRATION AND AUTOMATION ENGINEER I** JOB SUMMARY: * Implements integrations from designs and specifications provided by senior engineers, and asks for direction when a task falls outside the specification or runbook. * Executes cutover and migration tasks from the plan and records results. * Supports vendor exchanges under direction: test files, credential and certificate rotations, and conformance checks. * Learns Liberty's integration technologies and healthcare and ERP data standards through assigned work and pairing with senior engineers. * Builds, tests and deploys integrations across Liberty's integration technologies (SQL Agent and SSIS jobs, Mirth Connect channels, CloudSuite IPA and ION flows, ADF and Fabric pipelines, and vendor SFTP and API exchanges), following the team's integration standards for error handling, retry logic, logging, alerting and change control. * Writes, tests and amends T\-SQL extraction queries and validates output files and messages against vendor specifications before they go to production. * Participates in the integration support rotation: triages alerts, resolves known issues from the runbook, documents the resolution, and escalates clearly when an issue is new. * Maintains monitoring, alerting and runbooks for the integrations they work on, so that every production integration has a named alert recipient and current documentation. * Uses AI\-assisted development as the default first pass for code, queries, specifications and documentation, and reviews, tests and owns the result. * Builds and operates AI agents to the Liberty Agent Creation Standard, with read\-only\-first access patterns and server\-side guardrails. * Documents integrations, processes and lessons learned in Atlassian Confluence; actively looks for undocumented processes and integrations and documents them or seeks help. * Works with business owners, the ERP and BI teams, and implementation partners to clarify requirements and test plans. * Plans and tracks work in Jira and Azure DevOps and participates in planning and estimation. * Follows Liberty's security standards for credentials, secrets, encryption and PHI handling; treats any system as production unless confirmed otherwise. * Performs work during emergency and disaster situations. JOB REQUIREMENTS: * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, required. * No prior professional experience required. Preferred: up to 2 years of experience, internship or academic project work in systems integration, data engineering, application support, or software development. * Preferred: hands\-on exposure to SQL and at least one integration, ETL or scripting technology (for example SQL Server Integration Services, Azure Data Factory, Mirth Connect, an ERP workflow tool, Python or PowerShell). * Preferred: exposure to healthcare data standards (HL7 v2, FHIR, CCD) or ERP data (HR, payroll, finance). * Hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or comparable) required; experience building with LLM or agent frameworks preferred. * Experience in a healthcare, post\-acute care, or other regulated environment preferred. Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures. * Working knowledge of at least one integration or data\-movement technology and demonstrated ability to learn others quickly. * Working knowledge of secure file transfer (SFTP), file formats (delimited, fixed\-width, XML, JSON), and RESTful APIs. * Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and the basics of prompt engineering; interest in agent frameworks. * Working knowledge of Git version control, Azure DevOps, and Atlassian Jira and Confluence. * Understanding of sensitive data management and HIPAA basics, or the ability to learn them quickly. * Preferred: exposure to Azure data and identity services, Microsoft Fabric, or Power Platform. * Preferred: exposure to Infor CloudSuite or Lawson, PointClickCare, Axxess, or health information exchange interfaces. * Must have a valid driver's license. * Methodical troubleshooting across system boundaries: source system, transport, transform and destination. * Careful change discipline in production systems. * Communication and interpersonal skills as applied to interaction with coworkers, supervisors, vendors and business users, sufficient to exchange or convey information and to receive work direction. * Researching integration and AI topics via vendor documentation, the Internet and other online sources. Visit www.libertycareers.com for more information. Background checks/drug\-free workplace. EOE. Location: Liberty Health · Management Information Systems Schedule: Full Time, Day (8\), M\-F 8\-5

jobs.title: Electrical Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Electrical Controls Engineer Job Code: ELECCNTRLENG001**SUMMARY:**This position serves as the key technical resource and subject matter expert for electrical controls and automation systems supporting industrial manufacturing equipment. The Electrical Controls Engineer provides advanced technical support for existing production equipment, including troubleshooting complex controls issues and improving equipment reliability. The position is responsible for the design, programming, implementation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of controls systems for new and modified equipment. This role also provides technical ownership of plant controls infrastructure and industrial networks, ensuring systems remain reliable, supportable, secure, and current while identifying and implementing improvements that support safety, quality, productivity, and long\-term manufacturing capability. **WAGE TYPE:** Salaried Exempt FLSA Exemption: Professional **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND** **RESPONSIBILITIES****:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Serve as the subject matter expert for electrical controls and industrial automation systems, including PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, servo systems, industrial networks, safety controls, robotics, instrumentation, and related control hardware. * Experience with Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC platforms, Studio 5000, FactoryTalk/PanelView HMIs, industrial networks, VFDs, servo systems, and FANUC or similar industrial robotics * Provide advanced technical support and troubleshooting for manufacturing equipment when controls\-related issues exceed routine maintenance capabilities. Partner with Maintenance and Operations to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions. * Support Maintenance in developing controls troubleshooting capabilities through technical guidance, training, documentation, and mentoring, while maintaining Maintenance as the primary first\-line support organization. * Design, program, implement, test, commission, and troubleshoot control systems for new equipment, equipment upgrades, process changes, and internally developed automation projects and ensure compliance with applicable company requirements and electrical/machine\-safety standards * Develop, review, and maintain electrical schematics, control panel designs, I/O documentation, network drawings, equipment specifications, functional descriptions, and other controls\-related technical documentation. * Maintain the integrity and reliability of plant industrial controls networks and controls infrastructure, including network architecture, managed switches, PLC/HMI communications, remote I/O, device connectivity, and interfaces between manufacturing equipment and higher\-level systems. * Monitor controls hardware and software for obsolescence, supportability, compatibility, and lifecycle risk. Develop and recommend upgrade or migration plans before obsolete systems create unacceptable production risk. * Develop and maintain relationships with controls vendors, OEMs, system integrators, and equipment suppliers. Provide technical direction and review vendor controls designs to ensure compliance with company standards. * Coordinate with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Quality, Safety, and IT when controls changes may impact production processes, machine safety, data systems, or plant infrastructure. * Complete assigned controls and automation projects within established scope, schedule, and budget expectations. * Identify and recommend emerging automation and controls technologies that can improve manufacturing capability, equipment reliability, maintainability, or productivity. * Could potentially come in contact with hazardous chemicals. * Environmental responsibility is our commitment to our communities. * Proper disposal of waste such as recyclables, standard waste, hazardous waste, etc. is expected. * Any other tasks as required fulfilling Lincoln Industries' Beliefs and Drivers. **ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE:*** Reports to: Director, Engineering * Supervises: N/A **QUALIFICATIONS:** The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be substituted for the expected levels of education and experience required. Education and/or Experience: Expected: Associates degree in Automation/Controls Technology, Mechatronics, Electro\-mechanical maintenance, or Robotics or adjacent discipline. 3\-5 years solid experience in the installation and programming of the Allen Bradley and Siemens families of PLC’s, and Fanuc/ABB/Yaskawa robots. Preferred: BS in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is preferred. 5\-10 years of experience in designing, building, installing and troubleshooting control systems in a production manufacturing environment. Communication Skills:* Must be able to read, write and comprehend the English language. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Link Logistics Real Estate (“Link”) is a leading operator of warehouses and business parks, specializing in last\-mile logistics real estate. Established by Blackstone in 2019, the company connects consumption, technology, and the supply chain across its portfolio, which spans half a billion square feet. We leverage our scale, proprietary data and insights, and foundational focus on sustainability to drive success for our customers’ businesses and deliver value for our stakeholders. We put our people, customers, and communities first and find ways to make a conscious, positive impact where we live and work. Every day, we work to reinvent and lead our industry forward by thinking bigger and challenging the status quo. We're hiring a hybrid **ML/Backend Engineer** to own the intelligence layer of Link's Analytics Engine. This is the connective tissue role: you'll design the pipelines that bring disparate real estate data to life, build the knowledge graphs and retrieval systems that make that data queryable by LLMs, and architect the backend services that surface insights to investment teams in real time. You won't be handed a spec. You'll talk to investment analysts and asset managers, identify where analytical leverage is lost today, and build systems that close that gap — often combining classical ML, graph\-based reasoning, and LLM\-native workflows in the same solution. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Knowledge Graph \& Retrieval — Design graph\-based data structures encoding relationships across markets, assets, tenants, and transactions. Build retrieval pipelines (RAG, hybrid search, structured queries) that give LLMs accurate, contextually rich grounding. * LLM Workflow Automation — Develop rule\-based and agentic LLM workflows that automate investment analytical tasks. Own prompt engineering, eval frameworks, and production reliability. * Data Pipelines — Build ETL/ELT workflows that ingest, normalize, and enrich large\-scale internal and third\-party datasets (property records, leasing data, macro signals, alt data). Every dataset should have a clear owner, update cadence, and quality SLA. * Data Trust \& Provenance — Build systems that make data trustworthy by design: lineage tracking from source to insight, confidence scoring on derived outputs, and clear attribution so analysts always know where a number came from and how fresh it is. Treat a bad comp or stale signal as a production incident. * Backend API Layer — Develop and maintain APIs and services that expose ML outputs and structured data to front\-end applications. Prioritize low\-latency, reliability, and clean contracts with the application team. * Collaboration — Work directly with investment and asset management teams to understand analytical needs and iterate quickly. Treat analyst trust as a first\-class product requirement. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 4\+ years in ML engineering, backend engineering, or a role spanning both * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-powered applications in production — RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, eval frameworks * Strong Python skills; comfortable owning backend services and APIs end\-to\-end * Experience with knowledge graphs or graph databases (Neo4j or similar) * Proficiency building data pipelines at scale (Spark, Databricks, or equivalent) * Deep sensitivity to data provenance — a track record of building systems that create analyst trust, not just claim it $165,000 \- $185,000 represents the presently anticipated base compensation pay range for this position at Link. Actual pay may vary based on various factors, including but not limited to location and experience. Link provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off. The direct compensation and benefits described above are subject to the terms and conditions of any governing plans, policies, practices, agreements, or other materials or documents as in effect from time to time, including but not limited to terms and conditions regarding eligibility. **EEO Statement** The Company is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant, employee, or other covered person based on any legally recognized basis, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, caste, immigration status, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation or related medical conditions), age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected leave status, domestic violence victim status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email LinkRecruiting@linklogistics.com.

jobs.title: OSP Construction Project Engineer
jobs.description: As an **OSP Construction Project Engineer**, you'll play a key role in expanding Lumos' fiber network and delivering the reliable connectivity that powers our communities. You'll oversee contractor performance, resolve field challenges, and drive multiple fiber construction projects safely, on schedule, and within budget. Working closely with cross\-functional teams and contractor partners, you'll help keep projects moving from field readiness through closeout while ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency every step of the way. This field\-based position requires regular onsite work throughout the **Naperville, IL market**, so candidates must **reside within the 1 hour of the market** and be able to travel between active jobsites. **Why Lumos:** Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest\-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T\-Fiber, our joint venture with T\-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high\-speed internet in the communities we serve. Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions\-oriented, and ready to build what's next. **What You'll Do:** * Own multiple OSP builds across the market from construction readiness through closeout. * Set clear expectations for contractors and subcontractors, holding teams accountable for safety, quality, schedule, and budget. * Track production, schedules, costs, risks, and field progress, and keep stakeholders informed with clear, timely updates. * Inspect active jobsites and ensure work meets OSHA, NESC, Lumos, and applicable construction standards. * Coordinate permitting, materials, utilities, municipalities, and other field dependencies that keep construction moving. * Resolve field roadblocks and community concerns quickly, professionally, and with sound judgment. * Partner across Engineering, Operations, Permitting, and Supply Chain to improve how Lumos plans, builds, and scales. **What You'll Bring:** * High school diploma or equivalent. * 5\+ years of experience in OSP construction, telecommunications engineering, network deployment, or related field operations. * Strong knowledge of aerial, underground, and buried fiber construction, including OSHA and NESC requirements. * Experience managing contractors and several active construction projects at the same time. * Strong project management, problem\-solving, communication, and relationship\-building skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office. * Valid, unrestricted driver's license and ability to travel throughout the market; company vehicle and mobile phone provided. **What Makes You a Great Fit:** * Associate's or bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, telecommunications, or a related field. * Direct experience with FTTH, fiber broadband, telecommunications, or utility construction. * Experience with Sitetracker, Smartsheet, or a similar construction or project\-management platform. * Experience coordinating with municipalities and utilities while improving processes in a fast\-moving build environment. **Physical Requirements:** * Frequent travel, walking, and standing at active construction sites in varying weather and on uneven terrain. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment and appropriate safety footwear. * Regular use of computers and standard office equipment, along with the communication and judgment needed to inspect work and coordinate field activity. **Pay Range:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,000–$85,000\. Actual base salary and overall compensation may vary based on experience, skills, education, market conditions, business needs, work location, and other applicable factors. **Benefits \& Perks:** Our commitment to communities includes recruiting and rewarding the Lumos team members who are working together to build a brighter tomorrow. We have: * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. * Competitive compensation packages, including bonus options for eligible positions. * Paid Time Off \& Paid Holidays. * Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs). * 100% employer\-paid life and disability insurance. * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to professional support for life's challenges. * 401K plan w/ up to 5% employer contribution and a self\-directed brokerage option. * Wellness program offering education and cash incentives for gym attendance and nutrition programs. * Employee referral bonuses. * Discounts on Lumos Fiber Internet for employees who live in our service areas. * Discounts on T\-Mobile wireless service and select features for lines. **Applicant Eligibility Notice:** Applicants must be at least eighteen (18\) years of age at the time of application. **At Lumos we recruit, hire, employ, train, promote, and compensate individuals based on job\-related qualifications and abilities. We have a longstanding policy of providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of each individual and is free from all forms of employment discrimination, including harassment, because of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals** **with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief, in accordance with applicable laws.**

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an AI Engineer to architect, build, and scale our production AI systems. You will move beyond simple API wrappers to design reliable agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation infrastructure. You will own the full lifecycle of AI features, including rapid prototyping to deployment, observability, and cost optimization. ### **About MD Ally** MD Ally is a 9\-1\-1 Telehealth solution that enables greater connectivity between public health \& safety and the broader healthcare ecosystem. Our solutions allow dispatchers and first responders to transfer non\-emergency callers from 911 to virtual care instead of dispatching valuable, emergency resources. ### **Description** **About the Role** MD Ally integrates with public\-safety systems so eligible non\-emergency 911 callers can reach care from a clinician instead of defaulting to the highest\-cost transport and emergency department pathway. That adds a clinical step before a member enters that pathway. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to architect, build, and scale our production AI systems. These systems handle PHI and support clinical decisions, so they have to be accurate, private, and auditable. You'll build the infrastructure that makes that true: deterministic guardrails, HIPAA\-compliant data pipelines, clinical evaluation suites, and real\-time voice and text workflows integrated into our telehealth platform and Electronic Health Records (EHR). **What You Will Build and Own** **Clinician Productivity and EHR Automation** Doctors and nurses spend hours clicking through Electronic Health Records. You'll build tools to automate that administrative work: * **Ambient Clinical Scribes:** Build audio\-to\-text pipelines using models like Whisper or Deepgram combined with LLMs that listen to telehealth video visits, filter out small talk, and draft structured SOAP notes (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan). * **EHR Read/Write Agents:** Build integrations using FHIR or HL7 standards that pull a patient's past labs and medications before a visit, and push approved clinical notes, ICD\-10 billing codes, or draft prescriptions back into systems like Epic, Athenahealth, or Elation. * **Pre\-Visit Chart Summarization:** Architect Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that digest dozens of pages of messy PDF medical records or specialist referrals into clean, concise summaries with exact source citations for the provider. **Patient\-Facing Intake and Care Navigation** Before or after a virtual visit, patients interact with chat or voice interfaces. You'll build the backend logic that keeps these interactions helpful and safe: * **Dynamic Symptom Intake:** Build conversational agents that gather a patient's medical history and symptoms before a video call, and ask follow\-up questions based on clinical protocols. * **Smart Triage and Routing:** Develop classification systems that analyze patient messages to route urgent red\-flag symptoms (such as chest pain) immediately to an on\-call nurse, while routing routine prescription refills or scheduling requests to automated workflows. * **Post\-Visit Follow\-Up and Care Plans:** Create automated systems that translate complex medical jargon from a doctor's note into plain\-language instructions, medication reminders, and check\-ins in the patient's preferred language. **Clinical Safety, Privacy, and Guardrail Infrastructure** Because we handle Protected Health Information (PHI) and human health, you'll build the safety infrastructure around every model: * **PHI Redaction and Zero\-Retention Pipelines:** Build middleware that strips names, dates of birth, and SSNs before data reaches external APIs, routing all traffic strictly through HIPAA\-compliant endpoints (such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or GCP Vertex AI) under a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). * **Deterministic Clinical Guardrails:** Implement real\-time validation layers that block models from diagnosing conditions, recommending unapproved treatments, or hallucinating drug dosages, forcing standard fallback responses whenever clinical boundaries are crossed. * **Real\-Time Audio/Video Processing:** Engineer low\-latency streaming infrastructure using WebSockets and WebRTC so voice agents and live transcription tools respond in milliseconds during live telehealth calls without awkward pauses. **Clinical Evaluation and Observability Systems** We don't ship a prompt or model change without proving it's safe. You'll build automated testing harnesses: * **Synthetic Patient Simulators:** Build AI agents programmed to act like patients with specific conditions, accents, or edge\-case behaviors to stress\-test intake workflows before real patients interact with them. * **LLM\-as\-a\-Judge and Clinical Grading Pipelines:** Build automated test suites that grade generated SOAP notes against gold\-standard physician notes, checking for omitted allergies, incorrect dosages, or hallucinated symptoms. * **Audit Logs and Traceability:** Maintain full logging systems so that if a clinician or regulator asks why the system suggested an output, our team can trace the exact prompt, retrieved medical document, and model version used. **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with 2\+ years shipping production LLM, NLP, or speech\-to\-text applications. * **Strong Engineering Fundamentals:** High proficiency in Python and TypeScript/Node.js, with deep experience designing reliable APIs, state machines, asynchronous workers, and CI/CD pipelines. * **Hands\-On Applied AI Stack:** Practical experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom agent harnesses), RAG pipelines, vector databases (such as pgvector or Pinecone), and structured output validation. * **Security and Privacy Mindset:** Experience building systems under strict compliance frameworks (HIPAA, SOC2\) and working with Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) and encrypted data flows. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Ability to partner directly with clinicians, Product Managers, and Security teams to translate medical protocols into deterministic, testable software. **Preferences** * Direct experience in digital health, telehealth, or health\-tech startups. * Familiarity with healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7\), medical coding (ICD\-10, CPT), or EHR integrations (Epic, Athenahealth, Elation). * Experience with real\-time audio processing and medical transcription models (such as Whisper, Deepgram Medical, or AWS Transcribe Medical). **Benefits:** Salary and equity package, full medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) plan, and flexible PTO.

installation sites for installation, validation, and commissioning * Manage customer relationships and communicate project status clearly * Proactively identify and resolve technical issues during development and commissioning * Collaborate with engineering teams across U.S. and international locations **Requirements** * 5\+ years of relevant controls and automation engineering experience * jobs.title: Mechanical Designer: Junior & Senior Level Openings
jobs.description: Maybell Quantum is redefining the future of computing. As a venture\-backed quantum hardware innovator experiencing rapid growth, we're building technology that will transform industries for decades to come. Quantum computers will be as transformative to the next 30 years as the internet was to the last 30—and our team is creating the hardware foundation to make this revolution possible. Maybell Quantum is seeking Junior and Senior Mechanical Designers to develop accurate 3D models, detailed assemblies, and production\-ready manufacturing drawings for precision mechanical hardware. This is a hands\-on CAD design and drafting role. You'll translate concepts, sketches, and engineer\-provided requirements into clear, manufacturable documentation, working closely with engineers, technicians, manufacturing, and suppliers. **Key responsibilities** * Create, revise, and maintain detailed 3D part models, complex assemblies, and 2D production drawings from sketches, specifications, prototypes, and engineering direction. * Produce complete, fabrication\-ready drawings with appropriate dimensions, tolerances, notes, and GD\&T in accordance with applicable drafting standards (including ASME Y14\.5 / Y14\.100\). * Apply practical knowledge of machining, sheet metal, welding, brazing, and other manufacturing processes to improve part and drawing manufacturability. * Develop assembly models and documentation that support reliable fit, straightforward assembly, and repeatable production. * Create and maintain bills of materials (BOMs), part numbers, CAD files, drawing packages, and revision records. * Perform interference checks, dimensional reviews, and routine tolerance stack\-ups; work with engineers to resolve more complex fit or tolerance issues. * Prepare CAD and drawing packages for prototypes, suppliers, and in\-house fabrication; update designs and documentation based on build feedback. * Implement approved design changes and engineering change requests/orders (ECRs/ECOs), ensuring released drawings and files remain accurate. * Partner with machinists, technicians, manufacturing personnel, and vendors to troubleshoot fabrication and assembly issues. * Collaborate with mechanical engineers and physicists to translate new product concepts into detailed CAD models and practical manufacturing drawings. * Maintain organized CAD standards, templates, shared part libraries, and documentation practices. **Required qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional, hands\-on mechanical CAD design and drafting experience, ideally producing parts and assemblies for physical manufacturing. * Demonstrated ability to independently create accurate parametric 3D models, assemblies, and complete 2D fabrication drawings. * Strong proficiency with at least one parametric mechanical CAD platform (such as Onshape, SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor, Fusion 360, or NX). * Working command of mechanical drafting conventions, GD\&T, dimensional tolerancing, and drawing interpretation. * Practical familiarity with manufacturing methods, materials, and the information fabricators need from a drawing. * Experience organizing assembly documentation, BOMs, drawing revisions, and released CAD data. * Careful attention to drawing accuracy, file organization, and detail while managing multiple deliverables. * Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, machinists, technicians, and outside fabrication partners. **Preferred qualifications** Onshape is our primary CAD platform. Prior Onshape experience is valuable, but expertise in another parametric CAD system is equally welcome; we can support the transition. * Hands\-on Onshape experience with Part Studios, assemblies, drawings, and release/version workflows. * Experience preparing precision mechanical components, thermal hardware, vacuum equipment, or cryogenic\-system drawings. * Experience creating manufacturing drawings for machined parts, sheet metal, weldments, or brazed assemblies. * Experience with CAD/PDM or PLM release procedures and engineering change documentation. * Formal education in mechanical design, drafting, or mechanical engineering technology, or relevant CAD certifications. Equivalent practical experience is fully acceptable. **What we offer** * $35\.00 / hr \- $45\.00 / hr \+ potential bonuses commensurate with experience and performance * Company Equity options * Health, dental and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and holidays. * Professional development, training and certification support. Maybell Quantum is solving incredibly challenging problems at the cutting edge of physics and engineering. Don't meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workforce, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't aligned perfectly, we still encourage you to apply. *Maybell Quantum is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team.*

Job Summary The Vice President of Innovation and AI is a dual\-mandate executive role responsible for building and leading the organization's innovation capability while simultaneously establishing and governing its enterprise approach to artificial intelligence. This leader will build a high\-performing team of technologists and human\-centered designers who identify market opportunities, rapidly test new solutions, and determine what is ready to scale — while also standing up the governance, strategy, and responsible\-use framework that ensures AI is deployed safely, ethically, and effectively across the organization.This is a highly visible role requiring a leader who is equally comfortable driving fast, disciplined experimentation and building durable enterprise governance structures — someone who can move between “test and learn” and “policy and oversight” without losing rigor in either. Job Description MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS **Education:** Bachelors degree required; Masters degree (MBA, MHA, MS in relevant technical/design field) preferred. **Licenses/Certifications:** (None) **Experience / Knowledge / Skills:** * Minimum ten (10\) years of progressive leadership experience, including experience in healthcare, health tech, or a related regulated industry required. * Demonstrated experience building and leading innovation functions, including experience with human\-centered design, design thinking, or lean/agile innovation methodologies required. * Direct experience developing AI strategy and/or AI governance frameworks, ideally within a regulated or clinical environment required. * Strong understanding of responsible AI principles: bias/fairness, transparency, explainability, data privacy, and safety required. * Experience leading technical and design teams, including technologists, engineers, and designers required. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical/AI concepts for non\-technical clinical and business audiences required. * Experience in healthcare payer, provider, or health system environments preferred. * Familiarity with healthcare\-specific AI regulatory considerations (FDA SaMD, state AI healthcare laws, CMS guidance) preferred. * Experience establishing an AI governance committee or center of excellence from the ground up preferred. * Track record of scaling proof\-of\-concept solutions into enterprise production preferred. PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES Innovation Leadership * Build and lead a lean, versatile team of technologists and human\-centered design practitioners — individuals who can flex across multiple roles rather than a large, siloed organization — focused on solving complex healthcare problems with forward\-thinking, innovative solutions. * Champion human\-centered design as the teams starting point: leading with a deep understanding of the problem and the people affected by it before moving to a technology solution, rather than jumping straight to a tech\-first answer. * Scan the external marketplace (startups, emerging technology, competitor moves, adjacent industries) to identify white\-space opportunities relevant to the organizations strategic priorities. * Design and implement a lightweight, repeatable innovation process (e.g., discovery sprints, design thinking, rapid proof\-of\-concept methodology) that prioritizes speed\-to\-learning over long, resource\-intensive pilots. * Establish clear criteria and metrics for evaluating proof\-of\-concept outcomes — defining what “success” looks like and building a disciplined go/no\-go/scale decision framework. * Drive a culture of fast, disciplined experimentation and evidence\-based decision\-making; ensure experiments that dont pan out still generate usable learning rather than being treated as failures. * Partner with the Innovation Hub — comprised of business unit and clinical leaders — to determine which validated solutions should be scaled, operationalized, and transitioned into business\-as\-usual delivery. * Build and manage a portfolio view of innovation initiatives, ensuring resources are focused on the highest\-value opportunities. Artificial Intelligence Strategy\& Governance * Develop and lead the organizations enterprise AI strategy, aligning AI investments and initiatives with broader organizational and clinical priorities. * Design, implement, and oversee an AI governance process — including intake, risk assessment, model validation, monitoring, and retirement of AI/ML solutions across the organization. * Build a Responsible AI program establishing standards, policies, and practices for the ethical, safe, and equitable use of AI, with particular attention to healthcare\-specific risks (clinical safety, bias/health equity, patient privacy, regulatory compliance, transparency/explainability). * Partner with Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Clinical leadership, and IT/Data teams to ensure AI initiatives meet regulatory (e.g., HIPAA, FDA, state AI regulations) and organizational risk requirements. * Stay current on the evolving regulatory and technology landscape for AI in healthcare and proactively adjust governance and strategy accordingly. * Partner with HR to educate and build AI literacy across the organization, from front\-line staff to senior leadership and the Board. Leadership\& Organizational Impact * Build, lead, and develop a team combining technical, design, and governance/policy talent. * Represent the organization in select external forums (e.g., industry groups, conferences) as a voice on healthcare innovation and responsible AI. * Manage budget and resource allocation for the innovation and AI portfolios * Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service. * Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department\-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff. * Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards of providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and our workforce. * Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
jobs.description: ### **General Information** **Location** Cary, North Carolina Working Schedule Full\-Time Work Arrangement Hybrid Travel Required 10% Relocation Assistance Available No Grade 13T Posted Date 13\-Nov\-2026 Job ID 21592 ### **Description and Requirements** **The Team You Will Join** When you join MetLife’s Global Technology team, you’ll be part of a forward\-thinking group dedicated to shaping the future of digital solutions for customers worldwide. You’ll develop, maintain and support technology applications and delivery, leveraging AI, automation, and contemporary ways of working to enhance experiences and drive business outcomes. The team operates as a central capability with forward\-deployed SREs embedded in production support organizations, partnering across Application, Infrastructure, and Vendor teams to improve observability, reduce risk, and enhance customer and employee experience. automation and engineering\-led practices. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and deliver production automation, self\-healing, and engineering fixes in code that eliminate manual work and reduce L1 workload * Design and implement monitoring, observability, and SLO standards as code across applications and infrastructure, reducing alert noise, improving signal quality, and minimizing manual triage effort * Lead incident response and reviews hands\-on, perform root cause analysis, and ensure recurring issues translate into the engineering backlog and long\-term fixes * Establish and run production readiness reviews, identifying gaps and driving remediation with app, infra, and vendor teams * Implement and drive adoption of AI SRE solutions for anomaly detection, event correlation, and faster root cause analysis * Partner with application, infrastructure, and vendor engineers to improve system design, resilience, and operability, contributing code and configuration directly * Coach and enable engineers through pairing, code review, and reusable patterns, raising SRE capability across the organization * Lead the central SRE team and govern forward\-deployed SREs across application portfolios as the team grows * Track and report on reliability outcomes, including MTTR, incident reduction, and operational efficiency **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years in SRE, production support, or software/infrastructure engineering, with a hands\-on track record of building production automation and monitoring * Strong programming and scripting skills in Python and Bash/shell, with working knowledge of Java, Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript sufficient to read application code, diagnose defects, and contribute fixes * Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines to automate deployment, configuration, and operational tasks * Strong expertise in observability (logs, metrics, traces), distributed systems, and SLO/SLI design, including implementing monitoring and alerting as code * Ability to work independently, drive cross\-team initiatives, and influence engineering and operations practices * complex, enterprise environments * Experience automating ITSM workflows (e.g., ServiceNow), including event\-to\-incident integration and auto\-remediation * Experience driving enterprise SRE or monitoring transformations * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and containers * Experience with open\-source observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) * Exposure to AI SRE / AIOps platforms * Strong focus on measurable outcomes and operational improvement \#LI\-WRAPJOB Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role **requiring a minimum of 3 days per week** in office. *The expected salary range* *for this position is $140,000 \- $180,000**. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI\-enabled, people\-centered future. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: We’re hiring Research Engineers to join teams across Meta working at the intersection of frontier AI and real\-world product impact. You’ll be embedded directly in Facebook’s ecosystem, helping reimagine core experiences and reshape how people discover content, connect with creators, and interact with each other.The work spans some of the most bold bets in applied GenAI, including:\- Building the post\-training, evaluation, and serving systems that turn frontier LLMs into reliable, high\-quality product experiences used by billions.\- Building a general\-purpose agentic platform that powers a wide range of GenAI products across Facebook —enabling teams to ship faster, safer, and at scale.\- Building systems that enable capacity and cost optimizations through model fine\-tuning, post\-training and other techniques. \- Adapting and scaling these systems across Meta’s products. Why Join Us\- Product LLM work at singular scale Your post\-training decisions, evaluation frameworks, and serving architecture directly affect billions of daily interactions.\- End\-to\-end ownership We don't hand off models to a separate product team. We own the loop from training data to production behavior to measurement. The impact of your work shows up in days, not quarters.\- The problems are unsolved How do you evaluate open\-ended conversational AI at scale?
