jobs.title: Privacy Security Engineer, Privacy & Data Protection - Applied AI
jobs.description: Meta is seeking Security Engineers with Privacy and Data protection expertise to join our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) organization. You will apply deep privacy engineering expertise to hard, real\-world problems in how systems collect, use, retain, expose, and delete data. Your work is AI\-augmented from day one: you leverage AI tools and agents to accelerate your impact, and where the models fall short, your expertise directly drives their improvement.The problems that matter here are the ones a capable engineer cannot solve by reading the code in front of them: which jurisdiction's deadline applies to a deletion request, whether a derived dataset clears an anonymity threshold, where a deletion has to cascade. Models already handle the privacy obligations that are stated as ordinary good engineering practice, so the work is the obligation they cannot derive.This role is for privacy engineers who want to operate at the intersection of deep privacy expertise and frontier AI, not just applying AI to privacy work but shaping what it is capable of. ### **Privacy Security Engineer, Privacy \& Data Protection \- Applied AI Responsibilities:** * Identify and solve ambiguous problems within the privacy and data protection space where the solution and requirements are initially unknown, driving solutions that affect multiple teams * Architect privacy capabilities and evaluation infrastructure that sets the standard across teams * drive platform\-level decisions for AI\-driven privacy solutions at Meta's scale * Lead the strategy and methodology for the privacy problems AI cannot yet reason about: jurisdictional and regulatory obligations, de\-identification standards, data lifecycle controls, and data access reasoning * Shape how privacy expertise translates into AI capabilities: define the methodologies that make model improvement systematic and scalable * Drive cross\-organizational partnerships that define how privacy and AI intersect: influence technical direction beyond the immediate team * Break down problems into smaller scoped work streams, owning the most technically complex pieces while enabling others to execute against the overall solution * Mentor other engineers across the organization, build a community, and act as a role model for privacy engineering practices and Meta values * Disseminate findings through internal publications, knowledge sharing, and contributions to the broader privacy and security community ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent experience * 8\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience in technical privacy, data protection, or privacy\-adjacent security engineering * Deep expertise in at least one privacy subdomain with demonstrated ability to advance the state of the art: purpose limitation, retention and deletion, data access control, jurisdictional obligations, de\-identification, consent, or ML and model privacy * Experience implementing privacy obligations in production systems, in addition to reviewing or advising on them * Software engineering proficiency, including code review and maintenance, with experience coding in Python, PHP, Java, C/C\+\+, or an equivalent language * Track record of architecting privacy systems, controls or programs that operate at scale and influence how others build * Demonstrated ability to define and drive complex, ambiguous problem spaces with group\-level impact ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Experience improving AI model performance through expert feedback, red teaming, or evaluation design * Experience with pseudonymization lifecycle, including deletion of the user\-to\-pseudonym mapping * equivalence checking (LEC) for HBM SoC blocks and full\-chip across the implementation flow, including RTL\-to\-netlist, netlist\-to\-netlist (post\-synthesis, post\-DFT insertion, post\-CTS, equivalence. * Experience debugging non\-equivalence, aborts, and setup issues caused by synthesis optimizations such as retiming, register merging, clock gating, and multibit flops. * Working global, cross\-functional environment with strong communication and debugging skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with HBM / DRAM adjacent SoC designs, or memory\-subsystem\-heavy SoCs. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer

Seamlessly integrated with LLMs, this work drives Microsoft's future in the AI age, empowering Copilot to identify and utilize the best content for any task, enabling deep reasoning based on a rich representation of all enterprise data. We are looking for a talented **Senior Software Engineer** to join us in pushing the boundaries of technology for the Copilot experience. In this role, you will work on building highly scalable ingestion pipelines and indexing solutions at an exabyte scale, ensuring interactive freshness and low\-latency access to the best grounding data across enterprise content. Your work will directly impact users across the globe, making Copilot smarter and more responsive by ensuring it can deliver the right data for any enterprise scenario. If you are excited by the opportunity to make a transformative impact on a global scale, this role is for you! As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Experiments with AI tools and practices to improve their own capabilities. ### **Coding** Uses debugging tools, tests, logs, telemetry, and other methods to proactively verify assumptions while developing code before issues occur for products in production. Conducts incident retrospectives to identify root causes of problems, implements repair actions, and identifies mechanisms to prevent incident recurrence. Independently applies least\-access principles, uses logging, telemetry, and other appropriate mechanisms to investigate issues while retaining privacy and security, and drives those practices across the team. Reviews product code and test code to ensure it meets team standards, contains the correct test coverage, and is appropriate for the product or solution area. Brings insight to code reviews to help improve code quality, coaching and providing feedback to develop other engineers' skills. Conducts code reviews in a timely fashion that helps accelerate the pace of development on the team. Considers diagnosability, reliability, testability, and maintainability when reviewing code, and understands when code is ready to be shared or delivered. Applies and reviews for coding patterns, security risks, compliance issues, and best practices in code reviews, providing feedback on code to drive adherence to best practices. Uses automated source code analysis tools that are incorporated into the build/development process. Leads by example within the team to produce extensible, maintainable, well\-tested, secure, and performant code that adheres to design specifications. Continuously improves code performance, testability, maintainability, effectiveness, and cost, while learning about and accounting for relevant trade\-offs. Applies metrics to drive code quality and stability. Applies appropriate coding patterns and best practices (e.g., leveraging state\-of\-the\-art generative artificial intelligence \[GenAI], approaches to source code organization, naming conventions). Identifies and escalates blockers or unknowns during the development process, communicates how they will impact timelines, and identifies strategies and/or opportunities to address them. ### **Design** Leads discussions for and owns the architecture of a products/solutions and creates proposals for architecture by testing design hypotheses and develop complex design specifications. Tests and explores various design options for a complex product/solution scenario, outlining strengths and weakne  support documentation and additional test coverage to reduce likelihood of future user\-initiated incidents. Enables secure operations, security monitoring, and integration with live site investigation activities. Identifies and proposes opportunities (e.g., lunch talks, automation, practices, tools) that can be leveraged to improve the live site experience. jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Why Join the Pack? We understand that to win championships, it starts with the people. That’s why we’re all teammates with a united focus on fostering a winning culture that empowers, values and recognizes each other. Because working together is how we do what’s right for the communities we live, work and play in. It’s how we innovate, learn and grow as individuals and as a group. And it’s how we elevate lives through the power of basketball. **Position Summary/Objective:** The Data Engineering Manager owns data engineering and data strategy for the Minnesota Timberwolves and Lynx across ticketing, marketing, partnerships, sales, finance and operations, and architects and scales the unified data foundation behind them. The role owns data integrations, data infrastructure and automation workflows across CRM, ticketing, digital, mobile app, marketing automation and fan engagement platforms, and owns BI and Looker. It is central to the organization’s goal of leading in 1:1 marketing, predictive analytics and AI\-enabled fan engagement, and works closely with the NBA and WNBA to keep data aligned with league standards. A hands\-on player\-coach, the role is as comfortable in a revenue strategy meeting as they are writing SQL, and leads and grows a team of data and analytics engineers. **Essential Functions:** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform these essential functions. 1\. Cross\-functional, league and team leadership * Work directly with business stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, CRM, Technology and Finance to understand data needs, translate them into technical requirements and deliver solutions. * Drive business strategy and measurable results through data. * Work directly with NBA and WNBA data and technology teams, and represent the organization in league working groups on data standards and integrations. * Plan and prioritize the team’s work through a regular, predictable delivery cadence, keeping work visible and tied to business priorities, while staying hands\-on in the code. * Own intake and prioritization of requests from every department. * Lead, coach and develop the team’s engineers by setting technical direction, conducting code reviews, running regular 1:1s and owning hiring and performance management, and establish engineering standards and best practices. 2\. AI enablement and API integration * Build and maintain secure API connections between our data systems and approved AI platforms. * Structure pipelines to support AI\-driven personalization, recommendation engines, scoring models and automation workflows. * Monitor the performance, reliability and security of AI\-related data integrations. * Route AI\-generated insights back into CRM, marketing automation, ticketing and other operational systems. * Design, build and evolve the team’s own AI\-enabled tech stack, including AI coding assistants, LLM integrations and automated agents, and pilot and scale AI in BSA workflows. * Establish evaluation and governance standards for AI tools. * Align AI work with the team’s broader initiatives and roadmap, prioritizing use cases with clear, measurable business value. 3\. Business intelligence * Own BI and Looker, including governed metric definitions, semantic layer standards, documentation and self\-serve content. * Make sure dashboards give one trusted set of numbers that ties to Finance and league reporting. * Support Finance’s month\-end close with NetSuite, ticketing and revenue data that ties out. * Drive adoption and usage of the modern data stack (Snowflake, Looker, Fivetran, dbt) across the organization, including training, office hours and a champions network. 4\. Data integrity, governance and privacy * Establish and maintain data governance standards. * Monitor and enforce data quality, accuracy and completeness across systems. * Ensure compliance with privacy, consent management and league data policies. * Serve as BSA’s counterpart to IT and Technology, partnering on data infrastructure, security and governance. * Build validation checks, audit procedures and system monitoring dashboards, and track pipeline uptime and data freshness. * Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert on data reliability and system health. 5\. Automation and workflow enablement * Build and maintain the automated data workflows that power personalized 1:1 marketing journeys. * With CRM and Marketing, enable campaign triggers, lead score writeback, lead distribution, renewal intent models and lifecycle orchestration. * Make sure Sales and Marketing have the near\-real\-time data they need and that the data behind their automations is accurate and on time. * Reduce manual reporting and data processing through scalable system design. * Build the infrastructure for next\-best\-action and recommendation engines. 6\. Enterprise data integration and architecture * Own data engineering and data strategy across the organization, including ticketing, marketin nsional modeling, semantic layers and governed metrics. * Experience with data visualization, reporting and dashboard design. * Experience integrating CRM (Dynamics 365 / Dataverse preferred), marketing automation and digital platforms. * Experience implementing data governance and quality frameworks. * Proven track record translating business problems into data solutions and driving measurable outcomes, working cross\-functionally with non\-technical stakeholders. * Background spanning at least two of data engineering, analytics / BI and data science. * Experience mentoring engineers and leading data or analytics projects, including setting technical direction; people management experience a plus. * Experience running a lightweight delivery cadence, such as weekly triage and demos, planning every two weeks and tying every change to a tracked issue. * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a related field. **Pay:** $150,000\-180,000 annually. **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Specialized Knowledge, Licenses, etc.:** **Preferred:** domain depth in marketing analytics, sales analytics or data engineering; experience in sports, entertainment or media; experience at a high\-growth tech company or during a data platform migration or transformation; statistics, advanced analytics or predictive modeling; experience with league or enterprise\-level data standards; experience putting machine learning models into production; experience with vector databases and AI agents; familiarity with real\-time streaming technologies; exposure to customer data platforms, identity resolution and customer journey orchestration platforms. **Supervisory Responsibility:** This position manages a team of data and analytics engineers. Work Environment This job operates in a professional office environment. Office hours are typically 8:00 AM\-5:00PM Monday\-Friday. In addition to working office hours staff may work Timberwolves and Lynx home games as well as external events including but not limited to: charity and networking events. Work is both sedentary and active in nature. The working environment is generally favorable. Office lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous or unpleasant conditions caused by noise, dust, etc. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available, and may also operate in a sports arena which includes bleachers/steps and moderate noise levels. Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate and exchange information with others both in person and over the telephone. The employee frequently is required to remain in a stationary position, as well as operate computers and other office equipment, such as a copy machine, printer and telephone. Staff may occasionally ascend and descend bleachers/steps and traverse around the arena both on event days and non\-event days. Staff may occasionally move boxes or other items weighing up to 15 pounds. Travel Position may require travel. EEO Statement The Minnesota Timberwolves and Lynx are an equal employment opportunity organization. E\-Verify Statement We participate in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E\-Verify cannot prove this, we will give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) to resolve the issue before any action might be taken against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E\-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I\-9\.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Storage)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **About Mirantis** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** **Role Overview** Design and build the software that provisions, integrates, and operates high\-performance storage for GPU\-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will own a Storage as a Service component of the platform end\-to\-end, working with the Product Management, other development teams, and partner engineers to deliver against a dynamic set of requirements. You will develop the control\-plane services, drivers, and tooling that connect enterprise and scale\-out storage systems to Kubernetes\-based workloads across hybrid, edge, and air\-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack. **About the Role** We are looking for a principal\-level software engineer who thinks in systems and data paths — someone who can reason about throughput, latency, consistency, and failure across a storage stack, then express that understanding as clean, testable Go. The right candidate has built production software against real storage systems (whether enterprise NAS, scale\-out, or object), understands what makes storage fast and reliable at scale, and has a track record of leading an engineering team, exerting influence across the whole organization. **Responsibilities** 1\. Storage Software \& Integration * Design and build control\-plane services, drivers (e.g., CSI), and tooling that provision, configure, and operate storage for Kubernetes\-based AI/compute workloads. * Integrate high\-performance storage platforms — Dell PowerScale, VAST, and comparable systems — into automated, declarative provisioning workflows. * Build data\-path, telemetry, and observability tooling to diagnose and resolve performance, reliability, and scaling issues. 2\. Software \& Automation * Write production\-quality software — primarily in Go — with strong testing, code review, and operational rigor. * Deliver infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and GitOps\-driven pipelines (ArgoCD or Flux) for storage configuration and lifecycle. * Support bare\-metal and hybrid provisioning where storage intersects host and cluster bring\-up. 3\. Platform \& Hybrid Delivery * Deliver storage integration for k0s\-based Kubernetes via Cluster API (CAPI) and K0rdent management/child cluster topologies. * Architect storage software for fully disconnected (air\-gapped) environments, including local artifact/mirror connectivity (Harbor) and PKI/TLS considerations. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of software development, including production systems, with Go as a primary language. * 5\+ years building or integrating storage systems (distributed, scale\-out, NAS, or object) at scale. * Solid understanding of storage fundamentals: file/block/object models, throughput and latency behavior, caching, consistency, and failure modes. * Experience with Kubernetes storage (CSI, persistent volumes, storage classes), and Kubernetes controllers and operators patterns. * Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences, non\-technical stakeholders, and executive leadership. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with high\-performance storage platforms such as Dell PowerScale, VAST, or comparable technologies. * Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, k0s, MKE) and Cluster API. * Experience developing storage for GPU/AI workloads (high\-throughput data pipelines, GPUDirect Storage). **Additional Information** **Why you’ll love Mirantis** * Build the foundation platform for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI\-first enterprises * Collaborate with a world\-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence * Shape the product narrative and influence go\-to\-market success **It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision\-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment\-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com** By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities. \#remote We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, AI Strategy (Contract to Hire)
jobs.description: **About MojoTech** ------------------ MojoTech is an innovative technology consulting firm that leverages strategy, design, data, and software engineering to create results\-driven, AI\-enabled, digital products and experiences. We partner with our clients to discover and build tomorrow’s intelligent innovations, empowering every company to unlock future market potential, maximize returns on innovation, and drive transformational change. **Role Overview** ----------------- MojoTech is hiring a Senior Consultant in AI Strategy on a contract\-to\-hire basis. You will lead client AI strategy workstreams from discovery through business case and roadmap, working in a cross\-functional team with oversight from the Director of AI Strategy. Location: Remote, US Employment type: Contract to hire, full time (3\-month initial contract) Reports to: Director of AI Strategy Travel: Up to 25% Compensation: $120,000 to $150,000 base salary on conversion to full time Our AI Strategy practice takes clients from strategy to production using MojoTech's 7\-Phase AI Value Activation Framework. Clients follow a Growth track, to unlock new revenue with AI products and features, or an Efficiency track, to cut operating costs and add capacity with agentic workflows. You will deliver across our four AI offerings: * **AI Investment Workshop:** a short executive decision sprint that narrows a long list of AI ideas to one or two stress\-tested opportunities and a board\-ready investment brief. * **Forward Deployed AI Innovation Pod:** an embedded sprint where an AI Strategist and a Forward Deployed Engineer find high\-signal opportunities, build proof\-of\-value prototypes and assess data readiness. * **AI Transformation Strategy:** a multi\-week engagement that helps executives use AI to improve operational efficiency, ending with working prototype concepts, a board\-defensible investment decision and an engineering handoff. * **AI Product Strategy:** a multi\-week engagement that de\-risks AI product investment, ending with validated prototypes and an MVP\-to\-scale roadmap. **Responsibilities** -------------------- You will lead AI initiatives and drive solution discovery on 2 to 3 client engagements, with the Director of AI Strategy owning executive relationships and final recommendations. * **Lead workstreams day to day.** Own the plan, the working\-level client relationship and the deliverable through to sign\-off. * **Run discovery.** Lead stakeholder and customer interviews, workflow walkthroughs, and data and process reviews, then synthesize them into clear findings. * **Prioritize AI opportunities.** Assess each one on value, feasibility, risk and data readiness, and recommend where to invest. * **Build the business case.** Model ROI, total cost of ownership, payback and sensitivity, and defend the assumptions with client finance teams. * **Shape AI product strategy.** Identify which AI features belong on the product roadmap, validate them with customers and prototypes, and sequence them from MVP to scale. Support commercialization through market and competitive research, market sizing, customer profiles, positioning, and input to pricing and packaging, working with research partners. * **Shape AI transformation strategy.** Map how work gets done today, find where AI and agentic workflows can cut cost and effort, and build the roadmap, operating model, change management and adoption plan to capture the value. * **Write for decision makers.** Turn findings into decision briefs, roadmaps and executive readouts. * **Partner with technical teams.** Work with architects and engineers to define solution options, weigh build, buy or partner, and scope prototypes. * **Teach and enable.** Design and co\-deliver AI workshops, role\-based training, office hours and adoption materials. * **Build in responsible AI.** Address data privacy, human review and governance in every recommendation. * **Deliver with AI.** Use AI throughout your client work, applying and refining reusable templates, frameworks and AI\-assisted workflows to deliver faster and more consistently. **Desired Skills \& Experience** -------------------------------- * 5 to 8 years across consulting, product strategy or digital transformation, including at least 3 years leading AI or machine learning projects and doing hands\-on work yourself. * Consulting background with direct client\-facing delivery experience. * Industry experience in financial services, healthcare, energy and utilities, telecommunications or private equity. * A track record of leading client workstreams end to end with limited oversight. * Strong interviewing and synthesis skills: you turn messy input into structured findings and a clear point of view. * Financial modeling skills: you can build a business case in a spreadsheet and defend every assumption. * Applied, hands\-on knowledge of LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases and AI agents: how they work, where they fail and what they cost, used in real client or product work. * Practical command of responsible AI and AI governance, including data privacy, human oversight, evaluation and policy, applied to client recommendations. * A habit of using AI tools daily to research, analyze, model and write faster, while checking the output. * Executive\-ready writing and presentation skills. * Comfort with fixed\-fee timelines, ambiguity and switching between engagements. * US\-based, with the ability to travel to client sites up to 25% of the time. **Nice to have** ---------------- * AI certifications, such as OpenAI (AI Foundations), Anthropic (Claude), AWS, Microsoft Azure AI or Google Cloud. * Experience with AI governance and risk frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001\. * Experience running market research or willingness\-to\-pay studies. * Experience designing training, change management or adoption programs. * Familiarity with enterprise systems and data platforms such as NetSuite, HubSpot or Salesforce. **Flexible Working Environment** -------------------------------- We offer a flexible working model, allowing employees to choose between remote work, on\-site work in our offices located in Boulder, CO, and Providence, RI, or a hybrid of both. We also welcome candidates based in Phoenix, AZ as we continue to expand our presence in this area. * This job is remote, but requires you to be located in one of the following states: RI, CO, AZ, CT, FL, MA, MD, ME, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, SC, TN or UT. While the role is remote, preference will be given to candidates within commuting distance to our offices in Boulder, CO or Providence, RI or located in Phoenix, AZ. **Benefits** ------------ * Base salary $120,000 \- $150,000 * Medical, Dental, FSA * 401k with up to 4% match * Trust\-based time off * Catered lunches when in office * Dog\-friendly offices * Remote or in office (offices in Boulder, CO and Providence, RI) * Paid conference attendance/yearly education stipend * Generous family leave policy EQG3WeK0Ab

Our goal is to turn sophisticated software releases into repeatable, tested, automated workflows. We are looking for an engineer who enjoys working across different technologies, takes ownership of delivery, and builds systems that reduce manual work with each release. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Team **Information Technology and Digital** Business Unit **IT and Digital** Requisition No. **12750** City **Hicksville, US, 11801** **Waltham, US, 02451** **Brooklyn, US, 11217** Date posted **12 November 2026** **Senior Data Engineer** ======================== ### **Job Purpose** As a **Senior Data Engineer**, you’ll play a key role in building and evolving a cutting\-edge forecasting platform, helping teams across National Grid access high\-quality data and make smarter, more informed decisions. Working within a collaborative, cross\-functional development team, you’ll design and build scalable, end\-to\-end data pipelines that bring together large and complex datasets from multiple sources. Using agile ways of working and strong engineering principles, you’ll ensure our data is reliable, accessible and ready to power forecasting, analytics and reporting. You’ll also have the opportunity to help shape the future of our data engineering capability, modernising our architecture, tools and ways of working to improve scalability, performance and speed of delivery. This is an exciting opportunity for an innovative engineer who is passionate about **data, data quality and modern technology**, and wants to build solutions that make a real impact at scale. **National Grid is hiring a Senior Data Engineer. This role operates under a hybrid working model and is open to candidates based in either our Waltham, MA, Brooklyn, NY or Hicksville, NY office locations. Hybrid work expectations are subject to business needs and company policy.** ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build and support scalable data pipelines, ensuring they are robust, well\-tested and ready to meet growing business needs. * Build and evolve data integrations and APIs, enabling us to manage increasing volumes and complexity of data. * Champion data quality and governance, ensuring data is secure, consistent, reliable and accessible across the organisation. * Develop scalable data solutions that align with our architectural roadmaps and standards across data integration, storage, reporting and analytics. * Partner with analytics and business teams to improve data models, increase accessibility and enable better, data\-driven decision making. * Design and enhance data integration and quality frameworks, supported by strong unit, integration and functional testing. * Build and automate distributed data solutions that collect and process streaming events from multiple sources. * Investigate and resolve complex data issues, using data analysis to identify root causes and deliver effective solutions. * Guide and mentor junior engineers, sharing best practice around coding, engineering standards and optimisation. ### **Qualifications** You’ll be an experienced Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, working with large\-scale data and building high\-quality solutions that make data easier to access and use. We’d love you to bring: * Strong experience in **data engineering, analytics or business intelligence**, ideally with around **5 years’ relevant experience**. * Strong programming skills, particularly **Python**, alongside hands\-on experience with **PySpark and SQL**. * Strong experience working with **Databricks** and building scalable data solutions. * Experience designing and developing integrations across **multiple systems and APIs**. * Hands\-on experience with **Azure data technologies**, such as Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps and Azure Functions. * Strong SQL expertise, including working with and optimising queries across **large\-scale, complex datasets**. * Experience with **data warehousing** and developing **ETL and/or ELT pipelines**. * An understanding of **Agile software development methodologies** and modern engineering practices. * Excellent **problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills**, with a structured and process\-driven approach. * Strong documentation skills and a focus on creating maintainable, well\-engineered solutions. * A degree or equivalent experience, ideally within **Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or another technical discipline**. **It would be great if you also have:** * Experience designing data schemas and working with **SQL and NoSQL databases**. * Knowledge or experience with **Kafka, Flink, Fivetran or Matillion**. * Exposure to **Data Science and Machine Learning**. * A background in **software engineering**. * Experience working with **Snowflake**. \#LI\-NH2 \#LI\-HYBRID Salary Waltham: $129k\- $170k a year Brooklyn/Hicksville: $137k\- $180k a year National Grid will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **Summary:** NHA’s Application Development team builds and operates our proprietary, cloud\-native Student Information System — the platform that 100\+ schools and tens of thousands of students, families, and staff rely on every day. The Senior Software Engineer I leads well\-scoped, moderately complex projects from design through production, and raises the bar for the engineers around them through mentorship and code review. We build in a modern .NET (C\#) service\-oriented backend and an Angular/Nx front\-end, deploy continuously through Azure DevOps, and modernize legacy systems as we go. As an AI\-friendly team, we expect engineers to use modern AI development tools responsibly, with care for the student and staff data our systems handle. **Company Information:** National Heritage Academies (NHA) partners with communities to build and operate public charter schools. Founded in 1995, today NHA serves over 100 schools in nine states, with more than 65,000 students in kindergarten through 12th grade. Our schools are designed to eliminate the achievement gap and provide school choice to families so their children are prepared for success in college, career, and life. A majority of our schools consistently outperform their local district on the state test. According to the Center for Research on Education Outcomes at Stanford University, NHA is a leading performer among charter schools and management organizations, outperforming both conventional district schools and other charter school operators. In addition, according to our employee survey, over 90% of respondents agree that the work they do is meaningful to them. Join our team. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, test, and deliver features, enhancements, and fixes across NHA’s proprietary Student Information System and related custom applications, spanning the API, user interface, and data layers. * Write secure, well\-tested, and maintainable code in accordance with team standards, and support it in production. * Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and Agile ceremonies (e.g., SAFe/Scrum). * Diagnose and resolve production issues in supported areas using application logs and observability tooling; provide production support as needed. * Contribute to the ongoing modernization of legacy components onto NHA’s current technology stack. * Use modern AI development tools responsibly to improve productivity and code quality, exercising sound technical judgment and safeguarding sensitive student and staff data. * Collaborate with team members, product owners, quality assurance, and other stakeholders to plan and deliver complete solutions. * Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of student and staff data in accordance with NHA policy and applicable law. * Lead well\-scoped, moderately complex projects within a system from design through delivery. * Design feature\- and project\-level architecture, applying established patterns and weighing maintainability and testability. * Own the quality and production health of delivered features, diagnosing and resolving issues from logs and observability. * Mentor and review the work of less\-experienced engineers. * Coordinate with adjacent teams and stakeholders, and participate in the release\-owner rotation. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\-5 years of software engineering experience. * Proficiency with a modern object\-oriented back\-end language and a modern front\-end framework (NHA’s stack includes Microsoft .NET/C\# and Angular/TypeScript). * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL. * Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines (NHA uses Git and Azure DevOps). * Experience working on an Agile software development team (SAFe, Scrum, or similar). * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * A collaborative, coachable, and accountable approach to teamwork. * Broad proficiency across both front\-end and back\-end development (comfortable working full\-stack). * Strong technical judgment on trade\-offs and a track record of owning projects to production. * Ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes. * Experience with C\#/.NET and Angular/TypeScript (our core stack) preferred. * Experience with service\-based architecture patterns and SQL performance preferred. * Experience with modern identity (Okta / OpenID Connect) and production observability (Elastic APM) preferred. * Experience with CI/CD in Azure DevOps and containerized services preferred. This is an in\-person position at our NHA Service Center located at 3850 Broadmoor Ave., Grand Rapids, MI. Please click here to find out more about our core values. *National Heritage Academies is an equal\-opportunity employer.*

integrations that support enterprise analytics and business operations. * Build and optimize data solutions across modern cloud\-based data platforms and lakehouse environments. * Design and implement semantic data models and business\-ready data layers that improve data accessibility, consistency, and usability. * Support AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics initiatives through the effective solutions. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve data quality, reliability, and performance across the data ecosystem. * Contribute to data modeling, metadata management, and data governance practices that improve enterprise data understanding and reuse. * Research and recommend emerging technologies and best practices related to data engineering, analytics, and AI enablement. * Create and maintain a culture of engagement and one that is conducive to NISC's Statement of Shared Values. * Commitment to NISC's Statement of Shared Values. * Other duties as assigned. **Knowledge, Skills data solutions. * Strong understanding of data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, and data modeling concepts. * Experience designing semantic data models, business data layers, or related solutions that support reporting, analytics, and AI\-driven applications. * Familiarity with metadata management, ontology concepts, knowledge graphs, or similar approaches used to improve data discoverability and business understanding. * Experience supporting AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation initiatives through scalable data architectures. * Strong SQL and data analysis skills with experience working across structured and unstructured datasets. * Experience working with cloud\-based data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS analytics services, or similar technologies. * Experience with AWS services, Spark, ETL/ELT processes, and modern data integration tools. * Experience supporting and collaborating with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and implement practical solutions. **NISC's Shared Values \& Competencies:** * **Integrity** – We are committed to doing the right thing – always. * **Relationships** – We are committed to building and preserving lasting relationships. * **Innovation** – We promote the spirit of creativity and champion new ideas. * **Teamwork** – We exemplify the cooperative spirit by working together. * **Empowerment** – We believe individuals have the power to make a difference. * **Personal Development** – We believe the free exchange of knowledge and information is absolutely necessary to the success of each individual and the organization. **Benefits:** * Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance. * Health Savings Account (HSA) with $100 monthly contributions from NISC. + Like to walk? Improve your overall wellness knowledge? Ability to earn up to $800 additional dollars into your HSA each year through our Wellness Rewards program. * Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) thru Paylocity. * Fully covered life insurance up to x3 annual base salary. * Fully covered short\- and long\-term disability. * 401(k), traditional or Roth, with employee match up to 6% and employer 4% salary base contributions. * PTO accrual levels dependent on years of service, 120 Life Leave Event hours, 10 paid holidays and an annual holiday week. * $2,500 Interest\-FREE technology loan program. * $25,000 employee educational assistance program. * Volunteer, Wellness, Family Events and other employee fun supplied by our committees. * Employee Assistance Program; assisting employees and dependents with virtually any life event * Benevolence Committee to support employees with financial hardships like unexpected medical bills, funerals and other unfortunate hardships. **Education Preferred:** * Bachelor's degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science or similar discipline, preferred. **Minimum Physical Requirements:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Employees are regularly required to maintain a stationary position, move, and operate computer keyboards or office equipment. **Disclaimer:** Management may modify this job description by assigning or reassigning duties and responsibilities at any time. **Key Words:** SQL \| Data Engineering \| Data Lakehouse \| Semantic Layer \| Semantic Modeling \| Metadata Management \| Data Governance \| AI \| Generative AI \| AI Agents \| Knowledge Graphs \| ETL \| ELT \| Spark \| Python \| AWS \| Databricks \| Snowflake \| Microsoft Fabric \| Data Architecture

data transformation workflows. * Professional development experience with at least one procedural or object\-oriented programming language, preferably including multiple languages such as Scala, TypeScript, C\#, Java, or Python. * Experience with cloud platforms and data services, preferably within Azure and/or AWS environments. * Experience with source control and software development practices, preferably including Git and automated build/deployment processes. * Experience working with healthcare data. **Additional experience that is beneficial includes:** * Enterprise Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Big Data, unstructured data, or in\-memory data store technologies. * NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Cosmos DB. * Cloud\-based data movement and management using technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Service Bus, Kafka, Redis, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Azure Automation, machine learning services, or Elasticsearch. * Distributed data jobs.title: Internal Tools Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nutrient** ================== At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission\-critical. **Your Role at Nutrient…** ========================== As an Internal Tools Engineer with a strong focus on backend development, you will work on our applications, which power a lot of internal and external needs of the company, from product builds and licensing workflows to revenue analysis and operational management across Engineering, Sales, Product, and Finance. These tools range from CLI tools written in Bash to a medium\-sized Ruby on Rails application that provides our internal as well as customer\-facing interface and connects to a variety of 3rd party systems, and serves AI agents via an MCP server. Our primary tech stack: Rails, Postgres, Terraform/AWS. We are looking for an excellent collaborator who can solve problems independently and hold themselves to their own high standards. You will report directly to the COO and work as part of a small internal tools team, partnering closely with Engineering, Security and our go\-to\-market teams. If this is you, we want to hear from you. **What You’ll Work On…** ======================== * Build and extend our core internal platform, a Ruby on Rails application for customer and license management, including the customer\-facing features and release automation built on top of it. * Build and maintain reliable integrations between that platform and the business systems our teams depend on (CRM, support, project management and BI), so reporting and AI agents work from data people can trust. * Design and run the MCP servers and APIs that give AI agents governed access to company data and workflows: tool design, authentication and permission scoping, rate limits, observability, and evals that catch regressions. * Turn requests from Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product and Finance into working tools and automations, and help decide which ones are worth building. * Own security and compliance for the systems you run: SOC 2 evidence, penetration\-test findings, and dependency and vulnerability updates. * Work as part of a small internal tools team: review each other’s code, share ownership of systems, and keep each other unblocked. * Be a manager of one, spending your time on whatever is most valuable at the moment. **What You’ll Bring...** ======================== * A background in software engineering with a proven track record of independently driving projects from inception to completion. * Strong backend web development experience in a production framework (Ruby on Rails, Node, Python, Go or similar), plus shell scripting. * Deep understanding of databases and SQL (PostgreSQL). * Experience with managing and deploying backend services, including familiarity with containerization technologies and cloud platforms (Docker, Terraform, AWS). * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs in production: tool use and function calling, MCP, context engineering, and using evals and transcript review to find and fix real problems. **Nice to have:** * Experience designing systems for AI agents as users: clear tool schemas and descriptions, OAuth\-based authentication and data scoping, and observability for model and tool calls. * API or integration work with Salesforce, Zendesk, Linear or similar business systems. * Experience with SOC 2 or other security compliance work. **Who Thrives Here…** ===================== At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills. We’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are: * Collaborators: You work openly, listen actively, and put team success first. * Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels your progress and career growth. * Curious Thinkers: You dig into the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right. * Self\-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities. * Owners: You take responsibility for outcomes and always look for ways to improve what’s in your control. * Doers: You focus on results, not activity, and want to know how your work moved the goal. **Why You’ll Love Working Here…** ================================= At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact. * A small team, not a solo seat: you’ll have teammates to review your work and think through hard problems with. * Your users are right next to you: the people who use what you build are our leadership team and colleagues in every function, so you see the impact of your work right away. * Systems that matter: licensing, release builds, and a data platform that our reporting and AI agents depend on every day. * Fully remote and async\-first: minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work. * Mission\-critical product: Nutrient’s platform is trusted by 15%\+ of the Global 500 across 80\+ countries. * Strong growth trajectory: having more than doubled revenue over the past three years, backed by Insight Partners. *Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non\-merit factor.*

jobs.title: Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description: OneOncology is positioning community oncologists to drive the future of medical care through a patient\-centric, physician\-driven, and technology\-powered model to help improve the lives of everyone living with cancer and other diseases. Our team is bringing together leaders to the market place to help drive OneOncology’s mission and vision. Why join us? This is an exciting time to join OneOncology. Our values\-driven culture reflects our startup enthusiasm supported by industry leaders in oncology, urology, technology, and finance. We are looking for talented and highly\-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to improve and build new processes that support the meaningful work of independent physicians and the patients they serve. **Job Description:** Reporting to the Manager, Software \& AI Engineering, the **Platform Software Engineer** builds, operates, and enhances the Microsoft Azure foundation that supports OneOncology’s engineering teams and applications. This role is also responsible for the technical controls that support OneOncology’s HITRUST CSF certification, with a focus on automating infrastructure, strengthening a HIPAA\-regulated environment, and creating continuous, efficient processes for compliance evidence collection. This is a hands\-on role with a high degree of autonomy on a small engineering team. The Platform Software Engineer will contribute to both technical design and implementation and will take ownership of solutions from end to end—from developing and maintaining Terraform modules to supporting technical controls, compliance requirements, and audit responses. This is a full\-time remote position within the United States. Employees located in the Nashville, TN area have the option to work from the Nashville office. **Responsibilities:** * Design, provision, and operate Azure infrastructure—including App Service, AKS, Functions, networking, storage, and databases—using Terraform or Bicep with disciplined module design, state management, and peer review. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for secure, repeatable infrastructure and application deployments with appropriate change management. * Automate routine operational tasks and workflows using PowerShell, Bash, or Python. * Own the platform and infrastructure controls that support OneOncology’s HITRUST CSF certification, partnering with Security and Compliance on scoping, readiness, remediation, and assessment. * Build and maintain secure configuration baselines, reusable infrastructure modules, and automated control monitoring and evidence collection using tools such as Azure Policy and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. * Extend controls and tooling to newly acquired practices and environments as OneOncology grows. * Administer identity and access controls through Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management, Conditional Access, and MFA, including access reviews and enforcement of least\-privilege and segregation\-of\-duties principles. * Manage secrets, certificates, and encryption keys in Azure Key Vault, including rotation and lifecycle management. * Maintain centralized logging, monitoring, detections, alerts, and dashboards using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Sentinel, with appropriate audit retention and immutability requirements. Participate in incident response and the on\-call rotation. * Run authenticated vulnerability scanning and drive risk\-based remediation within agreed SLAs. * Manage patching across cloud and server workloads with minimal disruption. * Maintain backup and disaster recovery capabilities and test recovery against defined RTO and RPO targets. * Develop self\-service tooling, templates, runbooks, and documentation that enable application engineers to move quickly within established security and compliance guardrails * Additional responsibilities as assigned to help drive our mission of improving the lives of everyone living with cancer. **Qualifications:** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. * High school diploma or GED. * 5\+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, cloud, or site reliability engineering. * 3\+ years of hands\-on Microsoft Azure experience across compute, networking, identity, storage, and monitoring. * Demonstrated experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates), including module design and state management. * Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python. * Working knowledge of at least one healthcare or security compliance framework — HITRUST CSF, HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, or NIST — and practical experience enforcing those controls in a cloud environment. * Comfort operating autonomously on a small team and owning problems end to end. **Preferred** * Direct experience supporting a HITRUST CSF validated assessment (e1, i1, or r2\) or an equivalent audit, including evidence preparation. * Experience in healthcare technology or another HIPAA\-regulated environment. * Kubernetes / AKS and container security experience. * SIEM experience (Microsoft Sentinel) and familiarity with compliance automation tooling such as MyCSF, Vanta, or Drata. * Certifications such as AZ\-104, AZ\-400, AZ\-500, CKA/CKS, CISSP, or HITRUST CCSFP. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering tools and how to adopt them safely in a regulated environment. **Essential Competencies:** * Autonomy and ownership — able to take an ambiguous problem from design through production with limited oversight. * Architectural judgment — designs systems, not just features, and can explain the tradeoffs behind a decision. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical partners. * Generalist range and comfort operating on a small, fast\-moving engineering team. * Sound handling of protected health information and a security\-first mindset. * Attendance is an essential job function.

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer (Member of Technical Staff)
jobs.description: **About the OpenClaw Foundation** The OpenClaw Foundation is the steward of the world's largest open\-source AI agent project. Our mission is grounded in a foundational conviction: AI should be open, safe, and ultimately owned by the individuals and communities who use it. The Foundation operates across three core mandates: * Advancing research into the human\-agent relationship while continuously evolving the OpenClaw platform. * Ensuring the security, reliability, and long\-term sustainability of the OpenClaw codebase. * Establishing open standards for agent configuration, communication, trust, transactions, and user identity. Inspired by organizations like the Linux Foundation and W3C, we are building a neutral, multi\-stakeholder ecosystem that enables individuals and organizations to participate in the future of open\-source AI. **About the Role** OpenClaw Foundation is looking for our first Mobile Engineer (Member of Technical Staff) to help build and evolve the mobile experience for OpenClaw from the ground up (0\-1\). As the sole mobile developer, you'll work on the applications and infrastructure that bring personal AI agents directly into users' everyday lives. This includes building intuitive, high\-performance mobile experiences that allow users to interact with, configure, manage, and communicate with their agents from anywhere. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone with demonstrated experience building and shipping applications across both iOS and Android. You'll be responsible for delivering polished, reliable mobile experiences while navigating the unique technical requirements of each platform. You'll work closely with product, design, and platform engineering to translate complex agent capabilities into simple, accessible mobile experiences. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast\-moving, open\-source environment, takes ownership of features from concept through production, and enjoys working across the full mobile stack. **What You'll Do** 1\. Mobile Product Development * Build, ship, and maintain high\-quality mobile applications across both iOS and Android. * Develop core experiences that allow users to interact with, manage, configure, and communicate with their AI agents directly from their mobile devices. * Translate complex agent capabilities into intuitive, accessible, and performant mobile interfaces. * Own features end\-to\-end, from technical design and implementation through testing, release, and iteration. * Build and optimize real\-time interactions, messaging, notifications, and agent communication experiences. * Ensure consistent functionality and a polished user experience across different devices, screen sizes, and operating system versions. 2\. Mobile Architecture \& Infrastructure * Contribute to the architecture and technical direction of OpenClaw's mobile applications. * Build scalable, maintainable mobile infrastructure that supports an evolving ecosystem of agents, tools, and integrations. * Integrate mobile applications with OpenClaw's backend services, APIs, and agent communication protocols. * Develop reliable approaches to background processing, state management, synchronization, and offline functionality. * Work with cross\-platform frameworks and native iOS and Android capabilities to deliver consistent experiences without compromising platform\-specific functionality. * Ensure applications perform reliably across different devices, operating systems, and network conditions. 3\. Performance, Security \& Reliability * Optimize application performance, responsiveness, battery consumption, memory usage, and network efficiency. * Implement secure authentication, session management, permissions, and data handling. * Account for the unique security and privacy considerations of AI agents accessing user data, local devices, and external systems. * Build robust error handling, monitoring, logging, and debugging capabilities. * Identify and resolve technical issues across the mobile stack and both operating systems. * Establish testing and quality standards to ensure reliable releases across iOS and Android. 4\. Cross\-Functional \& Open\-Source Collaboration * Work closely with product designers, platform engineers, and the broader OpenClaw community to deliver cohesive product experiences. * Partner with design to translate product vision into polished, production\-ready mobile experiences. * Collaborate with backend and platform engineers to integrate new agent capabilities into the mobile experience. * Contribute to technical decisions, code reviews, documentation, and engineering standards. * Participate in open\-source development, contributing improvements and engaging with developers across the ecosystem. * Help identify opportunities to improve the overall developer and end\-user experience. **What We're Looking For** * 6\+ years of professional experience building and shipping production mobile applications. * Demonstrated experience developing for both iOS and Android, with a strong understanding of each platform's architecture, capabilities, and development requirements. * Experience with native development using Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android). * Experience shipping and maintaining applications across both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. * Strong understanding of mobile architecture, state management, API integrations, and asynchronous programming. * Experience working with REST APIs, WebSockets, real\-time communication, and backend services. * Strong understanding of mobile performance optimization, debugging, testing, and release management. * Experience with authentication, secure data storage, permissions, and mobile application security. * Ability to deliver consistent, high\-quality experiences across both platforms while accounting for native functionality and usability. * Ability to own features independently, make sound technical decisions, and deliver high\-quality code. * Strong product instincts and an appreciation for the details that make mobile experiences feel intuitive and polished. * Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment with evolving requirements and a high degree of ownership. **Nice to Have** * Experience building AI\-powered applications, AI assistants, or agentic products. * Familiarity with LLM integrations, streaming responses, tool calling, and real\-time agent interactions. * Experience with background tasks, push notifications, deep linking, and mobile\-to\-device communication. * Experience with native iOS and Android capabilities beyond cross\-platform development. * Experience with open\-source projects and community\-driven development. * Familiarity with Linux, self\-hosted infrastructure, or developer tooling. * Experience building applications that interact with local devices, APIs, and external services. * Experience optimizing applications for different network conditions, offline usage, and background execution. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer, GTM
jobs.description: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com. **Job Summary** --------------- OpenGov is seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to serve as a dedicated practitioner within the Applied AI team, focused on Sales/GTM use cases across the revenue organization — SDR outbound, AE pipeline and opportunity management, and CSM account management and renewals — along with the account/opportunity intelligence that feeds all three. This role sits at the intersection of seller workflows, revenue systems, and applied AI, and includes hands\-on GTM engineering: building the workflows, integrations, and automations across revenue systems that make sellers faster. It exists to systematically redesign how OpenGov's revenue organization runs its motion in an AI\-native world, from lead through cash and the renewals that follow. This is a technical role applied in a traditionally non\-technical space. You bring a sharp problem\-solving mind, comfort with modern AI tools, and the instinct to decompose a complex, manual seller workflow into its components — and then design something fundamentally better. You need the ability to think from first principles, build trust with sellers and RevOps before designing for them, and own the full lifecycle from problem discovery to solution adoption. You will build the agents and systems that turn raw go\-to\-market signal (procurement data, contract/vendor intelligence, account and contact records, call and email activity) into action sellers actually take — signal\-to\-sequence automation for SDR outbound, next\-best\-action and deal\-risk surfacing for AE opportunity management, and account\-health and renewal\-risk surfacing for CSMs. You will also serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house, and be the primary AI capability advisor for the revenue organization. This role operates within the Applied AI team's technical ecosystem. You will partner closely with a dedicated analytics/ops counterpart on the sales side, partner with AI and data engineers on complex builds, and work directly with sales leadership, RevOps, and SDR/AE/CSM teams for domain guidance and go\-to\-market context. Given the revenue\-centric focus of this work, this role requires a genuine interest in driving conversion across the funnel (such as contact\-to\-meeting rate, S1/S2 conversion, and win rate), along with deal\-cycle length and renewal outcomes. Pipeline management itself sits with sales leadership and RevOps, and you will work closely with them. You will not own KPI definitions or reporting, but you will apply the necessary rigor and ROI framing to make sure what gets built is actually moving those numbers. You will have access to data, ownership, and core responsibilities at a level comparable to senior sales leadership, and are expected to exercise that with corresponding discretion. **You Will…** ------------- * **Own the AI\-native signal\-to\-action layer for Sales**: design, build, and continuously improve the agents and automations that turn account/contact/product signal into qualified SDR sequences, AE opportunity actions, and CSM account and renewal actions, with clear human review and approval points before anything reaches a prospect or customer. * **Build for AE and CSM workflows specifically, not just top\-of\-funnel outbound**: deal\-risk and next\-best\-action surfacing for AEs managing opportunities through the pipeline, and account\-health, renewal\-risk, and expansion\-signal surfacing for CSMs managing customers through renewal — this role's scope is the revenue organization, not one segment of it. * **Serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house**: drive the roadmap, prioritization, and quality bar for the call\- and deal\-intelligence and other revenue systems the Applied AI team builds, in partnership with sales leadership and the RevOps/analytics counterpart. * **Design the human oversight for every agent you ship**: approval gates, escalation paths, and clear ownership boundaries so SDRs, AEs, and CSMs stay in control of what goes out under their name — an agent recommends and drafts, a human approves and sends. * **Build and run evaluation frameworks for agent behavi  tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar), and working fluency with SQL; able to extract insight from data and frame it clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-starter with high initiative: you see opportunities, propose solutions, and drive them forward without waiting to be told. This role will involve significant ambiguity, and the right person will find that energizing rather than paralyzing. * Exceptional written and verbal communication: you write clearly, you do not create information silos, and you know how to tailor your message to the audience in front of you. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Prior experience in sales/revenue operations, customer success operations, or a forward\-deployed/solutions\-architecture role. * Experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, or building MCP servers. * Familiarity with AI governance concepts: prompt design, data access controls, audit trails, and responsible AI principles in sensitive\-data environments. * Experience building or deploying workflow automations or internal tools without engineering support. * Familiarity with Snowflake, Looker, or similar data platforms at a data analysis level (not data engineering). * Applied ML and experimentation background: A/B testing, propensity models, recommendations, or lead/account scoring. * Experience working in a fast\-moving, high\-growth SaaS environment where the org is actively evolving and priorities shift quickly. * Experience working at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, or Sales and RevOps — roles that required navigating cross\-functional data ownership and system permissions. * Prior exposure to public sector or B2G sales, or other environments with elevated data handling standards. **Compensation** ---------------- Chicago, IL: $150,000 \- $165,000 On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location. **Why OpenGov?** ================ **A Mission That Matters.** At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. **Opportunity to Innovate** The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. **A Team of Passionate, Driven People** This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. **A Place to Make Your Mark** We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. **Benefits That Work for You** Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: * Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions * Professional development and growth opportunities * A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches. Compensation Range: $150K \- $165K
