jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer (Advanced Threat Protection)
jobs.description: Santa Clara, California, United States of America Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-024724 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. **Job Summary** **Your Career** As a Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you will provide technical leadership in architecting and delivering next\-generation, AI\-driven cloud security solutions. In this role, you will drive scalable cloud security architecture through hands\-on system design and coding, build and fine\-tune advanced AI/ML, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Small Language Models (SLMs), oversee the full product lifecycle, and collaborate cross\-functionally to transform complex security telemetry into high\-reliability Security\-as\-a\-Service (SECaaS) offerings. **Your Impact** --------------- * **Architect Agentic Systems:** Lead the design and implementation of ML/GenAI\-powered agents featuring dynamic planning, multi\-step execution, self\-correction, and seamless multi\-agent and human\-in\-the\-loop collaboration. * **Model Development, Diagnosis \& Fine\-Tuning:** Build, evaluate, and fine\-tune both LLMs and SLMs, alongside multimodal architectures. Diagnose model regressions or sub\-par performance, pinpoint root causes (data distribution shift, alignment failures, loss anomalies), and implement targeted fine\-tuning (SFT, DPO/RLHF, PEFT/LoRA) to drive continuous quality recovery and improvement. * **GPU \& System Optimization:** Profile, debug, and optimize model training and inference on GPU clusters, addressing memory allocation bottlenecks (OOMs), distributed communication overhead, and compute utilization. * **Data Pipelines \& Telemetry Integration:** Architect scalable data preprocessing and feature extraction pipelines to feed real\-time endpoint telemetry into agentic and analytical workflows. * **Production Engineering \& Standards:** Drive end\-to\-end engineering from prototype to enterprise\-grade production, establishing best practices for prompt architecture, agent memory persistence, context window optimization, tool\-use execution, and safety guardrails. * **Technical Strategy:** Continuously evaluate state\-of\-the\-art agent frameworks, model serving engines, and accelerator architectures to inform long\-term technical roadmaps.Your **Qualifications** **Your Experience** * **Experience:** 7\+ years in professional software engineering, with a proven track record of deploying production\-grade ML, GenAI, or agentic architectures at enterprise scale. * **Languages \& Backend:** Advanced proficiency in Python (AI/ML development) paired with production\-level Go or Java experience for building distributed microservices. * **Data Pipeline Engineering:** Strong hands\-on capabilities building and scaling data pipelines. Proficient with **Apache Spark, core data tools, SQL**, BigQuery schema design, and Google Cloud infrastructure (Dataproc, GKE, and GCP SDKs). * **LLM/SLM Operations \& Fine\-Tuning:** Practical operational experience with both **LLMs and SLMs**. Deep expertise in diagnosing model performance issues and executing remedial fine\-tuning strategies (dataset curation, parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning, loss monitoring, alignment, and evaluation benchmarks). * **Hardware \& Accelerator Debugging:** Practical experience with **GPU profiling and debugging** (e.g., CUDA memory optimization, multi\-GPU synchronization, batch throughput tuning, and handling GPU compute crashes/stalls). * **Core ML Foundations:** Solid understanding of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector storage, prompt optimization, model evaluation metrics, and applied statistical modeling. * **Education:** BS or MS in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. ### **Preferred Qualifications (Bonus)** * **Domain Knowledge:** Background in cybersecurity, threat detection, or cloud security principles is a strong bonus. * **Networking:** Working knowledge of L3–L7 networking protocols, packet inspection, and network security topologies. * **Telemetry:** Experience handling high\-volume cybersecurity telemetry, endpoint detection data, or real\-time threat intelligence feeds. \#LI\-TD1 **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $163,200\.00 \- $264,000\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship?: Yes

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: 46808 New York, NY, US, 10036 Los Angeles, CA, US, 90038 Technology New York Full\-Time On\-Site **Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.** Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. You’ll make application architecture, agent design, tool design and model selection decisions, while collaborating with the hiring manager and architecture review process on platform standards. **Responsibilities** * Architect and build secure, full stack AI applications using Python, TypeScript, APIs and React or similar user interface frameworks. Integrate LLMs, including Gemini, Claude, GPT and open weight models through Vertex AI and Azure OpenAI, with enterprise systems, MCP tool servers and Automation Anywhere A360 and Agentic Process Automation bots. Build deterministic guardrails, approval gates, role based permissions and complete audit trails so automated actions are explainable, attributable and reversible. Design state management, retries, idempotency and escalation paths for workflows that run over extended periods. * Apply enterprise security controls. Use OAuth2/OIDC and ensure service identities have the least privilege access. Manage secrets and implement defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration, like Model Armor. Translate requirements for offshore contractors and vendor engineers, and review their deliverables for quality and security. * Contribute reusable MCP servers, agent templates, approval interface components and evaluation harnesses to the shared platform. Create reference architectures and documentation. Mentor engineers in Enterprise Solutions \& Technology. Help them understand development practices that encourage self\-sufficiency. * Support ad hoc projects, including proofs of concept for executive stakeholders and evaluation of emerging models, protocols such as MCP and A2A, and vendor capabilities. **Basic Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * 2 years of designing and delivering production LLM applications. The applications should be used by real users on an enterprise scale. They must have features like retrieval augmented generation, tool or function calling, and a sions with business partners who might not have technical backgrounds. You should also write clear design documents. Additionally, you will present tradeoffs to senior leaders. * Experience coordinating with offshore or globally distributed teams. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent functional experience. **Bonus Skills (Nice\-to\-Haves)** * Experience with Automation Anywhere’s agentic capabilities, including AI Agent Studio, Process Reasoning Engine and Control Room/A360 governance, or building AI agents that invoke RPA bots as tools. * Experience with Google’s agent stack, including Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine, Gemini Enterprise and Model Armor, or with Azure OpenAI and Anthropic Claude platforms. * Experience authoring MCP servers, working with the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol or contributing to open source agent frameworks. * Awareness with LLM evaluation tools such as Vertex AI Evaluation, Ragas, DeepEval and Promptfoo. * Prior experience in media and entertainment business operations is preferred. This experience can include rights and royalties, content supply chain, finance procedures, and SOX controls. It can also include legal contract workflows. Alternatively, experience in a consulting role with Fortune 500 clients is acceptable. * Experience with token budgeting, caching, model routing and user interface design for enterprise applications. \#LI\-JJ1 **About Skydance** Skydance is a next\-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct\-to\-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount\+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Hiring Salary Range: $156,800\.00 \- 235,200\.00\. In compliance with local law, we are disclosing compensation, or a range thereof, for roles where legally required. Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short\- and long\-term incentives, and program\-specific awards. This position is bonus eligible. **What We Offer**: * Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here. * Generous paid time off. * Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount\+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products. * Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more. Skydance is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. This role supports the integration and assessment of advanced technologies across maritime, aerial, ground, and space domains. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, execute, and analyze physics\-based RF models and simulations across multi\-domain operational environments. * Assess RF propagation, radar cross section (RCS), link budgets, jammer\-to\-signal (J/S) ratios, and electromagnetic spectrum operations (EMSO) effects. * Model communication systems, including mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs) and point\-to\-point RF systems, as well as radar systems such as search, track, and phased\-array radar. * Evaluate technology performance in nominal, congested, and contested electromagnetic environments, including noise jamming, digital radio frequency memory (DRFM), and electromagnetic interference (EMI). * Utilize AFSIM, STK, or equivalent modeling and simulation tools to conduct physics\-based and mission\-level analyses. * Develop and execute mission\-level M\&S scenarios incorporating manned and unmanned vehicles, platforms, infrastructure, and U.S. and allied systems. * Assess technology performance within representative concepts of operation (CONOPS), including interactions and synergistic effects across systems and operational environments. * Ingest, transform, process, analyze, and visualize technical data generated during experimentation and test events. * Develop automated data\-processing workflows using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent analytical tools. * Apply statistical analysis, pattern recognition, and data\-cleaning techniques to evaluate large and heterogeneous datasets. * Analyze telemetry, RF specifications and measurements, and platform or flight logs to support technical interpretation and experimentation outcomes. * Develop analytical reports, consolidated datasets, figures, and visualization products supporting Government decision\-making and follow\-on tasking. * Utilize Power BI or equivalent visualization platforms to deliver structured and actionable analytical products. **Required Qualifications** * Technical knowledge and experience in physics\-based RF modeling and analysis. * Understanding of RF propagation, RCS, link budgets, J/S analysis, and EMSO effects. * Experience with RF communication and radar systems in multi\-domain environments. * Experience developing, executing, analyzing, and documenting mission\-level modeling and simulation. * Experience with AFSIM, STK, or equivalent modeling and simulation tools. * Experience with MATLAB, Python, or equivalent analytical programming tools. * jobs.title: Architecture & Performance Modeling Engineer, AI Inference Silicon (Senior / Principal)
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip\-to\-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first\-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders. **Role Overview** ----------------- As a Senior Architecture \& Performance Modeling Engineer, you will help shape the architecture of our next\-generation AI inference accelerators. You will work directly with chip architects to explore architectural options, quantify tradeoffs, identify bottlenecks, and turn modeling results into actionable design recommendations. This work starts before RTL exists. You will use analytical models and our in\-house simulators to answer architectural questions quickly, then refine and validate those models as the design matures. Each engineer on the team takes primary modeling responsibility for a next\-generation chip while contributing to a shared modeling framework. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Architecture Studies and Recommendations*** Partner with architects to turn design questions into focused modeling studies with clear assumptions, alternatives, metrics, and recommendations. * Perform what\-if analysis across compute engines, memory capacity and bandwidth, dataflow, DMA, command processing, on\-chip interconnect, and chip\-to\-chip communication. * Compare architectural options, explain performance sensitivities, and recommend changes within the system, power, area, and implementation constraints established with the architecture team. **Workload Analysis*** Evaluate representative AI inference workloads across prefill and decode, batch sizes, context lengths, and dense and mixture\-of\-experts models to identify what limits latency, throughput, and hardware utilization. * Provide timely feedback throughout the design cycle by communicating findings, investigating unexpected results, and updating studies as workloads and architectural choices evolve. **Model Development and Correlation*** Develop and extend analytical, transaction\-level, and cycle\-level models, choosing the level of detail needed to answer each question with useful turnaround time. * Maintain reusable models in our native Rust simulator and correlate predictions against RTL simulation, emulation, or silicon measurements as they become available, with regression coverage and clear documentation of assumptions, limitations, and discrepancies. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in computer architecture, microarchitecture, or performance modeling for accelerators, CPUs, or GPUs. * Demonstrated experience using models to influence architectural decisions, such as identifying a bottleneck, comparing design alternatives, or recommending a change backed by quantitative analysis. * A strong understanding of pipelines, queues, parallel execution, memory hierarchies, data movement, and interconnects. * Hands\-on experience building analytical, transaction\-level, or cycle\-level performance models, including first\-order estimates that help validate and explain simulation results. * Comfort working with incomplete specifications, making assumptions explicit, and balancing modeling fidelity with speed of iteration. * Strong Rust skills, or expert\-level C/C\+\+ skills and a willingness to work in Rust day to day, along with proficiency in Python for workload analysis, experiments, and visualization. * Ability to read SystemVerilog RTL and relevant verification results, reconcile them with architectural specifications, and calibrate models as implementation details become available. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain what drives a result, how much confidence to place in it, and what the architecture team should investigate or change next. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with LLM inference, including attention, KV caches, quantization, mixture\-of\-experts workloads, and parallelism across multiple chips. * A track record of connecting workload behavior and software execution choices to hardware performance. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * You will own the performance modeling for a next\-generation inference chip and see your analysis shape real architectural decisions before RTL is written. * You will work side by side with the architects behind Asimov and Titan on the hardware that defines how frontier models are served at scale. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role for Senior: $220,000 – $270,000, for Principal: $270,000\-$350,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

Qualifications** --------------------------- * 4\+ years of experience in developer tooling, developer platforms, or infrastructure engineering. * Demonstrated experience building tooling that LLM coding agents use in production, such as MCP servers or tool APIs, agent workflows in CI, evaluation harnesses, or agent\-driven code generation with verification. * A strong understanding of CI/CD jobs.title: Talent Acquisition & People Partner (AI Engineering, Product, GTM), New York / New Jersey
jobs.description: ### **About the Role:** The problem you'd be solving We build AI systems that enterprises run their business on. Production systems inside banks, insurers, and health systems, where our engineers embed with the client, learn the work, and own the outcome. We call them Forward Deployed Engineers and Forward Deployed Executives. These people hold design conversations with a Chief Data Officer on Tuesday and ship to production next Monday. We are hiring a People \& Talent Partner to help us scale our FDE/FDX, Product, and GTM teams. Five open reqs at a time, none of them generic. We would rather you run five properly than twenty badly. Beyond filling roles, you will own the talent community strategy around Provectus, and you will build the people\-operations presence for our US team locally — be the person our US colleagues come to first. Location: Hybrid, New York: 2\-3 days onsite. Type: Full\-time (W2\). ### **What You'll Do:** **Recruiting:** * Full\-cycle hiring across the US for Forward Deployed Engineers (software, AI/ML, architects, leads), Forward Deployed Executives, Product Owners, and Business Development Managers. Intake to offer: * Partnership with the hiring managers. You'll run calibration with them and bring market data when a scorecard doesn't match what exists. * Architect and execute Provectus's talent community strategy in the US. Meetups, workshops, hackathons, university programs, and the AI/ML communities. You don't need to have run events before. You need to want to help with that, and there's a budget and support from marketing when you do. * US hiring strategy. Talent market intelligence, compensation benchmarking, and how we position Provectus against the companies competing for the same engineers. **People operations for the US team.** You'll be the on\-the\-ground people partner for our US\-based colleagues, working with the Head of People Operations: * Onboarding of US hires. * First point of contact for US employees on benefits, time off, policies, and day\-to\-day people questions. * Support for the performance review cycle for US\-based staff: scheduling, collecting feedback, tracking outcomes. * Team engagement and onsite days — the rhythm that makes a hybrid New York team feel like a team. **What's the split between Recruiting and HR?** 70/30### **What You'll Bring:** * 4\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in a fast\-paced technical environment, ideally at an AI, cloud, or consulting firm * Proven track record of sourcing and hiring senior technical profiles — AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, or consulting leaders * Demonstrates personal AI adoption — uses AI tools as part of their recruiting workflow, not just aware of them * Exposure to HR generalist or people\-operations work — onboarding, benefits, employee relations — or a clear appetite to build it. You don't need to have been an HRBP. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable partnering with C\-level and senior technical leadership * Highly organized, self\-directed, and comfortable with ambiguity in a distributed, global team * Commitment to Provectus's core values: Obsession, Ownership, Transparency, and Partnership * Based in the New York / New Jersey area and able to be onsite \[2\-3] days a week **Nice to have:** * Experience building talent community: events, meetups, professional networks, or university programs * Familiarity with US benefits administration, onboarding, and experience with an HRIS. **Where this goes:** This is a growing US function. The person who does this well takes on more of the community mandate, more senior searches, a deeper people\-partner role as the US team grows, and a path toward owning the US talent function. We'll talk about that trajectory. ### **What We Offer:** * Direct impact on Provectus's growth in the US market with direct visibility to leadership. * Access to the Provectus Learning Hub, Claude Code certification support * Collaborative culture that rewards ownership, curiosity, and continuous learning * Full\-time W2 model. * Base $150k\- 170k. Final offer reflects experience, skills, and market data. * Health, vision, dental, disability, and life insurance; 401(k) plan; unlimited vacation. ### **About Provectus:** Provectus is an AWS Premier Partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner working at the front edge of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory work. We focus on Financial Services \& Insurance and Healthcare \& Life Sciences, with offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA.### **Hiring Process:** * 30\-45\-minute call with the Head of Talent Acquisition * 30\-minute call with the Head of People Operations * On\-site meeting with the CEO We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Since opening our first self\-storage facility in 1972, **Public Storage** has grown to become the **largest owner and operator of self\-storage facilities** in the world. With **thousands of locations** across the U.S. and Europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we're also one of the largest landlords. We've been recognized as **A Great Place to Work** by the Great Place to Work Institute. And, our employees have also voted us as having **Best Career Growth**, ranked us in the **Top 5% for Work Culture**, and in the **Top 10% for Diversity and Inclusion**. We're a member of the **S\&P 500** and **FT Global 500**. Our common and preferred stocks trade on the New York Stock Exchange. **Job Description** Designs, implements, and manages enterprise cloud infrastructure and services, primarily within Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Ensures cloud and supporting Windows infrastructure is reliable, secure, scalable, cost\-effective, and aligned with architecture and operational standards. Applies advanced technical judgment to evaluate design options, resolve complex issues, automate operations, and recommend improvements across cloud, container, networking, security, and infrastructure services. Partners with development, security, and IT teams and provides technical guidance, documentation, and project support for enterprise initiatives. * Designs, deploys, manages, and optimizes GCP infrastructure and core services, including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC networks, load balancing, Cloud CDN, and related platform components, to meet availability, scalability, performance, and cost requirements. * Designs and supports Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) environments and collaborates with development teams to integrate, deploy, and operate applications using reliable container and cloud architecture practices. * Leads or contributes to cloud and infrastructure projects, manages assigned milestones and stakeholder communications, maintains technical and operational documentation, and provides technical guidance and support to IT team members. * Investigates and resolves complex cloud, server, networking, and platform incidents; evaluates possible causes and recovery options, coordinates escalation when needed, and supports backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities. * Designs, administers, and troubleshoots Windows Server and Active Directory services that support cloud and enterprise infrastructure, including integration, authentication, availability, and operational support requirements. * Monitors cloud infrastructure, logging, capacity, performance, reliability, and cost using GCP tools and Datadog; analyzes trends and exceptions and recommends or implements corrective and optimization actions. * Automates cloud and infrastructure operations using infrastructure\-as\-code, GitOps, PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, Bitbucket, Jenkins, or similar technologies to improve consistency, security, and operational efficiency. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. * Preferred: Google Cloud Professional, Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, or other relevant Google Cloud certification. * Preferred: Datadog certification or demonstrated hands\-on experience with Datadog monitoring and logging. * Minimum 3 years of relevant cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or platform engineering experience, including at least 3 years working with Google Cloud Platform. * Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience with Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or comparable enterprise Kubernetes platforms. * Preferred 5 years of progressively responsible cloud and infrastructure engineering experience in an enterprise environment. * Preferred 5 years experience supporting Windows Server, Active Directory, cloud networking, security, automation, CI/CD, backup, and disaster recovery solutions. * Strong knowledge of GCP architecture and services, including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, GKE, VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, and Cloud Pub/Sub. * Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, cloud networking, identity and access management, encryption, security controls, compliance requirements, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices. * Ability to analyze ambiguous or complex technical issues, compare alternatives, assess risk and operational impact, and make or recommend sound architecture and troubleshooting decisions. * Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code, GitOps, PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, Bitbucket, Datadog, or similar tools. * Knowledge of DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including integrating security and operational controls into automated delivery pipelines. * Familiarity with GCP database services, including Cloud SQL, Spanner, Alloy DB, Bigtable, and BigQuery. * Strong project management, documentation, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage milestones, communicate with stakeholders and management, and provide technical guidance. **Additional Information** * Primarily office\-based in Frisco, Texas, with extended periods of computer use. * Expected to work in the office five days per week, with up to three flexible remote days per month in accordance with company policy. * Requires occasional work outside normal business hours, including weeknights and weekends, to support maintenance, incidents, releases, or project activities. * May require participation in scheduled on\-call or escalation support based on business needs. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Staff IT Auditor
jobs.description: The Staff Information Technology (IT) Auditor provides independent, objective assurance services designed to improve operations and manage risks that could impact Publix’s financial results, operations, or reputation. This role leads to audits and assessments of moderately complex technologies and processes, ensuring appropriate IT controls are in place and operating effectively. The Staff IT Auditor works closely with IT and business area teams to evaluate risks, recommend improvements, and support compliance with regulatory and industry standards. The IT Audit team at Publix plays a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and efficiency of the company’s technology infrastructure. The team conducts independent audits and assessments, provides consulting services, and supports compliance with regulatory and industry standards. Staff IT Auditors work closely with cross\-functional teams and leadership to evaluate risks, recommend improvements, and ensure that IT systems align with business objectives. Publix Super Markets is the largest employee\-owned supermarket chain in the United States. With no long\-term debt and consistent growth, Publix is recognized for its commitment to community involvement, sustainability, and diversity. Associates take pride in working for—and owning—a Fortune 100 company that is widely regarded as a leader in the supermarket industry. **Responsibilities** * Lead independent audits and assessments of moderately complex technologies and processes. * Evaluate IT controls, system configurations, and process design for effectiveness, efficiency, and compliance. * Analyze risks related to technology, vendors, and business processes. * Reperform representative samples of responsibilities from I/S roles such as IT Security Analyst, Engineer, DBA, and Systems Analyst. * Document technology and process flows using narratives and data diagrams. * Assess control environments and associate competency in audited areas. * Identify and evaluate risks, determine likelihood and impact, and assess mitigation strategies. * Recommend corrective actions for control deficiencies. * Communicate findings and recommendations to management, including senior leadership. * Monitor and test corrective actions for effectiveness and timeliness. * Maintain and enhance personal expertise in IT auditing, risk management, and compliance standards.

Full\-Stack Software Engineer** **Location: 1953 Gallows Rd, Ste 145, Vienna, VA 22182****Position Type: Full\-Time \| Onsite****Compensation: $60,000 \- $70,000, depending on qualifications and experience** **Why join STraffic America?** At STraffic America, you'll be part of a global organization driving the future of smart, safe, and sustainable urban mobility. with UI/UX designers and product teams to ensure a user\-centered experience. **Backend Development*** Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and server\-side business logic using Spring Boot. * documentation, including architecture diagrams and system specifications. * Participate in regular meetings across U.S. and Korean teams, with flexibility for time\-zone differences. **What We Are Looking For** **Essential Skills and Abilities*** Strong understanding of relational databases and experience with PostgreSQL. * Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS\-based deployment. * Comfortable using Git\-based version control systems (e.g., GitLab). * Working knowledge of Kafka, Redis, Prometheus, and Grafana (preferred). * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. * Skilled at balancing autonomous problem\-solving with open communication across cross\-functional groups in a quickly evolving workplace. **Education and Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 3–5 years of full\-stack software development experience. * Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front\-end frameworks (React preferred). * Proficiency in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Spring Boot. * Experience using development tools such as IntelliJ IDEA, Visual Studio Code, Confluence, and Figma (preferred). * Prior experience working in small\-to\-mid\-sized teams or cross\-regional projects (preferred). **Physical Requirements*** Ability to sit or stand for prolonged periods and work at a computer. * Occasional lifting of files or materials (up to 20 lbs.) **Submit your application today!****We value initiative, clear communication, and teammates who lift others up. Whether you are a seasoned full\-stack developer or a rising talent with strong fundamentals, your next opportunity may start here.**

jobs.title: Integration & Automation Engineer (Utility)
jobs.description: **Description** **Integration \& Automation Engineer, Utilities (Control Systems \& OT Integration)** ===================================================================================== **Position Summary** -------------------- Hanwha Qcells Georgia operates a vertically integrated solar manufacturing facility in Cartersville, GA, covering Ingot, Wafer, Cell, and Module production. The Integration \& Automation Engineer is responsible for the design, configuration, integration, and reliable operation of the plant's utility control systems — including PLC, DCS, SCADA/FMCS, HMI, field instrumentation, and industrial networks — that connect electrical, mechanical, and process utility equipment into a single, monitored and controlled system in a 24/7 critical manufacturing environment. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Control System Operation \& Maintenance** * Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot PLC, DCS, SCADA/FMCS, and HMI systems serving plant utilities (power distribution, chillers, compressed air, exhaust, UPW/wastewater, and bulk gas/chemical supply). * Manage control system backups, program revision control, firmware/software updates, licenses, and spare hardware. * Perform control loop checks, instrument calibration, and tuning of flow, pressure, temperature, level, and analyzer loops. **System Integration \& Communication** * Integrate package PLCs, power meters, switchgear, VFDs/MCCs, and third\-party equipment into FMCS/SCADA using Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC DA/UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, BACnet, and serial (RS\-485/RS\-232\) protocols. * Develop and maintain I/O lists, point/tag mapping, alarm lists, and interface specifications; resolve communication and data quality issues between systems. * Build and maintain HMI/SCADA graphics, alarms, trends, and historian data (e.g., OSIsoft/AVEVA PI) for operations and engineering use. **Industrial Network \& OT Cybersecurity** * Maintain the OT network architecture (switches, fiber, remote I/O, gateways) and its segregation from the IT network. * Implement OT cybersecurity practices, including access control, system hardening, patch management, and remote access procedures, in coordination with the IT team. **Safety \& Protection Systems** * Maintain interlocks, emergency shutdown logic, and safety\-related control functions; support review of safety instrumented functions and proof testing where applicable. * Support interfaces between the control system and fire alarm, gas detection, and toxic gas monitoring systems. **Troubleshooting \& Reliability** * Serve as first\-line technical responder for control system failures, communication losses, and nuisance trips; lead root cause analysis and corrective action reports. * Participate in the on\-call rotation for after\-hours control and automation emergencies. **Projects \& Expansion** * Support plant capacity expansion and modification projects: develop control philosophy and functional design specifications, prepare RFQs and technical bid evaluations, review vendor submittals, and attend FAT/SAT. * Oversee control system installation, loop checks, and commissioning (Level 3–5\) through turnover; coordinate with EPC/controls contractors, system integrators, and equipment vendors. **Documentation \& Technical Support** * Maintain system architecture drawings, P\&IDs, loop drawings, control narratives, network diagrams, and as\-built documentation. * Provide technical guidance and training to automation and instrumentation technicians and operators. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Control/Instrumentation, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in configuration, integration, commissioning, or maintenance of PLC, DCS, and/or SCADA systems in industrial, utility, or process plant environments. * Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, OPC, Ethernet\-based fieldbuses) and industrial networking. * Ability to read and interpret P\&IDs, loop diagrams, control narratives, one\-line diagrams, and wiring diagrams. * Familiarity with NEC, NFPA 70E, and OSHA electrical safety requirements. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. * Ability to communicate effectively in English with contractors, vendors, and plant personnel. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * **Experience integrating multi\-vendor control systems (e.g., Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, Yokogawa, Emerson, Honeywell) into a plant\-wide SCADA/FMCS or historian platform.** * Experience in semiconductor, high\-purity chemical, solar, battery, or other mission\-critical manufacturing facilities. * Experience with safety instrumented systems (SIS/ESD) and fire \& gas systems; TÜV Functional Safety Engineer (IEC 61511/61508\) certification. * Experience with OT cybersecurity standards and programs (e.g., ISA/IEC 62443\). * Electrical system knowledge, including MCCs, VFDs, switchgear, UPS, and power monitoring. * Project management experience, including scope, schedule, budget, and contract management with EPC contractors and vendors. * Network certifications (e.g., CCNA) or equivalent industrial networking training. * OSHA 10/30 certification; NFPA 70E qualified person training. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * Work in a 24/7 manufacturing facility, including control rooms, electrical rooms, utility buildings, and outdoor areas. * Participation in on\-call rotation and occasional after\-hours, weekend, or shutdown work. * Required to wear PPE, including arc\-rated clothing, as specified by task. * Ability to climb ladders, work in confined or elevated spaces, and lift up to 50 lbs. *Hanwha Q CELLS provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.*

Then bring your problem\-solving, passion, and creativity to help us power the next leap in electronics. AtQnity, we’re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high\-tech industries – we’re a tight\-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting\-edge technology possible. We value forward\-thinking challengers, boundary\-pushers, and diverse perspectives across all our departments, because we know we play a critical role in the world enabling faster progress for all. Learn how you can start or jumpstart your career with us. Senior AI Engineer Qnity is accepting applications for a full\-timeSenior AI Engineer position based at one of Qnity’s main campuses inWilmington, Delaware, USA. For engineers who want to take generative AI beyond experimentation and into daily production use, this is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team that plays a vital and dynamic role in the company. Qnity is a market leader in specialty materials for electronic devices and microchip fabrication. In this role, the Senior AI Engineer will collaborate with data scientists, operations scientists, and Digital and IT teams engaged in a variety of manufacturing and business activities, building the agentic AI and enterprise retrieval capabilities these teams depend on. Generative AI, agent orchestration, and enterprise search are becoming core to business operations, creating opportunities to contribute across: * Enterprise agentic AI platform architecture * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) over proprietary technical and business content * Multi\-agent automation for business and manufacturing workflows * Secure, permission\-aware enterprise data access * Production deployment, evaluation, observability, and AI cost optimization A strong candidate will bring modern AI engineering expertise in LLM application design, retrieval and ranking, agent orchestration, prompt engineering, evaluation, and machine learning. The role requires strong Python skills to prepare and index data, build and serve models and agents, and create clear documentation and demonstrations. The Senior AI Engineer will also plan delivery, lead technical work, communicate with business stakeholders, integrate with data engineering and software teams, deploy production solutions, and coach the broader community. Key Responsibilities * Partner with business stakeholders to define use cases, scope, and success criteria, and translate business problems into AI, machine learning, or computer vision solutions. * Lead end\-to\-end AI delivery, including architecture, technical direction, code quality, deployment, operations, reliability, performance, and cost. * Architect and operate the enterprise agentic AI platform on Azure AI Foundry, optimizing models, orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, latency, scale, and cost. * Design enterprise RAG over SharePoint and Microsoft 365 content using Microsoft Graph, permission\-aware ingestion, embeddings, metadata, re\-ranking, and access\-controlled search. * Build Copilot Studio agents, custom connectors, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams agents, MCP servers, and function\-calling tools for governed enterprise actions. * Design multi\-agent patterns, including orchestrator\-worker delegation, sequential and concurrent execution, handoff, collaboration, state management, and memory. * Develop and evaluate AI applications for knowledge discovery, workflow automation, quality improvement, process monitoring, defect detection, and operational efficiency. * Collaborate with data engineering, software, and digital teams to integrate enterprise data, build scalable pipelines, and deliver production solutions through CI/CD. * Set enterprise AI engineering standards, reusable architecture patterns, and design\-review practices that reduce production risk. * Communicate results, coach engineers and data scientists, and drive adoption through responsible AI, user feedback, and continuous improvement. Required Skills\& Education * Bachelor’s degree or higher in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related technical field. * 1\+ years of experience building and deploying production AI and machine learning systems. * Strong Python development skills, with SQL/NoSQL experience. Java or R experience is a plus. * Hands\-on Azure AI experience, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Agent Service, Prompt Flow, evaluation, embeddings, and content safety. * Advanced RAG and search skills, including Azure AI Search, hybrid/vector retrieval, semantic ranker, chunking, metadata filtering, re\-ranking, and document\-level security trimming. * Experience with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365 content, Entra ID app registrations, delegated/application permissions, and ACL\-based access control. * Copilot and agent extensibility experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams agents, MCP servers, custom connectors, function\-calling tools, Adaptive Cards, Graph connectors, and governed enterprise integrations. * Agent orchestration experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain/LangGraph, planner\-executor patterns, ReAct loops, tool calling, and guardrails. * Applied ML, NLP, and computer vision foundation, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, transformers, deep learning, object detection, and image segmentation. * Production AI engineering experience with LLMOps/MLOps, evaluation, regression testing, observability, tracing, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Azure Functions, AKS/Container Apps, API Management, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor. * Working knowledge of enterprise AI security and governance, including permission trimming, data residency, Purview sensitivity labels, DLP, responsible AI, prompt\-injection defenses, and cost controls. * Strong technical leadership, architecture review, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and delivery ownership skills. Preferred Experience * Experience in manufacturing, semiconductor, specialty materials, or operational technology environments. Living the Qnity ValuesAt Qnity, success is measured not only bywhat we achieve, but also byhow we achieve it. * Customer: Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, solve business challenges, and deliver meaningful outcomes. * Innovation: Continuously improve processes, technologies, and ways of working. * Speed: Act with urgency, focus, and precision to move work forward and deliver results. * People: Build trusted relationships, collaborate across teams, and inspire positive change. Join ourTalent Community to stay connected with us! Qnity is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation to search or apply for a position, please visit our Accessibility Page for Contact Information. Qnity offers a comprehensive pay and benefits package. To learn more visit theCompensation and Benefits page. We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance our recruitment process.

jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> ASICS Engineering **General Summary:** We are seeking a **Staff Engineer, Embedded Sensor Systems \& Physical AI** to develop next\-generation sensing technologies for Robotics, XR, mobile, \& IEIoT,I applications. This is a **hands\-on sensor systems engineering role** at the intersection of sensor hardware, embedded electronics, firmware, signal processing, characterization, and system integration. The ideal candidate can take a sensing concept from early evaluation through prototype development, characterization, embedded integration, and system demonstration. You will work with technologies such as **tactile, force, pressure, proximity, motion, environmental, and multimodal sensing** , integrating sensors with embedded compute platforms and intelligent perception/control systems. You will collaborate across robotics, XR, AI/ML, silicon, embedded software, and systems teams on applications including **dexterous manipulation, tactile perception, force control, HMI, multimodal perception, and contextual awareness** . We value **technical depth, hands\-on experimentation, system thinking, and the ability to turn emerging sensor technologies into robust working prototypes** . **Key Responsibilities** * **Lead the architecture, development, and validation of advanced sensor systems** for robotics, XR, mobile, IoT, and Physical AI applications. * **Design and build embedded sensing platforms** for sensor bring\-up, data acquisition, real\-time processing, characterization, control, and system validation. * **Develop sensor characterization and calibration methodologies** , including automated test infrastructure and performance metrics for noise, sensitivity, accuracy, latency, bandwidth, power, reliability, drift, and robustness. Create or partner for hardware prototypes and evaluation systems, including sensor boards, embedded platforms, sensor fixtures, test setups, and data collection infrastructure. * **Develop and debug hardware, firmware, and low\-level software** spanning sensors, analog/digital interfaces, MCUs/SoCs/DSPs/FPGAs, communication interfaces, and embedded processing. * **Architect and evaluate multimodal sensing and sensor\-fusion solutions** combining modalities such as tactile, force, proximity, motion, vision, audio, and environmental sensing. * **Collaborate with robotics, controls, AI/ML, silicon, software, and systems teams** to integrate sensing with perception, actuation, manipulation, HMI, and intelligent interaction. * **Provide technical leadership for emerging sensing technologies** , working with internal teams, suppliers, research partners, and universities to evaluate technologies, build prototypes, define roadmaps, and generate IP. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4\+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 3\+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. OR PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 2\+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Demonstrated hands\-on experience developing **sensor systems, embedded hardware, or sensor\-based platforms** . * Strong understanding of **sensor signal chains, characterization, calibration, noise, data acquisition, and system integration** . * Experience developing embedded firmware/software using **C/C\+\+ and/or Python** , and integrating sensors with MCU, SoC, DSP, FPGA, or similar platforms. * Hands\-on experience designing and debugging **PCBs, sensor modules, embedded platforms, laboratory instrumentation, and system\-level prototypes** . * Demonstrated ability to solve open\-ended engineering problems and drive solutions across hardware, firmware, software, algorithms, and systems teams. * **Ability to work effectively on open\-ended technical problems** , define requirements, make trade\-offs, and drive solutions across hardware, software, firmware, and systems teams. * **Strong communication skills** and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering organizations. *Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred. jobs.title: Engineer II - Distribution
jobs.description: Position Overview: **Power your Future with Qualus** as an Engineer II in our Distribution Department. As a Distribution Engineer II, you will provide technical leadership for electric utility distribution projects, including system expansion, resiliency, and infrastructure improvement initiatives. You will develop and review engineering designs using WMS, Pole Foreman, Design Manager/Electric Office, and AutoCAD, while ensuring compliance with utility standards and regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will perform QA/QC reviews, mentor junior engineers and designers, and collaborate with clients and project teams to deliver safe, reliable, and cost\-effective solutions. Responsibilities: * Provide technical leadership and engineering expertise for overhead and underground electrical distribution system projects. * Apply client standards, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements to the design and execution of distribution projects. * Support project execution by managing assignments, monitoring performance, resolving technical issues, and maintaining strong client relationships. * Develop and oversee engineering design packages using client\-specific software and design tools, including Distribution Design Studio, Pole Foreman, Design Manager, WMS, and AutoCAD. * Perform QA/QC reviews of engineering and design deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, quality, consistency, and compliance with project requirements. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers through training, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. * Communicate effectively with internal teams, clients, contractors, and regulatory agencies to support successful project delivery. * Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, design standards, team performance, and technical capabilities. * Maintain productivity and adaptability in a fast\-paced, evolving work environment. Minimum Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or related discipline) from an ABET\-accredited institution. * 3\-5 years of experience in electric utility distribution engineering and design. * **Working experience with Design Manager or Electric Office** * Experience designing and supporting overhead and underground distribution systems. * Knowledge of utility distribution standards, NESC requirements, and utility construction practices. * Proficiency with utility design and work management software, including Pole Foreman, Design Manager/Electric Office, WMS, AutoCAD, or similar platforms. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. * Experience preparing, reviewing, and coordinating engineering design packages and construction work orders. * Strong communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. * Excellent organizational, document management, and attention\-to\-detail skills. * Demonstrated ability to perform technical reviews and ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance of engineering deliverables. \#LI\-ML1 Preferred Skills: * Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure. * Experience with complex system expansion projects, load growth initiatives, and utility infrastructure upgrades. * Experience supporting government conversion projects, municipal utility programs, or utility acquisition integrations. * Experience with resiliency, system hardening, storm mitigation, reliability improvement, and grid modernization programs. * Experience supporting PIP (Pole Inspection Program), pole replacement, asset management, and vegetation management initiatives. * Advanced proficiency with Pole Foreman, Design Manager/Electric Office, WMS, AutoCAD, GIS, and related utility software platforms. * Experience performing formal QA/QC reviews of engineering designs, work packages, staking sheets, and construction deliverables. * Familiarity with distributed energy resources (DER), renewable energy interconnections, electric vehicle infrastructure, and distribution automation projects. * Experience working directly with investor\-owned utilities (IOUs), cooperatives, and municipal electric systems. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer serves as a senior technical leader supporting Quva's hybrid cloud environment spanning private cloud, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and managed\-service provider (MSP) delivered cloud services. This role combines hands\-on cloud and infrastructure engineering with leadership in architecture, governance, automation, security integration, operational escalation, cost optimization, and technical oversight. The position leads complex initiatives, establishes scalable standards, mentors technical team members, and strengthens internal cloud capability across providers while continuing to leverage external partners for operational scale, specialist capabilities, and after\-hours support. At Quva, you will be an essential part of a mission\-driven organization dedicated to expanding critical access to quality, affordable medication and data insights while promoting a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. **What the Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer Does Each Day:** * Lead the technical architecture, engineering standards, roadmap, and lifecycle direction for Quva's private cloud, Azure, and AWS environments * Provide direct engineering support for existing private\-cloud tenants, including compute, storage, networking, identity integration, monitoring, backup, recovery, and infrastructure troubleshooting * Design, implement, and govern Azure and AWS infrastructure using scalable, secure, repeatable patterns aligned with business and application requirements * Serve as an internal Azure/AWS technical resource and escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents, complex changes, migrations, integrations, and performance issues * Develop and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code and automation practices using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep/ARM, AWS CloudFormation, PowerShell, Python, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions, as appropriate to Quva standards * Partner with Cybersecurity to integrate cloud identity, privileged access, network security, logging, vulnerability management, endpoint/workload protections, and security monitoring into cloud architecture * Architect and maintain cloud connectivity and network services, including virtual networks/VPCs, routing, DNS, VPN/private connectivity, load balancing, firewalls/security groups, and hybrid\-cloud integration * Implement and maintain standards for cloud observability, monitoring, alerting, log collection, backup, disaster recovery, resilience, and capacity/performance management * Contribute technical expertise to workload migration planning, landing\-zone design, cloud adoption, tenant/account/subscription structure, and application infrastructure modernization * Implement cloud governance controls covering access, resource organization, tagging, configuration standards, policy enforcement, change control, documentation, and operational readiness * Monitor and optimize cloud utilization and spend through rightsizing, lifecycle management, reservations/savings approaches where appropriate, resource cleanup, and cost visibility; partner with IT leadership on cloud cost governance * Support the technical oversight of MSP\-delivered cloud services. Review designs, validate engineering decisions, coordinate escalations, and confirm that services align with Quva architecture, security, resiliency, and support requirements * Maintain architecture diagrams, technical standards, runbooks, inventories, support documentation, recovery procedures, and institutional knowledge for Quva’s cloud platforms * Participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, problem management, change management, and disaster\-recovery testing for infrastructure and cloud services * Collaborate with application, security, data, business systems, and infrastructure teams to translate business requirements into supportable technical solutions * Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to internal IT team members while reducing reliance on provider\-specific institutional knowledge * Establish clear technical ownership across Quva\-operated and provider\-operated cloud services, including architecture, IAM, networking, automation, monitoring, security, backup/disaster recovery, and optimization * Define technical acceptance criteria for MSP projects and operational changes and validate solutions before production handoff * Review MSP incidents, recurring problems, service performance, technical debt, security findings, and optimization opportunities; drive corrective actions to closure * Ensure Quva retains current architecture documentation, administrative knowledge, configuration visibility, and recovery information necessary to independently oversee its environments * Partner with Procurement, Finance, Security, and IT leadership as appropriate to evaluate technical scope, service consumption, licensing, capacity, and provider performance **Our Most Successful Senior Cloud Infrastructure Eng nfiguration automation, and CI/CD practices for infrastructure deployment * Experience working with managed\-service providers, consulting partners, or outsourced infrastructure teams, with the ability to independently evaluate technical designs and provider recommendations * Working knowledge of cloud security concepts, least\-privilege access, logging/monitoring, vulnerability remediation, encryption, secrets management, and secure configuration practices * Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across cloud, network, identity, operating system, application dependency, and provider boundaries * Familiarity with ITIL\-aligned incident, problem, change, configuration, and service\-management practices * Strong technical documentation, communication, vendor\-management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills * 18\+ years of age * Able to successfully complete a drug and background chec * Must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis; Quva is not able to sponsor applicants for work visas **Any of the Following Will Give You an Edge:** * Experience supporting regulated, pharmaceutical, healthcare, manufacturing, or other highly controlled environments * Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or comparable Azure credentials * AWS Certified Solutions Architect or SysOps Administrator certification * Experience with Terraform and enterprise landing\-zone or cloud\-governance frameworks * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, AWS IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Organizations, or comparable cloud\-management services **Benefits of Working at Quva:** * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental and vision * 401k retirement program with company match * 17 paid days off plus 8 paid holidays per year * National, industry\-leading high growth company with future career advancement opportunities **About Quva:** Quva provides industry\-leading health\-system pharmacy services and solutions, including 503B sterile injectable outsourcing services and AI\-based data software solutions that help power the business of pharmacy. Quva Pharma’s multiple production facilities and industry\-first dedicated remote distribution capabilities provide ready\-to\-administer sterile injectable medicines critical to patient care. Quva BrightStream partners with health systems to aggregate, normalize, and analyze large amounts of complex data across their sites of care, and through proprietary machine learning, transforms data into actionable insights supporting revenue optimization, script capture, inventory management, drug shortage control, and more. Quva’s overall progressive and integrated platform helps health\-systems transform pharmacy management to achieve greater value and deliver highest\-quality patient care. Quva is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating and maintaining a work environment that is free from all forms of discrimination and harassment. Quva's Equal Opportunity Policy prohibits harassment or discrimination due to age, ancestry, color, disability, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and any related medical conditions), sexual orientation, and any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable laws. All employment with Quva is “at will.” California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Notice for Applicants and Employees (https://onequva.com/california\-applicant\-employee\-privacy\-notice\-quva) Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Full time \| Remote\-friendly, NYC and New Orleans \| Reports to the CTO** ### **What is Rima** Rima's mission is to improve population health by giving people technology to make navigating their employer sponsored health plans easy. We see a world where it is possible to reduce the economic burden on employees and employers without sacrificing quality of care. This is both a moral imperative and a business opportunity. Rima is building an agentic navigation platform for self insured health plans to tackle the root cause underlying rising healthcare costs. We are empowering the individuals on which the entire system depends. We’re a small, fast\-moving team based in NYC and New Orleans. We are all in. ### **The Role** We're looking for a senior engineer to join the Platform team. Platform owns the core of Rima: the member experience, member management, the agent harness, the channels members reach it through, and the infrastructure underneath it all. A parent texts our agent at 9pm. Their son has a fever and the pediatrician is closed. Where should they go tonight, and what will it cost? Guiding them well depends on his coverage as a dependent, the family's deductible, and which urgent care and telehealth options their plan includes. It has to come together in seconds, from protected health data, and be right every time. That's the problem the Platform team exists to solve. At a larger company, each system you'll own would have its own team. Here it's yours: the architecture, the trade\-offs, and the results. You'll know these systems better than anyone and help decide where they go next. ### **Minimum qualifications** * You've built production software for 4\+ years, or built more in less time. We are impressed by results, not years and logos. * You've shipped complex, user\-facing systems end to end that you designed, from data model to API to UI. * You understand software design deeply. You model domains carefully, draw clean boundaries, plan for how things fail, and change systems without breaking what depends on them. * You've spent at least a year shipping production code mainly through coding agents, and you've built the tooling that keeps their output correct: rules, skills, tests, and evals. * You've built on regulated or sensitive data, with access control, audit trails, and least privilege designed in from the start. * You're an expert in TypeScript. * You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you can take a trade\-off from discussion to decision with an engineer, a designer, or a customer. ### **Nice to have** Bonus if you've: * Built LLM\-powered product features: agent tool design, context engineering, evals, guardrails, and trace interpretation. * Worked on multi\-tenant SaaS: tenancy, white\-labeling, and SSO (OIDC, SAML). * Used durable execution or workflow engines, such as Temporal, or built event\-driven systems. * Shipped across web, iOS, Android, browser extensions, and internal admin tooling. * Worked in healthcare, benefits, insurance, or payroll, including FHIR, EDI, or HL7\. * Built or maintained HIPAA\- or SOC 2\-compliant systems. ### **What you'll do** **Member experience and member management** * Build the features members expect from their health plan: insurance cards, claims, accumulators, dependents, and provider search. * Model benefits and entitlements precisely enough that a member reading the app and an agent answering a question reach the same correct answer. * Build member and company management for admins: onboarding, benefits configuration, and usage analytics. * Build internal admin tooling so our team can configure and support customers without an engineer. * Ship across web, iOS, Android, and our browser extension. * Work out requirements and trade\-offs with product and design before build. Talk to members and admins to see how the product actually gets used. **Agents and channels** * Build the features and data the member agent depends on, such as agent tools, entitlement data, and plan data, so it answers from what each member actually has. You'll work closely with the engineers who build the agent harness. * Build the channels the agent reaches members through, including web, mobile, SMS, Slack, Teams, and MCP clients, so it behaves the same in each one. * Add evals and tracing to the features you ship, so we know an answer is wrong before a member does. **Platform infrastructure and observability** * Own parts of our AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, and the pipeline from dev to production. * Strengthen observability: structured logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and incident response. * Treat security as architecture: PII minimization, envelope encryption with key rotation, least\-privilege access, purpose\-of\-use audit trails, and break\-glass workflows. **Developer tooling and practice** * Improve our developer tooling, including agent rules and skills, linting, CLI, and automated tests, so every engineer and agent ships faster and more safely. * Make good practice the default. When you find a better way to build, turn it into a rule, skill, or check so the whole team and every agent picks it up. * Bring consequential trade\-offs to the team early, with a recommendation. * Lead incident response for the systems you own. Our stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Hono, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Capacitor (web, iOS, Android), AWS with Terraform, Sentry, and Amplitude. ### **What success looks like in your first 90 days** * You own two or three platform systems. You know them better than anyone and are the first call when something goes wrong. * You've shipped at least one member\-facing feature end to end, from requirements through production monitoring. * You've closed one gap in observability, CI, or our developer tooling that makes the whole team faster. ### **How we work** * **Love and excellence.** We strive to win at the highest level and hold an extremely high bar, without losing the humanity that makes us who we are. * **High ownership.** You own problems end to end. No hand\-offs, no "not my problem." * **Crisp communication.** We say what we mean, raise problems early, and keep decisions easy to find. * **Fast iteration.** We ship in small batches, learn from members, and improve quickly. * **Results over process.** We care about what ships and how well it works, not how many meetings you attended. ### **Why work at Rima** * **Hard problems.** Health plans are complex, the data is regulated, and agents are capable, but new. You'll work where all three meet. * **Early in a category being reinvented.** Benefits navigation is being rebuilt around agents that reach members wherever they are. We're early, and you'll help shape what it becomes. * **Push agentic development forward.** We treat building software with agents as a system to engineer, and you'll help design it. * **Real impact, fast.** Our agents serve tens of thousands of members, and what you ship reaches them in days. * **Close to users.** You'll hear directly from the members and admins using what you built, not through layers of tickets. * **A team that pushes the tools.** Everyone here builds at the edge of what agents can do and shares what works. * **Competitive comp and benefits.** Base salary range $125,000\-$175,000, plus an equity package, flexible PTO, health insurance, dental, vision and more. Compensation Range: $125K \- $175K
