jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst
jobs.description: **Company Description** RRD is a leading global provider of marketing, packaging, print, and supply chain solutions that elevate engagement across the complete customer journey. The company offers the industry’s most trusted portfolio of creative execution and world\-wide business process consulting, with services designed to lower environmental impact. With 22,000 clients, including 93% of the Fortune 100, and 32,000 employees across 28 countries, RRD brings the expertise, execution, and scale designed to transform customer touchpoints into meaningful moments of impact. **Job Description** The Lead Data Analyst serves as a strategic advisor, guiding measurement strategies and translating data into innovative frameworks for cross\-channel success. This roles partners directly with clients to design, implement, and evolve marketing \& data analytics programs. It leads engagements that require integration of multi\-channel data, development of insights frameworks, and translates analytics into business outcomes across verticals. **Responsibilities:** * Partner with client leaders to co\-create marketing analytics strategies that support personalization, attribution, and media mix optimization. * Translate complex customer behavior data into scalable frameworks that inform future marketing innovation across channels. * Lead cross\-functional analytics initiatives and enterprise\-wide insights projects. * Represent analytics expertise in insight development, client consultations, strategic planning, and solution design. * Provide thought leadership across domains and mentor others in advanced analytics techniques. * Design and oversee strategic marketing science initiatives, including test frameworks, predictive modeling, and audience performance measurement. **Qualifications** **Education:** * 4 Year / Bachelors Degree In a quantitative field (Minimum) * Graduate Degree (Preferred) **Experience:** * 9 years experience in Advanced Marketing or Product Analytics roles * Industry experience: Business vertical experience in. Retail, Financial Services, Automotive , or CPG strongly preferred. * Programming \& Data Extraction: Expertise in Python and/or R. Strong SQL proficiency is mandatory; candidates must be able to read data models, write efficient queries, and independently extract data for analytic projects with limited assistance. * Statistical \& Modeling Acumen: Must possess a strong foundation in probability theory, as well as linear, logistic, and multinomial regression. Candidates must be able to develop custom models using modern machine learning ensembling techniques and software, as well as building custom solutions directly in R and Python. * S**pecialized Modeling: Must have experience building customer and/or store segmentation models. A forecasting background with the ability to build custom ARIMAX models, along with Marketing Mix and Multi\-Touch Attribution experience, is strongly preferred. Causal analysis experience is highly desirable.** * Market Research Knowledge: Foundational understanding of attitudinal research and segmentation approaches. Ideal candidates will have developed behavioral models predicting attitudinal segments. * **Generative AI: Comfortable using generative AI to develop code, conduct research, summarize methodology, and to develop client\-facing presentations.** **Interpersonal, Leadership \& Consulting Skills (Required)** * Communication \& Presentation: Strong communication and storytelling skills are an absolute must for this role. Candidates must be highly comfortable presenting to Executive\-level clients. * Consultative Problem\-Solving: Able to nimbly propose solutions to client problems. Although this is not a sales role, consultative selling skills are required for success. * Client Engagement: Strong active listening and documentation skills are required. The individual in this role must be able to identify solutions for clients that extend beyond their current request. * Leadership \& Autonomy: While this is an Individual Contributor role, the expectation is that the individual will be able to lead projects and oversee the work of more junior analysts. Must be highly resourceful, capable of developing relationships with Marketing Technologies/IT and Account Management, and able to independently develop solutions with minimal supervision. * Work Style: Thrives in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. Energized by new challenges with an optimistic outlook, resilient to changes, and nimble in shifting direction quickly as needed. **Advanced Technical Stack \& Tools (Flexible/Preferred)** * Cloud \& Database Platforms: Experience with modern cloud database solutions such as Snowflake, AWS, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, etc. Direct experience using Microsoft Fabric to build models for clients would be ideal. * Modern Data Stack: Strongly prefer experience with model development in a modern technology stack, specifically PySpark, Snowpark, and Pandas. * Data Architecture: Understanding of graph databases and NoSQL, alongside experience working with semi\-structured and unstructured data, is strongly desired. * Data Engineering \& MLOps: Azure DevOps, Git, or similar version control background is essential. Must have basic data engineering skills and be comfortable collaborating with data engineers to develop production processes. * Web Analytics Integration: Google Analytics and BigQuery experience. Candidates must know how to integrate customer engagement data into analytic and modeling projects. * Business Intelligence \& Visualization: Familiarity with Business Intelligence solutions such as Tableau, Power BI, SiSense, and other platforms. The ideal candidate would have some skill using these tools to generate data visualizations. **Additional Information** RRD's current salary range for this role is $107,000 to $171,2000 / year. The salary range may be adjusted based on the applicable geographic location of the hired employee, and the range may change in the future. At RRD, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions may vary based upon, but not limited to education, skills, experience, proficiency, performance, shift and location. Depending on the role, in addition to base salary, the total compensation package may also include participation in a bonus, commission or incentive program. RRD’s benefit offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, life insurance and other voluntary supplemental insurance coverages, plus parental leave, adoption assistance, tuition assistance and employer/partner discounts. \#LI\-MY1 \#LI\-Remote RRD is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans At RRD, we value innovation, authenticity, and integrity. To uphold the security and fairness of our hiring process, we ask that candidates refrain from using AI tools during interviews to ensure an authentic and secure experience. We appreciate your cooperation as we work to maintain a transparent and equitable hiring process. All employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of both a pre\-employment background and drug screen.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer (Enterprise & Training Systems) - Oak Ridge, TN
jobs.description: Company Overview RSI provides full\-service environmental and nuclear solutions supporting clients through all phases of cleanup, nuclear operations and security, and facility lifecycle management. Built on a strong foundation of collaboration and a people\-first culture, RSI delivers safe, technically sound solutions that help clients achieve mission success in some of the nation's most complex environments. RSI is part of the ASRC Industrial Services family of companies unified by purpose to deliver safe, reliable solutions to our clients’ unique challenges. We are committed to providing technically superior service, adding value at every stage, and leaving things better than we found them. Position Overview Detail\-oriented Full Stack Software Developer to join our development team. In this role, you will design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise\-level web applications, with a particular focus on our primary learning and training platforms. You will work across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) \- translating business needs into functional requirements, building database integrations, creating dynamic front\-end user interfaces, and ensuring the smooth delivery of digital learning assets. This position requires strong database development skills (specifically Oracle PL/SQL), web development expertise, and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) or training platforms. Roles \& Responsibilities Application Development \& Maintenance * Full\-Stack Engineering: Develop, test, and maintain enterprise web\-based applications (such as our LMS application) using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and back\-end languages like Java, Python, or C\#. * Database Development: Design, optimize, and maintain Oracle database structures. Write complex SQL queries and PL/SQL procedures to support application logic, retrieve data, and generate custom ad hoc reports. * Feature Enhancement: Design and implement new features, tools, and enhancements to expand application functionality, with a focus on administrative tools and interactive web\-based training resources. • Refactoring \& Optimization: Troubleshoot, debug, and refactor legacy code to improve system stability, response times, and overall user experience. System Integration \& Learning Management (LMS) * LMS Support: Provide technical support and operational guidance to the training and organizational development teams regarding LMS platforms and digital learning initiatives. • SCORM Compliance: Convert, package, and deploy educational materials and training courses into SCORM\-compliant formats for seamless integration and tracking within the company's LMS. * Cloud Integration: Assist in defining, directing, and executing implementations of Oracle Fusion Cloud Learning (OLC) features and associated modules. * Enterprise Integration: Contribute technical and functional support to large\-scale enterprise system integration projects. Requirements Gathering \& Collaboration * Business Analysis: Interface with end\-users and organizational stakeholders to gather, document, and translate business needs into technical specifications and software requirements. * Quality Assurance: Design and execute thorough test procedures to validate new features, security updates, and overall application changes. * Technical Support: Resolve Tier 2/3 application support issues, managing and tracking tickets through to resolution. * Standards Compliance: Review and revise digital materials, including presentations and documents, to ensure compliance with company brand guidelines, formatting requirements, and established directives. Experience Requirements Required Experience * Professional Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of professional experience in full stack software development, including the development, testing, and maintenance of enterprise\-level applications. * Database Proficiency: Hands\-on experience working with relational databases, specifically Oracle Database, including strong proficiency in PL/SQL, query optimization, and schema management. * Web Development: Proven experience with core web technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern development frameworks/libraries. * Tooling: Proficiency with development tools such as Git/Version Control, Visual Studio Code, and Oracle database tools (e.g., Toad for Oracle). Preferred Experience * LMS \& Training Systems: Direct experience administering or developing for Learning Management Systems (LMS) and deploying SCORM\-compliant training packages. * E\-Learning Authoring: Familiarity with e\-learning authoring tools such as iSpring or Articulate Storyline. * Cloud Solutions: Experience or exposure to Oracle Fusion Cloud Learning (OLC) or other enterprise cloud\-based ERP modules. * Multi\-Language Competency: Exposure to multiple programming paradigms (e.g., Java, Python, C\#, or PHP). Certifications (Preferred) * Industry\-recognized software development certifications (e.g., IT Specialist – Software Development or equivalent vendor\-specific certifications from Oracle, Microsoft, or AWS). Key Competencies * Analytical Thinking: Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex application and database issues. * Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders. * Adaptability: A motivated self\-starter who is eager to learn new technologies, platforms, and methodologies as business needs evolve. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Fullstack, Spend Controls
jobs.description: **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7\.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About the Role** ================== Great spend controls help businesses move quickly without losing control of their money. Ramp’s Spend Controls team builds the core capabilities behind Ramp’s most critical primitives, like budgets and cards,helping customers put spending policies into practice and understand how their money is being deployed. We’re looking for a fullstack engineer to build and improve these experiences, from the interfaces admins use to configure controls to the backend logic that makes them work reliably. You’ll build and own new features end to end, simplify complex spending workflows, and improve the quality of products customers depend on every day. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Build fullstack features to improve how customers manage the lifecycle of issued money, with clearer behavior and sensible defaults * Work with product, design, and engineering partners to turn customer needs into well\-scoped features and deliver them from technical design through launch and iteration * Build better visibility into spend and utilization, including configurable restrictions and sensible buffers, so that users can spend money easily, while transactions that shouldn’t happen are declined properly * Contribute to on\-call support, investigate production issues, and address recurring problems through testing and targeted quality improvements **What You’ll Need** -------------------- * Experience building and shipping production features across frontend interfaces and backend services * The ability to own a feature end to end, break down the work, design key components, and follow through on delivery * Sound judgment about data correctness, reliability, and keeping complex product behavior understandable * A customer\-focused approach to building software, with attention to usability and practical tradeoffs * Experience testing and debugging software, including investigating issues in production * Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working with product, design, and engineering teammates **Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Flexible PTO * Centralized home\-office equipment ordering * Health and wellness stipend * Budget for intra\-office travel * Weekly coffee stipend **United States** ----------------- * 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents * One Medical annual membership * 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp * Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay * Pet insurance * In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more * Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) **Canada** ---------- * Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life * Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage * Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) * Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay * Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health **United Kingdom** ------------------ * Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite * Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi * Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay **Referral Instructions** ------------------------- If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. **Other notices** ----------------- Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. *Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.* Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $172K \- $240K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Real Estate)
jobs.description: Overview: **Why this role** Real assets are among the largest asset classes in the world and among the least well served by software. Cherre already has the data layer that makes AI agents viable in this industry, which almost nobody else does. You would be among the first people turning that into something clients use every day, in a function you help define. Whether that means going deeper technically or eventually leading engagements is a choice you make later, not today. What the work actually looks like The future of real assets is agentic. Our clients feel this shift coming, but many struggle moving from pilot into production. That gap is the job: * A fund with 40 operating partners, each sending financials on a different chart of accounts. Agents build the mapping, maintain it as partners change their own books, and onboard the next partner as the business grows, without an analyst starting over every time. * An asset management team that answers the same portfolio questions every month by hand, out of four systems, into a deck. * An owner who wants to ask a plain\-English question about their portfolio and get an answer that is correct, from an agent that knows when it does not know. The interesting problems are rarely the model. They are entity resolution, messy source systems, workflows that exist only in someone's head, and the gap between an impressive demo and something a controller will sign off on. You will be hands on. You will also be the person in the room when a client explains their use case for the first time, and the person who decides what gets built to meet their objectives. Done is an agent reliable enough for production, handed off to whoever will run it, while you move on to their next problem. Responsibilities: **What you will do** * Embed with client teams. Map their data, decompose their processes, and define and prioritize the use cases worth building, including the parts of the workflow nobody documents. Translate those priorities into agentic solutions that create value for the business. * Architect and build. Design the approach, then build it: agent workflows, tool and data integrations, evaluation harnesses, and the plumbing connecting it to Cherre's platform. Business process becomes orchestration logic: triggers, tools, guardrails, and human checkpoints. * Own delivery end to end. From scoping through production and handoff to the teams who support it. Ship early, put it in front of real users, find out where it is wrong, and fix it. * Instrument everything you ship. Build for auditability, version control, and cost predictability. These clients operate under real financial and regulatory scrutiny, and "the agent decided" is not an acceptable answer. * Build for the second deployment while delivering the first. Decide what is worth making reusable, build it so the next client gets there faster, and feed recurring patterns back to product and engineering as templates and accelerators. * Deliver what was agreed. New use cases surface constantly. The good ones are the next engagement, not this week's extra work. * Help build the machine. As one of the first FDEs here, you will document how you work and help turn it into a process other engineers can run. How you work becomes how the function works. Qualifications: **What you bring** We care more about what you have done than how long you have been doing it. The experience range above is a guide, not a filter. * A record of shipping production systems inside someone else's environment, under someone else's constraints. You can walk us through one that broke, how you found out, and what you changed. * Strong hands\-on engineering, and you still want to write code. We are flexible on stack; Python, SQL, APIs, and comfort in messy data environments go a long way. * You have built with LLMs well beyond a prototype, and you have opinions about what is hard: evaluation, non\-determinism, context, tool design, and knowing when an agent is the wrong answer. * Judgment about where automation belongs and where a human stays in the loop. * Comfort sitting with business operators and turning how they describe their work into system design. You can hold both conversations in the same meeting: the technical tradeoff with their engineer, and the business outcome with their executive. * Fluency in real assets or financial operations: fund reporting, asset management, valuations, deal pipelines, investor reporting. You can follow a client conversation without a translator. * You work well when requirements arrive as a conversation instead of a ticket, and you know how to turn the first into the second. * 30% domestic travel **Bonus points** * Prior forward\-deployed, solutions architecture, or consulting\-adjacent engineering experience. * Experience with agentic orchestration and development tooling such as Claude Code, n8n, LangGraph, or Temporal. * Background in enterprise SaaS or data infrastructure serving regulated industries. * Early\-stage or 0 to 1 experience where you built the process as well as the product. ***SALARY AND BENEFITS*** RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:* Health, dental, and vision insurance. * Retirement savings plan with company match. * Paid time off and holidays. * Professional development opportunities. * Performance\-based bonus based on position. Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job\-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Pay Range: USD $129,400\.00 \- USD $220,400\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **ENGINEERING MANAGER** SAFEbuilt has the technical expertise to provide Community Development services, but the reason for our success is our people. Over 1,600 experts make up our team from across the country, with experience in a full range of professional services and skills. Each team member values integrity, improvement, service, teamwork, and respect. These Core Values are the foundation of positive relationships among coworkers, our clients, residents, and anyone invested in the continued success of their community. We are currently seeking a talented and experienced Engineering Manager to join our team of professionals in Georgia. This position offers an exciting opportunity to provide hands\-on municipal engineering services while helping expand and lead a growing team of engineering professionals. You'll support a variety of municipal public works projects through engineering inspections, plan reviews, design assistance, and technical reporting, while working alongside a highly respected team with the resources and support to keep you challenged. **JOB REQUIREMENTS** * Perform engineering inspections and construction observations for municipal public works and infrastructure projects. * Review engineering plans, specifications, construction documents, and supporting technical submittals for compliance with applicable codes, standards, and local requirements. * Provide design assistance and technical engineering support for municipal infrastructure and public works projects. * Support projects involving stormwater management, wastewater systems, drainage, roadway improvements, maintenance of traffic (MOT), and other municipal infrastructure improvements. * Prepare detailed inspection reports, technical evaluations, review comments, and project documentation. * Provide technical guidance and recommendations to municipal clients, contractors, engineers, and other project stakeholders. * Assist with evaluating construction activities to ensure work is consistent with approved plans, specifications, and applicable engineering standards. * Develop and maintain positive working relationships with municipal clients and serve as a technical resource for assigned projects. * Support the development and expansion of municipal engineering services throughout Georgia. * Build, manage, and mentor a team of engineering inspectors and plan review professionals as service demands grow. * Oversee team assignments, workload distribution, quality control, and service delivery to ensure client expectations are met. * Provide technical guidance, training, and professional development opportunities to team members. **SKILLS \& KNOWLEDGE** * Strong understanding of municipal engineering principles, public works operations, and infrastructure design and construction. * Knowledge of stormwater management, drainage systems, wastewater infrastructure, roadway improvements, and maintenance of traffic (MOT). * Ability to interpret and evaluate engineering plans, construction drawings, specifications, and technical reports. * Experience conducting field inspections and evaluating construction activities for compliance with approved plans and applicable standards. * Strong technical writing, documentation, and report preparation skills. * Ability to communicate technical information effectively to municipal officials, contractors, engineering professionals, and other stakeholders. * Strong organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. * Demonstrated ability to develop client relationships and provide responsive, professional customer service. * Leadership skills with the ability to mentor, motivate, and develop technical professionals. * Ability to work independently while collaborating with internal teams and external project partners. **EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. * Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred; Georgia PE licensure or the ability to obtain Georgia licensure is highly desirable. * Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in municipal engineering, public infrastructure, engineering inspections, plan review, or related engineering services. * Experience with municipal public works projects, including stormwater, wastewater, drainage, roadway improvements, or other infrastructure projects. * Previous experience performing engineering plan reviews, construction inspections, design assistance, or technical project support. * Prior supervisory or team leadership experience preferred, with the ability and interest to grow into a larger management role. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel locally to project sites and municipal client locations. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** SAFEbuilt pays competitive wages and has a comprehensive benefit offering. Benefits include health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid holidays, paid time off, matching 401K Plans, wellness programs and more. SAFEbuilt is committed to Career Progression through paid training and step increases for additional certifications and licenses. **More About SAFEbuilt:** http://safebuilt.com/ Our employees are our greatest asset, with exceptionally certified individuals in all departments, including Planning \& Zoning, Code Enforcement, Fire Prevention, and Engineering, as well as full\-service and supplemental Building Department services. SAFEbuilt invests in developing our employees, exploring innovative technology, and giving back to our communities. In partnership with over 1200 communities, our talented experts make a difference in the cities and towns where we live and work. Through quality people and consistent service, SAFEbuilt plays an important role in continually improving lives by developing safe, thriving communities. SAFEbuilt is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected factor. jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer, Early Career
jobs.description: **Region:** North America, all regions ### **The Role** SDVI’s backend engineers build the systems at the core of SDVI Rally. That starts with the distributed, microservice\-based platform that processes hundreds of thousands of hours of video content every month. It also includes products built on Rally itself to solve use cases many customers share, and a more data\-driven next generation of Rally. This role is for someone early in their career, joining a team that works AI\-first. You’ll help build the agent\-driven tooling and process we use to create reusable Rally supply chains that solve common customer use cases, and push how much of that work AI agents can take on. You’ll work with senior engineers, take well\-defined pieces of work from design to production, and grow toward owning part of that system yourself. ### **What You’ll Work On** * Build and maintain python backend services with guidance from senior engineers * Help build the agent\-driven tooling, pipelines, and checks we use to create reusable Rally supply chains * Work with AI coding agents every day, and help the team find where agents can take on more of the work and where a person still needs to decide * Write and optimize database queries and REST APIs * Establish trust in your work with effective development\-loop tests * Take part in code reviews, and ask questions to learn the codebase and the technologies behind it * Work with customers and customer\-facing teams to understand the use cases behind your work * Take part in design discussions, and apply the feedback you get on your own designs ### **What Success Looks Like** * **First 90 days.** You’ve shipped production changes with guidance, use AI agents as a normal part of how you deliver, can find your way around the code you work in, and take part in code reviews. * **First year.** You own part of the tooling we use to create reusable supply chains, deliver changes from design to production with little guidance, and have helped change how the team uses AI to ship. ### **What You’ll Bring** * Curiosity about new systems and technologies, and the habit of reading the docs and code before asking, then asking good questions * Clear, accurate communication about your work, and honesty about what you don’t know yet * Some experience building backend software in a mainstream server\-side language, from work, internships, or your own projects. We mostly use Python, but value being able to read and understand many languages over fluency in any one. If your strongest language is something else, you should be able to read Python and understand it thoroughly. * A working understanding of REST APIs and relational databases * Experience writing automated tests for your own code * Hands\-on experience building software with AI coding agents, interest in pushing how far they can go, and the habit of checking what they produce ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with FastAPI, Flask, SQLAlchemy, or PostgreSQL * Experience with Docker and containerized deployments * Experience with a mainstream cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure * Exposure to distributed systems or data pipelines * Familiarity with professional media formats, such as codecs, container formats, and metadata, and how media supply chains use them If you don’t meet every point above, we’d still like to hear from you. ### **How We Work** * **We’re small and distributed.** Most of our collaboration happens over Slack and Zoom, across time zones. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll work closely with people outside your immediate team. * **Engineers stay close to customers.** You’ll hear directly from the people using what you build. When something goes wrong in production, the team that owns the code helps fix it. * **We dig for root causes.** When something breaks, we find out why instead of patching the symptom and moving on. * **We ship, then refine.** We work in short sprints and improve things over time instead of waiting for a perfect first version. ### **How We Use AI** AI coding agents are part of how we work every day, and we invest in getting good at using them. We’re also careful with them, because customers run their content operations on Rally. We’re tracking industry trends and innovations, but using our day\-to\-day experiences to separate signal from noise. Our engineers are still responsible for the code they ship. We still expect them to explain and defend its architecture and intent, even as more is built with an agent’s help. We judge work by its quality, not its quantity. This role is not a fit for someone who would rather not use AI tools, or who is used to shipping generated changes they couldn’t explain. It probably is a fit for someone who knows where these tools go wrong and how to achieve quality with speed. ### **Logistics** * This is a remote role, open to candidates across the United States * Occasional travel may be required, but is not core to this role * Interview process: introductory call, AI proficiency interview, team technical interview, interview project, interview project presentation, and founders interview ### **Compensation and Benefits** *Salary range $90,000 to $145,000* *Salary range represents the expected range for this position and is based on a number of factors, including location, and* *will* *vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges are US\-applicable only.* ### **You Should Be Interested in SDVI Because:** * You are looking for your next big challenge * You are looking for a company that welcomes your talent virtually * You want teammates you can learn from, and who will learn from you * You want to be part of a team that respects individuals and their work * You consider the big picture and your contribution to it SDVI offers a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salary, medical, vision, dental, 401(k) match, and stock options in a stimulating and rewarding distributed work environment. SDVI is committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusivity in our workforce. We maintain a courteous work environment that recognizes the dignity and worth of each employee. SDVI respects the individual needs of employees and is an equal\-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Power Platform Developer & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Roberts Sinto Corporation, in Grand Ledge MI is part of the Sinto America Group of companies, the North American subsidiary of Sintokogio, Ltd., a worldwide family of companies with a global reputation for excellence in the manufacturing industry. Sinto America offers innovative, top\-class solutions to meet the needs of our customers and industries, with operating companies dedicated to providing superior customer service through practical, cost effective and technologically advanced equipment and service solutions across North America. Sinto America is comprised of seven primary segments, including Foundry Mold and Core Making, Sand Processing, Bulk Material Handling, Automation, 3D Ceramic Printing, Surface Treatment, and Surface Technologies. Roberts Sinto Corporation is a leading company in the design and manufacture for foundry, surface treatment and material handling markets. Founded over 50 years ago, Roberts Sinto began as an engineering and manufacturing firm with an emphasis on equipment for the foundry industry. As the industries have evolved, Roberts Sinto has developed and refined its capabilities to offer a broad range of services and equipment for all industrial applications. **Roberts Sinto is currently seeking a Power Platform Developer \& Automation Engineer to join our Team in Grand Ledge, MI** Sinto America is looking for a builder and systems thinker who can turn Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and AI/Copilot from scattered experiments into deployed, measurable efficiency gains across our entire organization. Across Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, HR, and Sales, critical daily operations still rely heavily on manual email triage, disconnected Excel trackers, static PDFs, and repetitive data entry between our ERP, CRM, and local files. Your mission is to eliminate these manual bottlenecks—replacing fragile spreadsheets and copy\-paste routines with connected, intelligent workflows that free our teams to focus on high\-value work. **General** * Productionize High\-Impact Workflows: Transition prototypes, manual spreadsheet processes, and one\-off scripts into resilient, enterprise\-grade solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, Power Pages, and Dataverse. * Extend Automation with AI \& Copilot: Design and deploy intelligent solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and Azure AI/OpenAI services to handle unstructured data—such as extracting data from PDFs/invoices, triaging emails, and automating complex document workflows where traditional rule\-based automation falls short. * Build Reusable Platform Patterns: Architect standardized templates for document extraction, multi\-stage approvals, CRM/ERP data syncing, and reporting so a solution built for one department can be rapidly deployed across others. * Drive External Product Innovation: Partner with After\-Sales and Engineering to build and scale customer\-facing solutions, including our planned spare\-parts portal integrated directly with live ERP inventory and pricing. * Own Governance \& Architecture: Establish Center of Excellence (CoE) best practices for the M365 ecosystem, including DLP policies, environment management (Dev/Test/Prod), API connectors, and data governance to prevent departmental silos and shadow IT. **What We Want From You** * Power Platform Mastery: 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and deploying production solutions across Power Automate (cloud and desktop flows), Power Apps (Canvas and Model\-Driven), Power Pages, Power BI, and Dataverse. * Applied AI Experience: Proven ability to integrate Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or Azure OpenAI / Document Intelligence into business workflows to process unstructured documents, emails, and natural\-language queries. * Integration \& Data Skills: Strong working knowledge of REST APIs, custom connectors, JSON, SQL, SharePoint Online, and integrating M365 with enterprise ERP and CRM systems. * Scripting Savvy: Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, or VBA/Office Scripts to understand, refactor, and migrate legacy one\-off scripts into maintainable platform workflows. * Business Acumen: A consultative mindset—able to sit with a Finance analyst, Manufacturing engineer, or After\-Sales specialist, map their manual bottlenecks, and deliver a tool they actually enjoy using. **The Benefits of Joining Our Team** Because we seek to hire the best people, we work hard to provide benefits that make their lives better, so we offer a comprehensive benefit program, which features: * Health coverage for Medical, Dental and Vision plans * 401(k) plan in with a generous company match and profit sharing * Financial protection through short term and long term disability, life insurance up to $50k of an employee’s base salary, and accidental death \& dismemberment insurance plans, at 100% company cost * Tax advantages through flexible spending accounts that allow you to pay for specific health\-care and dependent care expenses with pre\-tax dollars * Generous paid time off program in which the benefits increase along with your tenure with the company, as well as paid sick time * 100% company paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP), which covers family and marriage counseling, addiction counseling, will prep and financial support. * Tuition reimbursement. When you join our team, you do more than simply switch companies to progress your career. You become part of our family, a group of talented individuals who drive business success. **Learn More About Us** https://sintoamerica.com/companies/roberts\-sinto\-corporation/

jobs.title: CAD Systems Administrator
jobs.description: **Help Drive Technology and Innovation at Soltesz** Soltesz is seeking a skilled and motivated **CAD Systems Administrator** to support, maintain, and enhance our Bentley MicroStation and OpenRoads design environment across multiple Maryland offices. This role is ideal for a technology\-focused professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, improving workflows, and helping design teams maximize productivity and efficiency. As a key member of our team, you'll work closely with engineers, project managers, CAD professionals, and IT staff to ensure our design technology platforms remain efficient, consistent, and aligned with industry best practices. **What You'll Do** **CAD Systems Administration** * Administer, configure, and maintain Bentley MicroStation and OpenRoads Designer environments * Manage workspaces, standards, user configurations, and workspace customizations * Maintain cell libraries, feature definitions, templates, and related CAD standards * Implement software updates, patches, and version control within Bentley CONNECT environments * Support integration with ProjectWise and other Bentley applications, where applicable * Assist with software licensing, deployment, and system compliance initiatives **Technical Support \& Training** * Troubleshoot software issues, performance concerns, and user\-reported problems * Provide day\-to\-day support for engineering and production staff * Develop documentation, standards, and training materials * Lead onboarding, training sessions, and one\-on\-one coaching to improve user proficiency * Promote best practices and consistency across project teams and office locations **Process Improvement** * Partner with engineering teams to streamline production workflows and improve deliverable quality * Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through standards, automation, and improved processes * Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends to support continuous improvement * Help establish and maintain firmwide CAD standards and procedures **What You'll Bring** * Minimum two years of hands\-on experience administering Bentley MicroStation and/or OpenRoads Designer environments or supporting advanced production workflows * Strong understanding of workspace configuration, feature definitions, standards management, and template development * Experience with Bentley CONNECT applications; ProjectWise experience is a plus * Familiarity with civil engineering, transportation, land development, or infrastructure project workflows * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities * Excellent communication and customer\-service skills * Ability to effectively support multidisciplinary teams across multiple offices * Experience with VBA, PowerShell, Python, or other automation tools is a plus * Knowledge of DOT standards and CAD best practices is preferred **Why Join Soltesz?** At Soltesz, technology plays a critical role in delivering successful projects for our clients. We offer: * Competitive compensation * Comprehensive health and dental benefits * 401(k) retirement plan * Family\-friendly work environment * Professional development opportunities * Exposure to diverse civil engineering, land development, and infrastructure projects * Opportunities to influence technology strategy and standards across the firm **Please note:** This is a 100% in\-office position supporting multiple Maryland office locations. *Soltesz is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

results, support trends, and usage data (such as user journeys in Datadog) to show the product team what needs to change and where root causes lie * Document known fixes and testing practices in the team wiki * Complete other responsibilities as assigned **Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:** * B.S. in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience * 7\+ years of software QA experience * Hands\-on experience designing and building test automation, not only maintaining existing frameworks * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, and a track record of learning new ones * Experience making code changes in an existing codebase * Practical experience using AI\-assisted development or testing tools * Experience testing software applications, identifying bugs, and validating features against product requirements * Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, and Git * Experience providing software support, including triage and troubleshooting * Clear, concise communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, such as software engineering, field, and business leadership **Preferred Skills:** * Evidence of solving complex technical problems end to end * A track record of learning new technologies, domains, and languages, and growing in scope over your career * Experience building tools or systems from scratch where none existed * Experience testing data pipelines, analytics, or systems whose expected results change over time * Critical thinking about how systems fail: finding root causes, not just symptoms * Autonomy within a lean, fast\-paced team *Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.* ***SOLV Energy Is an Equal Opportunity Employer*** *At jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI models behind our diagnostic platform. You'll work on modern, large\-scale machine learning for health, turning large, messy, real\-world datasets into models that carry real clinical signal. You'll join a team of AI engineers who care about doing this the right way. We're looking for someone who brings current knowledge of the field, whether from graduate research or hands\-on work, and who pushes the team to approach problems from a modern AI perspective. We want someone who understands why methods work, not someone who can only run a tutorial notebook on an off\-the\-shelf model. Together you'll assemble and curate large datasets, train and evaluate models, and show whether they carry real clinical signal. Learning goes both ways here. You'll work alongside experienced AI engineers who review your code and talk through your results, and we expect you to teach them what's new. The work is hands\-on from week one. Over time you'll own larger pieces of the pipeline, from data to deployed model. ### **Responsibilities** * Train and evaluate modern deep learning models on large datasets, including self\-supervised approaches and fine\-tuning of large pretrained models. * Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed them: collecting, cleaning, deduplicating, and versioning large video datasets. * Develop ways to learn from noisy or limited labels, and measure how much real signal the models carry. * Run experiments carefully: track runs, make results reproducible, and write up what you found, including negative results. * Design evaluations that reflect real\-world use, and show clearly where offline metrics and product performance diverge. * Support our existing computer vision work as models move toward production. * Write clean, tested, well\-documented Python that teammates can pick up and reuse. * Take part in code review and technical discussions, and explain your results to both technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Stay on top of current AI research. Reproduce promising methods, propose experiments, and teach the team what you learn. * Pitch in on whatever the team needs. We're small, and everyone does a bit of everything. ### **About Senseye** Senseye is a NeuroTechnology company based in Austin, TX, on the cusp of revolutionizing mental health. We're developing the world's first objective mental health diagnostics platform, measuring cognitive activity through the eye using mobile devices. Our initial diagnostic for PTSD is entering clinical trials, with additional indications for anxiety and depression to follow. We're a team of scientists, engineers, and clinicians building technology that could redefine how mental health is understood and treated. **Requirements** * Master's degree or PhD in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience showing comparable machine learning skills, such as several years of applied ML work or substantial published or open\-source work. * Recent graduates are welcome. Up to about 3 years of hands\-on ML experience, including graduate research, a thesis, internships, and industry work, is a plus. * Solid Python and experience with at least one deep learning framework. * A working grasp of ML fundamentals: training and validation, overfitting, evaluation metrics, and why a good test score isn't the same as a working product. * Hands\-on experience with modern deep learning beyond off\-the\-shelf use. You've trained or substantially adapted models yourself and can explain your design choices and the tradeoffs. * Comfort with Git, the command line, and working on a shared codebase. * Clear writing and communication. You can explain a result or a plot simply and say what you're unsure of. * Curiosity and the habit of digging in when something looks off, in the data or in your own code. ### **Extra Points** None of these are required. * Hands\-on experience with self\-supervised, contrastive, or masked\-modeling methods. * Experience with large\-scale training: multi\-GPU runs or experiment tracking such as Weights \& Biases. * Experience with video, time\-series, or sensor data. * Experience with noisy\-label learning or semi\-supervised methods. * A paper, open\-source contribution, or substantial personal project you can show us. * Exposure to healthcare, medical device software, or other regulated settings. **Benefits** * Flexible schedule and flexible paid time off * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Short\- and long\-term disability and life insurance * 401(k) * Continuing education opportunities * Health and Wellness stipend * Fully stocked kitchen and a flexible hybrid environment * The freedom and trust to shape your role as we design, build, and ship our products

You’ll contribute to an innovative, multifaceted culture that is second to none — one that embraces collaboration, excellence, discovery and compassion. You’ll play a role in something that’s never been done before as we integrate science and clinical care to help patients achieve better, faster outcomes — as we Advance Human Ability, together. **Job Description Summary** General Summary The Data Engineer is a member of the Data Platform Engineering team, working in a dynamic cross\-functional environment to assist in developing the strategic direction and the meaningful use of data within the organization for our next generation data platform to provide a full and self\-service environment for clinicians, researchers, administrators and executives. Assists with development or selection of data models to be implemented in support of clinical, quality improvement, and research objectives. Creates ETL pipelines for data to and from various cloud and local sources consistent with existing data models. Adapts database systems and architecture as necessary to meet the operational, analytical, and reporting needs of the organization. The Data Engineer will consistently demonstrate support of the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab statement of Vision, Mission and Core Values by striving for excellence, contributing to the team efforts and showing respect and compassion for patients and their families, fellow employees, and all others with whom there is contact at or in the interest of the institute. The Data Engineer will demonstrate Shirley Ryan AbilityLab Core Attributes: Communication, Accountability, Flexibility/Adaptability, Judgment/Problem Solving, Customer Service and Core Values (Hope, Compassion, Discovery, Collaboration, \& Commitment to Excellence) while fulfilling job duties.**Job Description** **The Data Engineer will:** * Collaborate within the Data Platform Engineering team, Data Analytics and Data Governance teams, other Information Services (IS) teams, executive leadership, external consultants, and stakeholders from various departments within the hospital to: * Primarily utilizing existing resources, assist in developing secure, stable, scalable long\-term plans for the flow of the hospital’s data. * Assist in the development of scalable data infrastructure and platforms to collect and process large amounts of data, including structured and unstructured data for analysis by clinical, research, and business resources. Data sources may be internally (locally) or externally (cloud) sourced, both data owned by the organization and external to the organization from partners and vendors. * Establish methods and procedures for tracking data quality, completeness, redundancy, compliance and improvement along with related system operational performance. * Create strategies and plans for data capacity planning, data security, life cycle data management, scalability, backup and archiving. * Create the mapping of data sources, data movement, interfaces, and analytics, with the goal of ensuring data quality and accurate downstream delivery and reporting. * Define standards for engineering and architecture including naming, describing, managing, modeling, cleaning, enriching, transforming, transferring, data systems for performance and reliability. * Develop processes to support the deployment of high quality, flexible, and secure data management solutions * Leverage available tools to drive Automation of key data management processes * Create instrumentation and metrics to ensure ecosystem health \& ensure continuous improvement of KPI’s **Reporting Relationships** * Reports directly to jobs.title: Staff/Senior Analytics Engineer, Data Science & Analytics (DSA)
jobs.description: Simbe Robotics is a leading retail robotics company providing in\-store intelligence solutions that help retailers optimize operations, improve shelf execution, and deliver valuable data insights. forward with minimal oversight * **Apply AI tooling to accelerate work** — leverage LLMs, agents, and other AI\-assisted workflows to increase the speed and quality of analysis and development * clients * **Raise analytical standards** — establish best practices for reproducibility, documentation, and code quality across the team's data science and analytics work * **Build conversational data experiences** — design and prototype AI agent or chatbot interfaces that allow internal or external users to query and explore retail data through natural language *(nice to have)* ### **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in analytics engineering or a closely related role, with demonstrable delivery of production features * Experience with dbt for data transformation and Kimball Dimensional modeling: writing models, tests, and documentation as part of a production analytics engineering workflow * Solid SQL and experience working with large\-scale cloud data platforms (GCP/BigQuery preferred) * Experience owning the full lifecycle of analytics features: scoping, building, shipping, and maintaining * Proven ability to work across functions: you've partnered with Engineering, Product, or Commercial teams and know how to communicate tradeoffs and drive alignment * Retail industry experience strongly preferred (store operations, inventory, merchandising, supply chain, or equivalent) * Hands\-on experience using AI tools (LLM APIs, coding assistants, prompt engineering) to accelerate analytical work ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with, pipeline orchestration (Airflow or similar), model monitoring, CI/CD for analytical workflows * Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or similar) for communicating findings to billions of shelf observations, a genuinely rich and challenging domain The base salary offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job We believe the full package, including ownership through equity and well\-being support, is what drives engagement, retention, and alignment with our mission. At Simbe, you will be at the forefront of retail innovation, working with cutting\-edge AI and robotics technologies to transform retail operations. Our culture is dynamic, inclusive, and driven by a passion for improving the way retailers operate and serve their customers. Join us to be a part of a team that is not only reshaping the future of retail but also offering immense value to our clients worldwide. Simbe Values: R. E. T. A. I. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, New Product Initiatives
jobs.description: #### **About Us** At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice. More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry\-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients. Award\-winning and people\-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider. #### **The Role** As an Engineering Manager for New Product Initiatives, you will lead and empower a high\-performing engineering squad dedicated to building transformational, AI\-powered solutions for practitioners and clinical customers on the frontline of care delivery. In this role, you will redefine how clinicians manage their practice—from seamless homepage experiences to intelligent automation workflows—offloading the operational pressures of running a business so practitioners can focus on taking care of patients and clinic needs. You will champion deep personalization and customizable tooling that goes far beyond simple add\-ons, turning complex clinical and administrative demands into intuitive, reliable software. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role rooted in product thinking, customer empathy, and modern engineering practices. Beyond pure execution, you will apply strategic human judgment to architect deep, end\-to\-end customer solutions. Working in an AI\-forward culture, you will guide your squad in shipping production\-grade AI features while actively utilizing cutting\-edge AI developer tools (such as Cursor and Claude Code) to compound delivery velocity, elevate code quality, and inspire continuous innovation across the team. #### **Responsibilities** * Leadership \& People Management: Lead, mentor, and grow a squad of software engineers, building a high\-trust culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning while guiding individual career development. * Customer\-Centric Practice Automation: Drive technical strategy for key practitioner touchpoints—including homepage experience, core workflows, and business automation—to relieve operational friction for clinical customers managing practice needs. * Ship Production AI \& Deep Customization: Architect and deliver production\-grade AI features and highly customizable workflow tools that offer tailored value to clinicians beyond surface\-level add\-ons. * AI\-Assisted Engineering Leadership: Champion the squad's hands\-on adoption of frontier AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate release cycles, elevate software craft, and optimize development rhythms. * Full\-Stack Architectural Ownership: Own architectural decisions across the full stack—from data models, relational database schemas, and caching mechanisms to secure APIs and responsive front\-end interfaces. * Product Thinking \& Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Product, Design, and Clinical stakeholders to discover and prioritize impactful customer solutions, prioritizing holistic product thinking over pure task execution. * Clinical Quality \& Compliance: Champion clean, testable, and maintainable software while ensuring solutions adhere to healthcare data security, privacy, and regulatory standards (HIPAA/HITRUST). * Anticipate Roadblocks: See around corners to proactively identify cross\-pillar dependencies, resourcing constraints, and system bottlenecks before they impact delivery. #### **Desired Skills \& Experience** * 7\+ years of experience delivering high\-quality software products as a software engineer. * 3\+ years managing and mentoring software engineers, with direct ownership over hiring, team performance, and technical strategy. * Proven track record of taking zero\-to\-one initiatives from concept to production in fast\-paced SaaS, HealthTech, or complex digital product environments. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong foundational background in modern web application development and frameworks (Ruby on Rails preferred, not required). * Solid grasp of relational databases, data modeling, SQL optimization, and caching strategies. * Hands\-on experience architecting and shipping user\-facing AI/ML features (e.g., LLM orchestration, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or model inference pipelines). * Deep fluency with modern AI developer tooling (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and the practical ability to guide a team in using AI to write, test, refactor, and review code. * Proficiency with modern CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based workflows, release management, and testing frameworks. * Working familiarity with healthcare security, compliance frameworks (e.g., HIPAA), and handling protected health information (PHI). * Hands\-on technical leadership: comfortable evaluating architecture, participating in system design reviews, and getting into the code when needed. * Strong product and customer instincts with the ability to bridge customer empathy (understanding clinician workflows) with technical feasibility. * Excellent technical writing, communication, and stakeholder management skills; capable of aligning cross\-functional partners through ambiguity. * Pragmatic decision\-maker adept at managing technical debt, sequencing milestones, and maintaining delivery velocity. * Continuous curiosity and enthusiasm for frontier AI technologies and evolving software patterns. #### **Bonus Points** * Along with your application, share a link or write\-up of something you built or shipped using AI: a working prototype, an internal workflow, an agent, or a feature built with AI developer tooling. * Include a sentence or two on what you made, which models/tools you used (e.g., Claude, Cursor, OpenAI), and what you learned from the process. Examples of fraudulent domains include careers\-simplepractice.com, simplepractices.com, and simplepractice.careers. jobs.description: **General Information** ----------------------- Locations * Austin, TX * Chicago, IL * Cleveland, OH * Columbus, OH * Dallas, TX * Detroit, MI * Houston, TX * Kansas City, MO * Minneapolis, MN * Nashville, TN * St. Louis, MO Business Function Product engineering Date posted Friday, November 13, 2026 Ref \# 319 **Description and Requirements** -------------------------------- Job Description **Who You’ll Work With** The Cloud\-Build's Software Engineering discipline within Slalom co\-creates custom software, data, and cloud products with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We're passionate about technology, compelled by its potential as we help create the digital products, experiences, and technology\-driven organizations that drive true change. We’re thrilled by the opportunity to build the future we want to see, with anyone willing to join us. The Software Engineering discipline brings our clients’ vision to life! We use modern tools and techniques (including GenAI tools and copilots) to build secure, highly scalable software products that handle our clients' most innovative and strategic work. We follow Agile practices when building software components and applications that utilize modern frameworks and cloud scale in order to accelerate our clients' business. Our software engineers are committed to the craft of collaboratively building high\-quality and sustainable software products that delight our clients and their customers by taking advantage of emerging tools in an ever\-changing technological landscape. We build full\-stack solutions across a range of established and emerging technologies and techniques according to the needs of our clients including: * Front end applications targeting native mobile and modern web platforms. Examples include React, Angular and Vue. * APIs and back\-end services built using emerging frameworks and architectural patterns. Examples include Node, Typescript, Java and .Net. * Hosting, Generative AI, and application services provided by industry leading cloud providers. Examples include AWS, Azure and GCP. * Operational efficiencies leveraging modern ecosystems and automated build and deployment pipelines. * Collaborative build practices, including Generative AI tooling, that allow our teams to be agile and responsive to our clients’ needs. **Mission** As a Software Architect, you will contribute to the architecture of client solutions while advancing AI\-empowered software development. We value diverse perspectives and experiences that can foster innovation and drive success in building with generative AI, leading the organization towards cutting\-edge advancements. **Who you’ll work with** You'll join a collaborative product team, comprised of engineers, product leaders, designers, and data practitioners from diverse backgrounds. We co\-create modern software with our customers, embracing collective creativity and inclusive practices. Together, we transition from discovery to delivery, pairing on code, pressure\-testing ideas with real users, and transforming learnings into ship\-ready increments. You'll work closely with customer stakeholders and field teams to integrate outside\-in insights into the roadmap and aid clients in adopting sustainable practices and tools post\-launch. Think craft\-guided Builders who care about outcomes, not just output. **What you’ll do** * Redefine the AI\-first SDLC: Design flows, patterns, and guardrails that integrate generative AI from ideation through operations. * Guild with context engineering: Apply and guide strategies like prompt templating, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation, and data grounding to ensure AI\-guided development is accurate, reliable, and safe. * Manage GenAI\-aligned teams: Orchestrate multi\-developer environments where AI agents and engineers work side by side, ensuring productivity, quality, and responsible adoption. * Ship AI\-enabled platforms: Build and codify repeatable practices such as evaluation harnesses, code\-review agents, context packs, and CI/CD hooks. * Stay hands\-on: Own product architecture while prototyping and hardening AI\-driven solutions using modern DevOps and observability practices. * Enable and transform: Coach teams and client stakeholders on AI\-accelerated ways of working; translate complex AI concepts into clear business outcomes. **What you’ll bring** * Experience: You should have significant experience (typically 6\+ years) in building and operating production software. Leadership skills in system or platform architecture would be an asset. We welcome applicants with non\-traditional career paths or equivalent skills gained through various experiences. * Hands\-on AI\-accelerated development: Daily use of agentic IDEs and advanced tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) beyond basic chat interfaces. * Proven track record with GenAI integration: Experience delivering solutions where multiple developers collaborated with generative AI and AI agents using context engineering strategies. * Architecture expertise: Deep knowledge of APIs, microservices, eventing, reliability, and security. * Programming skills: Proficiency in languages like TypeScript/Node, Python, or Java; comfort with React/Next and modern frameworks. * Cloud \& DevOps: Strong background with AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, and production observability. * Leadership \& communication: Ability to guide teams, mentor engineers, and articulate value to both technical and business audiences. **Bonus Skills** * AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases, or model routing experience. * MLOps, AI governance, or safety practices. * Contributions to open source or thought leadership in AI\-accelerated engineering. **Application Deadline:** We will accept applications until the position is filled. **About Us** Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always.
