jobs.title: Compliance Engineer
jobs.description: **Compliance Engineer** BUSINESS GROUP/DEPT: Engineering FLSA: Exempt REPORTS TO: Engineering Manager DATE: October 2026 **Purpose of the Role** ----------------------- The Compliance Engineer owns regulatory compliance across SVL's product portfolio. This role sets product compliance strategy and works with engineering and other functions to ensure new and existing products meet applicable safety, EMC, environmental, and market\-access requirements. The role also maintains the documentation and certifications that support those claims. **Essential Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------------- **New Product Development** * Define applicable compliance requirements and certification plans for new products and target markets. * Participate in concept, schematic, PCB, mechanical, firmware, and design reviews to identify risks early and translate standards into practical design requirements. **Existing Product Compliance** * Maintain compliance of released products and assess whether product, component, supplier, material, firmware, or design changes affect certifications or required testing. * Support customer, vendor and distributor compliance inquiries and required documentation. **Testing and Certification / Supplier and External Agency Management** * Plan and coordinate pre\-compliance testing, formal testing, certifications, and renewals. * Oversee quarterly UL factory inspections, including audit preparation, responses, and corrective actions. * Lead root\-cause and corrective\-action efforts when testing identifies a compliance failure. * Serve as the technical liaison with certification bodies (UL, TUV, Intertek or equivalent) test laboratories, certification bodies, and suppliers. * Use technical judgment and negotiation skills to clarify requirements and achieve compliant outcomes while managing cost and schedule impact. **Standards Management** * Serve as SVL’s subject matter expert for product safety, EMC, photobiological safety, environmental, and market\-access requirements across North American, European, and Asian markets. * Monitor changes to standards and regulations, assess the impact on current products, and communicate required actions. * Collect and validate supplier declarations and supporting documentation to assess component and material compliance. * Manage materials\-compliance requirements, including RoHS, REACH, PFAS, EU POPs, TSCA, conflict minerals, and California Proposition 65\. **Documentation and Records** * Prepare and maintain technical files, Declarations of Conformity, risk assessments, test records, certificates, and supporting documentation in a manner that supports audits and market surveillance requests. * Negotiate documentation and evidence requirements with certification bodies when needed. * Implement and maintain a product compliance database that provides controlled access to compliance documentation, certifications, test records, product decisions, and renewal status. **Qualifications** ------------------ ***Required*** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent education and experience. * 3\+ years of product regulatory compliance experience with electrical or electronic products, including certification projects. * Demonstrated ability to interpret standards and convert requirements into engineering actions. * Ability to evaluate electrical schematics, PCB documentation, bills of materials, mechanical drawings, specifications, and test reports. * Strong organization, project management, technical writing, communication, and negotiation skills. ***Preferred*** * Familiarity with international market access requirements in North America, EU and Asia. (UL, CE, KC, CCC, NOM, BIS) * Experience with LED, optical, or photonic products and IEC 62471 photobiological safety. * Hands\-on EMC pre\-compliance testing and experience translating failures into electrical, PCB, or mechanical design recommendations. * Experience with materials\-compliance programs such as RoHS, REACH, PFAS, TSCA, Prop 65, and conflict minerals. * Experience with compliance systems such as Assent, GreenSoft, or comparable platforms; global market access; and ISO 9001\. **Key Competencies** -------------------- * Standards interpretation and technical judgment * Planning, organization, and follow\-through * Practical problem solving and cross\-functional influence * Negotiation and external\-agency management * Risk identification and clear escalation **Physical Requirements and Work Environment** ---------------------------------------------- Primarily office\-based with regular time in engineering lab and production areas. Occasional travel to test laboratories and supplier sites. Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and handle test equipment and product assemblies.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Socure?** --------------- Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. **About the Role** ================== Socure is building the future of trust for digital ecosystems. To accelerate our mission, we are expanding the platform to include agentic workflows and internal productivity tools that power innovation across the company. These systems will underpin how Socure builds, deploys, and scales AI\-driven identity solutions while enabling internal teams to operate with speed, intelligence, and precision. Reporting to the Head of New Product Engineering, you'll join a new Internal AI Engineering team with a mandate to design and ship the agentic systems that reshape how Socure operates across sales, marketing, revenue ops, finance, talent, and legal. As a Staff AI Engineer on this team, you'll define *what* to build \- not just execute what's been scoped. You'll be the first major internal partner building on Socure's Agentic AI Foundations platform \- using its primitives to ship faster and providing the real\-world pull\-through that shapes its roadmap. By delivering intelligent automation and agentic workflows you will play a central role in Socure's transformation into an AI\-native company, driving step\-function gains in efficiency, accuracy, and decision\-making across the enterprise. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Prioritization of High\-Impact Automation** \- Partner with business teams (e.g., Revenue Ops, Marketing, Finance Ops, Talent Acquisition) to catalog manual, high\-frequency workflows and rank them by impact, feasibility, and urgency. * **Production Agent Design \& Development** \- Build multi\-step, tool\-augmented agent workflows that can plan, execute, observe outcomes, and iteratively improve. Design and implement planner–executor and reflection\-based architectures to enhance reasoning quality and task reliability. Develop stateful agent systems and incorporate human\-in\-the\-loop controls, including approval gates, fallback paths, and escalation mechanisms. * **Platform Integration** \- Leverage the Agentic AI Foundations team's platform covering agent runtime, orchestration, memory, tool registry, guardrails, and observability. Provide feedback that shapes platform priorities. * **Innovation \& Standards** \- Leverage LLMs, multi\-agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms to create differentiated internal solutions that can't be bought off the shelf. Stay ahead of emerging AI technologies and regulatory frameworks to ensure Socure leads the industry in secure, compliant, and intelligent internal systems. * **Technical Patterns** \- Discover reusable agent design patterns while building real workflows and contribute them back to the Agentic AI Foundations paved paths so the work compounds across Socure. * **Operational Excellence** \- Leverage the evaluation harness and tracing substrate provided by Agentic AI Foundations for continuous performance assessment, failure\-mode analysis, and optimization of speed and accuracy of specific agentic solutions. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Required** ------------ * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems or LLM\-powered applications in production. * Deep hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and at least one agentic framework (e.g. LangGraph, CrewAI or AutoGen). * Strong Python skills and experience building production\-grade backend services, APIs, and data pipelines. * Proven ability to operate in ambiguity: you've walked into an undefined problem space, figured out what to build, built it, and measured the results. * Experience shipping AI/automation solutions that directly impacted business operations. * Strong systems thinking: you design for reliability, observability, and maintainability from day one, not as an afterthought. * Ability to collaborate directly with non\-technical business stakeholders to understand their actual workflows and translate those into technical solutions. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience with multi\-agent systems, workflow orchestration, or complex tool\-use patterns in production. * Familiarity with evaluation frameworks (e.g., LangSmith, Weights \& Biases, Arize, or custom eval pipelines) for AI systems (agent reliability, accuracy benchmarking, failure\-mode analysis). * Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, or memory/grounding systems. * Experience with real\-time or streaming AI systems. * Familiarity with AI safety and security practices, including prompt injection prevention, hallucinations mitigation and data protection/privacy. * Background in a regulated industry (fintech, healthcare, government) where compliance and security review processes are standard. * Experience with agent skill abstraction and structured tool integration via MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling or similar protocols. * Experience with AWS\-hosted LLM infrastructure (Bedrock, AgentCore/Strands, Lambda, SageMaker) or equivalent cloud ML services. *Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.* **Follow Us!** YouTube \| LinkedIn \| X (Twitter) \| Facebook Compensation Range: $220K \- $290K

If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. **Job Overview** ---------------- We are looking for a **Software Engineer – Backend Platforms and Agentic \& ML Systems** to help build the backend, artificial intelligence, and machine\-learning foundations that power Socure’s agentic investigation systems. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants to work across backend services, distributed systems, AI agents, retrieval, machine\-learning models, and production infrastructure. You will design, implement, test, and operate software that supports agent orchestration, asynchronous workflows, knowledge retrieval, model integration, evaluation, and reliable production operation. You will contribute to systems supporting multi\-step investigations across use cases such as watchlist review, sanctions and PEP matching, adverse\-media analysis, fraud\-ring correlation, case management, and other risk and compliance workflows. A key part of the role is helping agents work with accurate, relevant, and timely domain knowledge. You will build capabilities that dynamically provide contextual information to agents, combine structured and unstructured data, support knowledge\-graph and retrieval workflows, and preserve evidence and provenance for downstream decisions. You will work with experienced engineers, machine\-learning practitioners, product partners, and investigation experts to turn complex problems into dependable software. The role is calibrated for an engineer who can own well\-scoped features and components, learn quickly, contribute to design discussions, and grow toward broader technical ownership. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, implement, test, and operate backend services that support agent orchestration, task execution, state management, model integrations, and investigation workflows. * Build synchronous and asynchronous workflows for agent tasks, including queues, retries, resumability, cancellation, idempotency, scheduling, and failure recovery. * Contribute to agent frameworks and developer harnesses that support tool calling, structured outputs, reusable skills, actor\-based workflows, human review, and policy\-controlled execution. * Implement services that dynamically inject relevant knowledge into agent workflows based on investigation type, entity context, workflow state, customer policy, prior findings, and current task requirements. * Build domain\-grounding capabilities that help agents distinguish authoritative facts, customer\-defined policies, derived signals, hypotheses, and unverified observations. * Develop knowledge\-ingestion and enrichment pipelines that normalize, classify, chunk, index, version, and refresh structured and unstructured data. * Implement retrieval workflows using combinations of semantic search, lexical search, metadata filtering, hybrid retrieval, reranking, entity\-aware retrieval, and temporal filtering. * Contribute to knowledge\-graph systems that represent entities, relationships, events, evidence, provenance, and risk signals. * Support graph traversal, multi\-hop retrieval, graph\-enhanced context assembly, and integration between graph, vector, search, document, and API\-based data sources. * Implement context\-selection logic that balances relevance, freshness, source authority, latency, tenant permissions, and model context limits. * Add safeguards against stale, contradictory, duplicated, irrelevant, poisoned, or unauthorized information entering agent contexts. * Build state and memory capabilities for agents, including short\-term task state, investigation history, entity context, retrieval state, and provenance. * Integrate agents with internal APIs, identity and risk data sources, case\-management systems, watchlist systems, model endpoints, webhooks, and event streams. * Develop secure connector and tool\-execution patterns, including authentication, authorization, credential management, tenant isolation, audit logging, and sandboxed execution where appropriate. * Integrate machine\-learning models used for classification, ranking, extraction, entity resolution, summarization, and other investigation\-related capabilities. * Partner with machine\-learning and data\-science teammates on feature definitions, training data preparation, labeling strategies, dataset quality, model interfa f context assembly and prompt\-context construction, including relevance, freshness, source authority, permissions, context size, latency, and deduplication. * Working knowledge of machine\-learning concepts, including supervised learning, classification, ranking, embeddings, feature engineering, model evaluation, data quality, and model drift. * Experience supporting machine\-learning workflows such as dataset preparation, labeling, training, fine\-tuning, experiment tracking, model evaluation, versioning, deployment, or monitoring. * Experience evaluating AI or machine\-learning systems using offline datasets, regression tests, production monitoring, task\-level metrics, or qualitative review. * Experience optimizing AI or ML systems for latency, throughput, cost, and quality through caching, batching, parallelism, retrieval optimization, context reduction, model selection, or inference configuration. * Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized environments, preferably AWS and Kubernetes. * Experience with several of the following: relational databases, queues or event streams, object storage, caching systems, search platforms, vector databases, graph databases, and observability platforms. * Understanding of service authentication, authorization, secrets management, tenant isolation, data protection, and privacy\-sensitive system design. * Ability to write maintainable, well\-tested code and troubleshoot issues using logs, metrics, traces, debuggers, and other engineering tools. * Ability to break down technical problems, estimate work, identify dependencies, raise risks, and deliver features with appropriate guidance. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and an ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, data science, and operations partners. * Startup DNA required: you thrive in fast\-moving, high\-ambiguity environments and take ownership like a founder, not an employee. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building AI or machine\-learning systems for fraud, identity, financial crime, compliance, trust and safety, investigations, or other regulated domains. * Experience with agent frameworks, model gateways, evaluation and tracing platforms, GraphRAG, enterprise search, MCP\-style connectors, or custom orchestration systems. * Experience with AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS, vLLM, GPU\-backed inference, or comparable technologies. * Experience deploying fine\-tuned or domain\-specific models alongside larger managed models. * Experience with workflow engines, durable execution, distributed task processing, or long\-running job orchestration. * Experience with graph databases or graph\-processing technologies such as Neo4j, Neptune, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or comparable systems. * Experience building data\-enrichment pipelines, entity\-resolution systems, semantic search, knowledge platforms, or retrieval\-augmented applications. * Experience with model monitoring, feature and data drift detection, experiment tracking, model governance, or responsible AI practices. * Experience improving agent and model behavior using traces, evaluation results, investigator feedback, retrieval diagnostics, and production failures. * Experience working with fraud, identity, risk, compliance, or other high\-consequence data. * Contributions to reusable libraries, technical documentation, testing frameworks, architecture patterns, or engineering practices. *Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.* **Follow Us!** YouTube \| LinkedIn \| X (Twitter) \| Facebook Compensation Range: $230K \- $270K

jobs.description: At SolarWinds, we're a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Global Markets
jobs.description: ### **About Staffbase** We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first **AI\-native Employee Experience Platform**. Our **industry\-leading and award\-winning agentic AI communications channels** \- intranet, employee app and email solutions \- create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees. Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550\+ employees supports 1,500\+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience. We are proud to be a **Unicorn** company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we're shaping the future of workplace communication. This is a hands\-on technical role within Staffbase Build, responsible for turning specific enterprise customer needs into reliable, scalable extensions of the Staffbase platform, using its extensibility capabilities (widgets, plugins, integrations, and other platform objects). The role owns assigned customer solutions end\-to\-end, defining the use case with stakeholders, building and testing across the stack, deploying it, and validating it with users. The aim is to drive adoption and stickiness of the platform, not to create one\-off, standalone customer solutions. The role acts as a bridge, helping customers do what they and the platform can't do alone yet, and feeds what's learned back into shared standards and the product roadmap. This is a hybrid role. Core in\-office days in our Minneapolis office are Tuesdays\-Thursdays, and it is expected that folks will be in the office a minimum of 2 day per week during core days. The role reports into the regional Build Leader. **What you'll be doing** **Solution Delivery** * Owning the technical design, implementation, testing, and release of assigned custom solutions end\-to\-end * Building across the stack (customer\-facing UI, backend services, and integrations with Staffbase and third\-party APIs) **Customer \& Stakeholder Collaboration** * Partnering with customers, consultants and internal teams, e.g. Sales, to define and detail use cases before development. Supporting pre\-sales in a technical advisory capacity, primarily during requirements discovery: join customer and Sales conversations to clarify needs, assess technical feasibility, and help scope custom solutions * Validating shipped solutions with users and gathering feedback afterward * Supporting customers in building basic solutions themselves using Staffbase\-provided platform tools where appropriate, rather than defaulting to a fully bespoke build **Platform\-First Engineering** * Keeping up to date with new and evolving platform capabilities (new extensibility primitives, APIs, and platform objects) so solutions are built using the latest native capabilities rather than defaulting to more bespoke patterns * Applying the company's architectural, security, and compliance standards so solutions remain supportable **Pattern Capture \& Product Feedback** * Identifying reusable patterns and components arising from customer engagements; documenting and contributing them to a shared Build asset catalogue * Surfacing recurring, validated customer needs for consideration in the product roadmap **Craft \& Team Contribution** * Maintaining a strong quality bar (testing, code reviews, healthy CI/CD practices). * Participating in the Build on\-call rotation to support shipped customer solutions, in line with the applicable regional on\-call policy. * Helping bring structure and engineering standards to the team, and mentor less experienced engineers **What you need to be successful** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, building and running production systems * Customer\-facing technical experience (forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, consulting) * Strong React, TypeScript/JavaScript and experience in either Go, Java, Kotlin or Node.js on the backend * Deep experience designing and integrating REST APIs and third\-party systems, as well as testing, assessing and integrating APIs of third\-party systems * Ability to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical audiences * Experience mentoring or guiding less\-experienced developers, and a knack for bringing structure to how a team works * Comfort working directly with stakeholders — you can translate business needs into technical solutions and validate them afterwards * A strong focus on quality, clean code, testing, and continuous learning * A self\-starter who works well both independently and as part of a team * You understand and appreciate diversity and inclusivity in the workplace **What you'll get** * *Competitive Compensation \-* we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit\-based Long Term Incentive Plan) * *Flexibility \-* we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of $1608 * *Recharge* \- with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August * *Support \-* we're offering a 401(k) plan with company match and health plans, including dental \& vision as well as competitive Paid Parental Leave to support new parents * *Volunteer Day \-* you'll get one day off per year for supporting a social project In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles that will be performed in Minnesota. Actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Staffbase's total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $130,000 \- $175,000 base salary per year. Other rewards may include commissions and program\-specific awards. In addition, Staffbase provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, equity, paid parental leave, an employee growth budget, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, wellness days, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

jobs.title: AI QA Automation Engineer, AVP - State Street Investment Management
jobs.description: **Role Summary** ================ We are looking for an AI Quality Engineer to modernize and accelerate software quality engineering through AI\-assisted testing and intelligent automation. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands\-on QA automation experience and demonstrated expertise in Playwright, GitHub Copilot, and Tricentis Tosca, including Tosca AI capabilities. The engineer will use AI\-assisted development and automation techniques to improve test generation, automation development, execution, maintenance, defect analysis, and overall QA productivity. This role will also support the development and adoption of reusable AI\-powered QA agents and automation frameworks across multiple application teams. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering** ------------------------------------ * Use GitHub Copilot to accelerate the development of automated test cases, utilities, test data solutions, API tests, and QA frameworks. * Apply Generative AI to requirements analysis, test scenario identification, test case generation, automation generation, and defect analysis. * Develop reusable prompts, instructions, skills, and engineering patterns that improve the consistency and accuracy of AI\-generated QA assets. * Evaluate AI\-generated tests for accuracy, stability, coverage, maintainability, and security rather than accepting generated output without engineering validation. * Contribute to the development and enhancement of AI QA agents for requirements analysis, test design, automation generation, traceability, and defect triage. **Playwright Automation Engineering** ------------------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using Playwright. Hands\-on Playwright experience is mandatory for this role. * Build and maintain Playwright tests for modern web applications using JavaScript or TypeScript. * Develop reusable fixtures, page objects, utilities, reporting, test data, and environment configuration to support enterprise\-scale automation. * Implement reliable cross\-browser, API, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing with Playwright. * Integrate Playwright automation into GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent CI/CD and Continuous Testing pipelines. * Analyze failed automation and determine whether failures are caused by application defects, test data, environment, or automation issues. **Tricentis Tosca \& Tosca AI** ------------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Tricentis Tosca. * Apply Tosca AI\-assisted capabilities to increase automation productivity and improve test maintenance. * Build reusable Tosca components and automation assets that can be shared across applications. * Support GUI, API, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing. * Integrate Tosca automation into CI/CD and Continuous Testing pipelines. **QA Transformation \& Adoption** --------------------------------- * Partner with application QA and development teams to identify opportunities for AI\-assisted testing and automation. * Help application teams adopt Playwright, GitHub Copilot, Tosca, and AI QA capabilities. * Build reusable examples, templates, prompts, standards, and best practices. * Conduct demonstrations, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and technical enablement for QA engineers. * Measure improvements in automation coverage, development effort, execution time, maintenance effort, and defect detection. **Required Skills and Qualifications** ====================================== * 5\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering or QA Automation. * **Mandatory:** Strong hands\-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated tests and frameworks using Playwright. * Strong JavaScript or TypeScript experience for Playwright automation development. * Strong hands\-on experience with GitHub Copilot. * Strong experience with Tricentis Tosca. * Experience applying Generative AI or large language models (LLMs) to software testing or engineering workflows. * Strong understanding of test automation architecture, functional and regression testing, API testing, UI/web automation, test data management, CI/CD, Continuous Testing, defect analysis, and debugging. * Programming or scripting experience with Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or C\#. * Experience with Git/GitHub and modern development workflows. **Preferred Skills** ==================== * Tosca API and enterprise application automation. * GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. * Jira and Xray. * AI agent development or agentic workflows. * Prompt engineering and reusable AI instruction or skill development. * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and enterprise knowledge\-base integration. * Requirements\-to\-test traceability. * AI\-generated automation validation and governance. * Performance or data testing experience. **Salary Range:** $80,000 \- $140,000 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. *Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long\-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid\-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance\-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.* *For a full overview, visit* *https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home* *.* **About State Street** ====================== Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law. Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers Read our CEO Statement **Job Application Disclosure:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Your experience and judgment will guide architectural decisions and improvements in testing, security, and deployment practices. This position offers the opportunity to stay closely involved in software development while shaping the technical direction of applications with a lasting public service impact. **Please note:** Successful candidates will be required to pass multiple, comprehensive fingerprint\-based background checks specific to the agencies ITS supports. **Example of duties:** * Leads the architecture, quality, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and secure handling of sensitive and personal data * Collaborate closely with Data Governance Managers, Data Stewards, and Data Quality leads to prioritize and S3, SES, SQS, IAM); Azure/GCP equivalent acceptable * Exposure to GenAI/LLM\-powered application development, AI Agents, etc. * Solid understanding of data architecture, REST APIs, and system integration patterns * Experience building internal tools and products (dashboards, portals, workflow applications) for both business and technical stakeholders * Ability to work autonomously across jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Sycamore** ================== Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need. We are a small, engineering\-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders. **The role** ============ You sit with a handful of customers in one industry and own the product loop: learn how the work runs, turn messy asks into clear product, ship working apps yourself, and decide what should become reusable for every customer in that industry. You focus on one of three industries: financial services, telecommunications, or data centers. You map the workflows that matter, build the first version in Sycamore Forge with AI coding tools, put it in front of real users, and iterate until it sticks. When the same pattern shows up across accounts, you productize it for the core. You work with Applied AI engineers, Deployment Strategists, and the account team. Engineers own deep technical delivery. Strategists own the engagement, success criteria, and business outcome. You own customer signal in, shipped product out, and what should live on the platform. **Why this role exists** ======================== Enterprise AI fails when customer feedback stays in notes and never becomes software people use. Someone has to sit close enough to see the real workflow, ship something that works, and decide what is one\-off versus what belongs on the roadmap. That is this role. **What you will do** ==================== * Sit with operators and leaders in your industry (often with a Deployment Strategist). Learn how the work runs and what “good” looks like for the product. * Turn ambiguous requests into clear product: who it is for, what first version to build, and what not to build. * Ship working apps and agents in Sycamore Forge in days, not quarters. Put them in front of real users and iterate weekly or faster. * Connect apps to the systems customers already trust, within their permissions. * Iterate with users until the workflow sticks. Deployment Strategists own go\-live dates, resourcing, and the commercial engagement. * Separate account\-specific work from reusable industry product, and write that up so Engineering can put it on the platform. * Keep a simple industry product backlog, using accounts as evidence, not as engagements you own. * Demo what you built to customer executives. * Track product usage and whether the workflow changed. Deal success criteria and the business case belong to the Deployment Strategist. **What this role is not** ========================= * Not a Deployment Strategist role. Strategists own the AE engagement, success criteria in the agreement, pilot program management, the account map, and the business outcome. You own the product and what becomes reusable across the industry. * Not owning one account’s expansion list. You use accounts to learn; you own the industry product backlog. * Not a Domain Expert who writes specs for someone else. You build. * Not a roadmap PM who only writes tickets. You ship working software yourself. * Not pre\-sales that stops at the demo. * Not customer success that collects feedback without turning it into product. **What we are looking for** =========================== * 5\+ years in product management, or equivalent as a founder, early employee, solutions engineer, or forward deployed engineer who moved into product. * Industry experience in financial services, telecommunications, or data centers (see tracks below). * Evidence you have shipped working software yourself: links, repos, demos, or tools people used. * Strong discovery habits. You talk to customers constantly and turn what you hear into product priorities. * AI\-native. You use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar daily, and can go from a customer call to a working prototype in a day or two. * Technical enough to ship in Sycamore Forge yourself and to spot where agents break: bad permissions, weak integrations, or outputs you would not trust in production. * Product judgment. You choose a useful first version and hold scope when a request would break the outcome. * Comfortable with enterprise customers: discovery, pushback, and briefing operators and executives. * Clear writing. You turn a messy conversation into a crisp problem and a first version worth building. * Comfort with startup ambiguity, broad ownership, and regular customer travel. **Nice to have** ================ * LLM apps in production: prompts, tool use, MCP, evaluations. * Experience building for regulated or security\-conscious enterprises. **Industry tracks** =================== **Financial services.** Banks, capital markets, lenders, and fintechs. You might build for onboarding and review, alert triage, credit memos, or operations exception queues, plus governance workflows a firm can explain to a regulator. Helpful: time in or building for financial services; controls, audit, and model risk. **Telecommunications and communications.** Carriers, cloud communications, network and service assurance, and media. You might build for order\-to\-activation, network incident and ticket triage, customer care and billing disputes, or partner operations. Helpful: OSS/BSS, network ops, or telecom CX. **Data centers.** Owners, developers, and operators building capacity with small central teams and many partners. You might build for site readiness (land, power, permits, interconnection), procurement and long\-lead equipment, construction milestones, and commitments to boards, lenders, and partners. Focus is the business of the data center company, not building control systems. Helpful: data center development, construction, energy, infrastructure investing, or GPU cloud ops. **Interview process** ===================== * A 30\-minute introductory conversation. * A 30\-minute culture fit interview. * A take\-home app building assignment with a 30\-minute presentation. * A 30\-minute systems design interview. **Why join** ============ * Build product directly from Fortune 500 customer feedback, not from someone else’s backlog. * Ship on Forge with Applied AI engineers and see your work in production in weeks. * Shape the platform through patterns you find in the field. * Join early enough to define how Product works at Sycamore. * Competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity.

jobs.title: Systems Test Engineer BBD
jobs.description: Position Title: Senior Test Engineer Location: Carrollton Facility Reports To: Operations Engineering Manager Travel: Less than 10%, primarily supporting contract manufacturers, production activities, and engineering projects Employment Type: Full\-Time Overview Tellabs delivers technology that transforms the way the world communicates. As a leader in the Passive Optical LAN marketplace and a trusted provider of broadband access solutions, Tellabs is defining the future of networking across enterprise, government, and telecom sectors. The Senior Test Engineer provides cross\-functional technical leadership and hands\-on engineering support across the full product lifecycle for Tellabs products. This role applies expertise in hardware, software, automated test systems, product design, manufacturing, failure analysis, repair operations, and sustaining engineering to ensure products are effectively developed, validated, manufactured, tested, repaired, and delivered to customers. The Senior Test Engineer works closely with Product Design Engineering, Operations Engineering, Quality, Repair Operations, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to develop and maintain test solutions, resolve complex technical issues, support new product introduction and product changes, improve manufacturability and testability, and sustain both current and legacy product platforms. The position operates with a high degree of independence under the general direction of the Operations Engineering Manager and is expected to communicate technical findings, priorities, risks, and recommendations across functional teams. As a key member of a lean engineering organization, the Senior Test Engineer owns a broad range of manufacturing test responsibilities and partners with Product Design Engineering on manufacturing engineering support, particularly new product introduction, manufacturing readiness, product transitions, and contract manufacturer support. Key Responsibilities Manufacturing Test Engineering * Develop, implement, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair manual and automated test systems used to manufacture, validate, and repair Tellabs products, including hardware, software, optical, and related test platforms. * Design, modify, validate, and document manufacturing test software, fixtures, procedures, and equipment required to support new products, redesigned hardware, repair operations, and contract manufacturer production. * Partner with Product Design Engineering to provide technical support to contract manufacturers during new product introduction, production, troubleshooting, manufacturing process improvements, and ongoing sustaining activities. * Maintain test equipment repair\-parts inventory and initiate procurement requests as needed to support operational readiness. * Maintain and support legacy manufacturing test platforms, including obsolete PC\-based systems and limited\-spare equipment, while participating in modernization and replacement planning. * Lead technical problem\-solving efforts involving manufacturing test systems, production test processes, and test equipment by coordinating cross\-functional investigations, evaluating technical alternatives, and implementing effective engineering solutions. New Product Introduction (NPI) \& Manufacturing Engineering Support * Partner with Product Design Engineering to provide manufacturing engineering support throughout the product lifecycle, including new product introduction (NPI), manufacturing readiness, first article inspection support, production release activities, engineering changes, and ongoing sustaining activities. * Support the debug, validation, and manufacturing release of redesigned printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs), including hardware troubleshooting, test coverage validation, fixture verification, and production readiness. * Collaborate with Product Design Engineering to improve product manufacturability, design\-for\-test (DFT), and manufacturing test coverage throughout the product lifecycle. * Assist engineering teams with product enhancements, engineering investigations, research and development activities, and sustaining engineering projects as required. Product Support \& Failure Analysis * Support failure analysis activities by performing technical investigations, hardware and test\-system troubleshooting, data collection, and documentation of findings to assist in determining root causes and developing corrective actions. * Investigate and resolve manufacturing, supplier, repair, and test issues identified during NPI, PCB redesign implementation, product transitions, and ongoing production support. * Provide technical assistance and engineering support to Repair Operations as required. Documentation, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement * Create, maintain, and control documentation related to manufacturing test equipment, software, fixtures, procedures, engineering investigations, and failure analysis activities. * Maintain complete and ac  digital multimeters, signal generators, signal or spectrum analyzers, optical test equipment, and related electronic diagnostic instrumentation. * Ability to read, interpret, and develop engineering documentation, including schematics, wiring diagrams, block diagrams, flowcharts, technical procedures, and test documentation. * Experience developing, modifying, troubleshooting, and maintaining automated manufacturing test software using C, C\+\+, C\#, NI TestStand, LabWindows/CVI, or comparable test automation environments. * Ability to work with legacy programming languages and existing manufacturing test software to troubleshoot, modify, and maintain production test systems. * Experience supporting digital, analog, optical, telephony, RF, or mixed\-signal electronic systems. * Working knowledge of broadband telecommunications products and technologies, with experience in several of the following areas: GPON, XGS\-PON, FTTx, Ethernet networking, broadband access systems, traditional loop carrier systems, and copper\- or fiber\-based access technologies such as Tip/Ring and T1/DS1 interfaces. * Proficient through\-hole and surface\-mount soldering skills. Professional Skills * Demonstrated ability to investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement practical engineering solutions within a cross\-functional manufacturing environment. * Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to clearly present technical and non\-technical information to engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, contract manufacturers, management, and small groups. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical priorities while working independently and collaboratively within a lean engineering organization. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to quickly learn and effectively use new engineering, technical, and business software tools. * Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast\-paced engineering environment. Physical Requirements * Ability to stand for extended periods and safely lift up to 50 pounds. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting NPI, manufacturing readiness, first article inspection, production release, and product transitions. * Experience supporting domestic or international contract manufacturing operations. * Experience with Design for Test (DFT) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles. * Experience maintaining or modernizing legacy manufacturing test platforms. * Experience with automated production test systems using GPIB (IEEE\-488\), PXI, USB, Ethernet, or similar instrumentation interfaces. * Experience working with fiber\-optic communications products and optical test equipment. * Experience supporting broadband access or telecommunications products throughout the product lifecycle. * Experience working within ISO 9001, TL 9000, or a similar quality management system. Application Information Only fully complete submissions will be reviewed for consideration. No relocation assistance is provided. No employment sponsorship is provided. Tellabs participates in E\-Verify and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Tellabs encourages qualified minorities, women, individuals with disabilities, veterans, and other legally protected individuals to apply. The company complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations throughout the hiring process. Tellabs offers a collaborative engineering environment where individuals have the opportunity to work across multiple disciplines and directly influence the successful development, manufacture, and support of carrier\-grade telecommunications products. Candidates who enjoy solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of manufacturing test solutions throughout the product lifecycle are encouraged to apply. Qualified candidates should apply at: https://www.tellabs.com/careers/

jobs.title: Principal Product Engineer, Clinical Data Analytics
jobs.description: The Principal Product Manager, Clinical Data Analytics, will play a pivotal role in shaping Tendo’s data\-driven solutions by translating clinical and financial\-focused activities into actionable insights that support patients, providers, and health systems. This individual will help define product strategy and functional requirements for analytics offerings, leveraging deep expertise with healthcare coding systems (ICD\-10, DRG, CPT) and payer/provider data workflows. Specifically, this role will help define data requirements and business logic to: * Measure provider\-level clinical quality from claims data. * Analyze the relationship between quality, price, and market share for health procedures. * Identify missing comorbidities from EHR patient records. This role requires a strong balance of technical acumen, healthcare domain knowledge, and product management experience. This person will work closely with engineering, clinical informatics, and customer\-facing teams to deliver data solutions that improve decision\-making, enhance operational efficiency, and support Tendo’s marketplace growth. Under Tendo’s AI\-First R\&D model, this role operates as a Product Engineer with domain strength, owning features end\-to\-end from discovery through release, with AI as the first author at every stage. **About Tendo** Make an impact—join our team! We’re a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company building a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive. **Our team\-driven culture and rapid growth have earned us recognition as one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers for 2024, 2025, and 2026\.** Led by an experienced and proven team, we live by our values and are always on the hunt for motivated people with diverse experiences and backgrounds to help us improve the care journey for patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user\-friendly experiences. If you like working with innovative technologies and want to be part of a growing team that will help transform the healthcare experience, we encourage you to apply today! **Job Location** San Francisco Bay Area, CA Tendo has hubs in San Francisco, CA; Salt Lake City, UT; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and Philadelphia, PA. Candidates may be located in any one of our hub locations. ### **Responsibilities** * **Product Strategy \& Roadmap:** Help define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for clinical data analytics, aligning with company priorities, customer needs, and market opportunities. * **Healthcare Data Expertise:** Serve as a subject matter expert on EHR, claims, pricing, payment, and healthcare coding data to ensure accurate, compliant, and valuable use of clinical and financial information in products. * **Quality Measurement \& Methodology:** Define and maintain the business logic, measurement specifications, risk adjustment methodologies, scoring algorithms, and forecasting models that power Tendo’s quality analytics products, ensuring alignment with evolving CMS, commercial payer, and industry quality programs. * **Clinical Analytics Leadership:** Partner with quality measurement experts, clinical informatics, data science, and engineering teams to design methodologies that accurately measure provider performance, identify opportunities for quality improvement, and produce transparent and explainable analytics. * **Customer Engagement:** Collaborate with health systems, employers, payers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate use cases, and ensure products deliver measurable value. * **Execution \& Delivery:** Own assigned features end\-to\-end, from opportunity statement through specification, design input, build, documentation, and release, advancing work through the four PLA gate reviews with no handoffs between stages. * **Analytics \& Insights:** Partner with data science and engineering to build tools that surface actionable insights for users, ensuring outputs are accurate, meaningful, accessible, and aligned with defined methodologies. * **Market \& Internal Collaboration:** Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, and regulatory developments to inform product direction, and work closely with Sales, Customer Engagement, and Operations to support go\-to\-market, adoption, and customer satisfaction. * **AI\-Directed Delivery \& Knowledge Sharing:** Use AI as the first author for specifications, acceptance criteria, documentation, and analysis; critically evaluate and refine AI\-generated output, and contribute prompt patterns, quality examples, and design and decision standards to the shared team library. ### **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of product management experience in healthcare technology, healthcare analytics, data products, or a related field. * Deep expertise in U.S. healthcare quality measurement an ty measurement methodologies into scalable product requirements, analytics, AI\-driven insights, and decision\-support capabilities for healthcare organizations. * Strong working knowledge of healthcare coding systems, including ICD\-10, DRG, and CPT, as well as claims, payment, and payer/provider data workflows. * Experience working with healthcare data standards and interoperability technologies, including HL7, FHIR, EHR data models, provider directories, and clinical terminology standards such as LOINC, SNOMED CT, and RxNorm, strongly preferred. * Experience working with large, complex healthcare datasets and translating data into meaningful products, insights, or analytics. * Working familiarity with SQL, Python, relational data concepts, or similar technical tools and concepts. * Demonstrated ability to define product strategy, requirements, business logic, and roadmaps for complex data\-driven products. * Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, clinical, and business teams. * Demonstrated ability to own product initiatives from discovery through delivery and post\-release learning. * Demonstrated fluency with AI tools as a first author, with the ability to direct, evaluate, and refine AI\-generated product specifications, documentation, and analysis using strong independent judgment. ### **Nice to Have** * Advanced degree (MBA, MPH, MS in Health Informatics, MS in Data Science, or related field). * Experience with SaaS platforms, digital health solutions, or healthcare marketplaces. * Experience developing products that support provider quality reporting, value\-based care, population health, care management, or healthcare transparency initiatives. * Experience with CMS quality programs, HRRP, HCC, Leapfrog, U.S. News, commercial quality scorecards, or other healthcare performance measurement frameworks. * Experience applying predictive analytics or machine learning to healthcare quality measurement, risk prediction, or forecasting. * Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial claims data structures and reimbursement methodologies. * Familiarity with payer, provider, and employer data integration and reporting needs. * Understanding of value\-based care, reimbursement models, and healthcare economics. * Experience working with EHR systems and clinical informatics teams in a product capacity. **Base Salary Range** $157,250 \- $212,750 This salary range is offered with the understanding jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Tennessee Oncology, one of the nation’s largest, community\-based cancer care specialists, is home to one of the leading clinical trial networks in the country. Established 1976 in Nashville, Tennessee Oncology’s mission remains unchanged: To provide access to high\-quality cancer care and the expertise of clinical research for all patients, at convenient locations within their community and close to their home. Our growing network of physicians and locations is based on this mission. Tennessee Oncology is committed to advancing both the science of detection and targeted treatments, and to making these advances available to every patient. We believe caring for cancer patients is a privilege. Why Join Us? We are looking for talented and highly\-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to support the meaningful work of community oncologists and the patients we serve. **Job Description:** The Data Engineer is a hands\-on technical professional responsible for building, integrating, cleaning, and maintaining reliable data solutions that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence operations. This position develops and supports data pipelines and data models in Databricks, works with SQL\-based data sources and Parquet/Delta Lake storage, and delivers well\-governed datasets for Power BI Report Server. The Data Engineer works closely with business stakeholders, analysts, application teams, and technology partners to translate data needs into practical, supportable solutions while maintaining strong standards for data quality, security, documentation and performance. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: * Designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports data ingestion and transformation pipelines in Databricks using SQL, Python, PySpark, notebooks, workflows, and related platform capabilities * Connects to and integrates data from relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, vendor systems, and other enterprise data sources * Profiles, cleans, standardizes, enriches, and validates data so that downstream reporting and analytical datasets are accurate, consistent, and usable * Develops and maintains scalable lakehouse data structures using Parquet and Delta Lake, including appropriate partitioning, schema management, table design, and file optimization * Creates and maintains SQL queries, views, stored procedures, functions, and data models used for transformation, reconciliation, reporting, and analysis * Builds curated datasets, semantic models, reports, dashboards, and visualizations for Power BI Report Server, working with report developers and business users to ensure accurate presentation, consistent metric definitions, reliable refreshes, and effective performance * Implements data quality controls, reconciliation checks, exception handling, logging, and alerting throughout data pipelines * Investigates pipeline failures, unexpected results, refresh problems, and source\-system changes and coordinates corrective action through completion * Monitors scheduled jobs, data freshness, storage utilization, and query performance and improves operational reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency * Applies established data architecture, naming, metadata, lineage, retention, access, privacy, and lifecycle standards across data solutions * Protects sensitive and regulated information by applying least\-privilege access, secure data handling, appropriate masking, and organizational security and compliance requirements * Works with business users and technical teams to define source behavior, business rules, reporting needs, and acceptance criteria * Documents source\-to\-target mappings, business rules, transformations, dependencies, data models, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guidance * Uses version control, code review, testing, deployment, and change\-management practices to move data solutions safely between environments * Identifies opportunities to standardize, automate, and simplify recurring data work and helps reduce manual data preparation and reporting processes * Supports production data operations and participates in after\-hours troubleshooting or scheduled implementation activities when needed KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES: * Strong working knowledge of Databricks lakehouse concepts, notebooks, clusters or serverless compute, jobs/workflows, SQL Warehouses, and Delta Lake * Strong SQL development skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, query optimization, data reconciliation, and relational data modeling * Experience using Python and/or PySpark for data ingestion, transformation, validation, and automation * Knowledge of Parquet file structure and behavior, including columnar storage, compression, schema evolution, partitioning, and small\-file performance considerations * Understanding of dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and semantic model design * Working knowledge of Power BI Report Server, Power BI Desktop, Power Query, DAX, dataset refresh, gateways or connectivity, security, and report performance * Understanding of ETL and ELT patterns, batch processing, incremental loading, change data capture, orchestration, dependency management, and restartable pipeline design * Knowledge of data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, master/reference data, retention, privacy, and role\-based access principles * Ability to trace data from source through transformation to final report and explain discrepancies in clear, practical terms * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, organization, and time\-management skills * Ability to manage competing priorities, communicate risks or blockers, and drive assigned work through completion * Ability to explain technical data concepts and findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences * Self\-motivated and directed, with the judgment to ask questions, validate assumptions, and escalate concerns when necessary **EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE:** * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Engineering, Analytics, or a related field, or at least 4 years of equivalent experience in lieu of degree requirement. * At least 3 years of experience in data engineering, business intelligence, data integration, database development, or a comparable role * Demonstrated hands\-on experience developing SQL\-based data solutions and supporting production data pipelines * Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Parquet, Python/PySpark, and Power BI strongly preferred * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and Power BI Report Server strongly preferred * Experience working with healthcare data, regulated information, or complex clinical and operational source systems preferred * Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Engineer, or Power BI certification is a plus **OOCUPATIONAL RISK CATEGORY:** **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Work is primarily performed in an office or remote\-office environment and requires extended use of a computer * Must be willing and able to travel to clinic or business locations when necessary

jobs.title: Senior Software Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: »* **Date:** Nov 13, 2026 **Location:** North Reading, MA, US **Company:** Teradyne **Our Purpose** Join Teradyne, a global leader in automated test equipment (ATE) and industrial automation. Our technologies power the most advanced semiconductor and electronics testing in the world, enabling manufacturers to bring products to market faster and with greater confidence. As we deepen our AI capabilities, we are looking for exceptional engineers who combine rigorous technical foundations with the drive to take ideas all the way to production. **Opportunity Overview** As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you are Teradyne's highest individual contributor technical authority in ML. You own the end\-to\-end technical excellence of Teradyne's machine learning systems: from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing model performance. You will define modeling standards, set the engineering bar for the entire ML team, and take personal ownership of the most complex and highest\-impact ML problems. Your work will span time\-series analysis of semiconductor parametric test data, computer vision for defect detection, adaptive test optimization, and applied LLM systems. You will be the go\-to technical voice when the team faces hard problems and the mentor of junior engineers around you. * Own the technical direction and quality of all ML model development across Teradyne's AI initiatives, setting and enforcing engineering standards across the team. * Lead end\-to\-end development of production ML systems: data ingestion and feature engineering, model architecture design, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and deployment. * Design and implement novel ML approaches tailored to Teradyne's unique data domain including time\-series parametric test data (STDF/TEMS), wafer map analysis, etc. * Drive applied research and model innovation, explore and evaluate new architectures, algorithms, and training methodologies, and translate promising approaches into production systems. * Develop and maintain rigorous model evaluation frameworks, including validation methodologies, risk quantification, and production monitoring strategies. * Lead technical design reviews; serve as final arbiter of ML architecture and modeling decisions for the team. * Build and maintain production ML systems with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and performance in Teradyne's ATE and manufacturing environments. * Partner directly with customers and application engineers to understand real\-world debug workflows and translate them into ML solutions. * Mentor and develop junior ML engineers; cultivate a culture of technical rigor and continuous learning. **All About You** We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position. * 5\+ years of experience in machine learning, applied AI, or related fields. * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning large language models. * Experience with reinforcement learning (e.g., policy gradients, PPO, actor\-critic methods). * Experience designing reward models or evaluation systems. * Strong software engineering skills (Python, distributed systems familiarity). * Experience building production ML systems (MLOps, monitoring, deployment). * Ability to work cross\-functionally with product, software, and hardware teams. * Strong communication skills; comfortable engaging directly with customers \& stakeholders. * Computer vision skills in manufacturing inspection: defect detection, etc. * ML model deployment on edge devices is preferred, including quantization, ONNX, etc. * Open\-source ML project contributions, publications, or technical patents is preferred. * Knowledge of AI agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen) or reasoning\-driven workflow design (Chain\-of\-Thought, Chain\-of\-Action) is preferred. **Compensation:** The base salary range for this role is $141,300\-$242,000\. This range is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with experience and skill set. This range can also fluctuate depending on demand and location. **Incentive Plan:** This job is eligible for discretionary bonus(es) based on financial performance. **Benefits:** Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well\-being benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, and more. **Job Segment:** Test Engineer, Testing, Open Source, Electronics Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Engineering, Technology »

jobs.title: Data Forward Deployed Engineer – Applied Data & ML Engineering
jobs.description: **About Tessera Labs** ---------------------- Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera combines the reliability of an integrator with the speed of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** ---------------- We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for our Applied Data \& ML capability. You will work directly with enterprise clients to turn fragmented, multi\-system enterprise data into trusted data products and production ML models. You will collaborate closely with client teams, SMEs and Tessera product engineers to translate complex business logic into data pipelines, canonical data models and applied ML solutions, and you will feed proven patterns back into the Tessera platform. The role requires strong experience in SQL, Python, data modeling and applied machine learning, combined with the judgment to own ambiguous client problems end to end. This is a mid\- to senior\-level role. This role owns delivery quality on your engagements: validation, reconciliation to source and stakeholder sign\-off. **Why Join Tessera** -------------------- * Build at the frontier of applied AI. Work on a multi\-agent AI platform that automates complex business workflows across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, MuleSoft and more, and help bring real AI automation to the enterprise. * Shape the platform, not just the project. The pipelines, canonical models, mapping rules and ML components you build become reusable parts of the Tessera platform, and your field input goes straight to our product and R\&D teams. * Work on real enterprise data. Harmonize master and transactional data across ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems, and take ML models from feature engineering to production. * See more in a year than most see in five. You will work across several enterprise customers and landscapes, alongside senior functional architects, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI engineers. * Own real outcomes. You will work in a software platform company where engineers are trusted with decisions, and where the measure of success is what customers adopt and keep using. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Deploy with Clients** * Embed with client teams to scope data and ML problems, map source systems and deliver working outcomes in weeks. * Own delivery quality, including validation, reconciliation to source and stakeholder sign\-off. * Turn repeated client patterns into reusable components for the Tessera platform. ### **2\. Build and Harmonize Enterprise Data** * Design and develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and dbt to ingest and transform data from enterprise platforms, including ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems. * Design canonical enterprise data models and cross\-system mapping rules that standardize master and transactional data. * Implement validation, reconciliation and monitoring to resolve duplicate, inconsistent and legacy data. ### **3\. Apply Machine Learning** * Engineer features and build models on enterprise data for use cases such as forecasting and anomaly detection. * Deploy models to production and monitor them. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, ML Engineering or Applied Data Science. * Enterprise data harmonization, migration or analytics experience across ERP, CRM or finance systems. * Experience in client\-facing, consulting or forward\-deployed roles. * Advanced SQL, and strong Python for data pipelines and ML workflows. * Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and processing large\-scale enterprise datasets. * Relational and dimensional data modeling. * dbt for transformation, testing and documentation. * Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP or Azure). * At least one ML model built, deployed and monitored in production on business data. * Feature engineering from structured and time\-series enterprise data, and model evaluation and monitoring. * Working knowledge of core enterprise data domains and business processes, such as finance, supply chain and master data. * **Systems thinking:** the ability to understand complex enterprise systems and business processes, and to turn business rules into data and ML solutions that work across platforms. * **Client ownership:** comfortable working directly with client engineers, functional consultants and business stakeholders, scoping ambiguity, and pushing back with evidence. * **Data problem solving:** strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve enterprise data and model performance challenges. * **Ownership and execution:** the ability to take ownership of complex problems and deliver production\-grade solutions that scale across enterprise environments. **Who This Role Is Not For** ---------------------------- If you prefer to work on clean, well\-documented datasets inside a single platform team, this is not the role: the data here is fragmented, duplicated and spread across ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems. If you would rather hand a pipeline or model over than own it through validation, reconciliation to source and client sign\-off, the same applies. And if you are not comfortable working directly with client stakeholders, scoping ambiguity and pushing back with evidence, you will not enjoy this role. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Hands\-on experience with a cloud data platform such as Snowflake or Databricks. * Distributed processing (Spark / PySpark, DuckDB or similar). **First\-Year Measures of Success** ----------------------------------- * **Month 1:** Up to speed on the Tessera platform and delivering on at least one client engagement. Trusted by the client’s data and business stakeholders and by the Tessera team on that engagement. * **Month 2:** Your first data product in production, validated and reconciled to source, with stakeholder sign\-off. Repeated client patterns captured as reusable components for the Tessera platform. * **Month 3:** At least one ML model, for example for forecasting or anomaly detection, deployed and monitored in production on client data. Your reusable components in use on other engagements. If you want to turn fragmented enterprise data into trusted data products and production ML models, and to build it with us, we would like to hear from you. *Tessera Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.* *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs' name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $180K \- $233K
