jobs.title: Lead Data and Governance Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** Lead Data Governance Specialist The Disney Decision Science and Integration (DDSI) team leverages advanced technologies, data analytics, and scientific approaches such as optimization and statistical modeling to build innovative tools that shape business decisions across The Walt Disney Company. We support Disney Entertainment (ABC, The Walt Disney Studios, Disney\+, Hulu), ESPN, Disney Experiences (Theme Parks, Cruise Line, Consumer Products, DVC), and Corporate Finance with strategic applications that enable data\-driven decision\-making. This team works in office. What You Will Do As the Lead Data Governance Specialist, you will own the data governance craft for our team: the operating model, policies, standards, and stewardship practices that make Disney's data trusted, well described, properly protected, and genuinely easy to use. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Architecture, the Ontology/Semantic Librarian, Security, Privacy, and Legal to see them applied. Your time will be split roughly evenly across two mandates: Project Initiatives Projects that focus on unifying data and accelerating access to it across The Walt Disney Company. You will own the governance workstream that makes unified data safe to share and reuse at pace. Lead the development, adoption, and enforcement of the data governance policies, standards, and best practices that span the Data Unification Accelerators program, including the operating model and decision rights that let data be shared and reused safely at speed. Design governance guardrails that accelerate delivery rather than gate it: documented data ownership, pre\-agreed classification and data sharing rules, reusable approval paths, and templates that delivery teams can self\-serve. Define the metadata, glossary, lineage, and cataloging standards that make unified data discoverable and explainable — business definitions, critical data elements, ownership attributes, and provenance — partnering with the Ontology/Semantic Librarian so that business meaning, ownership, and governance attributes stay aligned with the semantic layer. Set and operate data quality standards for unified data assets: quality dimensions, measurable rules for critical data elements, profiling and scorecards, issue triage, and clear remediation ownership. Shape the governance of the internal Data Marketplace by defining what a data product must satisfy before it is offered to the enterprise — publishing and documentation standards, certification criteria, access and entitlement models, and usage terms. Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, and the Data Engineering teams to translate privacy, residency, and regulatory obligations into practical, implementable requirements — data classification and sensitivity tiering, role\- and attribute\-based access, masking, and retention — and assure that those requirements are met. Establish the governance that allows analytics and AI to consume unified data responsibly: approved use, data provenance and attribution, human accountability, and the controls that underpin responsible AI. Define and report the program's governance metrics, maturity measures, risks, and compliance posture to program leadership and enterprise governance forums. Divisional Data Governance Design, Advisory, and Delivery The data governance voice for our division, covering both the design of the capability and the hands\-on delivery of it. Act as the division's trusted data governance advisor — the person teams come to for a clear answer on data ownership, classification, sharing, quality, retention, and acceptable use. Design and stand up the divisional governance operating model: data owners and stewards, governance forums and councils, charters, decision rights, RACI, and escalation paths that fit how our teams genuinely work. Author, socialize, and maintain divisional data policies, standards, and procedures, together with the exception and waiver process that sits behind them, keeping all of it aligned to enterprise and corporate policy and current as data protection and AI regulation evolves. Run governance\-by\-design reviews of new solutions, data products, and third\-party or vendor data arrangements, giving teams practical requirements early rather than audit findings late. Deliver governance outcomes hands\-on for priority data domains: populate the catalog and business glossary, assign and confirm ownership, stand up quality monitoring, and close the gaps you find. Own the divisional data issue and risk register end to end — intake, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and tracking to closure — and support internal audit, external audit, and regulatory requests. Run access governance for divisional data, including entitlement design, request and approval workflow, periodic access reviews, and least\-privilege recertification. Build data literacy and governance capability through training, onboarding material, office hours, and a steward lls, with a track record of bringing business, engineering, legal, and privacy stakeholders to a shared decision, and the ability to write clearly for both executive and practitioner audiences. Sufficient technical fluency to engage credibly with data engineering, architecture, and semantic modeling teams on data models, access controls, and platform capabilities, without owning the build. Proven ability to run two mandates in parallel — a large cross\-company program and a divisional advisory and delivery portfolio — and to prioritize independently in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment. Desired Qualifications Experience leading data governance in large, complex enterprises, preferably in media, entertainment, or hospitality. Governance experience in a federated or multi\-domain operating model, such as data mesh or domain\-oriented ownership, where authority is shared rather than centralized. Familiarity with industry governance frameworks and standards (DAMA\-DMBOK, DCAM, EDM Council, ISO/IEC 38505, NIST Privacy Framework) and experience running a maturity assessment against one of them. Professional certification such as CDMP (DAMA), DCAM, CIPP/E or CIPM (IAPP), CISA, or CISM. Experience governing data products and internal data marketplaces, including data contracts, certification, and usage terms. Experience of master data and reference data management governance. Experience with records management and retention schedules, and with privacy operations such as data subject access requests, consent, and data minimization. Awareness of semantic technologies — ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers — and of how governance metadata, ownership, and quality rules attach to them. Experience of responsible AI or AI governance programs, including model and use\-case inventories and review processes under emerging AI regulation. Working SQL skills, or the ability to read a data model and profile data, sufficient to validate quality findings and ask sharper questions of engineering teams. engineering teams through aggressive hardware development and factory ramp\-up milestones. * Strong technical foundation in complex electro\-mechanical hardware assembly, especially in continuous web jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (R&D)
jobs.description: Join the team that's shaping the future of autonomous robotics and material handling. As an R\&D Software Engineer at Toyota Automated Logistics, you'll develop the brains behind intelligent robotic systems, from low\-level hardware control to high\-level autonomy and perception. You'll work on real robots. You'll ship real code. You'll help launch entirely new automation products into warehouses and factories across the world. We don't just build software; we build the future of logistics. **About Us** Toyota Automated Logistics R\&D is the **New Product Development (NPD)** division of the company. Our mission is to develop original products that expand Toyota Automated Logistics' automation capabilities — enabling our commissioning and systems teams to deliver integrated solutions that give our customers a competitive edge. Our \~70\-person team is distributed between our **Boise, Dallas, and Indianapolis** offices, and includes experts in mechanical, electrical, software, and AI disciplines, all with a strong foundation in robotics technology. Beyond our Toyota Automated Logistics offices, we collaborate heavily with our other Toyota partners to innovate and share our technology globally. Software engineers on our team are true full\-stack robotics developers, with opportunities to work across the entire software stack — from high\-level autonomy, AI, and perception to low\-level motor control, hardware interfaces, and everything in\-between. We take products from concept to production\-ready designs, and we execute our software on real robot hardware in live customer environments. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer

We are looking for a deep technical practitioner who leads through expertise, influence, and good engineering practice, with room to grow into a more senior technical or people\-leadership role over time. **Key Responsibilities:** Be the hands\-on technical authority for the Smart Mobility Platform and its expansion into a multi\-modal mobility ecosystem. Requires deep expertise in cloud\-native architecture, microservices, payment systems, and modern engineering practice. * **Platform Subject Matter Expertise:** Serve as the platform SME for Smart Mobility engineering leadership. Treat infrastructure as a first\-class deliverable: Terraform\-based client provisioning and environments, alongside CDK for the services you inherit. * **Legacy Systems \& Migration**: Operate and improve the established integration services that serve our largest clients, including a Kubernetes\-based file\-processing platform and dedicated client APIs. jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer \- Data Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning** **About the role and team** How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace. MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires dependable data, scalable model training and simulation, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans. The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers and scientists to turn complex data and modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong infrastructure background and a focus on data\-intensive systems. You’ll build and evolve feature stores, distributed data pipelines, and self\-service tooling that support forecasting, simulation, optimization, and financial measurement. Your work will help teams move from new data and modeling ideas to dependable production workflows. The challenges go beyond moving data from one place to another. How do we keep model inputs fresh and consistent as upstream sources evolve? How do we efficiently rebuild historical features for simulation and backtesting? How do we make complex data operations safe and self\-service? You’ll solve these problems through hands\-on engineering, cross\-team collaboration, and end\-to\-end ownership of production systems. **What you’ll do** * **Build scalable data infrastructure:** Design and evolve shared feature stores and distributed processing pipelines that support model training, inference, backtesting, simulation, and planning. * **Make data trustworthy:** Develop automated validation, monitoring, and alerting to detect freshness, completeness, and correctness issues before they affect downstream consumers. * **Improve data lifecycle operations:** Build efficient capabilities for incremental processing, historical backfills, schema evolution, data versioning, and recovery from failed or incorrect writes. * **Enable self\-service:** Create reusable frameworks, APIs, and developer tooling that help engineers and scientists onboard features, investigate issues, and operate workflows with less manual support. * **Optimize performance and cost:** Identify bottlenecks in data processing, storage, and orchestration, and improve throughput, resource efficiency, and reliability. * **Drive technical projects end to end:** Translate ambiguous requirements into designs, lead implementation and rollout, and own production health through on\-call, incident response, and long\-term improvements. * **Collaborate and mentor:** Partner with modeling, financial\-data, and shared\-platform teams to establish consistent data foundations; jobs.title: Senior Machine learning engineer, AI Authoring
jobs.description: **The opportunity** ------------------- Unity is building next\-generation intelligence systems for gaming: systems that help AI\-native teams understand the market and get the most out of the frontier models. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead this effort. You will own the end\-to\-end architecture, build pipelines, systems, and models, and scale a cross\-disciplinary team of engine developers, game developers, and machine learning engineers. The work spans market forecasting, outcome prediction, multimodal content understanding, evaluation, and agentic systems. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ ### **Technical Excellence** * Work on our Game Intelligence ML platform, from data ingestion, semantic layer and feature stores through model registry, evaluation and serving. * Make the calls that keep every model output reproducible and auditable: versioned data snapshots, model and prompt versions, and cost tracked per decision. * Define, lead, and spearhead engineering practices for the agentic era, including agentic development workflows and evaluation methodologies. * Partner with different functional teams and disciplines to translate expert human judgment into training signals. Shape the roadmap with the product team. ### **Modeling** * Build predictors of commercial outcomes for games such as user acquisition cost, lifetime value and return on ad spend from large, noisy, multi\-source signals. * Build forecasting models over market signals that detect emerging demand and estimate when a window opens, peaks and closes. * Deliver every prediction as a calibrated range with stated confidence, and own the ranking and portfolio logic that turns predictions into recommendations within a budget. ### **Experimentation and agentic systems** * Design online experimentation with guardrails, safe exploration and clear human decision points. * Build evaluation harnesses for LLM\-based agents, including automated playtesting and multimodal assessment of generated content. * Orchestrate frontier\-model agents in production with strict data boundaries and cost control. ### **Calibration and measurement** * Own the feedback loop that scores predictions against realized outcomes and corrects bias, coverage and signal weighting over time. * Make the system report its own error in plain language so that creators and internal stakeholders can trust it. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Passion for game industry * Deep experience in Game, Game Engine development or Game publishing. * Experience in machine learning with a track record of owning production ML systems or Agentic systems end to end, from data to serving to measured business outcome. * Deep experience in performance marketing or ad\-tech modeling: predicting acquisition cost, lifetime value, return on ad spend, retention or comparable outcomes. * Strong grounding in probabilistic prediction and calibration: quantile or interval prediction, coverage, bias correction and backtesting of forecasts. * Experience building LLM\-based agent systems in production: orchestration, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model versioning, and cost control. * Comfort building in a zero\-to\-one environment. **You might also have** ----------------------- * Experience in mobile game user acquisition, LiveOps or monetization, on the studio or publisher side. * Experience with Unity game engine, or with automated and bot\-driven playtesting. * Time\-series and demand forecasting experience over noisy, multi\-source market signals. * Experience with the Claude Agent SDK, Codex or similar frameworks for multi\-agent software production. * Hands\-on experience with BigQuery, ClickHouse, Kafka, Postgres, pgvector or their equivalents. * Publications or open\-source contributions in forecasting, causal inference, calibration or agentic systems. *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. jobs.title: Databricks Architect (hybrid) - Dallas, TX
jobs.description: **About V4C.ai** ---------------- V4C is a pure\-play Databricks partner, and in under two years we have earned 850\+ Databricks certifications across 325\+ customers and been named Databricks' 2026 Partner of the Year (C\&SI Emerging). As a Data Architect, you’ll own the target\-state architecture for enterprise Lakehouse platforms across industries, working directly with customers and often Databricks' own field teams. Every technical hire here gets a certification roadmap built for them and taught in\-house by Databricks\-approved trainers, plus a dedicated Employee Success Manager whose only responsibility is your experience at V4C **The Role** ------------ The **Data Architect** is the most senior technical voice on an engagement. You own the target\-state architecture — how data moves, where it lands, how it’s governed, what it costs to run — and defend those decisions to customer architects and executives. Most of your work starts where a legacy estate is the constraint: Teradata, Informatica, Hadoop, or cloud sprawl nobody wants to own. You design the path to a Databricks Lakehouse, then stay close enough to the build that the design survives it. **Responsibilities** * Own the target\-state Lakehouse architecture on enterprise engagements, including ingestion, storage, transformation, serving, and governance layers * Lead architecture assessments of legacy estates and produce migration paths with sequencing, risk, and effort * Define data modeling standards and Medallion layer conventions, and hold engineering teams to them across concurrent workstreams * Set the Unity Catalog governance model: catalogs, schemas, access patterns, lineage, and audit posture * Make and document platform trade\-offs (compute sizing, storage format, streaming versus batch, build versus buy) with cost and performance reasoning a customer can take to their CFO * Provide technical input into scoping and effort estimation on new engagements, including pre\-sales discovery and proof\-of\-concept design * Mentor senior engineers, review designs, and raise the architectural bar across the practice * Produce reference architectures, diagrams, and internal accelerators that make the next engagement faster **Requirements** * 8\+ years in data engineering/architecture or analytics platform development * Demonstrated ownership of end\-to\-end architecture for at least two enterprise\-scale data platforms, from design through production * Deep experience migrating legacy data warehouses or ETL estates to a modern cloud platform (Teradata, Informatica, Hadoop, Netezza, or equivalent) * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of Apache Spark and distributed processing fundamentals * Experience with data modeling across dimensional, normalized, and Lakehouse patterns, and the judgment to know when each applies * Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices for data platform deployment **Preferences** * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or a Platform Architect credentials are a plus * Hands\-on Databricks experience at scale: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Lakeflow, Asset Bundles * Experience with MLOps or productionizing machine learning workloads * Prior professional services, consulting, or customer\-facing architecture background * Experience contributing to pre\-sales scoping or technical proposals **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Training \& Development * Work from Home 3 days per week

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper\-targeted segmentation, AI\-powered recommendations, real\-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million\+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first\-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real\-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. **This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance\-driven future for the channel. **Your team** ------------- You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about. Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real\-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses. Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access. The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly. **Your mission** ---------------- As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale. **What you will do** -------------------- **Publisher integrations** * Build and improve publisher integrations end\-to\-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers. * Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory. * Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend. **Deals \& catalog** * Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API. * Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale\-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe. * Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it. **Supply tooling \& publisher platform** * Build real\-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend. * Build publisher\-facing features: reporting, insights, and self\-serve catalog tools. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production. * Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design. * Hands\-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day\-to\-day engineering workflow. * Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break. * Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy. * Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables. * Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts. * Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST. * Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels). * Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar). * Experience building partner\-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting. **Our Values** -------------- At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high\-performance environment with high\-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. **What We Offer** The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000\. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000\. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up: * Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. * Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! * Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. * Meal vouchers — Via Swile. * Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. * Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. **Our Interview Process** We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. * Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for. * Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role. * Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role. * Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions. * Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit. **Equal Opportunity** Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. **Referral Instructions** Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Summary** Supports deployment of the Quality strategy through direct execution of project Quality activities at supplier, integrator, test, and customer\-site locations. Develops and implements Project Quality Plans; performs structural, mechanical, electrical, and documentation inspections; coordinates FAT and IFAT activities; identifies nonconformances; and drives corrective\-action and punch\-list closure. Maintains complete project Quality records and provides objective evidence supporting shipment readiness and customer requirements. Core Responsibilities Develop and execute Project Quality Plans, inspection plans, hold points, and witness\-point activities for assigned projects. Perform supplier, integrator, in\-process, pre\-IFAT, IFAT, pre\-shipment, and site inspections as assigned. Review current drawings, specifications, ITPs, travelers, material records, calibration records, and applicable supplier Quality documentation. Verify structural and mechanical conformity, including dimensions, leveling, squareness, equipment installation, welding records, coating records, and traceability documentation. Verify electrical integration against approved drawings and requirements, including grounding and bonding, conductor identification, terminations, clearances, cable routing, equipment labeling, and documented test results. Coordinate NCR, SCAR, punch\-list, containment, corrective\-action, and closure\-evidence activities. Confirm required checklists, signatures, test records, redlines, and shipment\-readiness documentation are complete. Provide clear Quality reporting to PMO, Engineering, suppliers, customers, and Quality leadership. Comply with applicable HSE controls, electrical safe\-work requirements, PPE, LOTO, testing boundaries, and client procedures. Capture lessons learned and support prevention of recurring project and supplier issues. Qualifications / Requirements Bachelor degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent technical education and relevant experience. 3\-5 years, Relevant experience with low\- and medium\-voltage electrical distribution equipment, eHouses/PDCs, industrial fabrication, integration, manufacturing Quality, or field Quality. Ability to read and interpret single\-line diagrams, general arrangements, schematics, wiring diagrams, equipment drawings, weld documentation, and inspection/test records. Working knowledge of structured problem solving, NCR/SCAR processes, corrective action, and objective evidence. Effective written and verbal communication with suppliers, customers, Engineering, PMO, and field teams. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with FAT/IFAT execution, electrical distribution equipment, supplier Quality, or integrated eHouse/PDC projects. Knowledge of NEC, OSHA electrical safety expectations, AWS structural welding documentation, coating inspection, and calibration control. ASQ CQE, supplier Quality, welding inspection, coating inspection, or electrical testing credentials appropriate to assigned scope. Certifications and Role Readiness Required at hire or within the role\-readiness period established with HR and Quality leadership**:** The client electrical safety qualification appropriate to assigned responsibilities, including ECAP Level 3 and PICW when the employee is expected to perform or control applicable electrical work. OSHA 30 or equivalent construction/industrial safety training for regular supplier and field activity. Current CPR/AED/First Aid where required by site or HSE expectations. For structural/welding inspection scope**:** AWS CWI is preferred for personnel independently accepting weld quality; otherwise the QE verifies supplier CWI, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, weld maps, and NDE records and escalates acceptance questions to qualified personnel. For electrical testing scope**:** manufacturer or employer\-authorized training for Megger, ductor/contact resistance, and dielectric/hipot test witnessing; NICET Electrical Power Testing may be considered as a preferred external credential where the assigned scope warrants it. For coating scope**:** AMPP coating inspector training or equivalent may be preferred when independent coating acceptance is a material part of the role. Travel and Work Environment Requires travel to suppliers, integrators, factories, IFAT locations, and customer sites, including short\-notice travel based on project schedules. Work may occur around active fabrication, testing, energized\-equipment controls, construction, and shipping activities. HR Leveling Notes Level based on independence, technical breadth, equipment complexity, decision authority, and ability to lead inspections without direct supervision. Higher\-level placement should reflect demonstrated MV/eHouse integration capability, IFAT leadership, customer\-facing responsibility, and ownership of complex NCR/SCAR closure. Do not use certification count alone to determine level; evaluate applied scope, authority, complexity, and business impact. Internal Alignment Note This draft is designed for Workday and HR review. Final job profile, grade, compensation range, required credentials, and timing for completion remain subject to HR, Legal, HSE, and functional approval. VIVA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants have an equal opportunity for placement, and all employees have an equal opportunity to develop on the job. This means that VIVA will not discriminate against any employee or qualified applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - AI/ML Engineering
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** You will lead the technical vision, architectural design, and execution of cutting\-edge agentic AI/ML solutions within the Verizon Consumer Group (VCG) AI team. By shaping the future of customer experience, you will build intelligent, autonomous agents that power our digital channels, sales, and customer success ecosystems. Partnering with cross\-functional leadership, you will translate long\-term strategy into robust, scalable, and secure production systems. Responsibilities include: * Driving the technical strategy, research, and application of advanced agentic AI, large language models (LLMs), and cognitive frameworks to solve complex consumer challenges. * Designing and implementing production\-grade, highly scalable AI/ML pipelines and agent architectures that integrate seamlessly with digital and customer success platforms. * Collaborating with GTS Architecture, Security, and Legal teams to ensure all agentic systems conform to the highest standards of data privacy, compliance, and engineering rigor. * Partnering with Customer Service Operations and VCG Strategy teams to identify high\-impact business applications and translate them into robust technical designs. * Developing and maintaining a three\-to\-five\-year technical roadmap for agentic systems across VCG, outlining the future state of the technology stack. * Mentoring engineers, establishing engineering best practices, and introducing red\-teaming methodologies to stress\-test system capabilities and safety boundaries. * Translating complex technical concepts, system architectures, and AI breakthroughs into clear and compelling narratives for executive presentations. ### **What we’re looking for…** **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. * Three or more years of experience designing, building, and deploying production AI/ML systems at scale. * Experience with software development methodologies (e.g., Agile). **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field. * Hands\-on experience building production conversational AI with Python, Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, or comparable frameworks, including multi\-agent orchestration, stateful workflows, and enterprise tool integration. * Experience designing and developing asynchronous APIs and services using FastAPI and Pydantic, integrating enterprise REST, GraphQL, or SOAP services, and implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent\-to\-agent communication. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, Elasticsearch/vector search, and semantic routing, along with model gateways such as LiteLLM. * Experience deploying and operating cloud\-native AI applications on GCP, including Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery, using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. * Knowledge of PostgreSQL and Redis for conversational state, persistence, and caching, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance. * Experience developing automated AI evaluations and regression tests, including pytest, tool\-call and conversation\-trajectory validation, and LLM\-as\-judge evaluations. * Experience with AI observability and production troubleshooting using OpenTelemetry, New Relic, Arize Phoenix, Galileo, or comparable tools, including monitoring quality, latency, and cost. * Familiarity with enterprise customer\-service platforms such as Pega, and Digital Hub, and experience integrating AI into retail, IVR, or anything similar billing, ordering, or retention workflows with appropriate authorization and transaction safeguards. * Proven ability to lead technical architecture, planning, and prioritization; collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams; and deliver multiple large\-scale initiatives in a dynamic, Agile environment. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $120,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\.

jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Operating with end\-to\-end technical ownership, you will architect, build, and deploy production\-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full\-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations. In this role, you’ll embed with Network Capital Strategy (NCS) to lead the shift to agent\-first capital modeling. You’ll apply AI, statistical, and advanced analytics methods to complex questions about where, when, and how to invest in the Verizon network, across a portfolio of models spanning demand forecasting, solution prioritization, and total cost of ownership. The goal is to size and prioritize multi\-billion\-dollar network investments so each capital dollar goes where it delivers the most value for our customers, with results the planning, engineering, and finance teams who fund and build the network can trust and trace. You are a technical anchor: You pair deep systems craftsmanship and modeling rigor with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company\-wide. Key Responsibilities include: * **Applied Modeling \& Research:** Research and apply advances in statistics, machine learning, and AI to capital planning problems such as demand forecasting, solution prioritization, optimization, and impact measurement, and build the results into production models. * **End\-to\-End Architectural Blueprinting:** Define the full\-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi\-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back\-end integrations. * **Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance:** Architect stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event\-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic. * **Context \& Retrieval Systems:** Design production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re\-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture. Apply these systems to extract signal from unstructured engineering and project documents. * **Runtime \& Cloud Deployment:** Deploy production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure). * **Evaluation Harness Design:** Architect offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM\-as\-a\-judge, synthetic test generation, backtesting against actuals, human\-in\-the\-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics, so AI\-assisted capital recommendations stay explainable and traceable. * **Platform Codification \& IP Creation:** Generalize custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, modular UI components, and standardized modeling procedures; mentor engineers across the organization and lead invention disclosures and patent filings. * **Strategic Discovery \& Scoping:** Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest\-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift. * **Executive Translation:** Serve as the technical authority in the room with BU Vice Presidents and Managing Directors, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade\-offs. **What we’re looking for...** You’ll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Six signing offline and online evaluation harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (e.g., latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, tracing). * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js for API integration and backend orchestration. * Proven experience designing APIs and deploying containerized services (Docker) and data workflows on platforms such as Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and Domino Data Lab, across AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous initiatives, translate business requirements into technical architectures, lead delivery end\-to\-end, and present designs to senior executives. Even better if you have: * Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field. * Experience building and scaling centralized context platforms or enterprise search engines similar to Verizon’s internal enterprise context layer platforms. * Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense \+ sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management. * Deep experience in time series forecasting, mathematical optimization, or causal inference. * Experience with model risk management, explainability, or validation of models used in high\-stakes decisions. * Prior forward\-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top\-tier technology firms or hyperscalers. * A track record of turning one\-off operational builds into enterprise\-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents. * Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large\-scale customer care operations. jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. Code, GitHub Copilot, etc.) or building similar systems • Experience applying AI to solve engineering challenges or customer\-facing product features • Understanding of commercial payments, money movement, B2B payables, or payment processing • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern architectures • Knowledge of API design, microservices, and distributed systems • jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **GENERAL SERVICE** **JOB ANNOUNCEMENT** IT Application Development Senior/Specialist $99,300 \- $133,608 annually **Closes November 29,2026** The Washington State Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction (OSPI) seeks to fill an IT Application Development Senior/Specialist. This full\-time permanent position is based in Olympia, Washington. This position may be eligible for partial to near full\-time telework. Telework is a combination of in\-building and off\-site days. **During your training period you will be required to be in the office 2 days per week. After you’ve completed your initial training, you may have the option to work from home on a flexible telework schedule. While we’re happy to offer this balance of in\-office connections and telework flexibility, this isn’t a fully remote position.** We encourage interested candidates to visit the OSPI website to gain insight into our agency. **About OSPI and our initiatives** OSPI is the primary agency charged with overseeing public K–12 education in Washington state. Working with the state's 295 public school districts and 7 state\-tribal education compact schools, OSPI allocates funding and provides tools, resources, and technical assistance so every student in Washington is provided a high\-quality public education. At OSPI, we recognize that our employees are the key to the success of the agency. We are committed to our work but value the balance with our personal lives. We demonstrate our commitment to employees by providing an environment that stimulates professional growth and values them for their expertise. OSPI is a great place to work and has several initiatives to help create a great working environment, including: * We support a healthy work/life balance by offering flexible/alternative work schedules and mobile and telework options. (Depending on job duties and work location.) * We have an Infant at Work Program that is based on long\-term values of newborns and infant\-parent bonding. Eligible employees who are new parents or legal guardians can bring their infant (six weeks to six months) when returning to work. (Depending on job duties and work location.) * We value and are actively involved in promoting diversity, equity and inclusion within OSPI by way of cross\-divisional, collaborative committee. The focus of the committee includes employee engagement and education; reinforcing OSPI values; and maximizing the value of diversity and identifying strategies for inclusion. **Vision, Mission, and Values** Vision: All students prepared for post\-secondary pathways, careers, and civic engagement. Mission: Transform K\-12 education to a system that is centered on closing opportunity gaps and is characterized by high expectations for all students and educators. We achieve this by developing equity\-based policies and supports that empower educators, families, and communities. Values: Ensuring Equity, Collaboration and Service, Achieving Excellence through Continuous Improvement, Focus on the Whole Child **Equity** Each student, family, and community possesses strengths and cultural knowledge that benefits their peers, educators, and schools. Ensuring educational equity: * Goes beyond equality; it requires education leaders to examine the ways current policies and practices result in disparate outcomes for our students of color, students living in poverty, students receiving special education and English Learner services, students who identify as LGBTQ\+, and highly mobile student populations. * Requires education leaders to develop an understanding of historical contexts; engage students, families, and community representatives as partners in decision\-making; and actively dismantle systemic barriers, replacing them with policies and practices that ensure all students have access to the instruction and support they need to succeed in our schools. **Position Overview** The objective of this senior\-level position is to independently design, develop, maintain, sustain and modernize the Child Nutrition Services application suite and related data transfer systems. The position applies advanced application development, architecture, data integration, security, and troubleshooting expertise to support accurate and timely service delivery and financial support for Child Nutrition Services applications. The systems enable Child Nutrition Services to: * Administer 9 U.S. Department of Agriculture Child Nutrition Programs * Collect and approve a program application from program operators * Pay claims for reimbursement for meals served. * Account for state and federal dollars paid to program operators over multiple overlapping state and federal fiscal years. * Collect data for state and federal reporting efforts. * Determine eligibility for local level program participants. * Manage food inventory and food ordering. * Washington Integrated Nutrition System (WINS): an application and claiming system for USDA Child N s the flexibility to choose between multiple investment options. **Social Security** All state employees are covered by the federal Social Security and Medicare systems. The state and the employee pay an equal amount into the system. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** If you are employed by a government or not\-for\-profit organization, and meet the qualifying criteria, you may be eligible to receive student loan forgiveness under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **Holidays** Full\-time and part\-time employees are entitled to paid holidays and one paid personal holiday per calendar year. **Note:** Employees who are members of certain Unions may be entitled to additional personal leave day(s), please refer to position specific Collective Bargaining Agreements for more information*.* Full\-time employees who work full monthly schedules qualify for holiday compensation if they are employed before the holiday and are in pay status for at least 80 nonovertime hours during the month of the holiday; or for the entire work shift preceding the holiday. Part\-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro\-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full\-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave. **Sick Leave** Full\-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave. Sick leave accruals for part\-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. **Vacation (Annual Leave)** Full\-time employees accrue vacation leave at the rates specified in WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Full\-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave. Part\-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. As provided in WAC 357\-58\-175, an employer may authorize a lump\-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357\-31\-165\. **Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave. **Military Leave** Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year. **Bereavement Leave** Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5\) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave. **Additional Leave** Leave Sharing Parental Leave Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Leave Without Pay Please visit the State HR Website for more detailed information regarding benefits. jobs.title: Electrical Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Description: We are seeking an Electrical Controls Engineer to design, program, and support continuous improvement of the control systems on our electron beam equipment. Working closely with our mechanical engineering and manufacturing teams, this role is well suited for an electrical engineer with hands\-on Allen\-Bradley PLC and HMI experience and a solid foundation in industrial electrical systems and machine controls, who can independently manage controls projects while collaborating across teams to develop reliable, standardized, and manufacturable solutions. The successful candidate will develop and maintain PLC and HMI programs, electrical schematics, and controls documentation, and will help standardize the controls architecture for current and future machine offerings. This individual will work directly with manufacturing to support machine wiring, I/O checkout, commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting, as well as develop work instructions and documentation to improve consistency and efficiency. While travel is not expected as part of the role, occasional domestic and international travel to customer sites may be required to support installations, commissioning, troubleshooting, or technical projects. **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities** * Design, program, and implement machine control systems for our electron beam equipment using Allen\-Bradley PLCs and Studio 5000 Logix Designer. * Develop and maintain HMI applications using FactoryTalk View and PanelView Plus, including alarming, diagnostics, and operator interface screens. * Configure and troubleshoot industrial networks and devices, including EtherNet/IP, distributed I/O, variable frequency drives, and motion components. * Establish and maintain controls standards, including PLC program structure, tag naming conventions, reusable code, and program version control. * Develop, maintain, and standardize electrical and control panel schematics and wire run lists using AutoCAD Electrical. * Lead I/O checkout, commissioning, and functional testing of machines, and provide technical support to manufacturing during wiring, assembly, testing, and troubleshooting. * Collaborate with the mechanical engineering team to ensure effective integration of electrical, controls, and mechanical systems, including sensors, actuators, interlocks, and safety circuits. * Apply machine safety and electrical standards in control system and panel design. * Evaluate and recommend PLC hardware, electrical components, and controls solutions for existing and future machine designs, including migration of legacy controls platforms. * Coordinate with third\-party controls consultants, including Opto22 programming resources, to improve machine functionality, controls integration, and diagnostics. * Develop and maintain manufacturing SOPs, work instructions, and controls documentation, and ensure engineering documentation released to manufacturing is complete, accurate, standardized, and up to date. * Support the migration, organization, and maintenance of engineering documentation and PLC/HMI program files within the Autodesk Vault document management system. * Perform electrical testing, troubleshooting, and validation using common test equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and waveform/function generators. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to controls design standards, manufacturing processes, and machine performance. jobs.title: Culinary Operations Specialist
jobs.description: **About Wonder** Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise. Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20\+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine\-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on\-site by our culinary team and served hot. Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale. *Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.* **About the Opportunity** ------------------------- We’re looking for a Culinary Operations Specialist to support the daily operations of our robotic kitchen, A.K.A. Spyce Infinite Kitchen Lab \- Wonder’s kitchen of the future. You’ll work alongside a team, preparing menu items for demos, training sessions and supporting the testing of our robotic kitchen equipment. If you enjoy working with food and are curious about robotic technology, then this is the kitchen for you. This is a hands\-on lab and R\&D environment, so no two days look the same. Your contributions, observations and feedback directly shape how Wonder’s robotic technology and processes will be deployed to IKCs across the Wonder network. **What You'll Do** ------------------ Every day is different. Learn new skills, work alongside engineers and chefs, and make a real impact on enabling Wonder’s mission to make great food accessible to everyone. **Support Daily Kitchen Operations** * Receive, stock and organize ingredients. * Prep recipes to Wonder standards, keeping stations clean and organized throughout the day. * Work the hotline and finishing stations during testing, training and demo sessions. * Follow daily set up and breakdown SOPs, maintaining a clean, safe work environment. * Take daily inventory and support Operations managers with maintaining stock levels. **Test and Refine** * Support testing and trials on prototype robotic equipment, following written procedures. * Log observations, timings, and errors accurately and on time. * Flag issues, anomalies and ideas for improvement to the robotics and culinary teams. * Help trial changes to recipes, workflows and ingredient handling, and share honest feedback. **Food Safety and Sanitation** * Follow all food\-safety guidelines, including temperature and storage compliance. * Clean and sanitize robotic equipment, kitchen equipment, cookware, utensils and work areas throughout the shift. * Manage trash and recycling, and report equipment issues promptly. **Work Safely in a Lab Environment** * Follow safety protocols around automated and moving equipment. * Adapt quickly as procedures, software and equipment change. * Take part in training and help document what you learn. **Be a Key Part of the Team** * Support teammates, jump in where needed, and keep a positive, curious, high\-energy attitude. **What You Bring To The Table** ------------------------------- * Kitchen or food\-handling experience, or strong interest and aptitude to learn. jobs.title: Senior AI Governance Engineer
jobs.description: Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar \- delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy. Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact \- both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best. Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs. **Position Summary** This position designs, builds, and owns the technical capabilities that operationalize enterprise AI governance, spanning AI controls and risk assessments, implementation guidance, and working across Security, Architecture, Privacy, Legal, and Data Science teams. Working independently across multiple data domains, this role translates governance policy and regulatory requirements into enforceable technical controls, establishes the engineering patterns other team members follow, and serves as a technical resource to less experienced colleagues. **Essential Responsibilities** * Data Quality Engineering: Design and implement data quality frameworks, rule sets, and scoring methodologies across multiple data domains, including measurement approaches for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, validity, consistency, and uniqueness. Define the remediation workflow and escalation model. * Metadata and Catalog Engineering: Design and implement metadata and lineage capture automation spanning source systems, transformation layers, and consumption assets. Define harvesting strategy, integration approach, and the binding model between business glossary and physical assets. * Data Classification and Protection Engineering: Develop classification and access control patterns, including attribute\-based access control policies, tagging automation, and dynamic masking within the enterprise data platform. Partner with cyber security on control design and evidence. * Solution Design and Technical Standards: Develop reusable governance components, libraries, and APIs, and establish the engineering patterns applied by other members of the team. Solve complex data management problems where existing approaches are insufficient, taking a new perspective on established solutions. Evaluate tooling and recommend platform capability, configuration, and integration approaches. * Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Act as a technical resource and mentor to less experienced engineers. Review work products and provide guidance on standards, design, and troubleshooting. Lead technical workstreams within governance programs, including effort scoping, delivery sequencing, and progress reporting. * Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with data owners, data stewards, platform engineering, enterprise architecture, and cyber security to translate governance policy into enforceable technical controls. Communicate technical design and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders. **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Five or more years of experience in data management, data engineering, or data governance engineering. * Advanced SQL proficiency and demonstrated proficiency in Python. * Demonstrated experience implementing at least one enterprise data management capability end to end, such as data quality, metadata and catalog, master data, or data access control. * Demonstrated ability to design technical solutions independently and defend design decisions to technical and business stakeholders, including experience working across multiple data domains or business functions. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience implementing controls in a SOX, NERC CIP, or privacy\-regulated environment. Gas and/or Electric Utility Industry experience preferred. * Certifications such as IAPP AIGP (AI Governance Professional), CIPP/CIPM, CDMP (data management), or CISA/CRISC. * 5–7 years or more in data governance, AI/ML risk, model risk management, IT compliance or audit. * At least 2 years working directly with AI/ML or generative AI systems, such as model reviews, use\-case intake or risk assessments. * Experience in a regulated industry like utilities, energy. Familiarity with NERC CIP, FERC or state public utility commission oversight is especially valuable. * Hands\-on use of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO/IEC 42001 and 23894, and model risk guidance such as SR 11\-7\. * Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, U.S. state AI laws (for example, Colorado), and privacy rules like CCPA and GDPR. * Understanding of responsible AI principles: fairness, transparency, explainability, accountability, privacy and safety. Our culture is grounded in shared values and employee commitments that guide how we work, support one another, and grow together. **Our Values** Connected, Committed, Trustworthy, Safe **Our Employee Commitments** * Work that makes a difference * A team you can count of * Opportunities to grow * Rewards that help you thrive Xcel Energy provides job applicants reasonable accommodations for disabilities throughout the application process. In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information including but not limited to dates of school attendance and graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, Data
jobs.description: ### **About Zipline** Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real\-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. **About You and The Role** -------------------------- The P2 Analytics Platform team's mission is to supercharge every function at Zipline with the data they need to optimize every day. We design and build Zipline's central data platform to provide mission\-critical insights for Zipline's wide variety of business units, from manufacturing and inventory, to flight scheduling and dispatch, to customer delivery, and more. As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, Data, you are the owner of analytics infrastructure and datasets that directly inform operational decisions across the company, ensuring planes launch on time, inventory is accurate, and exception workflows keep customers and regulators satisfied. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, software engineering, and operations: you will ship production\-grade data models and pipelines that must meet strict accuracy, latency, and auditability requirements for live logistics and regulated aviation workflows. Location: Bay Area, CA (on\-site 3\+ days/week) preferred, with occasional travel to hubs and manufacturing sites required (\~10% annually). You will report to the Software Engineering Analytics Lead and be the DRI for at least one cross\-functional analytics product (e.g., delivery performance metrics, factory yield datasets, or safety event lineage). **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own end\-to\-end analytics products: define success metrics, design schemas, implement ETL/ELT pipelines, test for accuracy, and operate datasets in production. Be accountable for data correctness, freshness SLAs, and incident response until resolved. * Deliver the first 6\-month roadmap items as DRI (examples): consolidate multi\-source aircraft availability signals into a single fleet health data set; build governed delivery\-performance metrics with lineage to raw events; automate inventory reconciliation reports used by manufacturing and ops leads daily. * Implement rigorous validation: automated data\-quality checks, anomaly detection, and rollback procedures with measurable alert thresholds and agreed remediation SLAs with ops owners. * Build semantic layers, governed metrics, and documented data contracts consumed by BI and AI tools; enforce backward\-compatibility and versioning so downstream consumers do not break. * Partner closely with the Software, Hardware, Field Ops, and Manufacturing to fix upstream data quality issues at the source; prioritize engineering tradeoffs (cost, latency, reliability) and coordinate ship schedules for schema changes. * Instrument and measure impact: define and report KPIs such as data\-accuracy error rate, pipeline MTTR, consumer adoption, reduction in manual reconciliation time, and operational decisions enabled (e.g., % improvement in on\-time deliveries attributable to analytics changes). * Extend Zipline's internal AI analytics harness: add evaluation tests, ground\-truth datasets, and conservative fallback behaviors to ensure AI answers used in ops are explainable and auditable. * Mentor and elevate the team: set standards for testing, dbt CI/CD, production monitoring, and runbooks; onboard and review work from junior analytics engineers. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 7\+ years of analytics engineering, data engineering, or software engineering experience with ownership of production systems; demonstrated history as a DRI accountable for mission\-critical business outcomes. * Direct experience operating production systems under failure: you have seen systems break, led incident response, and implemented durable fixes and prevention measures. * Deep SQL expertise and production experience with Snowflake and dbt (or equivalent); able to author performant transformations and manage model versioning and deployments. * Production Python experience for EL pipelines, validation, and automation; familiarity with Airflow or equivalent orchestration tools. * Track record building semantic layers/governed metrics consumed by BI and AI systems, and designing data contracts with downstream SLAs. * Experience operating under strict correctness and latency SLAs in logistics, manufacturing, aviation, or other regulated operational environments; familiarity with auditability, lineage, and trace requirements. * Strong experience implementing automated data quality, anomaly detection, and incident response runbooks; able to quantify baseline and improvements (e.g., reduced incidence of errors by X%). * Comfortable making engineering tradeoffs: cost vs. latency vs. reliability, and driving cross\-team decisions with engineers and ops owners. * Location \& logistics: Bay Area\-based and able to work on\-site at least 3 days/week preferred; travel to hubs/factories \~10% annually; flexible for occasional early\-morning or after\-hours incident responses. * Education: bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience. Success in the first 6 months will look like: production delivery of at least one mission\-level dataset with end\-to\-end lineage and data\-quality checks; establishment of SLA targets and monitoring dashboards, and measurable reduction in a manual reconciliation or troubleshooting pain point owned by ops. **What Else You Need To Know** ------------------------------ The starting cash range for this role is $155,000 \- $210,000\. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more. Developers already love Render for how it feels to use; now the brand needs to carry that same clarity and confidence everywhere else: on our site, in our campaigns, on a conference floor, and in every launch we put into the world.
