You'll work closely with senior brand designers and creative leads, with plenty of room to take on bigger projects as you grow. What makes this work hard and interesting: developers are a famously skeptical audience. They can spot marketing gloss from a mile away, and they reward brands that are honest, specific, and a little bit delightful. Great brand work here has to earn attention from people who don't want to be sold to. That takes real craft and a good sense of what engineers find genuine. You'll join a design team that takes its craft seriously, with weekly critiques and deep collaboration with marketing, product, and engineering. You'll thrive here if you love making things, care deeply about the details, and want to grow your craft alongside people who will push you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Create high\-craft graphic design across the brand.** Design key visuals, web and social assets, ads, presentations, print, and merch. Typography, layout, color, and composition are your everyday tools, and you'll bring care to every piece, no matter how small. * **Contribute to concept development.** Join brainstorms and creative explorations with a steady stream of ideas. You'll sketch directions, build out options, and help the team find the concept that best fits the brief, then refine it until it's ready to ship. * **Design and extend campaigns.** Working from a creative platform set with e explorations, and how your thinking moved the work forward. * **Campaign and launch work.** You've designed assets for campaigns or product launches across digital, social, and print, and you know how to keep an idea consistent across many formats. * **Some event or physical design experience.** You've designed for print production, signage, booths, or merch, and you understand what it takes to get files ready for the real world. * **Comfort working within a brand system.** You can work fluently inside an established identity and know when to stretch it thoughtfully. * **Curiosity about developers.** You don't need a technical background, but you're interested in how developers think and what kind of brand they trust. * **Ownership and reliability.** You manage your own projects, hit deadlines, and know when to ask for direction. You take feedback well and use it to make the work better. * **Clear, collaborative communication.** You can present your work, explain your choices, and work smoothly with marketing, product, and engineering partners. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * **Animation and motion design.** You can add motion to brand work, such as animated social posts, logo stings, or simple launch videos. Experience with After Effects, Cavalry, Rive, or Lottie is a plus. * **Interactive design and experiences.** You've designed interactive web moments, microsites, or playful experiments that invite people to engage. * **Comfort near code.** Some familiarity with HTML, CSS, or prototyping tools that help you test interactive ideas. * **Experience at a developer tools or technical company.** * **Illustration or 3D skills** that expand what the brand can do in\-house. * **Curiosity about AI\-assisted design** and how new tools can speed up exploration. * **Side projects** that show your craft and point of view. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. **Benefits** ------------ * 4 weeks of paid vacation. * 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return. * Long\-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans. * 100% employer\-paid medical coverage and 99% employer\-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. * Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. * Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. * Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. * Continuous learning benefits \& related support. *This position is generally not eligible for new visa**sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.* *Render is an equal\-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.* *We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.* *We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!* Render — CCPA Applicant Privacy Notice Render — GDPR Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $158K \- $194K

Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting. **Role Description** ==================== As a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll lead the design, delivery, and ongoing optimization of automation solutions for Tennr’s most complex customers: large\-scale health systems, national provider groups, and enterprise partners. This is a highly technical, strategic, and customer\-facing role that demands deep domain fluency, executive presence, and strong systems thinking. You’ll own enterprise\-scale implementations end\-to\-end: from pre\-sale discovery and business case alignment to go\-live and expansion. You’ll act as both a trusted technical advisor and a project lead, working closely with senior customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams at Tennr to ensure lasting success. This role sits within a high\-performance implementation pod and directly influences Tennr’s go\-to\-market and product strategy. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Lead end\-to\-end enterprise implementations, from discovery to post\-go\-live * Align cross\-functional teams and manage project delivery, risks, and change * Conduct operational audits to identify workflow gaps and automation opportunities * Design scalable, configurable solutions using Tennr’s platform and APIs * Reimagine processes with automation best practices, not just replicate legacy systems * Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Sales to shape solutions and delivery scope * Maintain documentation, enable knowledge transfer, and improve internal delivery tools * Support sales strategy, mentor junior team members, and influence product roadmap **Qualifications** ================== * 4\+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS delivery or solution design * A degree or minor in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is strongly preferred * Strong understanding of APIs, systems integration, and technical architecture * Proven ability to lead complex technical engagements with large enterprise customers * Skilled at communicating technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences * Experience navigating complex org structures and aligning cross\-functional stakeholders * Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on strategic, scalable solutions * Business acumen and domain fluency — ideally in healthcare or similarly complex industries * Comfortable with ambiguity and fast\-paced, unstructured environments * Demonstrated ability to mentor others and contribute to team\-wide best practices * High ownership mindset and urgency — proactive, resourceful, and impact\-driven Nice to Haves * Familiarity with workflow automation, RPA, or enterprise integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Workato) * Background in consulting, solution architecture, or technical customer success * Experience in startup environments or scaling delivery functions **Why Tennr?** ============== * Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact. * Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure * Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high\-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system. * Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like\-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week * Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks. **Benefits** ============ * Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street * Unlimited PTO * 100% paid employee health benefit options * Employer\-funded 401(k) match * Competitive parental leave Compensation Range: $140K \- $160K

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Robot Learning
jobs.description: **About Warp** At Warp Sciences, our mission is to help the world discover new medicines faster—and build the capacity to do it here in America. We bring AI, robotics, and life sciences together in automated labs that design, run, and learn from experiments, with each experiment making the next one better. We’re not developing drugs of our own. We’re building the infrastructure for the people who do. Chemistry requires precise, dexterous manipulation in environments filled with instruments, materials, and consumables designed for human hands. Building autonomous laboratories requires robots that can learn the long tail of tasks scientists perform every day, adapt when conditions change, and operate reliably in the physical world. We’re looking for a Member of Technical Staff, Robot Learning, to build the learning systems that make this possible. You’ll own the loop from expert demonstrations and robot experience through policy training, evaluation, and deployment. You’ll work across robot learning, data, controls, hardware, and chemistry to turn capable models into systems that can perform difficult scientific tasks reliably. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Develop mid\- and post\-training methods for robot policies using real\-world demonstrations, robot experience, and task\-specific data. * Build systems that learn from expert chemists, turning demonstrations of difficult scientific procedures into capabilities robots can reproduce and generalize. * Develop and adapt world models, world\-action models, vision\-language\-action models, and other learned representations for precise, contact\-rich manipulation. * Build the training and evaluation systems needed to ingest, process, curate, and learn from large\-scale multimodal robot datasets. * Deploy policies on real robotic systems and diagnose failures across models, data, perception, controls, hardware, and task design. * Close the loop between data collection, training, evaluation, and deployment. Determine what data or training intervention is needed, measure whether it works, and use each deployment to improve the next iteration. * Partner closely with chemists, hardware engineers, infrastructure engineers, and robot operators to design tasks, collect useful experience, and turn research advances into dependable laboratory capabilities. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- We care much more about what you’ve built than your title or number of years of experience. * Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, and robot learning. * Experience with post\-training, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, behavior cloning, or fine\-tuning learned policies. * Experience training, adapting, and debugging modern deep learning models using frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. * A track record of designing rigorous experiments and producing measurable improvements in model or policy behavior. * Strong intuition for data quality and composition: what experience a model needs, where its current data is insufficient, and how to improve it efficiently. * Experience building data pipelines, training systems, or evaluation infrastructure for multimodal or robotics data. * Experience working with real\-world robotic systems, or a strong track record building learned systems that interact with complex physical environments. * The ability to investigate failures across the complete system rather than treating the model, data, controls, and hardware as separate problems. * High ownership and excitement about problems where neither the requirements nor the right technical approach are obvious yet. **Helpful, but Not Required** ----------------------------- Experience in any of the following is a plus: * World models, world\-action models, or vision\-language\-action models * Post\-training or adapting large pretrained models for robotics * Large\-scale multimodal datasets, dataset curation, and distributed training * Imitation learning, behavior cloning, reinforcement learning, or offline RL * Learning from human demonstrations, teleoperation data, or real\-world robot experience * Diffusion policies, action chunking, or other modern visuomotor policy architectures * Dexterous, precise, or contact\-rich manipulation * Multimodal representations spanning vision, language, actions, sensors, and robot state * Simulation, sim\-to\-real transfer, or synthetic robot data * Real\-world robot evaluation, benchmarking, and failure analysis **Example Problems You Might Work On** -------------------------------------- * How do we take a capable pretrained model and post\-train it to perform a new chemistry task using demonstrations collected from expert chemists? * How do we efficiently ingest, curate, and train on millions of trajectories containing video, actions, robot state, language, and other sensor data? * What data should we collect when a robot can complete 80% of a task but consistently fails during one particular stage? * How do we determine whether a failure came from the policy, the training data, perception, controls, hardware, or the way the task was specified? * How do we adapt policies to precise, contact\-rich tasks involving powders, liquids, vials, caps, pipettes, and scientific instruments designed for human hands? * How do we evaluate whether a policy is genuinely becoming more capable, rather than overfitting to a particular setup, object, or demonstration? **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- You establish a repeatable loop from expert demonstrations and robot experience to training, evaluation, and deployment. Policies become measurably more reliable on real chemistry tasks, and failures lead to clear decisions about what data to collect, what experiments to run, and what parts of the system to improve. Warp’s robots learn new tasks faster, recover from a broader range of failures, and generalize across materials, equipment, and laboratory conditions. Each round of real\-world experience makes the learning system—and the autonomous laboratory built on top of it—more capable. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Warp is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decision\-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. **Reasonable Accommodations** Warp provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact **recruiting@warp.xyz** **Fair Chance Hiring** Warp considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and other applicable laws. **General Notice** This job posting describes the position generally and does not constitute an offer of employment or an employment contract.
